## `packages/zig_runtime/android/tests/background-flow.mjs`

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/android/tests/background-flow.mjs","sha256":"519cfc4db9b316ee45e7b36f09e926fd969df126f5438a82c53e0a347e14de3c","bytes":6936} -->
```javascript
// Real native restart/hydration test; SDK and OS delivery remain fixtures.
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { resolve } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { parseArgs } from 'node:util';
import { BackgroundTasks } from '../src/background.mjs';
import { ExpoEffects } from '../src/effects.mjs';
import { NativeClient } from './native-client.mjs';

const { values } = parseArgs({ options: { library: { type: 'string',
  default: fileURLToPath(new URL('../work/libeyg_android_host.so', import.meta.url)) } } });
const library = resolve(values.library);
const saved = new Map();
const storage = { async getItem(key) { return saved.get(key) ?? null; },
  async setItem(key, value) { saved.set(key, value); }, async removeItem(key) { saved.delete(key); } };
const unwrap = 'let unwrap = match { Ok(value) -> { value } Error(reason) -> { !never(perform Abort(reason)) } }';
const sourceFor = (index, factor) => `${unwrap}
let resource = unwrap(perform Expo({module: "fixture", method: "acquire"}))
let total = unwrap(perform Expo({module: "fixture", method: "sum", args: [input.data.left, input.data.right, input.metadata.offset]}))
{case: ${index}, total: !int_multiply(total, ${factor}), tag: input.metadata.tag}`;

function manager() {
  const callbacks = new Map();
  return { callbacks, defineTask(name, callback) { callbacks.set(name, callback); },
    async isTaskRegisteredAsync() { return false; }, async unregisterTaskAsync() {},
    async getRegisteredTasksAsync() { return []; },
    emit(name, data) { return callbacks.get(name)({ data, error: null, executionInfo: { taskName: name, eventId: 'cold-event' } }); } };
}

function instance(native, persistence = storage) {
  const taskManager = manager();
  const state = { acquired: 0, disposed: 0, waiting: null, hosts: [] };
  const background = new BackgroundTasks({ storage: persistence, taskManager, native,
    nativeOptions: { packages: {} }, directory: '/fixture',
    hostFactory: () => {
      const host = new ExpoEffects({ fixture: {
        acquire() { state.acquired++; return { remove() { state.disposed++; } }; },
        async sum(left, right, offset) { await Promise.resolve(); return left + right + offset; },
        wait() { return new Promise(resolve => { state.waiting = resolve; }); },
      } });
      state.hosts.push(host);
      return host;
    } });
  return { background, taskManager, state };
}

let seed = 0x455947;
const random = n => { seed = (Math.imul(seed, 1664525) + 1013904223) >>> 0; return seed % n; };
const definitions = Array.from({ length: 32 }, (_, index) => ({
  name: 'query', source: sourceFor(index, 1 + random(1000)),
  metadata: { offset: random(20001) - 10000, tag: `program-${index}` },
  result_kind: ['task', 'fetch', 'value'][index % 3],
}));
const clients = [];
const adapters = [];
const open = persistence => {
  const native = new NativeClient(library);
  clients.push(native);
  const result = { ...instance(native, persistence), native };
  adapters.push(result.background);
  return result;
};
try {
  const first = open(storage);
  const task = await first.background.define(definitions[0]);
  assert.deepEqual(await first.native.stats(), { created: 0, destroyed: 0, live: 0 });
  first.background.close();
  await first.native.close();
  clients.splice(clients.indexOf(first.native), 1);

  let hydrate;
  const gate = new Promise(resolve => { hydrate = resolve; });
  const second = open({ ...storage, async getItem(key) { await gate; return storage.getItem(key); } });
  assert.equal(second.taskManager.callbacks.size, 16);
  const cold = second.taskManager.emit(task.task_name, { left: 12, right: 30 });
  assert.deepEqual(await second.native.stats(), { created: 0, destroyed: 0, live: 0 });
  hydrate();
  assert.equal(await cold, 1);
  let completed = 1;
  const factor = Number(definitions[0].source.match(/!int_multiply\(total, (\d+)\)/)[1]);
  assert.deepEqual((await second.background.result('query')).value, {
    case: 0, total: (42 + definitions[0].metadata.offset) * factor, tag: 'program-0',
  });
  for (let index = 1; index < definitions.length; index++) {
    const definition = definitions[index];
    const task = await second.background.define(definition);
    const left = random(200001) - 100000, right = random(200001) - 100000;
    const factor = Number(definition.source.match(/!int_multiply\(total, (\d+)\)/)[1]);
    const expected = { case: index, total: (left + right + definition.metadata.offset) * factor, tag: `program-${index}` };
    const callback = await second.taskManager.emit(task.task_name, { left, right });
    assert.deepEqual(callback, definition.result_kind === 'task' ? 1 : definition.result_kind === 'fetch' ? 2 : expected);
    assert.deepEqual((await second.background.result('query')).value, expected);
    completed++;
    assert.deepEqual(await second.native.stats(), { created: completed, destroyed: completed, live: 0 });
  }
  assert.equal(second.state.acquired, 32);
  assert.equal(second.state.disposed, 32);
  assert.ok(second.state.hosts.every(host => host.closed));
  const retained = await second.background.result('query');
  second.background.close();
  await second.native.close();
  clients.splice(clients.indexOf(second.native), 1);

  const third = open(storage);
  assert.deepEqual(await third.background.result('query'), retained);
  const blocked = await third.background.define({ name: 'cancel', source: `${unwrap}
let resource = unwrap(perform Expo({module: "fixture", method: "acquire"}))
unwrap(perform Expo({module: "fixture", method: "wait"}))` });
  const execution = third.taskManager.emit(blocked.task_name, null);
  const deadline = Date.now() + 5000;
  while (!third.state.waiting) {
    assert.ok(Date.now() < deadline, 'SDK fixture was never invoked');
    await new Promise(done => setImmediate(done));
  }
  await third.background.cancel('cancel');
  assert.equal(await execution, 2);
  assert.equal((await third.background.result('cancel')).status, 'cancelled');
  third.state.waiting({ close() { third.state.disposed++; } });
  await new Promise(done => setImmediate(done));
  assert.equal(third.state.acquired, 1);
  assert.equal(third.state.disposed, 2);
  assert.ok(third.state.hosts.every(host => host.closed && host.handles.size === 0));
  assert.deepEqual(await third.native.stats(), { created: 1, destroyed: 1, live: 0 });
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ seed: '0x455947', generatedPrograms: 32, nativeProcesses: 3,
    freshNativeSessions: 33, sdkResourcesDisposed: 34, coldCallbackWaitedForHydration: 'passed',
    inputBindingsAndEffectResume: 'passed', durableResultsAcrossNativeRestart: 'passed',
    taskFetchValueFormats: 'passed', cancelledVmAndLateSdkCleanup: 'passed',
    deviceValidation: false, sdkAndOs: 'deterministic fixtures' }));
} finally {
  for (const adapter of adapters) adapter.close();
  await Promise.all(clients.map(client => client.close()));
}
```

## `packages/zig_runtime/android/tests/background.test.mjs`

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/android/tests/background.test.mjs","sha256":"c59025f4c35691da1d8ea0b37c85f8394ae4adc834e12fecf22f50065662b5a8","bytes":16085} -->

```javascript
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { BackgroundTasks } from '../src/background.mjs';
import { ExpoEffects, fromSpec, toSpec } from '../src/effects.mjs';

function deferred() {
  let resolve, reject;
  const promise = new Promise((done, fail) => { resolve = done; reject = fail; });
  return { promise, resolve, reject };
}

function storageFixture() {
  const values = new Map();
  return { values, async getItem(key) { return values.get(key) ?? null; },
    async setItem(key, value) { values.set(key, value); }, async removeItem(key) { values.delete(key); } };
}

function managerFixture() {
  const definitions = new Map(), registered = new Set(), unregistered = [];
  return { definitions, registered, unregistered,
    defineTask(name, callback) { definitions.set(name, callback); },
    async isTaskRegisteredAsync(name) { return registered.has(name); },
    async getRegisteredTasksAsync() { return [...registered].map(taskName => ({ taskName })); },
    async unregisterTaskAsync(name) { unregistered.push(name); registered.delete(name); },
    emit(name, data = null) { return definitions.get(name)({ data, error: null, executionInfo: { taskName: name, eventId: 'fixture-event' } }); } };
}

function nativeFixture(evaluate = request => ({ status: 'done', result: { value: toSpec(fromSpec(request.input).data) } })) {
  const requests = [], destroyed = [];
  let created = 0;
  return { requests, destroyed, get created() { return created; },
    async create() { return ++created; },
    async evaluate(id, raw) { const request = JSON.parse(raw); requests.push({ id, request }); return JSON.stringify(await evaluate(request, id)); },
    async resume() { throw new Error('Unexpected resume'); },
    async destroy(id) { destroyed.push(id); } };
}

function fixture(options = {}) {
  const storage = options.storage ?? storageFixture();
  const taskManager = options.taskManager ?? managerFixture();
  const native = options.native ?? nativeFixture();
  const hosts = [];
  const background = new BackgroundTasks({ storage, taskManager, native,
    hostFactory: () => { const host = new ExpoEffects({}); hosts.push(host); return host; },
    directory: '/private/documents', nativeOptions: { packages: {} }, now: () => 123,
    ...options });
  return { storage, taskManager, native, background, hosts };
}

test('fixed global tasks exist before asynchronous restoration and dispatch waits for durable source', async () => {
  const first = fixture();
  const definition = await first.background.define({ name: 'history', source: 'input.data', metadata: { version: 3 }, result_kind: 'value' });
  first.background.close();
  const gate = deferred();
  const storage = { ...first.storage, async getItem(key) { await gate.promise; return first.storage.getItem(key); } };
  const second = fixture({ storage });
  assert.equal(second.taskManager.definitions.size, 16);
  const callback = second.taskManager.emit(definition.task_name, { camelCase: 42, coordinate: 0.74 });
  assert.equal(second.native.created, 0);
  gate.resolve();
  assert.deepEqual(await callback, { camelCase: 42, coordinate: { expo_number: '0.74' } });
  const request = second.native.requests[0].request;
  assert.equal(request.source, 'input.data');
  assert.equal(request.directory, '/private/documents');
  assert.deepEqual(fromSpec(request.input), { data: { camelCase: 42, coordinate: { expo_number: '0.74' } }, error: null,
    execution_info: { taskName: definition.task_name, eventId: 'fixture-event' }, metadata: { version: 3 } });
  assert.deepEqual((await second.background.get('history')).metadata, { version: 3 });
  assert.deepEqual((await second.background.result('history')).value, { camelCase: 42, coordinate: { expo_number: '0.74' } });
  assert.deepEqual(second.native.destroyed, [1]);
  assert.equal(second.hosts[0].closed, true);
  second.background.close();
});

test('OS registration is separate and each callback owns a fresh native session', async () => {
  const { background, taskManager, native, hosts } = fixture();
  const task = await background.define({ name: 'poll', source: 'input.data' });
  assert.equal(taskManager.registered.size, 0);
  assert.equal(await taskManager.emit(task.task_name, 1), 1);
  assert.equal(await taskManager.emit(task.task_name, 2), 1);
  assert.equal(native.created, 2);
  assert.deepEqual(native.destroyed, [1, 2]);
  assert.ok(hosts.every(host => host.closed));
  assert.equal((await background.result('poll')).value, 2);
  background.close();
});

test('result kinds return Expo task/fetch enums or the EYG data value', async () => {
  for (const [result_kind, success, failure] of [['task', 1, 2], ['fetch', 2, 3], ['value', 42, null]]) {
    let fails = false;
    const native = nativeFixture(() => fails ? { status: 'error', error: 'fixture failure' } : { status: 'done', result: { value: toSpec(42) } });
    const { background, taskManager } = fixture({ native });
    const task = await background.define({ name: result_kind, source: '42', result_kind });
    assert.equal(await taskManager.emit(task.task_name), success);
    fails = true;
    assert.equal(await taskManager.emit(task.task_name), failure);
    assert.equal((await background.result(result_kind)).status, 'error');
    assert.equal(native.destroyed.length, 2);
    background.close();
  }
});

test('definition limits and malformed durable stores fail without native execution', async () => {
  const { background, native } = fixture();
  for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) await background.define({ name: `task-${i}`, source: '42' });
  await assert.rejects(background.define({ name: 'overflow', source: '42' }), /limit/);
  for (const settings of [
    { name: '', source: '42' }, { name: 'task-0', source: '🌱'.repeat(16385) },
    { name: 'task-0', source: '' }, { name: 'task-0', source: '42', timeout_ms: 0 },
    { name: 'task-0', source: '42', timeout_ms: 300001 }, { name: 'task-0', source: '42', result_kind: 'unknown' },
    { name: 'task-0', source: '42', metadata: { number: Infinity } },
  ]) await assert.rejects(background.define(settings));
  assert.equal((await background.list()).length, 16);
  assert.equal(native.created, 0);
  background.close();
  const storage = storageFixture();
  storage.values.set('@eyg/background/v1/tasks', '{broken');
  const broken = fixture({ storage });
  await assert.rejects(broken.background.ready, SyntaxError);
  await assert.rejects(broken.background.list(), SyntaxError);
  assert.equal(await broken.taskManager.emit('eyg-background:0'), 2);
  assert.equal(broken.native.created, 0);
  broken.background.close();
});

test('timeout and cancellation abandon blocked VM calls and retain their terminal result', async () => {
  for (const timeout of [true, false]) {
    const started = deferred(), blocked = deferred();
    const native = nativeFixture(async () => { started.resolve(); return blocked.promise; });
    const { background, taskManager } = fixture({ native });
    const task = await background.define({ name: 'blocked', source: '42', timeout_ms: timeout ? 5 : 30000 });
    const callback = taskManager.emit(task.task_name);
    await started.promise;
    if (!timeout) assert.equal(await background.cancel('blocked'), true);
    assert.equal(await callback, 2);
    assert.equal((await background.result('blocked')).status, timeout ? 'timeout' : 'cancelled');
    assert.deepEqual(native.destroyed, [1]);
    blocked.reject(new Error('Late network failure'));
    await new Promise(done => setImmediate(done));
    assert.equal(background.active.size, 0);
    background.close();
  }
});

test('forget cancels active work, unregisters its OS slot, and prevents stale result restoration', async () => {
  const started = deferred(), blocked = deferred();
  const native = nativeFixture(async () => { started.resolve(); return blocked.promise; });
  const { background, taskManager, storage } = fixture({ native });
  const task = await background.define({ name: 'forget-me', source: '42' });
  taskManager.registered.add(task.task_name);
  const callback = taskManager.emit(task.task_name);
  await started.promise;
  assert.equal(await background.forget('forget-me'), true);
  assert.equal(await callback, 2);
  assert.deepEqual(taskManager.unregistered, [task.task_name]);
  assert.equal(await background.get('forget-me'), null);
  assert.equal(await background.result('forget-me'), null);
  assert.equal(await background.forget('forget-me'), false);
  blocked.resolve({ status: 'done', result: { value: toSpec(99) } });
  await new Promise(done => setImmediate(done));
  assert.equal(await background.result('forget-me'), null);
  const restarted = fixture({ storage });
  assert.deepEqual(await restarted.background.list(), []);
  background.close();
  restarted.background.close();
});

test('replacing a running definition isolates the new source and result from late old work', async () => {
  const started = deferred(), blocked = deferred();
  const native = nativeFixture(async request => {
    if (request.source === 'old') { started.resolve(); return blocked.promise; }
    return { status: 'done', result: { value: toSpec('new value') } };
  });
  const { background } = fixture({ native });
  await background.define({ name: 'replace', source: 'old' });
  const old = background.run('replace');
  await started.promise;
  await background.define({ name: 'replace', source: 'new' });
  const fresh = await background.run('replace');
  assert.equal(fresh.value, 'new value');
  assert.equal((await old).status, 'cancelled');
  blocked.resolve({ status: 'done', result: { value: toSpec('old value') } });
  await new Promise(done => setImmediate(done));
  assert.equal((await background.result('replace')).value, 'new value');
  assert.deepEqual(native.destroyed.sort(), [1, 2]);
  background.close();
});

test('OS unregistration can wait for a cancelled callback without blocking its completion', async () => {
  const started = deferred(), blocked = deferred(), unregisterStarted = deferred(), unregister = deferred();
  const native = nativeFixture(async () => { started.resolve(); return blocked.promise; });
  const { background, taskManager } = fixture({ native });
  const task = await background.define({ name: 'retiring', source: '42' });
  taskManager.registered.add(task.task_name);
  taskManager.unregisterTaskAsync = async () => { unregisterStarted.resolve(); await unregister.promise; };
  const callback = taskManager.emit(task.task_name);
  await started.promise;
  const forgetting = background.forget('retiring');
  await unregisterStarted.promise;
  assert.equal(await callback, 2);
  await assert.rejects(background.define({ name: 'retiring', source: '99' }), /being unregistered/);
  assert.equal(await taskManager.emit(task.task_name), 2);
  unregister.resolve();
  assert.equal(await forgetting, true);
  assert.equal(await background.result('retiring'), null);
  blocked.reject(new Error('Late network error'));
  await new Promise(done => setImmediate(done));
  background.close();
});

test('concurrent invocation is rejected without corrupting an active task', async () => {
  const started = deferred(), blocked = deferred();
  const native = nativeFixture(async () => { started.resolve(); return blocked.promise; });
  const { background, taskManager } = fixture({ native });
  const task = await background.define({ name: 'single', source: '42', result_kind: 'fetch' });
  const first = taskManager.emit(task.task_name);
  await started.promise;
  assert.equal(await taskManager.emit(task.task_name), 3);
  await assert.rejects(background.run('single'), /already running/);
  blocked.resolve({ status: 'done', result: { value: toSpec(42) } });
  assert.equal(await first, 2);
  assert.equal(native.created, 1);
  assert.equal((await background.result('single')).value, 42);
  background.close();
});

test('storage and unregister failures retain definitions and can be retried', async () => {
  const { background, storage, taskManager } = fixture();
  const task = await background.define({ name: 'retry', source: '42' });
  taskManager.registered.add(task.task_name);
  const unregister = taskManager.unregisterTaskAsync;
  taskManager.unregisterTaskAsync = async () => { throw new Error('OS denied unregister'); };
  await assert.rejects(background.forget('retry'), /OS denied/);
  assert.equal((await background.get('retry')).source, '42');
  taskManager.unregisterTaskAsync = unregister;
  const setItem = storage.setItem;
  storage.setItem = async () => { throw new Error('Storage full'); };
  await assert.rejects(background.define({ name: 'retry', source: '99' }), /Storage full/);
  assert.equal((await background.get('retry')).source, '42');
  await assert.rejects(background.run('retry'), /Storage full/);
  assert.equal(background.active.size, 0);
  storage.setItem = setItem;
  assert.equal(await background.forget('retry'), true);
  background.close();
});

test('adapter close cancels running tasks while preserving entrypoints for a new process', async () => {
  const started = deferred(), blocked = deferred();
  const native = nativeFixture(async () => { started.resolve(); return blocked.promise; });
  const { background, storage } = fixture({ native });
  await background.define({ name: 'durable', source: '42' });
  const execution = background.run('durable');
  await started.promise;
  background.close();
  assert.equal((await execution).status, 'cancelled');
  await assert.rejects(background.list(), /closed/);
  blocked.resolve({ status: 'done', result: { value: toSpec(42) } });
  const restarted = fixture({ storage });
  assert.equal((await restarted.background.get('durable')).source, '42');
  assert.equal((await restarted.background.run('durable', 42)).value, 42);
  restarted.background.close();
});

test('forgotten identities retain durable slot tombstones until verified reset and process restart', async () => {
  const first = fixture();
  const original = await first.background.define({ name: 'original', source: '42' });
  await first.background.forget('original');
  const other = await first.background.define({ name: 'different', source: '99' });
  assert.notEqual(other.task_name, original.task_name);
  assert.equal(await first.taskManager.emit(original.task_name, 'late old payload'), 2);
  assert.equal(first.native.created, 0);
  first.background.close();
  const restored = fixture({ storage: first.storage });
  await restored.background.forget('different');
  const same = await restored.background.define({ name: 'original', source: '100' });
  assert.equal(same.task_name, original.task_name);
  await assert.rejects(restored.background.resetSlots(), /Forget every/);
  await restored.background.forget('original');
  restored.taskManager.registered.add(original.task_name);
  await assert.rejects(restored.background.resetSlots(), /still registered/);
  restored.taskManager.registered.clear();
  assert.deepEqual(await restored.background.resetSlots(), { restart_required: true });
  await assert.rejects(restored.background.define({ name: 'after-reset', source: '1' }), /closed/);
  assert.equal(await restored.taskManager.emit(original.task_name, 'queued before reset'), 2);
  const restarted = fixture({ storage: first.storage });
  const fresh = await restarted.background.define({ name: 'after-reset', source: '1' });
  assert.equal(fresh.task_name, 'eyg-background:0');
  restarted.background.close();
});

test('slot reset gates new definitions while OS registrations are being checked', async () => {
  const { background, taskManager } = fixture();
  await background.ready;
  const started = deferred(), registrations = deferred();
  taskManager.getRegisteredTasksAsync = async () => { started.resolve(); return registrations.promise; };
  const resetting = background.resetSlots();
  await started.promise;
  await assert.rejects(background.define({ name: 'raced', source: '42' }), /reset/);
  await assert.rejects(background.resetSlots(), /reset/);
  registrations.resolve([]);
  assert.deepEqual(await resetting, { restart_required: true });
});
```

## `packages/zig_runtime/android/tests/effects.test.mjs`

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/android/tests/effects.test.mjs","sha256":"335534b5c4b5d12f8d0d1508ce71abd6e7406e7bc9f13245adff590e1cbeb052","bytes":26789} -->

```javascript
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { ExpoEffects, fromSpec, toSpec } from '../src/effects.mjs';
import { runSession } from '../src/session.mjs';

function deferred() {
  let resolve, reject;
  const promise = new Promise((done, fail) => { resolve = done; reject = fail; });
  return { promise, resolve, reject };
}

async function promptly(promise) {
  let timer;
  try {
    return await Promise.race([promise, new Promise((_, reject) => {
      timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Cancellation waited for blocked IO')), 1000);
    })]);
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}

test('generated data values round trip through the EYG effect boundary', () => {
  let seed = 0x455947;
  const rng = n => { seed = (Math.imul(seed, 1664525) + 1013904223) >>> 0; return seed % n; };
  function value(depth) {
    const kind = rng(depth ? 7 : 4);
    if (kind === 0) return rng(100000) - 50000;
    if (kind === 1) return ['é', '绿', '\u0000', '\n', '🚀'][rng(5)];
    if (kind === 2) return rng(2) === 1;
    if (kind === 3) return null;
    if (kind === 4) return Array.from({ length: rng(6) }, () => value(depth - 1));
    return Object.fromEntries(Array.from({ length: rng(6) }, (_, i) => [`key${i}`, value(depth - 1)]));
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 2000; i++) { const input = value(4); assert.deepEqual(fromSpec(toSpec(input)), input); }
});

test('abort abandons blocked native evaluation and ignores its late effect response', async () => {
  const started = deferred(), evaluation = deferred(), cleanup = deferred();
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const destroyed = [], updates = [];
  let resumes = 0;
  const host = new ExpoEffects({});
  host.encode({ remove() { return cleanup.promise; } });
  const native = {
    async create() { return 7; },
    evaluate(id, input) {
      assert.equal(id, 7);
      assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(input), { source: 'blocked', directory: '/fixture' });
      started.resolve();
      return evaluation.promise;
    },
    async resume() { resumes++; throw new Error('Late response must be ignored'); },
    async destroy(id) { destroyed.push(id); },
  };
  const session = runSession(native, host, 'blocked', state => updates.push(state), undefined, { directory: '/fixture' }, controller.signal);
  await started.promise;
  controller.abort();
  assert.deepEqual(await promptly(session), { status: 'cancelled' });
  assert.equal(host.closed, true);
  assert.deepEqual(destroyed, [7]);
  evaluation.resolve(JSON.stringify({ status: 'effect', effect: { label: 'Expo', value: toSpec({}) } }));
  cleanup.resolve();
  await new Promise(done => setImmediate(done));
  assert.deepEqual(updates, []);
  assert.equal(resumes, 0);
  assert.deepEqual(destroyed, [7]);
});

      async destroy(id) { destroyed.push(id); },

});

test('a new session stays independent while an abandoned native call fails later', async () => {
  const oldStarted = deferred(), oldCall = deferred(), newStarted = deferred(), sdkCall = deferred();
  const oldController = new AbortController();
  const oldUpdates = [], newUpdates = [], destroyed = [];
  let nextId = 0;
  const native = {
    async create() { return ++nextId; },
    async evaluate(id) {
      if (id === 1) { oldStarted.resolve(); return oldCall.promise; }
      return JSON.stringify({ status: 'effect', effect: { label: 'Expo', value: toSpec({ module: 'sdk', method: 'run' }) } });
    },
    async resume(id, reply) {
      assert.equal(id, 2);
      assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(reply), { tagged: { label: 'Ok', value: toSpec(42) } });
      return JSON.stringify({ status: 'done', result: { value: toSpec(42) } });
    },
    async destroy(id) { destroyed.push(id); },
  };
  const oldHost = new ExpoEffects({});
  const oldSession = runSession(native, oldHost, 'old', update => oldUpdates.push(update), undefined, {}, oldController.signal);
  await oldStarted.promise;
  oldController.abort();
  assert.deepEqual(await promptly(oldSession), { status: 'cancelled' });
  const newHost = new ExpoEffects({ sdk: { run() { newStarted.resolve(); return sdkCall.promise; } } });
  const newSession = runSession(native, newHost, 'new', update => newUpdates.push(update));
  await newStarted.promise;
  oldCall.reject(new Error('Old read failed'));
  await new Promise(done => setImmediate(done));
  assert.equal(newHost.closed, false);
  assert.deepEqual(oldUpdates, []);
  assert.deepEqual(newUpdates, [{ status: 'effect', label: 'Expo' }]);
  assert.deepEqual(destroyed, [1]);
  sdkCall.resolve(42);
  assert.deepEqual(await newSession, { status: 'done', result: { value: toSpec(42) } });
  assert.equal(newHost.closed, true);
  assert.deepEqual(destroyed, [1, 2]);
});

  await host.close();
});

});

test('pure callback mode rejects ambiguous modes, budgets, cycles and native resources', async () => {
  const host = new ExpoEffects({}, null, 1024, { pure() { throw new Error('must not call'); } });
  for (const extra of [{ expo_return: true }, { expo_reply: true }, { expo_steps: 0 }, { expo_steps: 10001 }, { expo_sync: 42 }]) {
    assert.throws(() => host.decode({ expo_callback: 'x', expo_sync: '(args) -> { args }', ...extra }), /combine|budget|source/);
  }
  const callback = host.decode({ expo_callback: 'x', expo_sync: '(args) -> { args }' });
  const cycle = []; cycle.push(cycle);
  assert.throws(() => callback(cycle), /only data/);
  assert.throws(() => callback(new (class Resource {})()), /only data/);
  assert.throws(() => callback(new Uint8Array(4096)), /binary data exceeds size/);
  assert.throws(() => callback(new ArrayBuffer(4096)), /binary data exceeds size/);
  assert.equal(host.handles.size, 0);
  await host.close();
});

test('native pure callback failures are synchronous errors', async () => {
  for (const response of [{ status: 'error', error: 'StepLimit' }, { status: 'done', result: { break: { NoMatch: {} } } }]) {
    const host = new ExpoEffects({}, null, 1024, { pure: () => JSON.stringify(response) });
    const callback = host.decode({ expo_callback: 'x', expo_sync: '(args) -> { args }' });
    assert.throws(() => callback(), /Synchronous EYG callback failed/);
    await host.close();
  }
  const missing = new ExpoEffects({});
  assert.throws(() => missing.decode({ expo_callback: 'x', expo_sync: '(args) -> { args }' }), /no synchronous/);
  await missing.close();
});
```

```text
package expo.modules.eyg;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
public final class EygNative {
  static native long create();
  static native byte[] evaluate(long session, byte[] input);
  static native byte[] resume(long session, byte[] reply);
  static native void destroy(long session);
  static native void cancel(long session);
  public static void main(String[] args) {
    System.load(args[0]);
    long session = create();
    if (session == 0) throw new AssertionError("Native allocation failed");
    try {
      for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++) {
        String request = "{\"source\":\"let n = perform Expo(20) !int_add(n, 22)\"}";
        String effect = new String(evaluate(session, request.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        if (!effect.contains("\"status\":\"effect\"")) throw new AssertionError(effect);
        String result = new String(resume(session, "{\"integer\":20}".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        if (!result.equals("{\"status\":\"done\",\"result\":{\"value\":{\"integer\":42}}}")) throw new AssertionError(result);
      }
      String request = "{\"program\":{\"0\":\"s\",\"v\":\"héllo\\u0000🌱\"}}";
      String result = new String(evaluate(session, request.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
      if (!result.contains("héllo\\u0000🌱")) throw new AssertionError(result);
      cancel(session);
      result = new String(evaluate(session, request.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
      if (!result.equals("{\"status\":\"error\",\"error\":\"Cancelled\"}")) throw new AssertionError(result);
      System.out.println("{\"jniEffectResumeCases\":1000,\"utf8AndNul\":\"passed\"}");
    } finally { destroy(session); }
  }
}
```

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/android/tests/native/NativeSessionsTest.kt","sha256":"65ea449cc9bfa7a33f745721ea840410d76215b555cfa0309ef0ccae8af9875e","bytes":10230} -->

```text
package expo.modules.eyg

import java.util.Random
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutionException
import java.util.concurrent.Executors
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference

private fun await(latch: CountDownLatch) {
  check(latch.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) { "Timed out waiting for test worker" }
}

private fun expectClosed(action: () -> Unit) {
  val failure = runCatching(action).exceptionOrNull()
  check(failure is IllegalStateException && failure.message!!.contains("destroyed", true) ||
    failure is IllegalStateException && failure.message!!.contains("Closed", true)) { "Expected a closed-session error, got $failure" }
}

private class Backend(
  private val callGate: CountDownLatch? = null,
  private val destroyGate: CountDownLatch? = null,
  private val createGate: CountDownLatch? = null,
  expectedDestructions: Int = 1,
) : NativeBackend {
  val entered = CountDownLatch(1)
  val creating = CountDownLatch(1)
  val destroying = CountDownLatch(1)
  val destroyed = CountDownLatch(expectedDestructions)
  val calls = AtomicInteger()
  val cancellations = AtomicInteger()
  val destructions = AtomicInteger()
  val failure = AtomicReference<Throwable>()
  private val next = AtomicLong()
  private val active = ConcurrentHashMap<Long, AtomicInteger>()
  private val retired = ConcurrentHashMap<Long, AtomicInteger>()
  private val cancelled = ConcurrentHashMap<Long, AtomicInteger>()

  override fun create(): Long {
    val pointer = next.incrementAndGet()
    active[pointer] = AtomicInteger()
    creating.countDown()
    createGate?.let(::await)
    return pointer
  }

  override fun evaluate(session: Long, request: ByteArray) = execute(session, request)
  override fun resume(session: Long, reply: ByteArray) = execute(session, reply)

  override fun cancel(session: Long) {
    try {
      check(active.containsKey(session)) { "Cancelled a destroyed pointer" }
      check(retired[session]?.get() != 1) { "Cancellation raced pointer destruction" }
      check(cancelled.computeIfAbsent(session) { AtomicInteger() }.incrementAndGet() == 1) { "Double cancellation" }
      cancellations.incrementAndGet()
    } catch (error: Throwable) {
      failure.set(error)
      throw error
    }
  }

  private fun execute(pointer: Long, input: ByteArray): ByteArray {
    val count = active[pointer] ?: error("Use after destruction")
    check(count.incrementAndGet() == 1) { "Concurrent calls used one native pointer" }
    calls.incrementAndGet()
    entered.countDown()
    try {
      callGate?.let(::await)
      if (input.contentEquals("throw".toByteArray())) error("Native failure")
      return input
    } finally {
      count.decrementAndGet()
    }
  }

  override fun destroy(session: Long) {
    try {
      check(active[session]?.get() == 0) { "Destroyed a live native pointer" }
      check(retired.computeIfAbsent(session) { AtomicInteger() }.incrementAndGet() == 1) { "Double destruction" }
      destructions.incrementAndGet()
      destroying.countDown()
      destroyGate?.let(::await)
      active.remove(session)
    } catch (error: Throwable) {
      failure.set(error)
      throw error
    } finally {
      destroyed.countDown()
    }
  }

  fun verify() {
    await(destroyed)
    check(failure.get() == null) { "Native ownership violation: ${failure.get()}" }
  }
}

/** Observe that the second caller has reached a lock wait before retirement. */
private fun awaitQueued(thread: Thread) {
  val deadline = System.nanoTime() + TimeUnit.SECONDS.toNanos(5)
  while (thread.state != Thread.State.BLOCKED) {
    check(thread.isAlive && System.nanoTime() < deadline) { "Second call never queued" }
    Thread.yield()
  }
}

fun main() {
  var checks = 0

  // Closing a runtime cannot wait for a blocked native network call.
  run {
    val gate = CountDownLatch(1)
    val backend = Backend(callGate = gate)
    val manager = NativeSessions(backend)
    val executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2)
    try {
      val id = manager.create()
      val call = executor.submit<String> { manager.call(id, "héllo\u0000🌱", false) }
      await(backend.entered)
      executor.submit { manager.close() }.get(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
      check(backend.cancellations.get() == 1)
      check(backend.destructions.get() == 0)
      gate.countDown()
      check(call.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS) == "héllo\u0000🌱")
      backend.verify()
      check(backend.destructions.get() == 1)
      expectClosed { manager.call(id, "late", false) }
      expectClosed { manager.create() }
      manager.close()
      checks++
    } finally {
      gate.countDown()
      manager.close()
      executor.shutdownNow()
    }
  }

  // Idle disposal also runs outside the lifecycle caller, including slow frees.
  run {
    val gate = CountDownLatch(1)
    val backend = Backend(destroyGate = gate, expectedDestructions = 2)
    val manager = NativeSessions(backend)
    val executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor()
    try {
      manager.create()
      manager.create()
      executor.submit { manager.close() }.get(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
      await(backend.destroying)
      check(backend.destroyed.count == 2L)
      gate.countDown()
      backend.verify()
      check(backend.destructions.get() == 2)
      check(backend.cancellations.get() == 0)
      checks++
    } finally {
      gate.countDown()
      manager.close()
      executor.shutdownNow()
    }
  }

  // Shutdown can win while native allocation is still outside the ownership lock.
  run {
    val gate = CountDownLatch(1)
    val backend = Backend(createGate = gate)
    val manager = NativeSessions(backend)
    val executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2)
    try {
      val create = executor.submit<Int> { manager.create() }
      await(backend.creating)
      executor.submit { manager.close() }.get(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
      gate.countDown()
      val failure = runCatching { create.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS) }.exceptionOrNull()
      check(failure is ExecutionException && failure.cause is IllegalStateException)
      backend.verify()
      check(backend.destructions.get() == 1)
      check(backend.cancellations.get() == 0)
      checks++
    } finally {
      gate.countDown()
      manager.close()
      executor.shutdownNow()
    }
  }

  // Exceptions release call ownership so explicit destruction remains possible.
  run {
    val backend = Backend()
    val manager = NativeSessions(backend)
    try {
      val id = manager.create()
      check(runCatching { manager.call(id, "throw", false) }.exceptionOrNull()?.message == "Native failure")
      manager.destroy(id)
      manager.destroy(id)
      backend.verify()
      check(backend.destructions.get() == 1)
      check(backend.cancellations.get() == 0)
      checks++
    } finally { manager.close() }
  }

  // Retirement signals cancellation once before a blocked native call returns,
  // even when another caller owns a reference while queued on the session lock.
  run {
    val gate = CountDownLatch(1)
    val backend = Backend(callGate = gate)
    val manager = NativeSessions(backend)
    val executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor()
    val queuedFailure = AtomicReference<Throwable>()
    var queued: Thread? = null
    try {
      val id = manager.create()
      val call = executor.submit<String> { manager.call(id, "active", false) }
      await(backend.entered)
      queued = Thread {
        try { manager.call(id, "queued", true) }
        catch (error: Throwable) { queuedFailure.set(error) }
      }.also { it.start() }
      awaitQueued(queued!!)
      manager.destroy(id)
      manager.destroy(id)
      manager.close()
      check(backend.cancellations.get() == 1)
      check(backend.destructions.get() == 0)
      check(gate.count == 1L)
      gate.countDown()
      check(call.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS) == "active")
      queued!!.join(5000)
      check(!queued!!.isAlive && queuedFailure.get() is IllegalStateException)
      backend.verify()
      check(backend.calls.get() == 1)
      check(backend.cancellations.get() == 1)
      check(backend.destructions.get() == 1)
      checks++
    } finally {
      gate.countDown()
      manager.close()
      executor.shutdownNow()
      queued?.join(5000)
    }
  }

  // Seeded schedules vary evaluate/resume, queued callers and competing closes.
  val random = Random(0x455947L)
  repeat(64) {
    val gate = CountDownLatch(1)
    val backend = Backend(callGate = gate)
    val manager = NativeSessions(backend)
    val executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(3)
    var queued: Thread? = null
    val queuedFailure = AtomicReference<Throwable>()
    try {
      val id = manager.create()
      val resumed = random.nextBoolean()
      val call = executor.submit<String> { manager.call(id, "result", resumed) }
      await(backend.entered)
      if (random.nextBoolean()) {
        queued = Thread {
          try { manager.call(id, "must not enter native", !resumed) }
          catch (error: Throwable) { queuedFailure.set(error) }
        }.also { it.start() }
        awaitQueued(queued!!)
      }
      val retire = executor.submit { manager.destroy(id) }
      val close = executor.submit { manager.close() }
      retire.get(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
      close.get(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
      check(backend.destructions.get() == 0)
      check(backend.cancellations.get() == 1)
      gate.countDown()
      check(call.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS) == "result")
      queued?.let {
        it.join(5000)
        check(!it.isAlive)
        check(queuedFailure.get() is IllegalStateException)
      }
      backend.verify()
      check(backend.calls.get() == 1)
      check(backend.destructions.get() == 1)
      check(backend.cancellations.get() == 1)
      checks++
    } finally {
      gate.countDown()
      manager.close()
      executor.shutdownNow()
      queued?.join(5000)
    }
  }
  println("{\"kotlinLifecycleChecks\":$checks,\"seededSchedules\":64,\"seed\":\"0x455947\",\"nativeOwnership\":\"passed\",\"nativeCancellation\":\"passed\"}")
}
```

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/android/tests/native-client.mjs","sha256":"d0512f8b1940ddab518a06769ddf24455351c2607f08c88e2de8cb063d25581d","bytes":2389} -->

```javascript
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { createInterface } from 'node:readline';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

/** Async Node transport to the stdlib ctypes proxy, not a simulated native VM. */
export class NativeClient {
  constructor(library) {
    this.nextId = 1;
    this.pending = new Map();
    let stderr = '';
    this.child = spawn(process.env.PYTHON ?? 'python3', [
      fileURLToPath(new URL('../scripts/native-proxy.py', import.meta.url)), library,
    ], { stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
    this.child.stderr.on('data', bytes => { stderr = (stderr + bytes).slice(-8192); });
    this.exit = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      this.child.once('error', reject);
      this.child.once('close', (code, signal) => {
        const error = new Error(`Native proxy exited (${signal ?? code}): ${stderr}`);
        for (const request of this.pending.values()) request.reject(error);
        this.pending.clear();
        if (code === 0) resolve(); else reject(error);
      });
    });
    this.exit.catch(() => {});
    createInterface({ input: this.child.stdout }).on('line', line => {
      const response = JSON.parse(line);
      const request = this.pending.get(response.id);
      if (!request) throw new Error('Unexpected native proxy response');
      this.pending.delete(response.id);
      if (response.ok) request.resolve(response.value); else request.reject(new Error(response.error));
    });
  }

  request(method, ...args) {
    const id = this.nextId++;
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        this.child.kill();
        reject(new Error(`Native proxy timeout at ${method}`));
      }, 10000);
      this.pending.set(id, {
        resolve: value => { clearTimeout(timer); resolve(value); },
        reject: error => { clearTimeout(timer); reject(error); },
      });
      this.child.stdin.write(JSON.stringify({ id, method, args }) + '\n', error => {
        if (error) this.pending.get(id)?.reject(error);
      });
    });
  }

  create() { return this.request('create'); }
  evaluate(id, source) { return this.request('evaluate', id, source); }
  resume(id, reply) { return this.request('resume', id, reply); }
  destroy(id) { return this.request('destroy', id); }
  stats() { return this.request('stats'); }
  async close() { this.child.stdin.end(); await this.exit; }
}
```

## `packages/zig_runtime/android/tests/phone-flow.mjs`

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/android/tests/phone-flow.mjs","sha256":"c71f817b13039a69bf93e196d25f484b917475b3ba9ff08578c3e1f266fe4a25","bytes":8940} -->
```javascript
// Host integration: actual Zig C ABI + production JS session/effects, fixture SDK.
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { createInterface } from 'node:readline';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { resolve } from 'node:path';
import { parseArgs } from 'node:util';
import { ExpoEffects, fromSpec } from '../src/effects.mjs';
import { runSession } from '../src/session.mjs';

class NativeProxy {
  constructor(library) {
    this.pending = new Map();
    this.sequence = 0;
    this.stderr = '';
    this.child = spawn(process.env.PYTHON ?? 'python3', [
      fileURLToPath(new URL('../scripts/native-proxy.py', import.meta.url)), library,
    ], { stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
    this.exit = new Promise((done, reject) => {
      this.child.once('error', reject);
      this.child.once('close', (code, signal) => {
        const error = new Error(`Native proxy exited (${signal ?? code}): ${this.stderr}`);
        for (const pending of this.pending.values()) pending.reject(error);
        this.pending.clear();
        if (code === 0) done(); else reject(error);
      });
    });
    this.exit.catch(() => {});
    this.child.stderr.on('data', data => { this.stderr = (this.stderr + data).slice(-8192); });
    createInterface({ input: this.child.stdout }).on('line', line => {
      const reply = JSON.parse(line);
      const pending = this.pending.get(reply.id);
      if (!pending) throw new Error(`Unexpected native proxy response ${reply.id}`);
      this.pending.delete(reply.id);
      if (reply.ok) pending.resolve(reply.value); else pending.reject(new Error(reply.error));
    });
  }

  request(method, ...args) {
    const id = ++this.sequence;
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        this.child.kill();
        reject(new Error(`Native proxy timed out at ${method}`));
      }, 5000);
      this.pending.set(id, {
        resolve: value => { clearTimeout(timer); resolve(value); },
        reject: error => { clearTimeout(timer); reject(error); },
      });
      this.child.stdin.write(JSON.stringify({ id, method, args }) + '\n', error => {
        if (error) this.pending.get(id)?.reject(error);
      });
    });
  }

  create() { return this.request('create'); }
  evaluate(id, source) { return this.request('evaluate', id, source); }
  resume(id, reply) { return this.request('resume', id, reply); }
  destroy(id) { return this.request('destroy', id); }
  stats() { return this.request('stats'); }
  async close() { this.child.stdin.end(); await this.exit; }
}

const unwrap = 'let unwrap = match { Ok(value) -> { value } Error(reason) -> { !never(perform Abort(reason)) } }';

function sourceFor(steps) {
  const lines = [unwrap, 'let resource = unwrap(perform Expo({module: "FakeSDK", method: "acquireResource"}))'];
  for (const [i, step] of steps.entries()) {
    lines.push(`
let pending${i} = unwrap(perform Expo({
  module: "FakeSDK", method: "asyncDecide", defer: True({}),
  args: [{expo_object: [{key: "requestId", value: ${step.request}}, {key: "score", value: ${step.score}}]},
    {expo_callback: "${step.topic}", expo_reply: True({}), expo_timeout_ms: 2000}]
}))
let event${i} = unwrap(perform ExpoNextEvent({timeout_ms: 2000}))
let reply${i} = unwrap(perform ExpoReply({token: event${i}.callback_token, value: ${step.accepted ? 'True' : 'False'}({})}))
let result${i} = unwrap(perform Expo({expo_handle: pending${i}.expo_handle, method: "$await"}))
let request_id${i} = unwrap(perform Expo({object: result${i}, method: "requestId", get: True({})}))`);
  }
  lines.push('[' + steps.map((_, i) => `{event: event${i}, result: result${i}, request_id: request_id${i}}`).join(', ') + ']');
  return lines.join('\n');
}

function fixture() {
  const state = { allocated: 0, removed: 0, started: 0, completed: 0, cancelled: 0, operations: [] };
  const sdk = {
    acquireResource() {
      state.allocated++;
      let removed = false;
      return { remove() { assert.equal(removed, false); removed = true; state.removed++; } };
    },
    asyncDecide(request, callback) {
      state.started++;
      const operation = (async () => {
        // Vary asynchronous delivery without wall-clock timers or a phone.
        if (request.requestId % 2) await new Promise(done => setImmediate(done));
        else await Promise.resolve();
        try {
          const accepted = await callback(request);
          assert.equal(typeof accepted, 'boolean');
          state.completed++;
          return { requestId: request.requestId, accepted, score: accepted ? request.score : -request.score };
        } catch (error) {
          state.cancelled++;
          throw error;
        }
      })();
      // The host observes the SDK promise; this also lets the test check cleanup.
      state.operations.push(operation.then(() => 'completed', () => 'cancelled'));
      return operation;
    },
  };
  return { host: new ExpoEffects({ FakeSDK: sdk }), state };
}

function assertClosed(host, state) {
  assert.equal(host.closed, true);
  assert.equal(host.handles.size, 0);
  assert.equal(host.deferred.size, 0);
  assert.equal(host.replies.size, 0);
  assert.equal(host.events.length, 0);
  assert.equal(host.waiters.length, 0);
  assert.equal(state.removed, state.allocated);
}

const { values } = parseArgs({ options: {
  library: { type: 'string', default: fileURLToPath(new URL('../work/libeyg_android_host.so', import.meta.url)) },
  cases: { type: 'string', default: '32' },
} });
const cases = Number(values.cases);
assert.ok(Number.isSafeInteger(cases) && cases > 0, '--cases must be a positive integer');
const native = new NativeProxy(resolve(values.library));
let seed = 0x455947;
const random = n => { seed = (Math.imul(seed, 1664525) + 1013904223) >>> 0; return seed % n; };
let cycles = 0;
let approvals = 0;
let denials = 0;
try {
  for (let index = 0; index < cases; index++) {
    const steps = Array.from({ length: 1 + random(3) }, (_, step) => ({
      request: 1 + random(100000), score: random(200001) - 100000,
      accepted: random(2) === 1, topic: `decision_${index}_${step}`,
    }));
    const { host, state } = fixture();
    const labels = [];
    const source = sourceFor(steps);
    const response = await runSession(native, host, source, update => labels.push(update.label), undefined, { packages: {} });
    assert.equal(response.status, 'done', `${JSON.stringify(response)}\n${source}`);
    assert.ok(response.result?.value, `${JSON.stringify(response)}\n${source}`);
    assert.deepEqual(fromSpec(response.result.value), steps.map((step, i) => ({
      event: { topic: step.topic, args: [{ requestId: step.request, score: step.score }], dropped: 0, callback_token: i + 1 },
      result: { requestId: step.request, accepted: step.accepted, score: step.accepted ? step.score : -step.score },
      request_id: step.request,
    })), `seed 0x455947 program ${index}`);
    assert.deepEqual(labels, ['Expo', ...steps.flatMap(() => ['Expo', 'ExpoNextEvent', 'ExpoReply', 'Expo', 'Expo'])]);
    assert.deepEqual(await Promise.all(state.operations), steps.map(() => 'completed'));
    assert.equal(state.started, steps.length);
    assert.equal(state.completed, steps.length);
    assert.equal(state.cancelled, 0);
    assertClosed(host, state);
    assert.deepEqual(await native.stats(), { created: index + 1, destroyed: index + 1, live: 0 });
    cycles += steps.length;
    approvals += steps.filter(step => step.accepted).length;
    denials += steps.filter(step => !step.accepted).length;
  }
  assert.ok(approvals > 0 && denials > 0, 'generated cases must cover both decisions');

  const { host, state } = fixture();
  let cancelled = false;
  const labels = [];
  const response = await runSession(native, host, sourceFor([{ request: 2, score: 42, accepted: true, topic: 'cancel' }]), update => {
    labels.push(update.label);
    if (update.label === 'ExpoNextEvent') cancelled = true;
  }, () => cancelled, { packages: {} });
  assert.deepEqual(response, { status: 'cancelled' });
  assert.deepEqual(labels, ['Expo', 'Expo', 'ExpoNextEvent']);
  assert.deepEqual(await Promise.all(state.operations), ['cancelled']);
  // Cancellation detaches promptly; allow asynchronous SDK disposal to finish.
  await new Promise(done => setImmediate(done));
  assert.equal(state.completed, 0);
  assert.equal(state.cancelled, 1);
  assertClosed(host, state);
  assert.deepEqual(await native.stats(), { created: cases + 1, destroyed: cases + 1, live: 0 });
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ seed: '0x455947', generatedPrograms: cases, callbackCycles: cycles,
    approvals, denials, actualZigVm: 'passed', jsSessionEffects: 'passed',
    camelCaseSdkOptionsAndResults: 'passed', suspendedVmCancellation: 'passed', nativeSessionsDestroyed: cases + 1,
    sdk: 'deterministic fixture; no device or hardware validation' }));
} finally {
  await native.close();
}
```

```javascript
// The production effect host calls an actual isolated Zig VM synchronously.
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { ExpoEffects } from '../src/effects.mjs';
const library = process.argv[2] ?? 'work/libeyg_android_host.so';
let calls = 0;
const pure = request => {
  calls++;
  const result = spawnSync(process.env.PYTHON ?? 'python3', [fileURLToPath(new URL('../scripts/pure-native.py', import.meta.url)), library], { input: request, encoding: 'utf8' });
  assert.equal(result.status, 0, result.stderr);
  return result.stdout;
};
const host = new ExpoEffects({}, null, 1024, { pure });
const source = '(args) -> { let score = match !list_pop(args) { Ok(item) -> { item.head } Error(_) -> { 0 } } match !int_compare(score, 50) { Lt(_) -> { True({}) } | (_) -> { False({}) } } }';
const callback = host.decode({ expo_callback: 'decision', expo_sync: source, expo_steps: 1000 });
for (let score = 0; score < 100; score += 3) assert.equal(callback(score), score < 50);
assert.equal((await host.nextEvent(0)).topic, 'decision');
const data = host.decode({ expo_callback: 'identity', expo_sync: '(args) -> { args }', expo_emit: false });
assert.deepEqual(data({ name: 'history', approved: true, score: 0.75 }), [{ name: 'history', approved: true, score: 0.75 }]);
const app = (f, a) => ({ 0: 'a', f, a });
const variable = name => ({ 0: 'v', l: name });
const select = (name, value) => app({ 0: 'g', l: name }, value);
const camelIR = { 0: 'f', l: 'args', b: select('canAskAgain', select('head', app({ 0: 'b', l: 'list_pop' }, variable('args')))) };
// list_pop returns Ok(record); unwrap using a tagged match before selecting.
camelIR.b = app(app(app({ 0: 'm', l: 'Ok' }, { 0: 'f', l: 'item', b: select('canAskAgain', select('head', variable('item'))) }), { 0: 'n' }), app({ 0: 'b', l: 'list_pop' }, variable('args')));
const foreign = host.decode({ expo_callback: 'foreign', expo_sync: JSON.stringify(camelIR), expo_emit: false });
assert.equal(foreign({ canAskAgain: true }), true);
assert.throws(() => host.decode({ expo_callback: 'effect', expo_sync: '(args) -> { perform Expo(args) }' })('no'), /PureEffectsNotAllowed/);
assert.throws(() => host.decode({ expo_callback: 'ref', expo_sync: '(args) -> { import "missing" }' })(), /PureReferencesNotAllowed/);
assert.throws(() => host.decode({ expo_callback: 'loop', expo_sync: '(args) -> { let loop = (self) -> { self(self) } loop(loop) }', expo_steps: 100 })(), /StepLimit/);
assert.throws(() => host.decode({ expo_callback: 'small', expo_sync: '(args) -> { args }', expo_steps: 1 })(), /StepLimit/);
assert.throws(() => host.decode({ expo_callback: 'bad', expo_sync: source, expo_steps: 10001 }), /step budget/);
assert.throws(() => host.decode({ expo_callback: 'bad', expo_sync: source, expo_return: true }), /combine/);
assert.throws(() => data(new (class Resource {})()), /only data/);
const grow = n => '(args) -> { let twice = (s) -> { !string_append(s, s) } ' + 'twice('.repeat(n) + '"x"' + ')'.repeat(n) + ' }';
assert.throws(() => host.decode({ expo_callback: 'memory', expo_sync: grow(23), expo_emit: false })(), /OutOfMemory/);
assert.throws(() => host.decode({ expo_callback: 'output', expo_sync: grow(17), expo_emit: false })(), /PureOutputTooLarge/);
assert.throws(() => host.decode({ expo_callback: 'recursive-equality', expo_sync: '(args) -> { !equal(args, args) }' })(), /PureBuiltinNotBounded/);
for (const builtin of ['string_split', 'string_split_once', 'string_replace']) {
  assert.throws(() => host.decode({ expo_callback: 'search', expo_sync: `(args) -> { !${builtin} }` })(), /PureBuiltinNotBounded/);
}
const before = calls;
await host.close();
assert.equal(callback(42), undefined);
assert.equal(calls, before);
assert.equal(host.handles.size, 0);
console.log(JSON.stringify({ realNativeSynchronousCallbacks: calls, argumentDependentDecisions: 34, effectsForbidden: true, referencesForbidden: true, stepBudget: 'passed', closedHost: 'passed' }));
```

```javascript
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { ExpoEffects } from '../src/effects.mjs';
import { renderView } from '../src/views.mjs';

const createElement = (type, props, ...children) => ({ type, props, children });
const components = { Host() {}, Column() {}, Text() {}, Button() {}, Native: { $$typeof: Symbol.for('react.forward_ref') } };
const node = (component, fields = {}) => ({ module: 'ui', component, ...fields });

test('native descriptors compose nested components and text with root styling', () => {
  const host = new ExpoEffects({ ui: components });
  const tree = renderView(node('Host', { props: { style: { flex: 1 } }, children: [
    node('Column', { children: [node('Text', { children: 'Hello EYG 🌱' }), node('Text', { children: 42 }), null] }),
  ] }), host, createElement, { rootStyle: { height: 240 } });
  assert.equal(tree.type, components.Host);
  assert.deepEqual(tree.props.style, [{ height: 240 }, { flex: 1 }]);
  assert.equal(tree.children[0].type, components.Column);
  assert.equal(tree.children[0].props.style, undefined);
  assert.deepEqual(tree.children[0].children[0].children, ['Hello EYG 🌱']);
  assert.deepEqual(tree.children[0].children[1].children, [42]);
  assert.equal(tree.children[0].children[2], null);
});

test('view props decode callback functions and retain native object handles', async () => {
  class Resource { close() {} }
  const resource = new Resource();
  const host = new ExpoEffects({ ui: components });
  const handle = host.encode(resource);
  const tree = renderView(node('Button', { props: {
    resource: handle, onPress: { expo_callback: 'pressed', expo_return: true },
    options: { expo_object: [{ key: 'camelCase', value: { expo_number: '0.5' } }] },
  } }), host, createElement);
  assert.equal(tree.props.resource, resource);
  assert.deepEqual(tree.props.options, { camelCase: 0.5 });
  assert.equal(tree.props.onPress({ count: 3 }), true);
  assert.deepEqual(await host.nextEvent(0), { topic: 'pressed', args: [{ count: 3 }], dropped: 0 });
  await host.close();
});

test('refs are optional and guarded refs publish handles only for the active run', async () => {
  const host = new ExpoEffects({ ui: components });
  assert.equal(renderView(node('Text'), host, createElement).props.ref, undefined);
  let current = true;
  const events = [];
  const tree = renderView(node('Native', { id: 'camera', ref: true }), host, createElement, {
    current: () => current, emit: (topic, args) => events.push({ topic, args }),
  });
  const instance = { remove() {} };
  tree.props.ref(instance);
  assert.equal(events[0].topic, 'view:camera:ready');
  assert.equal(host.decode(events[0].args[0]), instance);
  current = false;
  tree.props.ref({ remove() {} });
  tree.props.ref(null);
  assert.equal(events.length, 1);
  assert.equal(host.handles.size, 1);
  assert.throws(() => renderView(node('Host'), host, createElement, { current: () => false }), /Closed/);
  await host.close();
});

test('explicit ref topics work for nested native components', () => {
  const host = new ExpoEffects({ ui: components });
  const topics = [];
  const tree = renderView(node('Host', { children: node('Native', { ref: 'nested-ready' }) }), host, createElement, {
    emit: topic => topics.push(topic),
  });
  tree.children[0].props.ref({});
  assert.deepEqual(topics, ['nested-ready']);
});

test('unknown modules and component paths fail before mounting', () => {
  const host = new ExpoEffects({ ui: components, invalid: { value: 7, object: {} } });
  for (const spec of [
    { module: 'missing', component: 'Host' }, { module: '__proto__', component: 'toString' },
    node('Missing'), node('__proto__.toString'),
    { module: 'invalid', component: 'value' }, { module: 'invalid', component: 'object' },
  ]) assert.throws(() => renderView(spec, host, createElement), /Unknown|Invalid/);
  assert.throws(() => renderView(node('Text', { props: [] }), host, createElement), /props/);
  assert.throws(() => renderView(node('Text', { children() {} }), host, createElement), /children/);
  assert.throws(() => renderView(node('Native', { ref: true }), host, createElement), /ref/);
});

test('view trees accept 64 component levels and reject deeper or cyclic input', () => {
  const host = new ExpoEffects({ ui: components });
  const chain = depth => {
    let child = node('Text', { children: 'leaf' });
    for (let i = 1; i < depth; i++) child = node('Column', { children: child });
    return child;
  };
  assert.doesNotThrow(() => renderView(chain(64), host, createElement));
  assert.throws(() => renderView(chain(65), host, createElement), /depth/);
  const cycle = node('Column');
  cycle.children = [cycle];
  assert.throws(() => renderView(cycle, host, createElement), /Cyclic/);
  const array = [];
  array.push(array);
  assert.throws(() => renderView(node('Column', { children: array }), host, createElement), /Cyclic/);
  for (const maxDepth of [0, -1, 65, Infinity, 0.5]) assert.throws(() => renderView(node('Text'), host, createElement, { maxDepth }), /limit/);
});
```

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/build.zig","sha256":"8d03d405d95e7d553c89ef910d1ea02031d92b9e8f711999d0409ad2a8a2588d","bytes":864} -->
```zig
const std = @import("std");

pub fn build(b: *std.Build) void {
    const target = b.standardTargetOptions(.{});
    const optimize = b.standardOptimizeOption(.{});
    const exe = b.addExecutable(.{ .name = "eyg", .root_source_file = b.path("src/main.zig"), .target = target, .optimize = optimize });
    exe.root_module.strip = b.option(bool, "strip", "Strip debug information from the executable") orelse (optimize != .Debug);
    b.installArtifact(exe);
    const run = b.addRunArtifact(exe);
    run.step.dependOn(b.getInstallStep());
    if (b.args) |args| run.addArgs(args);
    b.step("run", "Run EYG (interactive by default)").dependOn(&run.step);
    const tests = b.addTest(.{ .root_source_file = b.path("src/tests.zig"), .target = target, .optimize = optimize });
    b.step("test", "Run runtime unit tests").dependOn(&b.addRunArtifact(tests).step);
}
```

## `packages/zig_runtime/docs/book_sources.py`

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/docs/book_sources.py","sha256":"2917005861e3fc47d5fcbacde6b479ff98910729e8504a91d5dc973a603dc579","bytes":5942} -->
```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Publish complete, verifiable source listings and reconstruct their build tree."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
LISTINGS = ROOT / "docs" / "source-listings.md"
SKIP = {".git", ".zig-cache", "zig-out", "node_modules", "build", ".gradle", "__pycache__", ".cxx", ".expo", "dist", "reports", "artifacts", "work"}
SUFFIXES = {
    ".zig", ".zon", ".py", ".mjs", ".js", ".ts", ".tsx", ".json", ".gleam", ".eyg",
    ".toml", ".sh", ".gradle", ".kts", ".kt", ".xml", ".properties", ".bat", ".c", ".h", ".cpp", ".java", ".pro", ".txt", ".md",
}
LANGUAGES = {".zig": "zig", ".py": "python", ".mjs": "javascript", ".js": "javascript",
             ".ts": "typescript", ".tsx": "tsx", ".sh": "sh", ".json": "json",
             ".xml": "xml", ".kts": "kotlin", ".c": "c", ".h": "c", ".eyg": "eyg"}


def source_paths() -> list[Path]:
    paths = [ROOT / "build.zig", ROOT / "build.zig.zon", ROOT / "README.md", Path(__file__).resolve()]
    for directory in ("src", "tools", "scripts", "tests", "git", "http", "android"):
        start = ROOT / directory
        if not start.exists():
            continue
        for directory_path, directories, files in os.walk(start):
            directories[:] = [name for name in directories if name not in SKIP]
            for name in files:
                if name in {"local.properties", "validation.json", "native-libraries.json", "native-benchmark.json", "native-benchmark-loaded.json"}:
                    continue
                path = Path(directory_path) / name
                if path.suffix in SUFFIXES or name in {"Makefile", "gradlew", "CMakeLists.txt", "zig", "verify"}:
                    paths.append(path)
    repository = ROOT.parent.parent
    fixtures = repository / "spec" / "evaluation"
    if fixtures.exists():
        paths.extend(fixtures.glob("*.json"))
    paths.append(repository / "LICENSE")
    return sorted({path for path in paths if path.is_file()})


def render() -> str:
    sections = [
        "# Crafting an EYG interpreter: complete source listings\n\n",
        "Generated by `python3 docs/book_sources.py`; do not edit this appendix.\n",
        "Each listing contains the exact UTF-8 bytes of its canonical file.\n",
        "From the package directory, reconstruct a separate build with\n",
        "`python3 docs/book_sources.py --extract ../../work/book-example`.\n",
        "The export includes `packages/zig_runtime/` and upstream evaluation fixtures\n",
        "under `spec/evaluation/`, so its unit tests have the same inputs.\n\n",
    ]
    for path in source_paths():
        data = path.read_bytes()
        source = data.decode("utf-8")
        name = path.relative_to(ROOT.parent.parent).as_posix()
        metadata = {"path": name, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), "bytes": len(data)}
        fence = "`" * max(3, max((len(m.group()) + 1 for m in re.finditer(r"`+", source)), default=3))
        sections.extend([
            f"## `{name}`\n\n",
            "<!-- eyg-source: " + json.dumps(metadata, separators=(",", ":")) + " -->\n",
            fence + LANGUAGES.get(path.suffix, "text") + "\n",
            source,
            "" if source.endswith("\n") else "\n",
            fence + "\n\n",
        ])
    return "".join(sections)


def extract(destination: Path) -> int:
    document = LISTINGS.read_bytes().decode("utf-8")
    pattern = re.compile(r"^<!-- eyg-source: (.+) -->\n(`{3,})[^\n]*\n", re.MULTILINE)
    count = 0
    for match in pattern.finditer(document):
        metadata = json.loads(match[1])
        relative = PurePosixPath(metadata["path"])
        if relative.is_absolute() or ".." in relative.parts or not relative.parts:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid source path: {relative}")
        closing = document.find("\n" + match[2] + "\n", match.end())
        if closing < 0:
            raise ValueError(f"Missing closing fence: {relative}")
        data = (document[match.end():closing] + "\n").encode("utf-8")[:metadata["bytes"]]
        if len(data) != metadata["bytes"] or hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != metadata["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError(f"Source hash mismatch: {relative}")
        target = destination.joinpath(*relative.parts)
        if any(parent.is_symlink() for parent in (target, *target.parents)):
            raise ValueError(f"Refusing symlink destination: {target}")
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        if target.exists() and target.read_bytes() != data:
            raise ValueError(f"Refusing to overwrite a different file: {target}")
        target.write_bytes(data)
        if target.name in {"gradlew", "zig", "verify"} or target.suffix == ".sh":
            target.chmod(target.stat().st_mode | 0o111)
        count += 1
    if count == 0:
        raise ValueError("The appendix contains no source listings")
    return count


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true", help="fail if canonical files differ from the appendix")
    parser.add_argument("--extract", type=Path, metavar="DIRECTORY", help="reconstruct package sources from the appendix")
    arguments = parser.parse_args()
    if arguments.extract:
        count = extract(arguments.extract)
        print(f"Reconstructed {count} verified source files in {arguments.extract}")
    elif arguments.check:
        if not LISTINGS.exists() or LISTINGS.read_bytes().decode("utf-8") != render():
            parser.exit(1, "Source appendix is stale; run python3 docs/book_sources.py\n")
        print("Source appendix matches canonical files")
    else:
        LISTINGS.write_text(render(), encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"Wrote {LISTINGS.relative_to(ROOT)}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

## `packages/zig_runtime/git/README.md`

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/git/README.md","sha256":"6d1b6ac622c09a5d58fa03ab11444a6ced48be40929992229520e36456a06495","bytes":8492} -->
````text
# Native Git through EYG effects

`native.eyg` is the EYG facade for the Zig runtime's local `GitQuery` effect.
Storage decoding and writes use Zig's standard library; the implementation never
spawns Git. Git is an independent verifier in the Python tests.

The reference implementation is `real-world` at
`f1e32bad77d7ffdef6c416cb7ccbf7b23ec0bbd9`, particularly `dark/git/{read,write,config}.eyg`.
This is a native backend with an EYG interface. It is not a claim that those
EYG modules are executed unchanged or that every Git API is identical.

## Use in the TUI

Launch `zig-out/bin/eyg` from the repository root, paste this program and press
Enter. Bindings remain available for later queries:

```eyg
let git = import "packages/zig_runtime/git/native.eyg"
let repo = "/absolute/path/to/eyg-lang"
let subjects = (rows) -> {
  !list_fold(rows, [], (commit, found) -> { [commit.subject, ..found] })
}
subjects(git.query({repo, contains: "parser", author: "Peter", limit: 3}))
```

Query options are ordinary records. `ref` defaults to `HEAD`; hexadecimal SHA-1
IDs, local branches, full refs, tags and `~N`/`^N` parent suffixes are accepted.
`path` selects commits where that committed path's object ID differs from the
first parent, including deletions. `since`/`until` are inclusive Unix **seconds**
from the committer header. `contains` and `author` are case-sensitive substrings.
`limit` defaults to 20 and bounds returned records; `scan_limit` defaults to
10,000 and bounds visited commits. A bounded query can stop before finding all
matches. Traversal follows first parents, without date sorting.

```eyg
subjects(git.query({repo, path: "guides/syntax.md", limit: 3}))
subjects(git.query({repo, author: "Peter", since: 1793130000, until: 1793220000, limit: 3}))
git.show(repo, "HEAD~2", "README.md")
git.remotes(repo)
```

`history(repo, limit)`, `head`, `resolve`, `commit`, `object`, `tree`, `show`,
`remotes` and `query` are exported. The facade unwraps `Ok` replies and performs
`Abort` on failures. Object/show results contain `{kind, bytes, encoding, size}`:
`bytes` is a **base64 string**, `encoding` is `"base64"`, and a `text` field is
included for valid UTF-8 bytes. This transport representation differs from the
binary-valued `real-world` facade. History records retain `id`, `tree`, `parents`,
`author`, `committer`, `subject`, `message` and add a numeric `timestamp`.

## JSONL interface and writes

Run `eyg --protocol` and send one JSON object per line. Every request has
`{"op":"git","repo":"/absolute/checkout","action":"..."}`. The action defaults
to `query`. Errors return `{"error":"Name"}`.

| Action | Additional fields | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `head` | none | `{branch,id}` |
| `resolve` | `ref` | SHA-1 string |
| `object` / `commit` / `tree` | `id` or `ref` | object / commit / entries |
| `history` / `query` | options above | commit records |
| `show` | `ref`, `path` | object bytes |
| `remotes` | none | local remote records |
| `init` | `branch` (default `main`) | absolute repository path |
| `write_blob` | `text` or base64 `bytes` | object ID |
| `write_object` | `kind`, `text` or base64 `bytes` | object ID |
| `write_tree` | `entries:[{name,mode,id}]` | tree ID |
| `commit_tree` | `tree`, `parents`, `author`, `committer`, `message` | commit ID |
| `snapshot_tree` | `files:[{path,mode,text/bytes}]` | tree ID |
| `update_ref` | `ref`, `id`, `expected` | published ID |
| `create_branch` | `name`, `id` | published ID |
| `commit_snapshot` | `files`, `ref`, `expected`, identities, `message` | `{id,tree}` |

An identity is `{name,email,timestamp,timezone}`; timezone is `+0000` or similar.
An absent/JSON-null `expected` means the ref must be absent; an existing tip
requires its SHA-1 string. `commit_snapshot` uses the expected tip as its parent
unless `parents` is supplied. A snapshot is the **complete intended tree**.
Writes create objects/refs and do not update the index or working-tree files.
They can also be requested from EYG with `git.query({action: "write_blob", ...})`.

Tree entries are validated and sorted in Git's byte order, including the
trailing slash comparison for directories. Ref publication locks `packed-refs`
then the branch, checks the logical old value, fsyncs the new ref and atomically
renames its lock. Existing locks are preserved. Writers must cooperate with Git's
lock convention. A crash can leave locks or unreachable objects; there are no
reflogs, directory fsync or multi-file crash transactions.

## Libraries and implementation review

- `src/git.zig`: loose objects, v2 pack indexes, 64-bit offsets, OFS/REF delta
  reconstruction, refs, linked worktrees, trees, commits and queries. Reuses
  `std.compress.zlib` and `std.crypto.hash.Sha1`. Every requested object ID and
  index checksum is verified. Pack data checksums are not scanned in full.
- `src/git_write.zig`: reuses the standard zlib encoder (`.fast`), SHA-1,
  filesystem locks, fsync and rename. No C zlib or OpenSSL is necessary for the
  measured workload. A libgit2 binding would remove format code but add an ABI,
  build and audit dependency; it was not used.
- `src/git_config.zig`: a small repository-local parser preserves repeated URLs,
  quoted subsection case, escapes and continuations. It does not resolve global
  configuration, includes, URL rewrites or environment overrides.

The decoded-object cache is scoped to one Repository/request. It caps retained
cache entries at 512 and accounted bytes at 16 MiB, including delta bases. This
**does not bound total arena memory**: response data, uncached objects, temporary
buffers and query metadata live until the caller releases the arena. Mutable
HEAD, refs and config are always read afresh.

SHA-256 repositories, object alternates, shallow boundaries, network transport,
index/status, diff, checkout and merge are unsupported. Delta recursion is capped
at 64, objects at 64 MiB and indexes at 128 MiB. JSON metadata requires UTF-8;
object bytes remain lossless through base64. Large filtered scans and synchronous
fsync writes can exceed 10 ms; the UI must schedule those operations if strict
input responsiveness is required.

## Verify and benchmark

With Zig 0.14.1, from the repository root:

```sh
zig build-exe -O ReleaseFast --dep git -Mroot=packages/zig_runtime/git/driver.zig \
  -Mgit=packages/zig_runtime/src/git.zig -femit-bin=work/git-native
python3 packages/zig_runtime/git/verify_native.py
python3 packages/zig_runtime/git/verify_writes.py
python3 packages/zig_runtime/git/benchmark.py
```

The standalone driver wraps each answer with `result` and `duration_ns`; the
integrated binary returns the raw result. For integrated verification pass
`--binary packages/zig_runtime/zig-out/bin/eyg --protocol`.

Read verification generates 100 seeded binary blobs, checks each loose and packed
against Git, generates 40 commits, and forces both delta formats using a valid
hand-built pack. It also checks linked worktrees, path/message/author queries,
mutable refs, truncated packs and index checksums. Write verification checks
hashes, Git tree order, nested snapshots, fsck, stale tips, owned locks and a
simultaneous compare-and-swap race.

`benchmark.py` compares every returned history ID to Git. Its native roundtrip
includes JSON, fresh repository/index setup, decompression, SHA-1 validation and
full structured records. Its `real-world` comparison uses a binary actually built
from the pinned checkout; it reports cold decoded-cache, warm decoded-cache and
process time separately. OS disk caches are warm. Results go under
`work/git-native-verification`; no universal latency or fastest-possible claim is
inferred from one machine.

`tests/record_git.py` records a real PTY session, verifies visible query results,
and exports an asciinema cast plus MP4. The MP4 renders that captured terminal
stream; it is not a mock TUI animation.

## Effect boundary rationale

The runtime also exposes general `Inflate` and existing `Hash` effects, so an
EYG decompressor or Git implementation can use native byte kernels. The new
`GitQuery` effect is a local object-database capability shared by CLI and TUI. It
is explicit in source, handler-replaceable and useful for structured repository
inspection and atomic local writes; it is not a shell-command escape. A native
backend was chosen after measuring the pinned EYG implementation's query cost.
This adds a platform capability rather than claiming to preserve a pure-EYG Git
implementation unchanged.
````
