```python
"""Contemporaneous native and pinned-real-world history measurements.
Query times include fresh native Repository/index setup and SHA-1 validation.
OS caches are warm; no cold-disk or persistent decoded-cache claims are made.
"""
import argparse,hashlib,json,math,os,platform,statistics,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
from verify_native import ROOT,Native,git

def percentile(samples,p): return sorted(samples)[max(0,math.ceil(len(samples)*p)-1)]
def summary(samples): return dict(samples=len(samples),min_ms=round(min(samples),4),p50_ms=round(statistics.median(samples),4),p95_ms=round(percentile(samples,.95),4),p99_ms=round(percentile(samples,.99),4),max_ms=round(max(samples),4))
def main():
 ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('--binary',default=str(ROOT/'work/git-native'));ap.add_argument('--protocol',action='store_true');ap.add_argument('--repo',default=str(ROOT));ap.add_argument('--repeat',type=int,default=100);ap.add_argument('--count',type=int,default=20);ap.add_argument('--gleam-repeat',type=int,default=3);ap.add_argument('--skip-gleam',action='store_true');args=ap.parse_args()
 repo=Path(args.repo);expected=git(repo,'rev-list','--first-parent',f'--max-count={args.count}','HEAD').decode().splitlines()
 native=Native(args.binary,args.protocol);times=[];engine_times=[]
 try:
  for _ in range(args.repeat):
   start=time.perf_counter_ns();rows=native.call(repo,'history',limit=args.count);elapsed=(time.perf_counter_ns()-start)/1e6
   assert [c['id'] for c in rows]==expected
   times.append(elapsed)
   if native.last_duration_ns is not None:engine_times.append(native.last_duration_ns/1e6)
 finally:native.close()
 result=dict(repo=str(repo),count=len(expected),native_roundtrip=summary(times),native_includes=['JSONL roundtrip','repository and pack-index setup','zlib decoding','SHA-1 object and index checks','full structured commit records'],cache='OS file caches warm; native decoded cache starts empty each query',platform=platform.platform(),logical_cpus=os.cpu_count(),binary_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(args.binary).read_bytes()).hexdigest())
 if engine_times:result['native_engine']=summary(engine_times)
 if not args.skip_gleam:
  oracle=ROOT/'work/oracle-real-world';binary=oracle/'packages/gleam_cli/dist/eyg'
  source=f'''let git = import {json.dumps(str(oracle/'dark/git/index.eyg'))}
let list = import {json.dumps(str(oracle/'dark/shell/stream.eyg'))}
let run = (_) -> {{
  let start = perform Now({{}})
  let records = list.take({args.count},git.commits({json.dumps(str(repo))}))
  let end = perform Now({{}})
  let _ = perform StandardOut(!string_append(!int_to_string(!int_subtract(end,start)),"\\n"))
  !list_fold(records,{{}},(c,_) -> {{ perform StandardOut(!string_append(c.id,"\\n")) }})
}}
let _ = run({{}})
run({{}})'''
  cold=[];warm=[];process=[]
  for _ in range(args.gleam_repeat):
   start=time.perf_counter();run=subprocess.run([str(binary),'run','-c',source],capture_output=True,text=True,cwd=repo,timeout=60);elapsed=(time.perf_counter()-start)*1000
   assert run.returncode==0,(run.stdout,run.stderr)
   lines=run.stdout.splitlines();size=len(expected)+1
   assert len(lines)==size*2 and lines[1:size]==expected and lines[size+1:]==expected,run.stdout
   cold.append(int(lines[0]));warm.append(int(lines[size]));process.append(elapsed)
  result.update(oracle_commit='f1e32bad77d7ffdef6c416cb7ccbf7b23ec0bbd9',gleam_cold_query=summary(cold),gleam_warm_query=summary(warm),gleam_fresh_process=summary(process))
 out=ROOT/'work/git-native-verification';out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);(out/('benchmark-native.json' if args.skip_gleam else 'benchmark.json')).write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
```

```zig
//! Standalone verifier/benchmark driver for the native Git module.
const std = @import("std");
const git = @import("git");
pub fn main() !void {
    var buffered = std.io.bufferedReader(std.io.getStdIn().reader());
    const reader = buffered.reader();
    const writer = std.io.getStdOut().writer();
    while (true) {
        var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.heap.page_allocator);
        defer arena.deinit();
        const a = arena.allocator();
        const line = (try reader.readUntilDelimiterOrEofAlloc(a, '\n', 4 * 1024 * 1024)) orelse break;
        const parsed = try std.json.parseFromSlice(std.json.Value, a, line, .{ .allocate = .alloc_always });
        const start = std.time.nanoTimestamp();
        const answer = git.request(a, parsed.value) catch |err| {
            try writer.print("{{\"error\":\"{s}\"}}\n", .{@errorName(err)});
            continue;
        };
        const elapsed = std.time.nanoTimestamp() - start;
        try writer.writeAll("{\"result\":");
        try std.json.stringify(answer, .{}, writer);
        try writer.print(",\"duration_ns\":{d}}}\n", .{elapsed});
    }
}
```

## `packages/zig_runtime/git/native.eyg`

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/git/native.eyg","sha256":"f7c5818b2a7c82cffe69e3674e100cce19fc1efd6a4338f60c646fbeda4174a9","bytes":1065} -->
```eyg
// Native local Git plumbing. Every I/O boundary remains an explicit effect.
// GitQuery is local to the Zig runtime and never runs a Git subprocess.
let unwrap = match { Ok(value) -> { value } Error(reason) -> { !never(perform Abort(reason)) } }
{
  head: (repo) -> { unwrap(perform GitQuery({action: "head", repo})) },
  resolve: (repo, ref) -> { unwrap(perform GitQuery({action: "resolve", repo, ref})) },
  object: (repo, id) -> { unwrap(perform GitQuery({action: "object", repo, id})) },
  commit: (repo, id) -> { unwrap(perform GitQuery({action: "commit", repo, id})) },
  history: (repo, limit) -> { unwrap(perform GitQuery({action: "history", repo, limit})) },
  tree: (repo, id) -> { unwrap(perform GitQuery({action: "tree", repo, id})) },
  show: (repo, ref, path) -> { unwrap(perform GitQuery({action: "show", repo, ref, path})) },
  remotes: (repo) -> { unwrap(perform GitQuery({action: "remotes", repo})) },
  // Query options are regular EYG records; defaults are applied by the runtime.
  query: (options) -> { unwrap(perform GitQuery(options)) },
}
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Independent Git correctness checks and seeded object/history generation.
Only this verifier invokes Git. Fixtures are isolated under repository work/.
"""
import argparse, base64, hashlib, importlib.util, json, os, random, subprocess
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]

def git(repo, *args, data=None, env=None):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(repo), *args], input=data, env=env)

class Native:
    def __init__(self, binary, protocol=False):
        self.process = subprocess.Popen([str(binary)] + (['--protocol'] if protocol else []), stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
    def call(self, repo, action, **kw):
        self.process.stdin.write(json.dumps(dict(op='git',repo=str(repo),action=action,**kw))+'\n'); self.process.stdin.flush()
        line = self.process.stdout.readline()
        assert line, f'native process exited: {self.process.poll()}'
        result = json.loads(line)
        self.last_duration_ns = result.get('duration_ns') if isinstance(result, dict) else None
        if isinstance(result, dict):
            if 'result' in result: return result['result']
            assert 'error' not in result, result
        return result
    def close(self):
        self.process.stdin.close(); assert self.process.wait(timeout=10) == 0

def commit_data(repo, oid):
    raw = git(repo, 'cat-file', 'commit', oid).decode()
    headers, message = raw.split('\n\n',1); fields={}; parents=[]
    for line in headers.splitlines():
        if line.startswith('parent '): parents.append(line[7:])
        elif line.startswith(('tree ','author ','committer ')):
            k,v=line.split(' ',1); fields[k]=v
    return dict(id=oid,tree=fields['tree'],parents=parents,author=fields['author'],committer=fields['committer'],subject=message.split('\n',1)[0],message=message,timestamp=int(fields['committer'].rsplit(' ',2)[1]))

def main():
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser(); ap.add_argument('--binary',default=str(ROOT/'work/git-native')); ap.add_argument('--protocol',action='store_true'); ap.add_argument('--seed',type=int,default=1847); ap.add_argument('--objects',type=int,default=100); args=ap.parse_args()
    rng=random.Random(args.seed); out=ROOT/'work/git-native-verification'; out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    # A valid handcrafted pack guarantees both REF_DELTA and OFS_DELTA even if
    # this Git version chooses a different compression strategy for random data.
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('real_world_verifier',ROOT/'work/oracle-real-world/dark/git/verify.py'); old=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(old)
    fixture=out/'formats'; samples,idx=old.fixture(fixture)
    subprocess.run(['git','verify-pack',str(idx)],check=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    n=Native(args.binary,args.protocol); checks=0
    try:
        for kind,data,oid in samples:
            value=n.call(fixture,'object',id=oid)
            assert value['kind']==kind
            assert base64.b64decode(value['bytes'])==data==git(fixture,'cat-file',kind,oid)
            checks+=1
        assert n.call(fixture,'show',path='hello.txt')['text']=='hello'; checks+=1
        assert n.call(fixture,'head')['id']==samples[-2][2]; checks+=1
        assert n.call(fixture,'history',limit=20)==[commit_data(fixture,samples[-2][2])]; checks+=1
        # Deep REF_DELTA chains count delta links, not both the lookup wrapper
        # and decoder calls. Forty links is valid and below our depth budget.
        chain_repo=out/'ref-chain'; chain_git=chain_repo/'.git'; (chain_git/'objects/pack').mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        chain_pack=b'PACK'+old.u32(2)+old.u32(41); chain_entries=[]; previous=b'hello'; previous_id=old.oid('blob',previous)
        for i in range(41):
            offset=len(chain_pack)
            if i==0: entry=old.header(3,len(previous))+__import__('zlib').compress(previous)
            else:
                data=previous+bytes([65+i%26]); delta=old.varint(len(previous))+old.varint(len(data))+bytes([0x90,len(previous),1,data[-1]])
                entry=old.header(7,len(delta))+previous_id+__import__('zlib').compress(delta)
                previous=data;previous_id=old.oid('blob',data)
            chain_entries.append((previous_id,offset,__import__('zlib').crc32(entry)));chain_pack+=entry
        pack_hash=old.sha(chain_pack);chain_pack+=pack_hash;ordered=sorted(chain_entries)
        chain_index=b'\xfftOc'+old.u32(2)+b''.join(old.u32(sum(e[0][0]<=i for e in chain_entries)) for i in range(256))
        chain_index+=b''.join(e[0] for e in ordered)+b''.join(old.u32(e[2]) for e in ordered)+b''.join(old.u32(e[1]) for e in ordered)+pack_hash;chain_index+=old.sha(chain_index)
        basename='pack-'+pack_hash.hex();(chain_git/'objects/pack'/f'{basename}.pack').write_bytes(chain_pack);(chain_git/'objects/pack'/f'{basename}.idx').write_bytes(chain_index);(chain_git/'HEAD').write_text(previous_id.hex()+'\n')
        subprocess.run(['git','verify-pack',str(chain_git/'objects/pack'/f'{basename}.idx')],check=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        assert base64.b64decode(n.call(chain_repo,'object',id=previous_id.hex())['bytes'])==previous;checks+=1

        def expect_error(repo, action, **kw):
            n.process.stdin.write(json.dumps(dict(op='git',repo=str(repo),action=action,**kw))+'\n'); n.process.stdin.flush()
            answer=json.loads(n.process.stdout.readline()); assert 'error' in answer,answer
        # A truncated pack must return an error, including Debug builds where
        # unchecked `size - 20` arithmetic would otherwise panic.
        pack=idx.with_suffix('.pack'); packed_bytes=pack.read_bytes()
        try:
            pack.write_bytes(packed_bytes[:12]);expect_error(fixture,'object',id=samples[0][2]);checks+=1
        finally:pack.write_bytes(packed_bytes)
        index_bytes=idx.read_bytes()
        try:
            idx.write_bytes(index_bytes[:-1]+bytes([index_bytes[-1]^1]));expect_error(fixture,'object',id=samples[0][2]);checks+=1
        finally:idx.write_bytes(index_bytes)

        # Every generated object is checked loose and then again after repacking.
        repo=out/f'generated-{args.seed}'; repo.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        if (repo/'.git').exists():
            import shutil; shutil.rmtree(repo/'.git')
        git(repo,'init','-q','-b','main'); git(repo,'config','user.name','Native EYG oracle'); git(repo,'config','user.email','oracle@example.test')
        ids=[]
        for i in range(args.objects):
            alphabet=b'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz\n\x00\xff'
            data=bytes(rng.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(rng.randrange(0,12000)))
            oid=git(repo,'hash-object','-w','--stdin',data=data).decode().strip(); ids.append(('blob',data,oid))
            value=n.call(repo,'object',id=oid); assert base64.b64decode(value['bytes'])==data; checks+=1
        for i in range(40):
            (repo/'changed.txt').write_text(f'{i//3}\n')
            (repo/'periodic.txt').write_text(f'{i//7}\n')
            person='Ada' if i%2 else 'Grace'
            env=os.environ | {'GIT_AUTHOR_NAME':person,'GIT_AUTHOR_DATE':f'{1700000000+i*60} +0000','GIT_COMMITTER_DATE':f'{1700000000+i*60} +0000'}
            git(repo,'add','.'); git(repo,'commit','--allow-empty','-qm',f'change {i}: '+('parser' if i%3 else 'runtime'),env=env)
        # Preserve otherwise-unreachable generated objects during gc by adding tags.
        for i,(_,_,oid) in enumerate(ids): git(repo,'update-ref',f'refs/tags/blob-{i}',oid)
        git(repo,'repack','-adf','--depth=30','--window=30'); git(repo,'prune-packed')
        for kind,data,oid in ids:
            assert base64.b64decode(n.call(repo,'object',id=oid)['bytes'])==git(repo,'cat-file',kind,oid)==data; checks+=1
        expected=git(repo,'rev-list','--first-parent','HEAD').decode().splitlines()
        actual=n.call(repo,'history',limit=100)
        assert actual==[commit_data(repo,oid) for oid in expected]; checks+=len(expected)
        assert n.call(repo,'resolve',ref='HEAD~7')==expected[7]; checks+=1
        assert n.call(repo,'resolve',ref='HEAD^')==expected[1]; checks+=1
        for contains,author in [('parser','Ada'),('runtime','Grace'),('change 1',''),('','Ada')]:
            want=[commit_data(repo,oid) for oid in expected if contains in commit_data(repo,oid)['message'] and author in commit_data(repo,oid)['author']]
            assert n.call(repo,'query',contains=contains,author=author,limit=100)==want; checks+=1
        for path in ['changed.txt','periodic.txt','missing']:
            want=git(repo,'log','--first-parent','--format=%H','--',path).decode().splitlines()
            assert [c['id'] for c in n.call(repo,'query',path=path,limit=100)]==want; checks+=1
        for revision in ['HEAD','HEAD~5','HEAD~20']:
            shown=n.call(repo,'show',ref=revision,path='changed.txt')
            assert base64.b64decode(shown['bytes'])==git(repo,'show',revision+':changed.txt'); checks+=1
        # Detached linked worktrees and packed refs are observed through commondir.
        linked=out/f'linked-{args.seed}'
        if linked.exists():
            import shutil; shutil.rmtree(linked)
        git(repo,'worktree','add','--detach','-q',str(linked),'HEAD~3')
        assert n.call(linked,'head')['id']==expected[3]; checks+=1
        git(repo,'pack-refs','--all'); assert n.call(repo,'head')['id']==expected[0]; checks+=1
        # A ref must stay fresh across requests; immutable-object caching must not
        # turn HEAD into a stale value when another writer updates its target.
        git(repo,'update-ref','refs/heads/main',expected[2])
        assert n.call(repo,'head')['id']==expected[2]; checks+=1
        git(repo,'update-ref','refs/heads/main',expected[0])
        git(repo,'config','--add','remote.Origin.url','https://example.test/a#b')
        git(repo,'config','--add','remote.Origin.url','ssh://example.test/second')
        git(repo,'config','--add','remote.Origin.pushurl','ssh://example.test/push')
        git(repo,'config','--add','remote.Origin.fetch','+refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/Origin/*')
        git(repo,'config','--add','remote.Backup.url','https://example.test/backup')
        remotes=n.call(repo,'remotes')
        assert remotes==[dict(name='Origin',urls=['https://example.test/a#b','ssh://example.test/second'],push_urls=['ssh://example.test/push'],fetch=['+refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/Origin/*']),dict(name='Backup',urls=['https://example.test/backup'],push_urls=['https://example.test/backup'],fetch=[])];checks+=1

        result=dict(passed=True,checks=checks,seed=args.seed,generated_objects=args.objects,generated_commits=40,formats=['loose','packed','OFS_DELTA','REF_DELTA','pack-index-v2','packed-refs','worktree','first-parent','path-history','ref-freshness'],native_git_runtime_dependency=False)
        (out/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n'); print(json.dumps(result))
    finally: n.close()
if __name__=='__main__': main()
```

## `packages/zig_runtime/git/verify_writes.py`

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Native Git writes, checked against Git hashes/fsck and lock races."""
import argparse,base64,hashlib,json,shutil,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from verify_native import ROOT,git,Native

def main():
 ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('--binary',default=str(ROOT/'work/git-native'));ap.add_argument('--protocol',action='store_true');args=ap.parse_args()
 repo=ROOT/'work/git-native-verification/writes';shutil.rmtree(repo,ignore_errors=True)
 native=Native(args.binary,args.protocol);checks=0
 def raw(action,**kw):
  native.process.stdin.write(json.dumps(dict(op='git',repo=str(repo),action=action,**kw))+'\n');native.process.stdin.flush();return json.loads(native.process.stdout.readline())
 def fails(action,reason=None,**kw):
  result=raw(action,**kw);assert 'error' in result,result
  if reason:assert reason in str(result),result
  return result
 person=dict(name='EYG writer',email='eyg@example.test',timestamp=1700000000,timezone='+0000')
 try:
  native.call(repo,'init',branch='main');checks+=1
  fails('init','RepositoryExists');checks+=1
  data=bytes(range(256))*5
  oid=native.call(repo,'write_blob',bytes=base64.b64encode(data).decode());expected=hashlib.sha1(f'blob {len(data)}\0'.encode()+data).hexdigest()
  assert oid==expected and git(repo,'cat-file','blob',oid)==data;checks+=1
  nested=native.call(repo,'write_tree',entries=[dict(name='leaf',mode='100755',id=oid)])
  tree=native.call(repo,'write_tree',entries=[dict(name='a',mode='40000',id=nested),dict(name='a.c',mode='100644',id=oid),dict(name='link',mode='120000',id=oid)])
  rawtree=git(repo,'cat-file','tree',tree)
  assert rawtree.index(b'a.c\0')<rawtree.index(b'a\0');checks+=1
  first=native.call(repo,'commit_tree',tree=tree,parents=[],author=person,committer=person,message='first commit')
  assert git(repo,'cat-file','commit',first).endswith(b'\n\nfirst commit\n');checks+=1
  native.call(repo,'update_ref',ref='refs/heads/main',expected=None,id=first);checks+=1
  fails('update_ref','StaleReference',ref='refs/heads/main',expected=None,id=first);checks+=1
  native.call(repo,'create_branch',name='other',id=first);checks+=1
  fails('create_branch','StaleReference',name='other',id=first);checks+=1
  second=native.call(repo,'commit_snapshot',ref='refs/heads/main',expected=first,files=[dict(path='src/deep/file.txt',text='hello EYG\n',mode='100644'),dict(path='run',text='#!/bin/sh\n',mode='100755')],author=person,committer=person,message='second commit')
  assert git(repo,'show','HEAD:src/deep/file.txt')==b'hello EYG\n';checks+=1
  assert git(repo,'rev-parse','HEAD^').decode().strip()==first;checks+=1
  fails('commit_snapshot','StaleReference',ref='refs/heads/main',expected=first,files=[],author=person,committer=person,message='stale');checks+=1
  fails('write_tree','DuplicatePath',entries=[dict(name='same',mode='100644',id=oid)]*2);checks+=1
  fails('snapshot_tree','InvalidPath',files=[dict(path='../escape',text='bad')]);checks+=1
  fails('snapshot_tree','InvalidPath',files=[dict(path='.git/config',text='bad')]);checks+=1
  fails('snapshot_tree','DuplicatePath',files=[dict(path='file',text='bad'),dict(path='file/sub',text='bad')]);checks+=1
  git(repo,'pack-refs','--all');native.call(repo,'update_ref',ref='refs/heads/main',expected=second['id'],id=first);checks+=1
  # A writer owns only locks it created; failures must preserve somebody else's.
  packedlock=repo/'.git/packed-refs.lock';packedlock.write_text('other writer')
  fails('update_ref',ref='refs/heads/main',expected=first,id=second['id']);assert packedlock.read_text()=='other writer';packedlock.unlink();checks+=1
  lock=repo/'.git/refs/heads/main.lock';lock.write_text('other writer')
  fails('update_ref',ref='refs/heads/main',expected=first,id=second['id']);assert lock.read_text()=='other writer';assert not packedlock.exists();lock.unlink();checks+=1
  request=json.dumps(dict(op='git',repo=str(repo),action='update_ref',ref='refs/heads/main',expected=first,id=second['id']))+'\n'
  cmd=[str(args.binary)]+(['--protocol'] if args.protocol else [])
  contenders=[subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,text=True) for _ in range(2)]
  for process in contenders:process.stdin.write(request);process.stdin.close()
  replies=[json.loads(process.stdout.readline()) for process in contenders]
  for process in contenders:assert process.wait(timeout=10)==0
  assert sum('error' not in reply for reply in replies)==1,replies
  assert git(repo,'rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==second['id'];checks+=1
  subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(repo),'fsck','--strict'],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,check=True);checks+=1
  result=dict(passed=True,checks=checks,features=['SHA1 object names','zlib objects','canonical tree ordering','commit headers','nested complete snapshots','branch create','packed refs','stale-tip CAS','exclusive writer locks','concurrent CAS','git fsck --strict'],mutates_worktree=False)
  (repo.parent/'writes.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(result))
 finally:native.close()
if __name__=='__main__':main()
```

## `packages/zig_runtime/http/README.md`

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/http/README.md","sha256":"6b68eebf1578db196a9b1d602e3f27e59eb19f8917e3ba964a0c27d0d9e7725c","bytes":6999} -->
````text
# Native Fetch

`src/http.zig` implements the `touch_grass/fetch` boundary from `next-tui`
`be502aa03df926a8f9df474a0a7fe16c8fb14fbd`.

```zig
pub fn effect(engine: *Engine, lift: Value) !Value;
pub const Response = struct {
    status: u16,
    headers: []const std.http.Header,
    body: []const u8,
};
pub fn get(allocator: Allocator, url: []const u8) !Response;
```

`effect` receives the actual EYG request record:

```eyg
perform Fetch({
  method: GET({}),
  scheme: HTTPS({}),
  host: "example.test",
  port: None({}),
  path: "/resource",
  query: Some("q=hello%20world"),
  headers: [{key: "Accept", value: "application/json"}],
  body: !string_to_binary(""),
})
```

It returns `Ok({status, headers, body})` or `Error(reason)`. `body` is a real
EYG binary; headers are a list of `{key, value}` records. HTTP 4xx/5xx statuses
remain successful HTTP responses. Reproducible closed-port, untrusted-certificate, hostname-mismatch, redirect-limit
and OPTIONS-body failures preserve the pinned Gleam `NetworkError("...")`
strings. Unmapped native failures retain explicit Zig error names. `get` exposes the same
transport to the read-only hub and returns caller-owned storage with normal Zig
error propagation.

The transport supports HTTP, verified HTTPS, optional ports/query strings,
UTF-8 URL text, binary request/response bodies, gzip/deflate decoding and up to
20 redirects. GET/HEAD ignore the supplied body, as in the reference transport.
POST 301/302 and non-GET/HEAD 303 redirects become GET; 307/308 replay the body.
Authorization, cookies and custom Host headers are removed when redirecting
across scheme, hostname or port. Header framing is generated by the transport;
provided Content-Length, Transfer-Encoding and Proxy-Authorization fields are
not forwarded as destination headers.

Behavior was checked against the actual pinned Gleam decoder, encoder and
`gleam/fetchx`, including its Bun runtime details: ordinary duplicate response
headers keep the last value, Set-Cookie fields remain separate at the end,
TRACE returns an empty body, and OPTIONS with a nonempty body returns an error.
Request header values follow Bun's accepted code points and wire encoding;
response header bytes decode as Latin-1. These observations avoid substituting
assumed browser semantics for the selected oracle.

## Failure compatibility

The failure oracle runs the actual `loam/system.run` and the platform's
`result.map_error(string.inspect)` conversion before `touch_grass/fetch.encode`.
Failure comparisons check complete Result values, including their strings.
`probe_errors.py` saves native/oracle values in `failure-probe.json`.

Some observed cases remain explicit compatibility gaps:

- Invalid headers and out-of-range ports throw JavaScript constructor exceptions
  outside the Result contract. Native Fetch returns an Error value.

The pinned Bun Request constructor recognizes a fixed set of methods; other
OTHER strings become GET. Native Fetch follows that behavior. A refused CONNECT
returns the proxy's HTTP response, including 407, without sending an origin
request or retrying over a direct or plaintext connection.

The report records each counterexample and sets `parity_complete: false` when
any remains. Diagnostic mappings cover the tested failure causes and first-hop
URLs; arbitrary platform/DNS errors and errors after cross-origin redirects are
not claimed to have identical JavaScript diagnostics. Working network behavior
is preserved rather than suppressing or disguising these failures.

## Libraries and review

The implementation reuses `std.http.Client`, `std.Uri`,
`std.crypto.Certificate.Bundle` and native `std.crypto.tls.Client`. It has no
OpenSSL, libcurl or C runtime dependency. HTTP extension methods longer than
std.http's eight-byte Method representation use a small request-line writer
while keeping the same acquired connection, HTTP response parser and TLS.

A review found that Zig 0.14.1's stock proxy CONNECT helper omits configured
proxy authentication and leaves the tunnel at the proxy's transport protocol.
The module therefore performs authenticated CONNECT explicitly and upgrades the
tunnel to TLS with the origin hostname and CA verification. A rejected proxy
request never triggers a direct-connection or plaintext HTTPS fallback.

Proxy configuration comes from `initDefaultProxies`, retaining the inherited
HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/all_proxy settings. Zig 0.14.1 has no NO_PROXY handling,
so exclusions are matched explicitly for every redirect hop. Exact hosts,
domain suffixes, optional ports, bracketed IPv6 exclusions and `*` are supported;
CIDR exclusions are not. Loopback is bypassed only when configured in NO_PROXY.
The process environment is never changed by the module.

On Android, TLS reads both `/apex/com.android.conscrypt/cacerts` and
`/system/etc/security/cacerts`. The directory loader accepts PEM and DER
certificates under hashed names such as `0123abcd.0`; missing platform
directories are skipped, and an empty trust bundle fails closed. Host tests
exercise PEM-only and DER-only stores through real verified local TLS.

TLS loads system trust and adds configured `SSL_CERT_FILE`, `SSL_CERT_DIR` and
`NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS`. Verification remains enabled. Standard-library limits
remain: IP-only subject alternative names and TLS nested through an
HTTPS-schemed proxy are unsupported. A conventional HTTP proxy carrying a
verified HTTPS origin is supported and tested.

Network scratch, connection and CA allocations use a temporary arena released
after each request. Returned bytes and header strings use the caller's allocator.
Responses are limited to 64 MiB, header storage to 64 KiB. I/O is synchronous;
network operations are not included in a universal 10 ms interaction guarantee.

## Reproduce

From the repository root, with Zig 0.14.1:

```sh
zig test packages/zig_runtime/src/http.zig
zig build-exe -O Debug --dep http \
  -Mroot=packages/zig_runtime/http/driver.zig \
  -Mhttp=packages/zig_runtime/src/http.zig -femit-bin=work/http-native
python3 packages/zig_runtime/http/verify.py
```

The verifier uses only loopback servers: HTTP, HTTPS and an authenticated local
CONNECT proxy that can reach only the local fixture origin. It preserves the
normal proxy environment except inside the explicit local-proxy test child.
Temporary test certificates are generated with Python `cryptography` under
`work/http-verification`; they are test fixtures, not application credentials.
The Gleam oracle needs the compiled pinned checkout and Bun from the main
oracle setup. `--skip-oracle` runs native protocol checks alone.

The suite checks all nine exposed method tags, a long OTHER method, binary and
Unicode data, header ordering/duplicates, gzip, redirects, credential stripping,
malformed input, CA and hostname rejection, authenticated TLS tunneling, proxy
refusal without fallback and the shared GET helper. It saves the explicit check
list and comparison count in `work/http-verification/result.json`.
````

## `packages/zig_runtime/http/driver.zig`

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/http/driver.zig","sha256":"8bd5611e10445c1555cf1d0eb15dc4facb44c279eed649e3dad960f5310eb8c9","bytes":1406} -->
```zig
//! Test-only direct Fetch transport, separate from the effect router.
const std = @import("std");
const http = @import("http");

const J = std.json.Value;
pub fn main() !void {
    var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.heap.page_allocator);
    defer arena.deinit();
    const a = arena.allocator();
    const args = try std.process.argsAlloc(a);
    if (args.len == 3 and std.mem.eql(u8, args[1], "--ca-directory")) {
        var bundle = std.crypto.Certificate.Bundle{};
        defer bundle.deinit(a);
        try http.addCertificatesFromDirectory(&bundle, a, args[2]);
        try std.io.getStdOut().writer().print("{d}\n", .{bundle.map.count()});
        return;
    }
    if (args.len == 3 and std.mem.eql(u8, args[1], "--get")) {
        const response = try http.get(a, args[2]);
        try std.json.stringify(response, .{}, std.io.getStdOut().writer());
        try std.io.getStdOut().writeAll("\n");
        return;
    }
    const bytes = try std.io.getStdIn().readToEndAlloc(a, 4 * 1024 * 1024);
    const input = try std.json.parseFromSlice(J, a, bytes, .{ .allocate = .alloc_always });
    var engine = http.Engine.init(a);
    const lift = try engine.fromJson(input.value);
    const result = try http.effect(&engine, lift);
    const json = try engine.toJson(result);
    try std.json.stringify(json, .{}, std.io.getStdOut().writer());
    try std.io.getStdOut().writeAll("\n");
}
```

```javascript
// Actual next-tui touch_grass decoder/encoder and Gleam fetch transport.
// No HTTP behavior is implemented by this adapter.
import { pathToFileURL, fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { dirname, resolve } from 'node:path';
const root = resolve(process.env.EYG_ORACLE_ROOT || resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../../../work/oracle-next-tui'));
const base = resolve(root, 'packages/gleam_cli/build/dev/javascript');
const load = p => import(pathToFileURL(resolve(base,p)).href);
const [runtime, values, dict, fetch, system, results, strings] = await Promise.all([
  'eyg_cli/gleam.mjs','eyg_interpreter/eyg/interpreter/value.mjs','gleam_stdlib/gleam/dict.mjs','touch_grass/touch_grass/fetch.mjs','loam/loam/system.mjs','gleam_stdlib/gleam/result.mjs','gleam_stdlib/gleam/string.mjs'
].map(load));
function decode(v) {
  if ('string' in v) return new values.String(v.string);
  if ('integer' in v) return new values.Integer(v.integer);
  if ('binary' in v) return new values.Binary(new runtime.BitArray(Uint8Array.from(Buffer.from(v.binary['/'].bytes,'base64'))));
  if ('list' in v) return new values.LinkedList(runtime.toList(v.list.map(decode)));
  if ('record' in v) return new values.Record(dict.from_list(runtime.toList(Object.entries(v.record).map(([k,v])=>[k,decode(v)]))));
  if ('tagged' in v) return new values.Tagged(v.tagged.label,decode(v.tagged.value));
  throw new Error('bad fixture');
}
function encode(v) {
  if (v instanceof values.Integer) return {integer:v.value};
  if (v instanceof values.String) return {string:v.value};
  if (v instanceof values.Binary) return {binary:{'/':{bytes:Buffer.from(v.value.rawBuffer).toString('base64').replace(/=+$/,'')}}};
  if (v instanceof values.LinkedList) return {list:Array.from(v.elements).map(encode)};
  if (v instanceof values.Record) return {record:Object.fromEntries(Array.from(dict.to_list(v.fields)).map(([k,v])=>[k,encode(v)]))};
  if (v instanceof values.Tagged) return {tagged:{label:v.label,value:encode(v.value)}};
  throw new Error('bad oracle response');
}
try {
  const request=fetch.decode(decode(JSON.parse(await new Response(Bun.stdin.stream()).text())));
  if (!request.isOk()) throw new Error('invalid request');
  const response=await system.run(system.fetch(request[0]));
  console.log(JSON.stringify(encode(fetch.encode(results.map_error(response,strings.inspect)))));
} catch(error) {
  console.log(JSON.stringify({oracle_exception:{name:error.name,message:error.message,string:String(error)}}));
}
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Print native and actual Gleam host failure values using local fixtures only."""
import json,os
from verify import *
def main():
 out=ROOT/'work/http-verification';out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 native=[str(ROOT/'work/http-native')];oracle=['/workspace/tooling/bin/bun',str(ROOT/'packages/zig_runtime/http/oracle.mjs')]
 plain=Server();closed=Server();port=closed.port;closed.close();context,ca=make_tls(out);secure=Server(context);proxy=Server(handler=Proxy)
 trust=dict(os.environ,SSL_CERT_FILE=str(ca),NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS=str(ca));bad=f'http://test:wrong@127.0.0.1:{proxy.port}';denied=dict(trust,https_proxy=bad,HTTPS_PROXY=bad,no_proxy='',NO_PROXY='')
 invalid=request(plain.port);invalid['record']['method']=tagged('OTHER',string('BAD METHOD'))
 cases=[('closed port',request(port),None),('untrusted TLS',request(secure.port,https=True,host='localhost'),None),('hostname mismatch',request(secure.port,https=True,host='127.0.0.1'),trust),('redirect limit',request(plain.port,'/loop'),None),('invalid header',request(plain.port,headers=[('X-Bad','bad\r\nInjected: yes')]),None),('invalid method',invalid,None),('invalid port',request(70000),None),('proxy denial',request(secure.port,https=True,host='localhost'),denied),('OPTIONS nonempty body',request(plain.port,'/echo',method='OPTIONS',body=b'abc'),None)]
 rows=[]
 try:
  for name,fixture,env in cases:
   actual=run(native,fixture,env=env);expected=run(oracle,fixture,env=env)
   row=dict(name=name,native=actual,oracle=expected);rows.append(row);print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
  (out/'failure-probe.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
 finally:plain.close();secure.close();proxy.close()
if __name__=='__main__':main()
```

## `packages/zig_runtime/http/verify.py`

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/http/verify.py","sha256":"d3ac748e3612e60db9d773acac4bc9631adceea934f1b7e494e676cceb782656","bytes":16976} -->
```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Local-only native Fetch / pinned Gleam oracle checks, including verified TLS.
Needs cryptography for temporary test CA generation; never calls a remote URL.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse,base64,datetime,gzip,hashlib,http.server,json,os,random,select,shutil,socket,ssl,subprocess,sys,threading
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
BODY='Hello 🌿 — λ\n'.encode()

class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
 protocol_version='HTTP/1.1'
 other_port=0
 def log_message(self,*args):pass
 def date_time_string(self,timestamp=None):return 'Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT'
 def answer(self,status,body=b'',headers=()):
  self.send_response(status)
  for name,value in headers:self.send_header(name,value)
  self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(body)));self.end_headers()
  if self.command!='HEAD':self.wfile.write(body)
 def do_GET(self):
  if self.path=='/redirect':return self.answer(302,headers=[('Location','/unicode')])
  if self.path=='/redirect-other':return self.answer(302,headers=[('Location',f'http://127.0.0.1:{self.other_port}/echo')])
  if self.path=='/redirect-same':return self.answer(302,headers=[('Location','/echo')])
  if self.path=='/loop':return self.answer(302,headers=[('Location','/loop')])
  if self.path=='/unicode':return self.answer(200,BODY,[('X-Repeat','one'),('X-Repeat','two'),('Set-Cookie','a=1'),('Set-Cookie','b=2')])
  if self.path=='/latin':return self.answer(200,BODY,[('X-Latin','café')])
  if self.path=='/gzip':return self.answer(200,gzip.compress(BODY,mtime=0),[('Content-Encoding','gzip')])
  if self.path.startswith('/echo'):
   content=self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0')))
   value=dict(method=self.command,path=self.path,body=base64.b64encode(content).decode(),authorization=self.headers.get('Authorization'),cookie=self.headers.get('Cookie'),repeat=self.headers.get('X-Repeat'),content_type=self.headers.get('Content-Type'),custom=self.headers.get('X-Value'))
   return self.answer(200,json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True).encode(),[('Content-Type','application/json')])
  return self.answer(404,b'not found')
 def do_TRACE(self):return self.answer(200,BODY,[('X-Trace','yes')])
 def do_HEAD(self):return self.answer(200,BODY,[('X-Head','yes')])
 def do_POST(self):
  if self.path.startswith('/redirect-'):
   self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0')))
   return self.answer(int(self.path.rsplit('-',1)[1]),headers=[('Location','/echo')])
  return self.do_GET()
 do_DELETE=do_POST
 do_OPTIONS=do_POST
 do_PUT=do_POST
 do_PATCH=do_POST
 do_PROPPATCH=do_POST

class Proxy(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
 protocol_version='HTTP/1.1'
 accepted=0
 def log_message(self,*args):pass
 def date_time_string(self,timestamp=None):return 'Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT'
 def do_CONNECT(self):
  if self.headers.get('Proxy-Authorization')!='Basic dGVzdDpsb2NhbA==':
   self.send_response(407);self.send_header('Content-Length','0');self.end_headers();return
  host,port=self.path.rsplit(':',1)
  if host not in ['localhost','127.0.0.1']:
   self.send_response(403);self.send_header('Content-Length','0');self.end_headers();return
  target=socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',int(port)))
  self.send_response(200);self.end_headers();Proxy.accepted+=1
  try:
   while True:
    ready,_,_=select.select([self.connection,target],[],[],5)
    if not ready:break
    for current in ready:
     data=current.recv(65536)
     if not data:return
     (target if current is self.connection else self.connection).sendall(data)
  finally:target.close();self.close_connection=True

class Server:
 def __init__(self,tls=None,handler=Handler):
  self.server=http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),handler);self.server.daemon_threads=True
  if tls:self.server.socket=tls.wrap_socket(self.server.socket,server_side=True)
  self.port=self.server.server_address[1];self.thread=threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever,daemon=True);self.thread.start()
 def close(self):self.server.shutdown();self.server.server_close();self.thread.join()

def string(s):return dict(string=s)
def integer(n):return dict(integer=n)
def record(**kw):return dict(record=kw)
def tagged(label,value=None):return dict(tagged=dict(label=label,value=record() if value is None else value))
def binary(data):return dict(binary={'/':dict(bytes=base64.b64encode(data).decode().rstrip('='))})
def request(port,path='/unicode',method='GET',body=b'',headers=(),query=None,https=False,host='127.0.0.1'):
 return record(method=tagged(method),scheme=tagged('HTTPS' if https else 'HTTP'),host=string(host),port=tagged('Some',integer(port)),path=string(path),query=tagged('None') if query is None else tagged('Some',string(query)),headers=dict(list=[record(key=string(k),value=string(v)) for k,v in headers]),body=binary(body))
def body(response):return base64.b64decode(response['tagged']['value']['record']['body']['binary']['/']['bytes']+'===')
def headers(response):return [(h['record']['key']['string'],h['record']['value']['string']) for h in response['tagged']['value']['record']['headers']['list']]
def run(command,fixture,env=None):
 result=subprocess.run(command,input=json.dumps(fixture),text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=30,env=env,cwd=ROOT)
 assert result.returncode==0,(result.returncode,result.stdout,result.stderr)
 return json.loads(result.stdout)

def make_tls(out):
 from cryptography import x509
 from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes,serialization
 from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import rsa
 from cryptography.x509.oid import NameOID
 import ipaddress
```

```javascript
// Export fixed type declarations, not inference results, from the pinned source.
// Usage: node scripts/export_types.mjs /absolute/oracle-next-tui
import {pathToFileURL,fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';
import {execFileSync} from 'node:child_process';
import {resolve,dirname} from 'node:path';
import {writeFile} from 'node:fs/promises';
const root=resolve(process.argv[2]);
const expected='be502aa03df926a8f9df474a0a7fe16c8fb14fbd';
if(execFileSync('git',['-C',root,'rev-parse','HEAD'],{encoding:'utf8'}).trim()!==expected)throw new Error('oracle SHA mismatch');
if(execFileSync('git',['-C',root,'status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=no'],{encoding:'utf8'}).trim())throw new Error('oracle tracked files are dirty');
const build=resolve(root,'packages/gleam_cli/build/dev/javascript');
const load=p=>import(pathToFileURL(resolve(build,p)).href);
const [infer,computer,iface]=await Promise.all([
'eyg_analysis/eyg/analysis/inference/levels_j/contextual.mjs',
'loam/loam/platform/computer.mjs','touch_grass/touch_grass/interface.mjs'].map(load));
// The second field of EffectExtend is a tuple, all other type arguments are
// individual type constructors. Var keys are [quantified,id] for schemes.
function type(t){let name=t.constructor.name;if(name==='Var')return ['Var',t.key];if(name==='Fun')return [name,type(t[0]),type(t[1]),type(t[2])];if(name==='RowExtend')return [name,t[0],type(t[1]),type(t[2])];if(name==='EffectExtend')return [name,t[0],type(t[1][0]),type(t[1][1]),type(t[2])];if(t[0])return [name,type(t[0])];return [name];}
const builtins=Object.fromEntries(Array.from(infer.builtins(),([name,scheme])=>[name,type(scheme)]));
const effects=Array.from(iface.types(computer.effects()),([name,[lift,reply]])=>[name,type(lift),type(reply)]);
const out=resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)),'../src');
await writeFile(resolve(out,'builtin_types.json'),JSON.stringify(builtins,null,2)+'\n');
await writeFile(resolve(out,'computer_types.json'),JSON.stringify(effects,null,2)+'\n');
console.log(Object.keys(builtins).length,effects.length);
```

```javascript
// Generate only the program-independent builtin environment displayed by the
// pinned Gleam generic inspector. Runtime frames and values remain native.
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { dirname, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

const packageRoot = resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const oracle = resolve(process.env.EYG_ORACLE_ROOT || resolve(packageRoot, '../../work/oracle-next-tui'));
const sha = execFileSync('git', ['rev-parse', 'HEAD'], { cwd: oracle, encoding: 'utf8' }).trim();
if (sha !== 'be502aa03df926a8f9df474a0a7fe16c8fb14fbd') throw new Error(`Unexpected oracle revision ${sha}`);
const build = resolve(oracle, 'packages/gleam_cli/build/dev/javascript');
const load = path => import(pathToFileURL(resolve(build, path)).href);
const [builtins, runtime, string] = await Promise.all([
  load('eyg_interpreter/eyg/interpreter/builtin.mjs'),
  load('eyg_interpreter/gleam.mjs'),
  load('gleam_stdlib/gleam/string.mjs'),
]);
const text = string.inspect(builtins.default$(runtime.List$Empty$const).builtins);
const manifest = await readFile(resolve(oracle, 'packages/gleam_cli/manifest.toml'));
const manifestHash = createHash('sha256').update(manifest).digest('hex');
const hashFile = async path => createHash('sha256').update(await readFile(path)).digest('hex');
const [generatorHash, builtinHash, inspectorHash] = await Promise.all([
  hashFile(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)),
  hashFile(resolve(build, 'eyg_interpreter/eyg/interpreter/builtin.mjs')),
  hashFile(resolve(build, 'gleam_stdlib/gleam_stdlib.mjs')),
]);
const output = `//! Generated by scripts/generate_inspector.mjs from the actual pinned oracle.\n` +
  `pub const oracle = ${JSON.stringify(sha)};\n` +
  `pub const manifest_sha256 = ${JSON.stringify(manifestHash)};\n` +
  `pub const generator_sha256 = ${JSON.stringify(generatorHash)};\n` +
  `pub const builtin_module_sha256 = ${JSON.stringify(builtinHash)};\n` +
  `pub const inspector_module_sha256 = ${JSON.stringify(inspectorHash)};\n` +
  `pub const builtins = ${JSON.stringify(text)};\n`;
await writeFile(resolve(packageRoot, 'src/generated_builtins_inspect.zig'), output);
console.log(JSON.stringify({ oracle: sha, manifest_sha256: manifestHash, bytes: text.length }));
```

## `packages/zig_runtime/scripts/generate_unicode.py`

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/scripts/generate_unicode.py","sha256":"5934c166342777a67dc99435e0d29c2b3d6f22fafca06671ad4c4ff7a57240f3","bytes":2808} -->
```python
"""Rebuild Unicode 16 tables. Requires regex==2024.11.6 and ICU 76.

Only development uses Python/ICU; the interpreter has no Unicode shared-library
or Python runtime dependency. The generated data are derived from Unicode data
(https://www.unicode.org/license.txt).
"""
import array, ctypes, ctypes.util, pathlib, re, importlib.metadata
import regex
assert importlib.metadata.version("regex") == "2024.11.6", "requires regex==2024.11.6 (Unicode16)"
root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
text = ''.join(map(chr, range(0x110000)))
props = array.array('H', [0]) * len(text)
names = ['CR','LF','Control','Extend','ZWJ','Regional_Indicator','Prepend','SpacingMark','L','V','T','LV','LVT']
for n,name in enumerate(names,1):
 for match in regex.finditer(r'\p{gcb='+name+r'}+', text):
  props[match.start():match.end()] = array.array('H',[n]) * (match.end()-match.start())
for name,bit in [('Extended_Pictographic',32),('InCB=Consonant',64),('InCB=Linker',128),('InCB=Extend',256),('Cased',512),('Case_Ignorable',1024)]:
 for match in regex.finditer(r'\p{'+name+r'}+',text):
  for i in range(match.start(),match.end()): props[i] |= bit
ranges=[]
i=0
while i<len(props):
 j=i+1
 while j<len(props) and props[j]==props[i]:j+=1
 if props[i]: ranges.append((i,j-1,props[i]))
 i=j
libname = ctypes.util.find_library('icuuc')
lib = ctypes.CDLL(libname)
version = re.search(r'\.so\.(\d+)',libname).group(1)
assert version == "76", "requires ICU76 (Unicode16)"
case=[]
for upper in [False,True]:
 func=getattr(lib,('u_strToUpper_' if upper else 'u_strToLower_')+version)
 func.restype=ctypes.c_int32
 func.argtypes=[ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_uint16),ctypes.c_int32,ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_uint16),ctypes.c_int32,ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int32)]
 entries=[]
 for cp in range(0x110000):
  if 0xd800<=cp<=0xdfff:continue
  ch=chr(cp); raw=ch.encode('utf-16-le'); source=(ctypes.c_uint16*(len(raw)//2)).from_buffer_copy(raw)
  output=(ctypes.c_uint16*16)(); error=ctypes.c_int32(0)
  length=func(output,16,source,len(source),b'',ctypes.byref(error))
  result=bytes(output)[:length*2].decode('utf-16-le')
  if result!=ch: entries.append((cp,result))
 case.append(entries)
def zstr(s):return '"'+''.join('\\x%02x'%b for b in s.encode())+'"'
with (root/'src/unicode_data.zig').open('w') as f:
 f.write('// Generated by scripts/generate_unicode.py; Unicode 16, ICU 76.\n')
 f.write('pub const ranges = [_]struct {first:u21,last:u21,flags:u16}{\n')
 for a,b,n in ranges:f.write('    .{.first=0x%x,.last=0x%x,.flags=%d},\n'%(a,b,n))
 f.write('};\n')
 for name,entries in zip(['lower','upper'],case):
  f.write('pub const '+name+' = [_]struct {cp:u21,text:[]const u8}{\n')
  for cp,s in entries:f.write('    .{.cp=0x%x,.text=%s},\n'%(cp,zstr(s)))
  f.write('};\n')
print(len(ranges),*[len(a) for a in case])
```

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env sh
set -eu
repo_dir=$(git -C "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." rev-parse --show-toplevel)
next_sha=be502aa03df926a8f9df474a0a7fe16c8fb14fbd
real_sha=f1e32bad77d7ffdef6c416cb7ccbf7b23ec0bbd9
mkdir -p "$repo_dir/work"
for ref in "$next_sha" "$real_sha"; do
  if ! git -C "$repo_dir" cat-file -e "$ref^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
    git -C "$repo_dir" fetch origin "$ref"
  fi
done
if [ ! -e "$repo_dir/work/oracle-next-tui/.git" ]; then
  git -C "$repo_dir" worktree add --detach work/oracle-next-tui "$next_sha"
fi
if [ ! -e "$repo_dir/work/oracle-real-world/.git" ]; then
  git -C "$repo_dir" worktree add --detach work/oracle-real-world "$real_sha"
fi
test "$(git -C "$repo_dir/work/oracle-next-tui" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$next_sha"
test "$(git -C "$repo_dir/work/oracle-real-world" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$real_sha"
cd "$repo_dir/work/oracle-next-tui/packages/gleam_cli"
gleam build --target javascript --warnings-as-errors
```

## `packages/zig_runtime/scripts/prepare_oracle.py`

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/scripts/prepare_oracle.py","sha256":"18426bfb08394be1d37bea449cb6bd162a264a6a2d717503f1f2d1663d8d6da8","bytes":1505} -->
```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build an isolated oracle at the exact next-tui revision used by the tests."""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import subprocess

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
PIN = "be502aa03df926a8f9df474a0a7fe16c8fb14fbd"
ORACLE = REPO / "work/oracle-next-tui"


def run(*command, cwd=REPO, **kwargs):
    return subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, check=True, **kwargs)


if not ORACLE.exists():
    known = subprocess.run(["git", "cat-file", "-e", PIN + "^{commit}"], cwd=REPO, capture_output=True)
    if known.returncode:
        run("git", "fetch", "origin", PIN)
    ORACLE.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    run("git", "worktree", "add", "--detach", str(ORACLE), PIN)
observed = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=ORACLE, text=True).strip()
if observed != PIN:
    raise SystemExit(f"refusing to use oracle {observed}; expected {PIN}")
dirty = subprocess.check_output(["git", "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=no"], cwd=ORACLE, text=True).strip()
if dirty:
    raise SystemExit("refusing to use modified oracle sources: " + dirty)
target = ORACLE / "packages/gleam_cli"
cached = REPO / "packages/gleam_cli/build"
if cached.exists() and not (target / "build").exists():
    shutil.copytree(cached, target / "build")
env = dict(os.environ)
env["PATH"] = "/workspace/tooling/bin:" + env.get("PATH", "")
run("gleam", "build", "--target", "javascript", "--warnings-as-errors", cwd=target, env=env)
print(f"Gleam oracle ready: {PIN}")
```

```text
#!/usr/bin/env sh
set -eu
package_dir=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
export ZIG_GLOBAL_CACHE_DIR=${ZIG_GLOBAL_CACHE_DIR:-"$package_dir/work/zig-global-cache"}
if command -v zig >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if [ "$(zig version)" = 0.14.1 ]; then
    exec zig "$@"
  fi
fi
if [ -x /workspace/tooling/ziglang/ziglang/zig ]; then
  exec /workspace/tooling/ziglang/ziglang/zig "$@"
fi
if [ ! -x "$package_dir/work/tooling/ziglang/zig" ]; then
  python3 -m pip install --target "$package_dir/work/tooling" 'ziglang==0.14.1'
fi
exec "$package_dir/work/tooling/ziglang/zig" "$@"
```

```zig
//! A session based C ABI shared by Android JNI and the host bridge tests.
//! Output bytes remain valid until the next call on that session or destroy.
//! The caller serializes access except cancel, which is safe during a call.
//! The owner keeps the pointer alive until that call returns.
const std = @import("std");
const interpreter = @import("interpreter.zig");
const parser = @import("parser.zig");
const git = @import("git.zig");
const hub = @import("hub.zig");
const http = @import("http.zig");
const computer = @import("computer.zig");
const codec = @import("ir_codec.zig");
const sources = @import("source.zig");
const effect_cast = @import("effect_cast.zig");
const Json = std.json.Value;
const alloc = std.heap.c_allocator;
const Parent = struct { engine: *interpreter.Engine, path: []const u8, hub_cid: ?[]const u8 = null };
const Session = struct {
    arena: std.heap.ArenaAllocator,
    engine: *interpreter.Engine,
    parents: std.ArrayList(Parent),
    loading: std.StringHashMap(void),
    hub: hub.Cache,
    cancelled: std.atomic.Value(bool),
    directory: []const u8 = ".",
    output: []const u8 = "",
    phase: enum { fresh, suspended, done } = .fresh,
};

export fn eyg_android_create() ?*Session {
    const s = alloc.create(Session) catch return null;
    s.arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(alloc);
    s.cancelled = std.atomic.Value(bool).init(false);
    const a = s.arena.allocator();
    s.engine = a.create(interpreter.Engine) catch {
        s.arena.deinit();
        alloc.destroy(s);
        return null;
    };
    s.engine.* = interpreter.Engine.init(a);
    s.parents = @TypeOf(s.parents).init(a);
    s.loading = std.StringHashMap(void).init(a);
    s.hub = hub.Cache.configured(a) catch {
        s.arena.deinit();
        alloc.destroy(s);
        return null;
    };
    s.hub.transport = cancellableGet;
    s.hub.transport_context = s;
    s.directory = ".";
    s.output = "";
    s.phase = .fresh;
    return s;
}

export fn eyg_android_destroy(optional: ?*Session) void {
    const s = optional orelse return;
    if (s.output.len > 0) alloc.free(s.output);
    s.arena.deinit();
    alloc.destroy(s);
}

export fn eyg_android_cancel(optional: ?*Session) void {
    if (optional) |s| s.cancelled.store(true, .release);
}

fn checkActive(s: *Session) error{Cancelled}!void {
    if (s.cancelled.load(.acquire)) return error.Cancelled;
}

export fn eyg_android_result_len(optional: ?*Session) usize {
    return if (optional) |s| s.output.len else 0;
}

export fn eyg_android_evaluate(optional: ?*Session, input: [*]const u8, len: usize) ?[*]const u8 {
    const s = optional orelse return null;
    evaluate(s, input[0..len]) catch |err| writeError(s, @errorName(err));
    return s.output.ptr;
}

export fn eyg_android_resume(optional: ?*Session, input: [*]const u8, len: usize) ?[*]const u8 {
    const s = optional orelse return null;
    resumeSession(s, input[0..len]) catch |err| writeError(s, @errorName(err));
    return s.output.ptr;
}

/// A separate, bounded VM for synchronous SDK decisions. It cannot suspend or
/// load modules, and never borrows a running foreground session's continuation.
export fn eyg_android_pure(optional: ?*Session, input: [*]const u8, len: usize) ?[*]const u8 {
    const s = optional orelse return null;
    pure(s, input[0..len]) catch |err| writeError(s, @errorName(err));
    return s.output.ptr;
}

fn pure(s: *Session, input: []const u8) !void {
    try checkActive(s);
    if (input.len > 64 * 1024) return error.InputTooLarge;
    const memory = try alloc.alloc(u8, 4 * 1024 * 1024);
    defer alloc.free(memory);
    var fixed = std.heap.FixedBufferAllocator.init(memory);
    const a = fixed.allocator();
    const request = (try std.json.parseFromSlice(Json, a, input, .{ .allocate = .alloc_always })).value;
    if (request != .object) return error.InvalidRequest;
    const source = request.object.get("source") orelse return error.MissingSource;
    if (source != .string or source.string.len > 4096) return error.InvalidPureSource;
    try shallowSource(source.string);
    const requested = request.object.get("max_steps") orelse Json{ .integer = 1000 };
    if (requested != .integer or requested.integer < 1 or requested.integer > 10_000) return error.InvalidStepBudget;
    const budget: usize = @intCast(requested.integer);
    const argument = request.object.get("argument") orelse return error.MissingArgument;
    if (!validSpec(argument, 0)) return error.InvalidInput;
    const ir = blk: {
        // Canonical IR text can select SDK fields that surface EYG identifiers
        // cannot spell (camelCase, reserved words and punctuation).
        if (std.json.parseFromSlice(Json, a, source.string, .{ .allocate = .alloc_always })) |decoded| {
            if (interpreter.validIr(decoded.value)) break :blk decoded.value;
        } else |_| {}
        break :blk try parser.parse(a, source.string);
    };
    try pureIR(ir, 0);
    var engine = interpreter.Engine.init(a);
    engine.max_steps = budget;
    const function = engine.eval(ir) catch |err| return pureFailure(s, &engine, err);
    const spent = engine.steps;
    if (spent >= budget) return error.StepLimit;
    engine.max_steps = budget - spent;
    const value = engine.call(function, &.{try engine.fromJson(argument)}) catch |err| return pureFailure(s, &engine, err);
    try checkActive(s);
    try pureWrite(s, a, try interpreter.object(a, &.{
        .{ "status", .{ .string = "done" } },
        .{ "steps", .{ .integer = @intCast(spent + engine.steps) } },
        .{ "result", try interpreter.object(a, &.{.{ "value", try engine.toJson(value) }}) },
    }));
}

fn pureFailure(s: *Session, engine: *interpreter.Engine, err: anyerror) !void {
    if (engine.failure) |failure| {
        if (failure == .step_limit) return error.StepLimit;
        try pureWrite(s, engine.allocator, try interpreter.object(engine.allocator, &.{
            .{ "status", .{ .string = "done" } },
            .{ "result", try interpreter.object(engine.allocator, &.{.{ "break", try engine.reasonJson(failure) }}) },
        }));
    } else return err;
}

fn pureWrite(s: *Session, a: std.mem.Allocator, value: Json) !void {
    const output = try std.json.stringifyAlloc(a, value, .{});
    if (output.len > 64 * 1024) return error.PureOutputTooLarge;
    const owned = try alloc.dupe(u8, output);
    if (s.output.len > 0) alloc.free(s.output);
    s.output = owned;
}

fn pureIR(ir: Json, depth: usize) !void {
    if (depth > 128 or ir != .object) return error.InvalidPureSource;
    const code = interpreter.stringField(ir, "0") orelse return error.InvalidPureSource;
    if (std.mem.eql(u8, code, "p") or std.mem.eql(u8, code, "h")) return error.PureEffectsNotAllowed;
    if (std.mem.eql(u8, code, ".") or std.mem.eql(u8, code, "@") or std.mem.eql(u8, code, "#")) return error.PureReferencesNotAllowed;
    // These operations can traverse shared DAGs or perform adversarial
    // superlinear substring searches outside the VM step loop. They remain
    // available in the ordinary asynchronous interpreter.
    if (std.mem.eql(u8, code, "b")) {
        const name = interpreter.stringField(ir, "l") orelse "";
        for ([_][]const u8{ "equal", "string_split", "string_split_once", "string_replace" }) |blocked| {
            if (std.mem.eql(u8, name, blocked)) return error.PureBuiltinNotBounded;
        }
    }
    if (std.mem.eql(u8, code, "a")) {
        try pureIR(interpreter.field(ir, "f"), depth + 1);
        try pureIR(interpreter.field(ir, "a"), depth + 1);
    } else if (std.mem.eql(u8, code, "l")) {
        try pureIR(interpreter.field(ir, "v"), depth + 1);
        try pureIR(interpreter.field(ir, "t"), depth + 1);
    } else if (std.mem.eql(u8, code, "f")) try pureIR(interpreter.field(ir, "b"), depth + 1);
}

fn shallowSource(source: []const u8) !void {
    var string = false;
    var escaped = false;
    var nesting: usize = 0;
    for (source) |byte| {
        if (string) {
            if (escaped) escaped = false else if (byte == '\\') escaped = true else if (byte == '"') string = false;
        } else if (byte == '"') {
            string = true;
        } else if (byte == '(' or byte == '[' or byte == '{') {
            nesting += 1;
            if (nesting > 64) return error.InvalidPureSource;
        } else if (byte == ')' or byte == ']' or byte == '}') {
            nesting -|= 1;
        }
    }
}

fn evaluate(s: *Session, input: []const u8) !void {
    try checkActive(s);
    if (input.len > 16 * 1024 * 1024) return error.InputTooLarge;
    if (s.phase == .suspended) return error.AwaitingEffectReply;
    _ = s.arena.reset(.free_all);
    const a = s.arena.allocator();
    s.engine = try a.create(interpreter.Engine);
    s.engine.* = interpreter.Engine.init(a);
    s.parents = @TypeOf(s.parents).init(a);
    s.loading = std.StringHashMap(void).init(a);
    s.hub = try hub.Cache.configured(a);
    const parsed = try std.json.parseFromSlice(Json, a, input, .{ .allocate = .alloc_always });
    if (parsed.value != .object) return error.InvalidRequest;
    if (parsed.value.object.get("hubOrigin")) |origin| {
        if (origin != .string) return error.InvalidHubOrigin;
        s.hub = try hub.Cache.init(a, origin.string);
    }
    s.hub.transport = cancellableGet;
    s.hub.transport_context = s;
    if (parsed.value.object.get("packages")) |packages| {
        try s.hub.ingestPackages(packages);
        s.hub.transport = fixtureGet;
    }
    const directory: Json = parsed.value.object.get("directory") orelse .{ .string = "." };
    if (directory != .string) return error.InvalidDirectory;
    s.directory = try std.fs.path.resolve(a, &.{try nativePath(a, directory.string)});
    attach(s, s.engine, s.directory);
    const ir = if (parsed.value.object.get("program")) |program| program else blk: {
        const source = parsed.value.object.get("source") orelse return error.MissingSource;
        if (source != .string) return error.InvalidSource;
        break :blk try parser.parse(a, source.string);
    };
    if (parsed.value.object.get("input")) |input_value| {
        if (!validSpec(input_value, 0)) return error.InvalidInput;
        try s.engine.bind("input", try s.engine.fromJson(input_value));
    }
    s.phase = .fresh;
    try checkActive(s);
    const value = s.engine.eval(ir) catch |err| return completeError(s, err);
    try complete(s, value);
}

fn resumeSession(s: *Session, input: []const u8) !void {
    try checkActive(s);
    if (s.phase != .suspended) return error.NoPendingEffect;
    if (input.len > 16 * 1024 * 1024) return error.InputTooLarge;
    const parsed = try std.json.parseFromSlice(Json, s.arena.allocator(), input, .{ .allocate = .alloc_always });
    if (!validSpec(parsed.value, 0)) return error.InvalidReply;
    const reply = try s.engine.fromJson(parsed.value);
    const value = s.engine.@"resume"(reply) catch |err| return completeError(s, err);
    try complete(s, value);
}

fn complete(s: *Session, value: interpreter.Value) !void {
    try checkActive(s);
    var current = value;
    while (s.parents.pop()) |parent| {
        _ = s.loading.remove(parent.path);
        if (parent.hub_cid) |cid| remember(s, cid, current);
        s.engine = parent.engine;
        current = s.engine.@"resume"(current) catch |err| return completeError(s, err);
    }
    s.phase = .done;
    try write(s, try object(s, &.{
        .{ "status", .{ .string = "done" } },
        .{ "result", try object(s, &.{.{ "value", try s.engine.toJson(current) }}) },
    }));
}

fn attach(s: *Session, engine: *interpreter.Engine, directory: []const u8) void {
    engine.origin = directory;
    engine.effect_handler = effect;
    engine.effect_context = s;
    engine.reference_handler = reference;
    engine.reference_context = s;
}

fn nativePath(a: std.mem.Allocator, path: []const u8) ![]const u8 {
    if (!std.mem.startsWith(u8, path, "file://")) return path;
    return std.Uri.percentDecodeInPlace(try a.dupe(u8, path[7..]));
}

fn effect(context: ?*anyopaque, engine: *interpreter.Engine, label: []const u8, lift: interpreter.Value) anyerror!interpreter.Value {
    const s: *Session = @ptrCast(@alignCast(context.?));
    try checkActive(s);
    const result = try dispatchEffect(context, engine, label, lift);
    try checkActive(s);
    return result;
}

fn dispatchEffect(context: ?*anyopaque, engine: *interpreter.Engine, label: []const u8, lift: interpreter.Value) anyerror!interpreter.Value {
    const s: *Session = @ptrCast(@alignCast(context.?));
    // Module initialization is pure. Returned functions execute later under
    // the caller's normal phone/native effect handler.
    if (s.parents.items.len != 0) {
        engine.failure = .{ .unhandled_effect = .{ .label = label, .value = lift } };
        return error.Runtime;
    }
    try effect_cast.validateNative(engine, label, lift);
    if (std.mem.eql(u8, label, "Fetch")) return http.effect(engine, lift);
    if (std.mem.eql(u8, label, "EYGParse") or std.mem.eql(u8, label, "DecodeJSON") or std.mem.eql(u8, label, "CreateKey") or std.mem.eql(u8, label, "Sign")) return computer.effect(engine, label, lift);
    if (std.mem.eql(u8, label, "Hash")) {
        const algorithm = try valueField(engine, lift, "algorithm");
        const bytes = try valueField(engine, lift, "bytes");
        if (algorithm != .tagged) return badTerm(engine, "Tagged", algorithm);
        if (bytes != .binary) return badTerm(engine, "Binary", bytes);
        if (std.mem.eql(u8, algorithm.tagged.label, "SHA256")) {
            const digest = try engine.allocator.alloc(u8, 32);
            std.crypto.hash.sha2.Sha256.hash(bytes.binary, digest[0..32], .{});
            return .{ .binary = digest };
        }
        if (std.mem.eql(u8, algorithm.tagged.label, "SHA1")) {
            const digest = try engine.allocator.alloc(u8, 20);
            std.crypto.hash.Sha1.hash(bytes.binary, digest[0..20], .{});
            return .{ .binary = digest };
        }
        return badTerm(engine, "Variant better error needed", algorithm);
    }
    if (std.mem.eql(u8, label, "Inflate")) {
        if (lift != .binary) return badTerm(engine, "Binary", lift);
        const bytes = git.inflate(engine.allocator, lift.binary) catch |err| return engine.tag("Error", .{ .string = @errorName(err) });
        return engine.tag("Ok", .{ .binary = bytes });
    }
    if (std.mem.eql(u8, label, "GitQuery")) {
        var request = try engine.toPlainJson(lift);
        if (request != .object) return engine.tag("Error", .{ .string = "InvalidGitRequest" });
        const repo: Json = request.object.get("repo") orelse .{ .string = "." };
        if (repo != .string) return engine.tag("Error", .{ .string = "InvalidRepositoryPath" });
        const path = try std.fs.path.resolve(engine.allocator, &.{ engine.effect_origin orelse s.directory, try nativePath(engine.allocator, repo.string) });
        try request.object.put("repo", .{ .string = path });
        const response = git.request(engine.allocator, request) catch |err| return engine.tag("Error", .{ .string = @errorName(err) });
        return engine.tag("Ok", try engine.fromPlainJson(response));
    }
    engine.failure = .{ .unhandled_effect = .{ .label = label, .value = lift } };
    return error.Runtime;
}

fn badTerm(engine: *interpreter.Engine, expected: []const u8, got: interpreter.Value) error{Runtime} {
    engine.failure = .{ .incorrect_term = .{ .expected = expected, .got = got } };
    return error.Runtime;
}

fn valueField(engine: *interpreter.Engine, value: interpreter.Value, name: []const u8) anyerror!interpreter.Value {
    if (value != .record) return badTerm(engine, "Record", value);
    for (value.record) |field| if (std.mem.eql(u8, field.name, name)) return field.value;
    engine.failure = .{ .missing_field = name };
    return error.Runtime;
}

fn reference(context: ?*anyopaque, engine: *interpreter.Engine, ir: Json) anyerror!interpreter.Value {
    const s: *Session = @ptrCast(@alignCast(context.?));
    try checkActive(s);
    const code = interpreter.stringField(ir, "0") orelse "";
    if (std.mem.eql(u8, code, "#") or std.mem.eql(u8, code, "@")) {
        if (s.parents.getLastOrNull()) |parent| if (parent.hub_cid != null and std.mem.eql(u8, code, "@") and interpreter.field(ir, "l") == .null) {
            engine.failure = .{ .undefined_reference = ir };
            return error.Runtime;
        };
        const cid = s.hub.referenceCID(ir) catch |err| {
            if (err == error.OutOfMemory) return err;
            engine.failure = .{ .undefined_reference = ir };
            return error.Runtime;
        };
        if (s.hub.modules.get(cid)) |module| if (module.value) |value| return value;
        const tree = s.hub.resolveIR(ir) catch |err| {
            if (err == error.OutOfMemory) return err;
            engine.failure = .{ .undefined_reference = ir };
            return error.Runtime;
        };
        try checkActive(s);
        const key = try std.mem.concat(engine.allocator, u8, &.{ "hub:", cid });
        return load(s, engine, tree, key, s.directory, cid, try sources.content(engine.allocator, cid));
    }
    if (!std.mem.eql(u8, code, ".")) {
        engine.failure = .{ .undefined_reference = ir };
        return error.Runtime;
    }
    const a = engine.allocator;
    if (s.parents.items.len >= 64) return error.ImportDepthLimit;
    if (s.parents.getLastOrNull()) |parent| if (parent.hub_cid != null) {
        engine.failure = .{ .undefined_reference = ir };
        return error.Runtime;
    };
    const location = interpreter.stringField(ir, "i") orelse return error.InvalidImport;
    const path = try std.fs.path.resolve(a, &.{ engine.origin orelse s.directory, try nativePath(a, location) });
    if (s.loading.contains(path)) return error.CyclicImport;
    const source = std.fs.cwd().readFileAlloc(a, path, 64 * 1024 * 1024) catch {
        engine.failure = .{ .undefined_reference = ir };
        return error.Runtime;
    };
    try checkActive(s);
    const parsed = try sources.disk(a, source, path);
    return load(s, engine, parsed.program, path, std.fs.path.dirname(path) orelse ".", null, parsed.meta);
}

fn load(s: *Session, engine: *interpreter.Engine, tree: Json, path: []const u8, directory: []const u8, cid: ?[]const u8, meta: interpreter.InspectionMeta) anyerror!interpreter.Value {
    try checkActive(s);
    const a = engine.allocator;
    if (s.parents.items.len >= 64) return error.ImportDepthLimit;
    if (s.loading.contains(path)) return error.CyclicImport;
    try s.loading.put(path, {});
    try s.parents.append(.{ .engine = engine, .path = path, .hub_cid = cid });
    const imported = try a.create(interpreter.Engine);
    imported.* = interpreter.Engine.init(a);
    attach(s, imported, directory);
    imported.inspection_meta = meta;
    imported.effect_handler = null;
    s.engine = imported;
    // Keep the child engine and parent frame until initialization returns,
    // preserving the child diagnostic if a nested reference fails.
    const result = try imported.eval(tree);
    _ = s.parents.pop();
    _ = s.loading.remove(path);
    if (cid) |key| remember(s, key, result);
    s.engine = engine;
    return result;
}

fn remember(s: *Session, cid: []const u8, value: interpreter.Value) void {
    if (s.hub.modules.getPtr(cid)) |module| module.value = value;
}

fn fixtureGet(_: ?*anyopaque, _: std.mem.Allocator, _: []const u8) anyerror!hub.Response {
    return error.NoModule;
}

fn cancellableGet(context: ?*anyopaque, a: std.mem.Allocator, url: []const u8) anyerror!hub.Response {
    const s: *Session = @ptrCast(@alignCast(context.?));
    try checkActive(s);
    const response = http.get(a, url) catch |err| {
        try checkActive(s);
        return err;
    };
    try checkActive(s);
    return response;
}

fn completeError(s: *Session, err: anyerror) !void {
    try checkActive(s);
    if (err != error.Runtime) return err;
    const failure = s.engine.failure orelse return error.MissingFailure;
    if (failure == .unhandled_effect and s.parents.items.len == 0) {
        s.phase = .suspended;
        const pending = failure.unhandled_effect;
        try write(s, try object(s, &.{
            .{ "status", .{ .string = "effect" } },
            .{ "effect", try object(s, &.{
                .{ "label", .{ .string = pending.label } },
                .{ "value", try s.engine.toJson(pending.value) },
            }) },
        }));
    } else {
        s.phase = .done;
        try write(s, try object(s, &.{
            .{ "status", .{ .string = "done" } },
            .{ "result", try object(s, &.{.{ "break", try s.engine.reasonJson(failure) }}) },
        }));
    }
}

fn object(s: *Session, fields: []const struct { []const u8, Json }) !Json {
    var result = std.json.ObjectMap.init(s.arena.allocator());
    for (fields) |field| try result.put(field[0], field[1]);
    return .{ .object = result };
}
fn write(s: *Session, value: Json) !void {
    const output = try std.json.stringifyAlloc(alloc, value, .{});
    if (s.output.len > 0) alloc.free(s.output);
    s.output = output;
}
fn writeError(s: *Session, reason: []const u8) void {
    const output = std.fmt.allocPrint(alloc, "{{\"status\":\"error\",\"error\":\"{s}\"}}", .{reason}) catch return;
    if (s.output.len > 0) alloc.free(s.output);
    s.output = output;
}

fn validSpec(value: Json, depth: usize) bool {
    if (depth > 128 or value != .object or value.object.count() != 1) return false;
    if (value.object.get("integer")) |i| return codec.jsonInteger(i) != null;
    if (value.object.get("string")) |s| return s == .string;
    if (value.object.get("binary")) |b| {
        if (b != .object) return false;
        const slash = b.object.get("/") orelse return false;
        if (slash != .object) return false;
        const bytes = slash.object.get("bytes") orelse return false;
        if (bytes != .string) return false;
        return codec.base64Size(bytes.string) != null;
    }
    if (value.object.get("record")) |r| {
        if (r != .object) return false;
        for (r.object.values()) |v| if (!validSpec(v, depth + 1)) return false;
        return true;
    }
    if (value.object.get("list")) |list| {
        if (list != .array) return false;
        for (list.array.items) |v| if (!validSpec(v, depth + 1)) return false;
        return true;
    }
    if (value.object.get("tagged")) |t| {
        if (t != .object) return false;
        const label = t.object.get("label") orelse return false;
        const inner = t.object.get("value") orelse return false;
        return label == .string and validSpec(inner, depth + 1);
    }
    return false;
}
```

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/src/async_git.zig","sha256":"18de5bfb31dc04237bf615f9a0231626b2d0cd52399a7ba4e6186e16a26d0ed7","bytes":3727} -->
```zig
//! A Git effect runs outside the UI thread. The worker owns all its memory;
//! only a completed immutable result crosses back to the interpreter.
const std = @import("std");
const git = @import("git.zig");
const J = std.json.Value;

pub const Worker = struct {
    arena: std.heap.ArenaAllocator,
    request: J,
    response: union(enum) { pending, success: J, failure: anyerror } = .pending,
    completed: std.atomic.Value(bool) = std.atomic.Value(bool).init(false),
    owners: std.atomic.Value(usize) = std.atomic.Value(usize).init(2),
    thread: ?std.Thread = null,
    cancelled: bool = false,

    pub fn start(request: J) !*Worker {
        const self = try std.heap.page_allocator.create(Worker);
        self.* = .{ .arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.heap.page_allocator), .request = .null };
        errdefer {
            self.arena.deinit();
            std.heap.page_allocator.destroy(self);
        }
        const a = self.arena.allocator();
        const bytes = try std.json.stringifyAlloc(a, request, .{});
        self.request = (try std.json.parseFromSlice(J, a, bytes, .{ .allocate = .alloc_always })).value;
        self.thread = try std.Thread.spawn(.{}, run, .{self});
        return self;
    }
    fn run(self: *Worker) void {
        defer self.release();
        if (git.request(self.arena.allocator(), self.request)) |value| self.response = .{ .success = value } else |err| self.response = .{ .failure = err };
        self.completed.store(true, .release);
    }
    pub fn ready(self: *Worker) bool {
        return self.completed.load(.acquire);
    }
    /// The caller consumes/clones a ready response before releasing its owner.
    /// An unfinished job owns its snapshot until completion, so terminal
    /// shutdown never waits for filesystem I/O and cannot free worker storage.
    pub fn destroy(self: *Worker) void {
        if (self.thread) |thread| thread.detach();
        self.release();
    }
    fn release(self: *Worker) void {
        if (self.owners.fetchSub(1, .acq_rel) != 1) return;
        self.arena.deinit();
        std.heap.page_allocator.destroy(self);
    }
};

test "worker error result crosses an acquire/release boundary" {
    var request = std.json.ObjectMap.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer request.deinit();
    try request.put("repo", .{ .string = "/definitely-missing-eyg-repository" });
    const job = try Worker.start(.{ .object = request });
    defer job.destroy();
    while (!job.ready()) std.Thread.yield() catch {};
    try std.testing.expect(job.response == .failure);
}

test "releasing the UI owner does not wait for the worker" {
    const Flag = std.atomic.Value(bool);
    const Gate = struct {
        worker: *Worker,
        started: Flag = Flag.init(false),
        proceed: Flag = Flag.init(false),
        finished: Flag = Flag.init(false),

        fn run(gate: *@This()) void {
            gate.started.store(true, .release);
            while (!gate.proceed.load(.acquire)) std.Thread.yield() catch {};
            gate.worker.completed.store(true, .release);
            gate.worker.release();
            gate.finished.store(true, .release);
        }
    };
    const worker = try std.heap.page_allocator.create(Worker);
    worker.* = .{ .arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.heap.page_allocator), .request = .null };
    var gate = Gate{ .worker = worker };
    worker.thread = try std.Thread.spawn(.{}, Gate.run, .{&gate});
    while (!gate.started.load(.acquire)) std.Thread.yield() catch {};
    worker.destroy();
    // A join here would deadlock: only the returning UI can open this gate.
    gate.proceed.store(true, .release);
    while (!gate.finished.load(.acquire)) std.Thread.yield() catch {};
}
```
