<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/src/async_hub.zig","sha256":"4ffaf3686cea1aacb8ff9e3b1a803e8ac5a8e873329dea37e783bc9c02c76e20","bytes":8476} -->
```zig
//! Hub I/O and decoding run in an independent arena. The UI merges a completed
//! immutable snapshot; no mutable cache or interpreter allocation crosses threads.
const std = @import("std");
const hub = @import("hub.zig");
const runtime = @import("interpreter.zig");
const J = std.json.Value;
const A = std.mem.Allocator;

pub const Worker = struct {
    arena: std.heap.ArenaAllocator,
    origin: []const u8,
    reference: ?J,
    seed: J,
    snapshot: J = .null,
    failure: ?anyerror = null,
    completed: std.atomic.Value(bool) = std.atomic.Value(bool).init(false),
    references: std.atomic.Value(u32) = std.atomic.Value(u32).init(2),
    thread: ?std.Thread = null,

    /// null reference replicates the package ledger; a reference fetches its
    /// verified module and every pinned/content dependency.
    pub fn start(cache: *const hub.Cache, reference: ?J) !*Worker {
        const self = try std.heap.page_allocator.create(Worker);
        self.* = .{ .arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.heap.page_allocator), .origin = "", .reference = null, .seed = .null };
        errdefer {
            self.arena.deinit();
            std.heap.page_allocator.destroy(self);
        }
        const a = self.arena.allocator();
        self.origin = try a.dupe(u8, cache.origin);
        // Cache strings/programs live in the UI arena. Deep-copy through the
        // transport before the worker starts, not while it is running.
        self.seed = try clone(a, try exportCache(a, cache));
        if (reference) |ref| self.reference = try clone(a, ref);
        self.thread = try std.Thread.spawn(.{}, run, .{self});
        return self;
    }
    fn run(self: *Worker) void {
        self.execute() catch |err| {
            self.failure = err;
        };
        self.completed.store(true, .release);
        self.release();
    }
    fn execute(self: *Worker) !void {
        var cache = try hub.Cache.init(self.arena.allocator(), self.origin);
        try mergeCache(&cache, self.seed);
        defer {
            self.snapshot = exportCache(self.arena.allocator(), &cache) catch |err| snapshot: {
                self.failure = err;
                break :snapshot .null;
            };
        }
        if (self.reference) |ref| {
            var seen = std.StringHashMap(void).init(self.arena.allocator());
            try fetchReference(&cache, ref, &seen);
        } else try cache.refresh();
    }
    pub fn ready(self: *Worker) bool {
        return self.completed.load(.acquire);
    }
    pub fn merge(self: *Worker, cache: *hub.Cache) !void {
        if (self.snapshot != .null) try mergeCache(cache, self.snapshot);
        if (self.failure) |err| cache.last_error = @errorName(err);
    }
    pub fn destroy(self: *Worker) void {
        // Read-only network I/O must not hold terminal cleanup. This worker
        // owns all request/result storage and never accesses the departed UI.
        if (self.thread) |thread| thread.detach();
        self.release();
    }
    fn release(self: *Worker) void {
        if (self.references.fetchSub(1, .acq_rel) == 1) {
            self.arena.deinit();
            std.heap.page_allocator.destroy(self);
        }
    }
};

fn clone(a: A, value: J) !J {
    const bytes = try std.json.stringifyAlloc(a, value, .{});
    return (try std.json.parseFromSlice(J, a, bytes, .{ .allocate = .alloc_always })).value;
}

pub fn exportCache(a: A, cache: *const hub.Cache) !J {
    var latest = std.ArrayList(J).init(a);
    var releases = std.ArrayList(J).init(a);
    var modules = std.ArrayList(J).init(a);
    var packages = cache.latest.valueIterator();
    while (packages.next()) |p| try latest.append(try runtime.object(a, &.{
        .{ "name", .{ .string = p.name } }, .{ "version", .{ .integer = p.version } },
        .{ "cid", .{ .string = p.cid } },   .{ "cursor", .{ .integer = p.cursor } },
    }));
    var release_it = cache.releases.iterator();
    while (release_it.next()) |entry| try releases.append(try runtime.object(a, &.{ .{ "key", .{ .string = entry.key_ptr.* } }, .{ "cid", .{ .string = entry.value_ptr.* } } }));
    var module_it = cache.modules.iterator();
    while (module_it.next()) |entry| try modules.append(try runtime.object(a, &.{ .{ "cid", .{ .string = entry.key_ptr.* } }, .{ "bytes", .{ .string = try hub.canonicalBytes(a, entry.value_ptr.source) } } }));
    return runtime.object(a, &.{ .{ "latest", .{ .array = latest } }, .{ "releases", .{ .array = releases } }, .{ "modules", .{ .array = modules } }, .{ "cursor", .{ .integer = cache.cursor } }, .{ "pulled", .{ .bool = cache.pulled } }, .{ "refresh_on_miss", .{ .bool = cache.refresh_on_miss } } });
}

pub fn mergeCache(cache: *hub.Cache, snapshot: J) !void {
    const a = cache.allocator;
    const latest = runtime.field(snapshot, "latest");
    if (latest == .array) for (latest.array.items) |entry| {
        try cache.addPackage(runtime.stringField(entry, "name") orelse return error.InvalidCacheSnapshot, runtime.field(entry, "version").integer, runtime.stringField(entry, "cid") orelse return error.InvalidCacheSnapshot, runtime.field(entry, "cursor").integer);
    };
    const releases = runtime.field(snapshot, "releases");
    if (releases == .array) for (releases.array.items) |entry| {
        const key = runtime.stringField(entry, "key") orelse return error.InvalidCacheSnapshot;
        const cid = runtime.stringField(entry, "cid") orelse return error.InvalidCacheSnapshot;
        try cache.releases.put(try a.dupe(u8, key), try a.dupe(u8, cid));
    };
    const modules = runtime.field(snapshot, "modules");
    if (modules == .array) for (modules.array.items) |entry| {
        const cid = runtime.stringField(entry, "cid") orelse return error.InvalidCacheSnapshot;
        if (!cache.modules.contains(cid)) _ = try cache.ingestModule(cid, runtime.stringField(entry, "bytes") orelse return error.InvalidCacheSnapshot);
    };
    const cursor = runtime.field(snapshot, "cursor");
    const refresh = runtime.field(snapshot, "refresh_on_miss");
    if (refresh == .bool) cache.refresh_on_miss = refresh.bool;
    if (cursor == .integer and cursor.integer >= cache.cursor) {
        cache.cursor = cursor.integer;
        const pulled = runtime.field(snapshot, "pulled");
        if (pulled == .bool) cache.pulled = pulled.bool;
    }
}

fn fetchReference(cache: *hub.Cache, reference: J, seen: *std.StringHashMap(void)) anyerror!void {
    const cid = try cache.referenceCID(reference);
    if (seen.contains(cid)) return;
    if (seen.count() >= 10000) return error.ModuleDependencyLimit;
    try seen.put(cid, {});
    const source = try cache.resolveIR(reference);
    try fetchDependencies(cache, source, seen);
}
fn fetchDependencies(cache: *hub.Cache, value: J, seen: *std.StringHashMap(void)) anyerror!void {
    switch (value) {
        .object => |object| {
            const code = runtime.stringField(value, "0") orelse "";
            if (std.mem.eql(u8, code, "#") or (std.mem.eql(u8, code, "@") and runtime.field(value, "l") != .null)) {
                try fetchReference(cache, value, seen);
                return;
            }
            for (object.values()) |child| try fetchDependencies(cache, child, seen);
        },
        .array => |array| for (array.items) |child| try fetchDependencies(cache, child, seen),
        else => {},
    }
}

test "hub snapshots own transferred programs and verify their content" {
    var source_arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    var target_arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer target_arena.deinit();
    const a = source_arena.allocator();
    var source = try hub.Cache.init(a, "http://localhost:1");
    const program = try runtime.object(a, &.{ .{ "0", .{ .string = "i" } }, .{ "v", .{ .integer = 42 } } });
    const cid = try hub.canonicalCID(a, program);
    _ = try source.ingestModule(cid, try hub.canonicalBytes(a, program));
    try source.addPackage("demo", 1, cid, 1);
    source.pulled = true;
    var target = try hub.Cache.init(target_arena.allocator(), "http://localhost:1");
    try mergeCache(&target, try exportCache(a, &source));
    source_arena.deinit();
    var engine = runtime.Engine.init(target_arena.allocator());
    const value = try target.resolve(&engine, try runtime.object(target_arena.allocator(), &.{ .{ "0", .{ .string = "@" } }, .{ "p", .{ .string = "demo" } } }));
    try std.testing.expectEqual(@as(i64, 42), value.integer);
}
```

```zig
const std = @import("std");
const tui = @import("tui.zig");
const parser = @import("parser.zig");

fn key(a: std.mem.Allocator, name: []const u8) !std.json.Value {
    return parser.object(a, &.{.{ "key", .{ .string = name } }});
}
fn start(a: std.mem.Allocator, shell: *tui.Tui) !void {
    try shell.event(try parser.object(a, &.{.{ "paste", .{ .string = "perform GitQuery({repo: \"/definitely-missing-eyg-repository\", action: \"head\"})" } }}));
    try shell.event(try key(a, "enter"));
}
test "Git effect suspends and completes on the UI thread" {
    var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer arena.deinit();
    const a = arena.allocator();
    var shell = tui.Tui.init(a);
    defer shell.shutdown();
    try start(a, &shell);
    try std.testing.expect(shell.hasPendingWork());
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("running", @tagName(shell.mode));
    const deadline = std.time.nanoTimestamp() + 5 * std.time.ns_per_s;
    while (shell.hasPendingWork() and std.time.nanoTimestamp() < deadline) {
        _ = try shell.pollWork();
        std.Thread.yield() catch {};
    }
    try std.testing.expect(!shell.hasPendingWork());
    try std.testing.expectEqual(@as(usize, 1), shell.history.items.len);
    const value = shell.history.items[0].value orelse return error.MissingQueryResult;
    try std.testing.expect(value == .tagged);
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("Error", value.tagged.label);
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("GitQuery", shell.history.items[0].occured[0].label);
}
test "cancelling a worker preserves the cancelled history outcome" {
    var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer arena.deinit();
    const a = arena.allocator();
    var shell = tui.Tui.init(a);
    defer shell.shutdown();
    try start(a, &shell);
    try shell.event(try key(a, "esc"));
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("Cancelled", shell.history.items[0].result.?);
    const deadline = std.time.nanoTimestamp() + 5 * std.time.ns_per_s;
    while (shell.hasPendingWork() and std.time.nanoTimestamp() < deadline) {
        _ = try shell.pollWork();
        std.Thread.yield() catch {};
    }
    try std.testing.expectEqual(@as(usize, 1), shell.history.items.len);
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("Cancelled", shell.history.items[0].result.?);
}
```

```zig
//! Reify a runtime value as closed canonical EYG IR. Closure environments retain
//! only free variables, sharing equal definitions and renaming shadowed ones.
const std = @import("std");
const runtime = @import("interpreter.zig");
const A = std.mem.Allocator;
const J = std.json.Value;
const V = runtime.Value;
const Definition = struct { name: []const u8, source: J };
const Rename = struct { scoped: []const u8, name: []const u8 };
const Ignore = struct { name: []const u8, next: ?*const Ignore };
const Capture = struct {
    allocator: A,
    definitions: std.ArrayList(Definition),
    fn node(c: *Capture, code: []const u8, fields: []const struct { []const u8, J }) !J {
        var result = try runtime.object(c.allocator, &.{.{ "0", .{ .string = code } }});
        for (fields) |f| try result.object.put(f[0], f[1]);
        return result;
    }
    fn apply(c: *Capture, f: J, arg: J) !J {
        return c.node("a", &.{ .{ "f", f }, .{ "a", arg } });
    }
    fn value(c: *Capture, input: V) anyerror!J {
        return switch (input) {
            .integer => |i| c.node("i", &.{.{ "v", .{ .integer = i } }}),
            .javascript_integer => |f| c.node("i", &.{.{ "v", .{ .float = f } }}),
            .string => |s| c.node("s", &.{.{ "v", .{ .string = s } }}),
            .binary => |b| c.node("x", &.{.{ "v", try runtime.encodeBytes(c.allocator, b) }}),
            .tagged => |t| c.apply(try c.node("t", &.{.{ "l", .{ .string = t.label } }}), try c.value(t.value)),
            .record => |input_fields| blk: {
                const fields = try @import("oracle_order.zig").fields(c.allocator, input_fields);
                var result = try c.node("u", &.{});
                var i = fields.len;
                while (i > 0) {
                    i -= 1;
                    const field = fields[i];
                    const item = try c.value(field.value);
                    result = try c.apply(try c.apply(try c.node("e", &.{.{ "l", .{ .string = field.name } }}), item), result);
                }
                break :blk result;
            },
            .list => |head| blk: {
                var values = std.ArrayList(V).init(c.allocator);
                var cursor = head;
                while (cursor) |cell| : (cursor = cell.tail) try values.append(cell.head);
                var result = try c.node("ta", &.{});
                var i = values.items.len;
                while (i > 0) {
                    i -= 1;
                    const item = try c.value(values.items[i]);
                    result = try c.apply(try c.apply(try c.node("c", &.{}), item), result);
                }
                break :blk result;
            },
            .partial => |p| blk: {
                const code = switch (p.kind) {
                    .cons => "c",
                    .extend => "e",
                    .overwrite => "o",
                    .select => "g",
                    .tag => "t",
                    .match => "m",
                    .no_cases => "n",
                    .perform => "p",
                    .handle => "h",
                    .builtin => "b",
                };
                var result = try c.node(code, if (p.kind == .cons or p.kind == .no_cases) &.{} else &.{.{ "l", .{ .string = p.label } }});
                for (p.args) |arg| result = try c.apply(result, try c.value(arg));
                break :blk result;
            },
            .@"resume" => error.CannotCaptureContinuation,
            .closure => |closure| blk: {
                var names = std.ArrayList([]const u8).init(c.allocator);
                const ignore = Ignore{ .name = closure.param, .next = null };
                try freeVariables(closure.body, &ignore, &names);
                var renames = std.ArrayList(Rename).init(c.allocator);
                for (names.items) |name| {
                    var cursor = closure.env;
                    var captured: ?V = null;
                    while (cursor) |binding| : (cursor = binding.next) {
                        if (runtime.eq(name, binding.name)) {
                            captured = binding.value;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    const term = captured orelse continue;
                    const expression = try c.value(term);
                    var old: ?J = null;
                    for (c.definitions.items) |definition| {
                        if (runtime.eq(definition.name, name)) {
                            old = definition.source;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (old) |previous| {
                        if (canonicalEqual(previous, expression)) continue;
                        const prefix = try std.mem.concat(c.allocator, u8, &.{ name, "#" });
                        var existing: ?[]const u8 = null;
                        for (c.definitions.items) |definition| if (std.mem.startsWith(u8, definition.name, prefix) and canonicalEqual(definition.source, expression)) {
                            existing = definition.name;
                            break;
                        };
                        const scoped = existing orelse try std.fmt.allocPrint(c.allocator, "{s}#{d}", .{ name, c.definitions.items.len });
                        if (existing == null) try c.definitions.insert(0, .{ .name = scoped, .source = expression });
                        try renames.insert(0, .{ .scoped = scoped, .name = name });
                    } else try c.definitions.insert(0, .{ .name = name, .source = expression });
                }
                var result = try c.node("f", &.{ .{ "l", .{ .string = closure.param } }, .{ "b", closure.body } });
                for (renames.items) |rename| result = try c.node("l", &.{ .{ "l", .{ .string = rename.name } }, .{ "v", try c.node("v", &.{.{ "l", .{ .string = rename.scoped } }}) }, .{ "t", result } });
                break :blk result;
            },
        };
    }
};
fn freeVariables(source: J, ignore: ?*const Ignore, names: *std.ArrayList([]const u8)) anyerror!void {
    const code = runtime.stringField(source, "0") orelse return;
    if (runtime.eq(code, "v")) {
        const name = runtime.stringField(source, "l") orelse return;
        var cursor = ignore;
        while (cursor) |binding| : (cursor = binding.next) if (runtime.eq(binding.name, name)) return;
        for (names.items) |existing| if (runtime.eq(existing, name)) return;
        try names.append(name);
    } else if (runtime.eq(code, "a")) {
        try freeVariables(runtime.field(source, "f"), ignore, names);
        try freeVariables(runtime.field(source, "a"), ignore, names);
    } else if (runtime.eq(code, "f") or runtime.eq(code, "l")) {
        if (runtime.eq(code, "l")) try freeVariables(runtime.field(source, "v"), ignore, names);
        const inner = Ignore{ .name = runtime.stringField(source, "l") orelse "", .next = ignore };
        try freeVariables(runtime.field(source, if (runtime.eq(code, "f")) "b" else "t"), &inner, names);
    }
}
fn canonicalEqual(a: J, b: J) bool {
    if (a == .object and b == .object) {
        var it = a.object.iterator();
        while (it.next()) |entry| {
            if (runtime.eq(entry.key_ptr.*, "_native_node")) continue;
            const other = b.object.get(entry.key_ptr.*) orelse return false;
            if (!canonicalEqual(entry.value_ptr.*, other)) return false;
        }
        it = b.object.iterator();
        while (it.next()) |entry| if (!runtime.eq(entry.key_ptr.*, "_native_node") and !a.object.contains(entry.key_ptr.*)) return false;
        return true;
    }
    return runtime.jsonEqual(a, b);
}
pub fn capture(allocator: A, value: V) anyerror!J {
    var state = Capture{ .allocator = allocator, .definitions = std.ArrayList(Definition).init(allocator) };
    var result = try state.value(value);
    for (state.definitions.items) |definition| result = try state.node("l", &.{ .{ "l", .{ .string = definition.name } }, .{ "v", definition.source }, .{ "t", result } });
    return result;
}
test "capture preserves lexical closure shadowing" {
    var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer arena.deinit();
    const a = arena.allocator();
    const parser = @import("parser.zig");
    var engine = runtime.Engine.init(a);
    const original = try engine.eval(try parser.parse(a, "let x = 42 let f = (y) -> { !int_add(x, y) } f"));
    const source = try capture(a, original);
    var fresh = runtime.Engine.init(a);
    const restored = try fresh.eval(source);
    const got = try fresh.call(restored, &.{.{ .integer = 8 }});
    try std.testing.expectEqual(@as(i64, 50), got.integer);
}
```

```zig
//! Pure computer effects with the pinned touch_grass wire contracts.
//! JSON uses Julienne's lexical number/flat-stream model rather than f64 trees.
const std = @import("std");
pub const runtime = @import("interpreter.zig");
const parser = @import("parser.zig");
const codec = @import("ir_codec.zig");
const Engine = runtime.Engine;
const V = runtime.Value;
const J = std.json.Value;
const A = std.mem.Allocator;
const Ed25519 = std.crypto.sign.Ed25519;

pub fn effect(engine: *Engine, label: []const u8, lift: V) anyerror!V {
    if (eq(label, "DecodeJSON")) {
        var decoder = JsonDecoder{ .engine = engine, .input = try asBinary(engine, lift), .terms = std.ArrayList(V).init(engine.allocator), .stack = std.ArrayList(Container).init(engine.allocator) };
        const terms = decoder.parse() catch |err| {
            if (err == error.InvalidJson) return engine.tag("Error", .{ .string = decoder.reason.? });
            return err;
        };
        return engine.tag("Ok", terms);
    }
    if (eq(label, "EYGParse")) return parseEyg(engine, try asString(engine, lift));
    if (eq(label, "CreateKey")) {
        const algorithm = try asTagged(engine, lift);
        if (!eq(algorithm.label, "Eddsa")) return incorrect(engine, "Variant better error needed", lift);
        const keys = Ed25519.KeyPair.generate();
        return engine.tag("Ok", try engine.tag("Eddsa", try record(engine, &.{
            .{ .name = "kty", .value = .{ .string = "OKP" } },
            .{ .name = "crv", .value = .{ .string = "Ed25519" } },
            .{ .name = "x", .value = .{ .binary = try engine.allocator.dupe(u8, &keys.public_key.toBytes()) } },
            .{ .name = "d", .value = .{ .binary = try engine.allocator.dupe(u8, &keys.secret_key.seed()) } },
        })));
    }
    if (eq(label, "Sign")) {
        const key = try field(engine, lift, "key");
        const data = try asBinary(engine, try field(engine, lift, "data"));
        const algorithm = try asTagged(engine, key);
        if (!eq(algorithm.label, "Eddsa")) return incorrect(engine, "Variant better error needed", key);
        const seed = try asBinary(engine, try field(engine, algorithm.value, "d"));
        if (seed.len != 32) return engine.tag("Error", .{ .string = "invalid Ed25519 private key" });
        const keys = Ed25519.KeyPair.generateDeterministic(seed[0..32].*) catch return engine.tag("Error", .{ .string = "invalid Ed25519 private key" });
        const signature = try keys.sign(data, null);
        return engine.tag("Ok", .{ .binary = try engine.allocator.dupe(u8, &signature.toBytes()) });
    }
    return error.UnhandledEffect;
}

fn incorrect(engine: *Engine, expected: []const u8, got: V) error{Runtime} {
    engine.failure = .{ .incorrect_term = .{ .expected = expected, .got = got } };
    return error.Runtime;
}
fn asString(engine: *Engine, value: V) ![]const u8 {
    return if (value == .string) value.string else incorrect(engine, "String", value);
}
fn asBinary(engine: *Engine, value: V) ![]const u8 {
    return if (value == .binary) value.binary else incorrect(engine, "Binary", value);
}
fn asTagged(engine: *Engine, value: V) !*const runtime.Tagged {
    return if (value == .tagged) value.tagged else incorrect(engine, "Tagged", value);
}
fn field(engine: *Engine, value: V, name: []const u8) !V {
    if (value != .record) return incorrect(engine, "Record", value);
    for (value.record) |entry| if (eq(entry.name, name)) return entry.value;
    engine.failure = .{ .missing_field = name };
    return error.Runtime;
}
fn record(engine: *Engine, fields: []const runtime.Field) !V {
    return .{ .record = try engine.allocator.dupe(runtime.Field, fields) };
}
fn list(engine: *Engine, values: []const V) !V {
    var tail: ?*const runtime.List = null;
    var i = values.len;
    while (i > 0) {
        i -= 1;
        tail = (try engine.cons(values[i], tail)).list;
    }
    return .{ .list = tail };
}
fn eq(a: []const u8, b: []const u8) bool {
    return std.mem.eql(u8, a, b);
}

fn parseEyg(engine: *Engine, source: []const u8) !V {
    const code = if (std.mem.startsWith(u8, source, "#!")) source[(if (std.mem.indexOfScalar(u8, source, '\n')) |i| i + 1 else source.len)..] else source;
    const parsed = std.json.parseFromSlice(J, engine.allocator, code, .{ .allocate = .alloc_always }) catch null;
    if (parsed) |value| if (runtime.validIr(value.value)) {
        if (flatten(engine, value.value)) |ast| return engine.tag("Ok", ast) else |err| {
            if (err != error.InvalidIR) return err;
        }
    };
    const ir = parser.parseExpression(engine.allocator, code) catch return engine.tag("Error", .{ .string = try parser.diagnostic(engine.allocator, code) });
    return engine.tag("Ok", try flatten(engine, ir));
}

fn attribute(ir: J, key: []const u8) !J {
    if (ir != .object) return error.InvalidIR;
    return ir.object.get(key) orelse error.InvalidIR;
}
fn textAttribute(ir: J, key: []const u8) ![]const u8 {
    const value = try attribute(ir, key);
    return if (value == .string) value.string else error.InvalidIR;
}
fn reference(engine: *Engine, ir: J, code: []const u8) !V {
    if (eq(code, ".")) return engine.tag("Relative", .{ .string = try textAttribute(ir, "i") });
    if (eq(code, "#")) return engine.tag("Content", .{ .string = try codec.canonicalCid(engine.allocator, try textAttribute(try attribute(ir, "l"), "/")) });
    const package = try textAttribute(ir, "p");
    if (ir.object.get("r")) |version| {
        const number = codec.jsonInteger(version) orelse return error.InvalidIR;
        const version_value = runtime.numberValue(number);
        if (ir.object.get("l")) |cid| return engine.tag("Release", try record(engine, &.{
            .{ .name = "package", .value = .{ .string = package } },
            .{ .name = "version", .value = version_value },
            .{ .name = "cid", .value = .{ .string = try codec.canonicalCid(engine.allocator, try textAttribute(cid, "/")) } },
        }));
        return engine.tag("Version", try record(engine, &.{
            .{ .name = "package", .value = .{ .string = package } },
            .{ .name = "version", .value = version_value },
        }));
    }
    return engine.tag("Package", .{ .string = package });
}

fn flatten(engine: *Engine, ir: J) anyerror!V {
    var pending = std.ArrayList(J).init(engine.allocator);
    var flat = std.ArrayList(V).init(engine.allocator);
    try pending.append(ir);
    while (pending.pop()) |current| {
        const code = try textAttribute(current, "0");
        const descriptor: struct { []const u8, V } = if (eq(code, "a")) blk: {
            try pending.append(try attribute(current, "a"));
            try pending.append(try attribute(current, "f"));
            break :blk .{ "Apply", runtime.unit() };
        } else if (eq(code, "l")) blk: {
            try pending.append(try attribute(current, "t"));
            try pending.append(try attribute(current, "v"));
            break :blk .{ "Let", .{ .string = try textAttribute(current, "l") } };
        } else if (eq(code, "f")) blk: {
            try pending.append(try attribute(current, "b"));
            break :blk .{ "Lambda", .{ .string = try textAttribute(current, "l") } };
        } else if (eq(code, "i")) blk: {
            const n = try attribute(current, "v");
            const number = codec.jsonInteger(n) orelse return error.InvalidIR;
            if (number < -runtime.safe_integer or number > runtime.safe_integer) return error.InvalidIR;
            break :blk .{ "Integer", .{ .integer = @intFromFloat(number) } };
        } else if (eq(code, "s")) .{ "String", .{ .string = try textAttribute(current, "v") } } else if (eq(code, "x")) .{ "Binary", .{ .binary = runtime.decodeBytes(engine.allocator, try attribute(current, "v")) catch return error.InvalidIR } } else if (eq(code, "#") or eq(code, ".") or eq(code, "@")) .{ "Reference", try reference(engine, current, code) } else blk: {
            const names = .{
                .{ "v", "Variable" }, .{ "e", "Extend" }, .{ "g", "Select" },  .{ "o", "Overwrite" },
                .{ "t", "Tag" },      .{ "m", "Case" },   .{ "p", "Perform" }, .{ "h", "Handle" },
                .{ "b", "Builtin" },
            };
            inline for (names) |item| if (eq(code, item[0])) break :blk .{ item[1], .{ .string = try textAttribute(current, "l") } };
            const constants = .{ .{ "ta", "Tail" }, .{ "c", "Cons" }, .{ "z", "Vacant" }, .{ "u", "Empty" }, .{ "n", "NoCases" } };
            inline for (constants) |item| if (eq(code, item[0])) break :blk .{ item[1], runtime.unit() };
            return error.InvalidIR;
        };
        try flat.append(try engine.tag(descriptor[0], descriptor[1]));
    }
    return list(engine, flat.items);
}

const Container = enum { array, object };
fn describeBits(a: A, bytes: []const u8) ![]const u8 {
    var output = std.ArrayList(u8).init(a);
    try output.appendSlice("<<");
    for (bytes, 0..) |byte, i| {
        if (i > 0) try output.appendSlice(", ");
        try output.writer().print("{d}", .{byte});
    }
    try output.appendSlice(">>");
    return output.toOwnedSlice();
}

const JsonDecoder = struct {
    engine: *Engine,
    input: []const u8,
    at: usize = 0,
    terms: std.ArrayList(V),
    stack: std.ArrayList(Container),
    reason: ?[]const u8 = null,

    fn fail(self: *JsonDecoder, reason: []const u8) error{InvalidJson} {
        self.reason = reason;
        return error.InvalidJson;
    }
    fn unexpected(self: *JsonDecoder, bytes: []const u8) anyerror {
        if (std.unicode.utf8ValidateSlice(bytes)) return self.fail(bytes);
        const description = describeBits(self.engine.allocator, bytes) catch |err| return err;
        return self.fail(description);
    }
    fn whitespace(self: *JsonDecoder) void {
        while (self.at < self.input.len and std.mem.indexOfScalar(u8, " \t\r\n", self.input[self.at]) != null) self.at += 1;
    }
    fn emit(self: *JsonDecoder, tag: []const u8, value: V) !void {
        try self.terms.append(try record(self.engine, &.{
            .{ .name = "term", .value = try self.engine.tag(tag, value) },
            .{ .name = "depth", .value = .{ .integer = @intCast(self.stack.items.len) } },
        }));
    }
    fn string(self: *JsonDecoder) anyerror![]const u8 {
        self.at += 1;
        var bytes = std.ArrayList(u8).init(self.engine.allocator);
        while (self.at < self.input.len) {
            const c = self.input[self.at];
            self.at += 1;
            if (c == '"') {
                if (!std.unicode.utf8ValidateSlice(bytes.items)) {
                    return self.unexpected(bytes.items);
                }
                return bytes.toOwnedSlice();
            }
            if (c != '\\') {
                try bytes.append(c);
                continue;
            }
            const original = self.at - 1;
            if (self.at == self.input.len) {
                return self.unexpected(self.input[original..]);
            }
            const escape = self.input[self.at];
            self.at += 1;
            switch (escape) {
                '"', '\\', '/' => try bytes.append(escape),
                'b' => try bytes.append(8),
                'f' => try bytes.append(12),
                'n' => try bytes.append(10),
                'r' => try bytes.append(13),
                't' => try bytes.append(9),
                'u' => {
                    const high = try self.hex4(original);
                    const cp: u21 = if (high >= 0xd800 and high <= 0xdbff) blk: {
                        if (!std.mem.startsWith(u8, self.input[self.at..], "\\u")) {
                            return self.unexpected(self.input[original..]);
                        }
                        self.at += 2;
                        const low = try self.hex4(original);
                        if (low < 0xdc00 or low > 0xdfff) {
                            return self.unexpected(self.input[original..]);
                        }
                        break :blk 0x10000 + (@as(u21, high) - 0xd800) * 0x400 + (@as(u21, low) - 0xdc00);
                    } else if (high >= 0xdc00 and high <= 0xdfff) {
                        return self.unexpected(self.input[original..]);
                    } else high;
                    var encoded: [4]u8 = undefined;
                    const size = try std.unicode.utf8Encode(cp, &encoded);
                    try bytes.appendSlice(encoded[0..size]);
                },
                else => {
                    return self.unexpected(self.input[original..]);
                },
            }
        }
        return self.fail("unexpected end of JSON");
    }
    fn hex4(self: *JsonDecoder, original: usize) !u16 {
        if (self.input.len - self.at < 4) return self.fail("unexpected end of JSON");
        for (self.input[self.at..][0..4]) |c| if (!std.ascii.isHex(c)) {
            return self.unexpected(self.input[original..]);
        };
        const n = std.fmt.parseInt(u16, self.input[self.at..][0..4], 16) catch {
            return self.unexpected(self.input[original..]);
        };
        self.at += 4;
        return n;
    }
    fn digits(self: *JsonDecoder) !struct { value: f64, size: usize } {
        @setFloatMode(.strict);
        const start = self.at;
        var n: f64 = 0;
        while (self.at < self.input.len and std.ascii.isDigit(self.input[self.at])) : (self.at += 1) n = n * 10 + @as(f64, @floatFromInt(self.input[self.at] - '0'));
        return .{ .value = n, .size = self.at - start };
    }
    fn number(self: *JsonDecoder) !void {
        const negative = self.input[self.at] == '-';
        if (negative) self.at += 1;
        if (self.at == self.input.len or !std.ascii.isDigit(self.input[self.at])) {
            return self.unexpected(self.input[self.at - @as(usize, if (negative) 1 else 0) ..]);
        }
        const whole = if (self.input[self.at] == '0') blk: {
            self.at += 1;
            break :blk @as(f64, 0);
        } else (try self.digits()).value;
        var decimal: f64 = 0;
        var places: usize = 0;
        var exponent: f64 = 0;
        var lexical_number = false;
        if (self.at < self.input.len and self.input[self.at] == '.') {
            lexical_number = true;
            self.at += 1;
            const fraction = try self.digits();
            if (fraction.size == 0) return self.fail("missing digits in number");
            decimal = fraction.value;
            places = fraction.size;
        }
        if (self.at < self.input.len and (self.input[self.at] == 'e' or self.input[self.at] == 'E')) {
            lexical_number = true;
            self.at += 1;
            var exp_negative = false;
            if (self.at < self.input.len and (self.input[self.at] == '+' or self.input[self.at] == '-')) {
                exp_negative = self.input[self.at] == '-';
                self.at += 1;
            }
            const exp = try self.digits();
            if (exp.size == 0) return self.fail("missing digits in number");
            exponent = if (exp_negative) -exp.value else exp.value;
        }
        if (!lexical_number) return self.emit("Integer", runtime.numberValue(if (negative) -whole else whole));
        try self.emit("Number", try record(self.engine, &.{
            .{ .name = "sign", .value = try self.engine.tag(if (negative) "Negative" else "Positive", runtime.unit()) },
            .{ .name = "integer", .value = runtime.numberValue(whole) },
            .{ .name = "decimal", .value = try record(self.engine, &.{
                .{ .name = "numerator", .value = runtime.numberValue(decimal) },
                .{ .name = "size", .value = .{ .integer = @intCast(places) } },
            }) },
            .{ .name = "exponent", .value = runtime.numberValue(exponent) },
        }));
    }
    fn parse(self: *JsonDecoder) anyerror!V {
        var state: enum { value, key, separator, continuation } = .value;
        while (true) {
            self.whitespace();
            if (state == .continuation and self.stack.items.len == 0) return list(self.engine, self.terms.items);
            if (self.at == self.input.len) return self.fail("unexpected end of JSON");
            const c = self.input[self.at];
            switch (state) {
                .value => {
                    if (c == '[' or c == '{') {
                        try self.emit(if (c == '[') "Array" else "Object", runtime.unit());
                        try self.stack.append(if (c == '[') .array else .object);
                        state = if (c == '[') .value else .key;
                        self.at += 1;
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (c == ']' and self.stack.items.len > 0 and self.stack.items[self.stack.items.len - 1] == .array) {
                        _ = self.stack.pop();
                        self.at += 1;
                    } else if (c == '"') {
                        try self.emit("String", .{ .string = try self.string() });
                    } else if (std.mem.startsWith(u8, self.input[self.at..], "true")) {
                        self.at += 4;
                        try self.emit("True", runtime.unit());
                    } else if (std.mem.startsWith(u8, self.input[self.at..], "false")) {
                        self.at += 5;
                        try self.emit("False", runtime.unit());
                    } else if (std.mem.startsWith(u8, self.input[self.at..], "null")) {
                        self.at += 4;
                        try self.emit("Null", runtime.unit());
                    } else if (c == '-' or std.ascii.isDigit(c)) {
                        try self.number();
                    } else return self.unexpected(self.input[self.at..]);
                    state = .continuation;
                },
                .key => {
                    if (c == '}') {
                        _ = self.stack.pop();
                        self.at += 1;
                        state = .continuation;
                    } else if (c == '"') {
                        try self.emit("Field", .{ .string = try self.string() });
                        state = .separator;
                    } else return self.unexpected(self.input[self.at..]);
                },
                .separator => {
                    if (c != ':') return self.unexpected(self.input[self.at..]);
                    self.at += 1;
                    state = .value;
                },
                .continuation => {
                    const container = self.stack.items[self.stack.items.len - 1];
                    if ((container == .array and c == ']') or (container == .object and c == '}')) {
                        _ = self.stack.pop();
                        self.at += 1;
                    } else if (c == ',') {
                        self.at += 1;
                        state = if (container == .array) .value else .key;
                    } else return self.unexpected(self.input[self.at..]);
                },
            }
        }
    }
};

test "lexical JSON, flattened AST and RFC8032 Ed25519 signature" {
    var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer arena.deinit();
    var engine = Engine.init(arena.allocator());
    const json = try effect(&engine, "DecodeJSON", .{ .binary = "{\"x\":[-1.020e-3,true,null]}" });
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("Ok", json.tagged.label);
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("Object", json.tagged.value.list.?.head.record[0].value.tagged.label);
    const ast = try effect(&engine, "EYGParse", .{ .string = "!int_add(20, 22)" });
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("Apply", ast.tagged.value.list.?.head.tagged.label);
    var seed: [32]u8 = undefined;
    _ = try std.fmt.hexToBytes(&seed, "9d61b19deffd5a60ba844af492ec2cc44449c5697b326919703bac031cae7f60");
    const signature = try effect(&engine, "Sign", try record(&engine, &.{
        .{ .name = "key", .value = try engine.tag("Eddsa", try record(&engine, &.{.{ .name = "d", .value = .{ .binary = &seed } }})) },
        .{ .name = "data", .value = .{ .binary = "" } },
    }));
    const hex = std.fmt.bytesToHex(signature.tagged.value.binary[0..64].*, .lower);
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("e5564300c360ac729086e2cc806e828a84877f1eb8e5d974d873e065224901555fb8821590a33bacc61e39701cf9b46bd25bf5f0595bbe24655141438e7a100b", &hex);
}
```

## `packages/zig_runtime/src/effect_cast.zig`

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/src/effect_cast.zig","sha256":"4aa18496543c9bc55fe9695cf71f99b5e4a4c967a0c71efd7061967c050188db","bytes":11291} -->
```zig
//! The pinned computer harness decodes before invoking any host operation.
//! Its runtime casts are deliberately narrower than static effect types: unit
//! requires an empty record, while CreateKey ignores its options payload.
const std = @import("std");
pub const runtime = @import("interpreter.zig");
const V = runtime.Value;
const Engine = runtime.Engine;
const Error = error{Runtime};

fn eq(a: []const u8, b: []const u8) bool {
    return std.mem.eql(u8, a, b);
}
fn incorrect(engine: *Engine, expected: []const u8, got: V) Error {
    engine.failure = .{ .incorrect_term = .{ .expected = expected, .got = got } };
    return error.Runtime;
}
fn missing(engine: *Engine, name: []const u8) Error {
    engine.failure = .{ .missing_field = name };
    return error.Runtime;
}
pub fn asString(engine: *Engine, value: V) Error![]const u8 {
    return if (value == .string) value.string else incorrect(engine, "String", value);
}
pub fn asBinary(engine: *Engine, value: V) Error![]const u8 {
    return if (value == .binary) value.binary else incorrect(engine, "Binary", value);
}
pub fn asNumber(engine: *Engine, value: V) Error!f64 {
    return switch (value) {
        .integer, .javascript_integer => runtime.numberFloat(value).?,
        else => incorrect(engine, "Integer", value),
    };
}
fn asRecord(engine: *Engine, value: V) Error![]const runtime.Field {
    return if (value == .record) value.record else incorrect(engine, "Record", value);
}
pub fn asUnit(engine: *Engine, value: V) Error!void {
    if ((try asRecord(engine, value)).len != 0) return missing(engine, "actually to many fields");
}
pub fn field(engine: *Engine, value: V, name: []const u8) Error!V {
    for (try asRecord(engine, value)) |entry| if (eq(entry.name, name)) return entry.value;
    return missing(engine, name);
}
fn variant(engine: *Engine, value: V, names: []const []const u8) Error!*const runtime.Tagged {
    if (value != .tagged) return incorrect(engine, "Tagged", value);
    for (names) |name| if (eq(name, value.tagged.label)) return value.tagged;
    return incorrect(engine, "Variant better error needed", value);
}
const OptionInner = enum { number, string };
fn option(engine: *Engine, value: V, inner: OptionInner) Error!void {
    const tagged = try variant(engine, value, &.{ "Some", "None" });
    if (eq(tagged.label, "None")) return asUnit(engine, tagged.value);
    switch (inner) {
        .number => _ = try asNumber(engine, tagged.value),
        .string => _ = try asString(engine, tagged.value),
    }
}
fn fetch(engine: *Engine, lift: V) Error!void {
    const method = try variant(engine, try field(engine, lift, "method"), &.{ "CONNECT", "DELETE", "GET", "HEAD", "OPTIONS", "PATCH", "POST", "PUT", "TRACE", "OTHER" });
    if (eq(method.label, "OTHER")) _ = try asString(engine, method.value) else try asUnit(engine, method.value);
    const scheme = try variant(engine, try field(engine, lift, "scheme"), &.{ "HTTP", "HTTPS" });
    try asUnit(engine, scheme.value);
    _ = try asString(engine, try field(engine, lift, "host"));
    try option(engine, try field(engine, lift, "port"), .number);
    _ = try asString(engine, try field(engine, lift, "path"));
    try option(engine, try field(engine, lift, "query"), .string);
    const headers = try field(engine, lift, "headers");
    if (headers != .list) return incorrect(engine, "List", headers);
    var cursor = headers.list;
    while (cursor) |cell| : (cursor = cell.tail) {
        _ = try asString(engine, try field(engine, cell.head, "key"));
        _ = try asString(engine, try field(engine, cell.head, "value"));
    }
    _ = try asBinary(engine, try field(engine, lift, "body"));
}

/// Validate the next-tui computer labels in their actual decoder order. Extra
/// provider labels, such as GitQuery and phone effects, keep their own decoder.
pub fn validate(engine: *Engine, label: []const u8, lift: V) Error!void {
    if (eq(label, "CWD") or eq(label, "Now") or eq(label, "Flip") or eq(label, "StandardIn")) return asUnit(engine, lift);
    if (eq(label, "StandardOut") or eq(label, "StandardError") or eq(label, "Env") or eq(label, "EYGParse") or eq(label, "ReadDirectory") or eq(label, "MakeDirectory") or eq(label, "DeleteFile")) {
        _ = try asString(engine, lift);
    } else if (eq(label, "Sleep") or eq(label, "Random") or eq(label, "Exit")) {
        _ = try asNumber(engine, lift);
    } else if (eq(label, "DecodeJSON")) {
        _ = try asBinary(engine, lift);
    } else if (eq(label, "ReadFile")) {
        _ = try asString(engine, try field(engine, lift, "path"));
        _ = try asNumber(engine, try field(engine, lift, "offset"));
        _ = try asNumber(engine, try field(engine, lift, "limit"));
    } else if (eq(label, "WriteFile") or eq(label, "AppendFile")) {
        _ = try asString(engine, try field(engine, lift, "path"));
        _ = try asBinary(engine, try field(engine, lift, "contents"));
    } else if (eq(label, "Hash")) {
        const algorithm = try variant(engine, try field(engine, lift, "algorithm"), &.{"SHA256"});
        try asUnit(engine, algorithm.value);
        _ = try asBinary(engine, try field(engine, lift, "bytes"));
    } else if (eq(label, "CreateKey")) {
        _ = try variant(engine, lift, &.{"Eddsa"});
    } else if (eq(label, "Sign")) {
        const key = try field(engine, lift, "key");
        _ = try asBinary(engine, try field(engine, lift, "data"));
        const algorithm = try variant(engine, key, &.{"Eddsa"});
        _ = try asBinary(engine, try field(engine, algorithm.value, "d"));
    } else if (eq(label, "Fetch")) {
        try fetch(engine, lift);
    }
}

/// The native Git provider additionally exposes SHA1. Its structure and unit
/// payload follow the same decoder; oracle-facing sandbox hosts stay strict.
pub fn validateNative(engine: *Engine, label: []const u8, lift: V) Error!void {
    if (!eq(label, "Hash")) return validate(engine, label, lift);
    const algorithm = try variant(engine, try field(engine, lift, "algorithm"), &.{ "SHA256", "SHA1" });
    try asUnit(engine, algorithm.value);
    _ = try asBinary(engine, try field(engine, lift, "bytes"));
}

fn record(a: std.mem.Allocator, fields: []const runtime.Field) !V {
    return .{ .record = try a.dupe(runtime.Field, fields) };
}
fn expectIncorrect(engine: *Engine, expected: []const u8, got: V) !void {
    const reason = engine.failure.?.incorrect_term;
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings(expected, reason.expected);
    try std.testing.expect(runtime.equal(got, reason.got));
}

test "effect casts distinguish strict unit from ignored key options" {
    var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer arena.deinit();
    const a = arena.allocator();
    var engine = Engine.init(a);
    const text: V = .{ .string = "ignored by Eddsa" };
    try validate(&engine, "CreateKey", try engine.tag("Eddsa", text));
    try std.testing.expectError(error.Runtime, validate(&engine, "CWD", text));
    try expectIncorrect(&engine, "Record", text);
    const extra = try record(a, &.{.{ .name = "extra", .value = runtime.unit() }});
    try std.testing.expectError(error.Runtime, validate(&engine, "StandardIn", extra));
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("actually to many fields", engine.failure.?.missing_field);
    const hash = try record(a, &.{ .{ .name = "algorithm", .value = try engine.tag("SHA256", text) }, .{ .name = "bytes", .value = .{ .binary = "" } } });
    try std.testing.expectError(error.Runtime, validate(&engine, "Hash", hash));
    try expectIncorrect(&engine, "Record", text);
}

test "effect casts stop at the first decoded field and retain offending values" {
    var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer arena.deinit();
    const a = arena.allocator();
    var engine = Engine.init(a);
    try std.testing.expectError(error.Runtime, validate(&engine, "ReadFile", runtime.unit()));
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("path", engine.failure.?.missing_field);
    const wrong: V = .{ .integer = 17 };
    const request = try record(a, &.{.{ .name = "path", .value = wrong }});
    try std.testing.expectError(error.Runtime, validate(&engine, "ReadFile", request));
    try expectIncorrect(&engine, "String", wrong);
    const key: V = .{ .string = "not a key" };
    const sign = try record(a, &.{ .{ .name = "key", .value = key }, .{ .name = "data", .value = wrong } });
    try std.testing.expectError(error.Runtime, validate(&engine, "Sign", sign));
    try expectIncorrect(&engine, "Binary", wrong);
    try std.testing.expectError(error.Runtime, validate(&engine, "CreateKey", try engine.tag("unknown", runtime.unit())));
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("Variant better error needed", engine.failure.?.incorrect_term.expected);
}

test "effect integer decoder accepts all native Integer representations" {
    var engine = Engine.init(std.testing.allocator);
    for ([_]V{ .{ .integer = 123 }, .{ .javascript_integer = 1e100 }, .{ .javascript_integer = std.math.nan(f64) } }) |value| {
        try validate(&engine, "Sleep", value);
        try validate(&engine, "Exit", value);
    }
}

test "fetch decoder checks options and header fields before the body" {
    var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer arena.deinit();
    const a = arena.allocator();
    var engine = Engine.init(a);
    const fields = try a.dupe(runtime.Field, &.{
        .{ .name = "method", .value = try engine.tag("GET", runtime.unit()) },
        .{ .name = "scheme", .value = try engine.tag("HTTPS", runtime.unit()) },
        .{ .name = "host", .value = .{ .string = "example.org" } },
        .{ .name = "port", .value = try engine.tag("Some", .{ .javascript_integer = 1e100 }) },
        .{ .name = "path", .value = .{ .string = "/" } },
        .{ .name = "query", .value = try engine.tag("None", runtime.unit()) },
        .{ .name = "headers", .value = .{ .list = null } },
        .{ .name = "body", .value = .{ .binary = "" } },
    });
    const request: V = .{ .record = fields };
    try validate(&engine, "Fetch", request);
    fields[6].value = try engine.cons(try record(a, &.{.{ .name = "key", .value = .{ .string = "x" } }}), null);
    fields[7].value = .{ .integer = 0 };
    try std.testing.expectError(error.Runtime, validate(&engine, "Fetch", request));
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("value", engine.failure.?.missing_field);
    fields[5].value = try engine.tag("None", .{ .integer = 1 });
    try std.testing.expectError(error.Runtime, validate(&engine, "Fetch", request));
    try expectIncorrect(&engine, "Record", .{ .integer = 1 });
}

test "SHA1 is isolated to the native provider extension" {
    var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer arena.deinit();
    var engine = Engine.init(arena.allocator());
    const hash = try record(engine.allocator, &.{
        .{ .name = "algorithm", .value = try engine.tag("SHA1", runtime.unit()) },
        .{ .name = "bytes", .value = .{ .binary = "payload" } },
    });
    try std.testing.expectError(error.Runtime, validate(&engine, "Hash", hash));
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("Variant better error needed", engine.failure.?.incorrect_term.expected);
    try validateNative(&engine, "Hash", hash);
}
```

## `packages/zig_runtime/src/frame_test.zig`

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/src/frame_test.zig","sha256":"122194c870084b1b6f29e8e6f97729c067c26ea9c1c0bb9623ba3558078b7213","bytes":3349} -->
```zig
const std = @import("std");
const tui = @import("tui.zig");

test "JSON frames retain symbols and distinguish styles after source disposal" {
    var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer arena.deinit();
    var text = [_]u8{'a'};
    var buffer = try tui.Buffer.init(std.testing.allocator, 3, 1);
    buffer.cells[0].symbol = &text;
    buffer.cells[1].symbol = &text;
    buffer.cells[1].style.fg = .{ .indexed = 1 };
    buffer.cells[2].symbol = &text;
    const frame = try buffer.json(arena.allocator());
    buffer.deinit();
    text[0] = 'b';
    const cells = frame.object.get("cells").?.array.items;
    for (cells) |cell| try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("a", cell.object.get("symbol").?.string);
    try std.testing.expect(cells[0].object.get("fg").? == .null);
    try std.testing.expectEqual(@as(i64, 1), cells[1].object.get("fg").?.integer);
    try std.testing.expect(cells[2].object.get("fg").? == .null);
}

test "caller-owned frames survive scratch disposal without retaining discarded renders" {
    var session = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer session.deinit();
    var retained = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer retained.deinit();
    var discarded = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer discarded.deinit();
    var shell = tui.Tui.init(session.allocator());
    defer shell.shutdown();
    shell.sandboxed = true;
    const paste = try std.json.parseFromSlice(std.json.Value, session.allocator(),
        \\{"paste":"{answer: 42, label: \"λ\"}"}
    , .{});
    try shell.event(paste.value);
    const first = try shell.frameAlloc(retained.allocator(), 80, 24);
    const wire = @import("json_wire.zig");
    const expected = try wire.stringifyAlloc(retained.allocator(), first);
    const capacity = session.queryCapacity();
    for (0..16) |_| {
        _ = try shell.frameAlloc(discarded.allocator(), 80, 24);
        _ = discarded.reset(.retain_capacity);
    }
    try std.testing.expectEqual(capacity, session.queryCapacity());
    const replace = try std.json.parseFromSlice(std.json.Value, session.allocator(),
        \\{"paste":"[1, 2, 3]"}
    , .{});
    try shell.event(replace.value);
    _ = try shell.frameAlloc(discarded.allocator(), 40, 10);
    _ = discarded.reset(.free_all);
    const actual = try wire.stringifyAlloc(retained.allocator(), first);
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings(expected, actual);
}

test "picker rendering does not retain temporary matching allocations" {
    var session = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer session.deinit();
    var output = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer output.deinit();
    var shell = tui.Tui.init(session.allocator());
    defer shell.shutdown();
    shell.sandboxed = true;
    var open = std.json.ObjectMap.init(session.allocator());
    try open.put("key", .{ .string = "j" });
    try shell.event(.{ .object = open });
    _ = try shell.frameAlloc(output.allocator(), 80, 24);
    _ = output.reset(.retain_capacity);
    const capacity = session.queryCapacity();
    for (0..16) |_| {
        _ = try shell.frameAlloc(output.allocator(), 80, 24);
        _ = output.reset(.retain_capacity);
    }
    try std.testing.expectEqual(capacity, session.queryCapacity());
}
```

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/src/git.zig","sha256":"8df63d12697b0691aa6fef0d0a75146e880ec4c25cd373859e1874e9f149af3b","bytes":30382} -->
