```zig
//! Native Git object plumbing. Git is used only by the independent verifier.
//! All allocations belong to the caller; use one arena per request or session.
const std = @import("std");
const Allocator = std.mem.Allocator;
const J = std.json.Value;
const max_object = 64 * 1024 * 1024;
const max_index = 128 * 1024 * 1024;
const max_delta_depth = 64;

pub const Object = struct { kind: []const u8, bytes: []const u8 };
const Index = struct { path: []const u8, bytes: []const u8, count: usize };
pub const Commit = struct {
    id: []const u8,
    tree: []const u8,
    parents: []const []const u8,
    author: []const u8,
    committer: []const u8,
    subject: []const u8,
    message: []const u8,
    timestamp: i64,
};
pub const Entry = struct { name: []const u8, mode: []const u8, kind: []const u8, id: []const u8 };

pub const Repository = struct {
    allocator: Allocator,
    root: []const u8,
    gitdir: []const u8,
    common: []const u8,
    indexes: std.ArrayList(Index),
    indexed: bool = false,
    cache: std.StringHashMap(Object),
    cache_bytes: usize = 0,

    pub fn init(a: Allocator, root: []const u8) !Repository {
        const abs = try std.fs.path.resolve(a, &.{root});
        const dotgit = try std.fs.path.join(a, &.{ abs, ".git" });
        const gitdir = blk: {
            var dir = std.fs.openDirAbsolute(dotgit, .{}) catch {
                const marker = readFile(a, dotgit, 16 * 1024) catch {
                    // Bare repositories are accepted as well as ordinary checkouts.
                    const head_path = try std.fs.path.join(a, &.{ abs, "HEAD" });
                    std.fs.accessAbsolute(head_path, .{}) catch return error.NotRepository;
                    break :blk abs;
                };
                if (!std.mem.startsWith(u8, marker, "gitdir: ")) return error.NotRepository;
                break :blk try std.fs.path.resolve(a, &.{ abs, std.mem.trim(u8, marker[8..], "\r\n ") });
            };
            dir.close();
            break :blk dotgit;
        };
        const common_path = try std.fs.path.join(a, &.{ gitdir, "commondir" });
        const common = if (readFile(a, common_path, 16 * 1024)) |marker|
            try std.fs.path.resolve(a, &.{ gitdir, std.mem.trim(u8, marker, "\r\n ") })
        else |_|
            gitdir;
        // SHA-256 object formats need a distinct index and tree decoder.
        const config = readFile(a, try std.fs.path.join(a, &.{ common, "config" }), 4 * 1024 * 1024) catch "";
        if (std.mem.indexOf(u8, config, "objectformat = sha256") != null or std.mem.indexOf(u8, config, "objectFormat = sha256") != null)
            return error.UnsupportedObjectFormat;
        return .{ .allocator = a, .root = abs, .gitdir = gitdir, .common = common, .indexes = std.ArrayList(Index).init(a), .cache = std.StringHashMap(Object).init(a) };
    }

    fn join(self: *Repository, pieces: []const []const u8) ![]const u8 {
        return std.fs.path.join(self.allocator, pieces);
    }

    pub fn head(self: *Repository) !J {
        const bytes = try readFile(self.allocator, try self.join(&.{ self.gitdir, "HEAD" }), 4096);
        const value = std.mem.trim(u8, bytes, "\r\n ");
        const branch = if (std.mem.startsWith(u8, value, "ref: ")) value[5..] else "(detached)";
        return obj(self.allocator, &.{ .{ "branch", str(branch) }, .{ "id", str(try self.resolve("HEAD")) } });
    }

    pub fn resolve(self: *Repository, revision: []const u8) anyerror![]const u8 {
        if (std.mem.indexOfAny(u8, revision, "~^")) |at| {
            var id = try self.resolve(revision[0..at]);
            var cursor = at;
            while (cursor < revision.len) {
                const operator = revision[cursor];
                if (operator != '~' and operator != '^') return error.InvalidRevision;
                cursor += 1;
                const start = cursor;
                while (cursor < revision.len and std.ascii.isDigit(revision[cursor])) : (cursor += 1) {}
                const n = if (cursor == start) 1 else std.fmt.parseInt(usize, revision[start..cursor], 10) catch return error.InvalidRevision;
                if (n > 100000) return error.QueryLimit;
                if (operator == '^') {
                    if (n == 0) continue;
                    const c = try self.commit(id);
                    if (n > c.parents.len) return error.NoParent;
                    id = c.parents[n - 1];
                } else {
                    for (0..n) |_| {
                        const c = try self.commit(id);
                        if (c.parents.len == 0) return error.NoParent;
                        id = c.parents[0];
                    }
                }
            }
            return id;
        }
        if (isOid(revision)) return std.ascii.allocLowerString(self.allocator, revision);
        if (revision.len == 0 or std.mem.indexOf(u8, revision, "..") != null or std.fs.path.isAbsolute(revision) or std.mem.indexOfScalar(u8, revision, '\\') != null)
            return error.InvalidReference;
        const names: []const []const u8 = if (std.mem.eql(u8, revision, "HEAD") or std.mem.startsWith(u8, revision, "refs/")) &.{revision} else &.{ revision, try std.fmt.allocPrint(self.allocator, "refs/heads/{s}", .{revision}), try std.fmt.allocPrint(self.allocator, "refs/tags/{s}", .{revision}) };
        for (names) |name| {
            if (self.resolveRef(name, 0)) |id| return id else |err| switch (err) {
                error.FileNotFound, error.UnknownReference => {},
                else => return err,
            }
        }
        return error.UnknownReference;
    }

    fn resolveRef(self: *Repository, ref: []const u8, depth: usize) anyerror![]const u8 {
        if (depth >= 16) return error.ReferenceCycle;
        if (ref.len == 0 or std.mem.indexOf(u8, ref, "..") != null or std.fs.path.isAbsolute(ref)) return error.InvalidReference;
        const path = try self.join(&.{ if (std.mem.eql(u8, ref, "HEAD")) self.gitdir else self.common, ref });
        if (readFile(self.allocator, path, 4096)) |bytes| {
            const value = std.mem.trim(u8, bytes, "\r\n ");
            if (std.mem.startsWith(u8, value, "ref: ")) return self.resolveRef(value[5..], depth + 1);
            if (!isOid(value)) return error.InvalidReference;
            return std.ascii.allocLowerString(self.allocator, value);
        } else |err| {
            if (err != error.FileNotFound) return err;
        }
        const packed_path = try self.join(&.{ self.common, "packed-refs" });
        const packed_refs = readFile(self.allocator, packed_path, 32 * 1024 * 1024) catch |err| {
            if (err == error.FileNotFound) return error.UnknownReference;
            return err;
        };
        var lines = std.mem.splitScalar(u8, packed_refs, '\n');
        while (lines.next()) |line| {
            if (line.len >= 42 and line[40] == ' ' and std.mem.eql(u8, std.mem.trimRight(u8, line[41..], "\r"), ref)) {
                if (!isOid(line[0..40])) return error.InvalidReference;
                return self.allocator.dupe(u8, line[0..40]);
            }
        }
        return error.UnknownReference;
    }

    fn loadIndexes(self: *Repository) !void {
        if (self.indexed) return;
        self.indexed = true;
        const path = try self.join(&.{ self.common, "objects", "pack" });
        var dir = std.fs.openDirAbsolute(path, .{ .iterate = true }) catch |err| {
            if (err == error.FileNotFound) return;
            return err;
        };
        defer dir.close();
        var iter = dir.iterate();
        while (try iter.next()) |entry| {
            if (!std.mem.endsWith(u8, entry.name, ".idx")) continue;
            const idx_path = try self.join(&.{ path, entry.name });
            const bytes = try readFile(self.allocator, idx_path, max_index);
            if (bytes.len < 1072 or !std.mem.eql(u8, bytes[0..8], "\xfftOc\x00\x00\x00\x02")) return error.UnsupportedPackIndex;
            const n = be32(bytes[1028..1032]);
            const minimum = std.math.mul(usize, n, 28) catch return error.InvalidPackIndex;
            if (minimum > bytes.len - 1072) return error.InvalidPackIndex;
            // The checksum covers fanout, names, CRCs, offsets and pack identity.
            const digest = sha1(bytes[0 .. bytes.len - 20]);
            if (!std.mem.eql(u8, &digest, bytes[bytes.len - 20 ..])) return error.IndexChecksum;
            var previous: u32 = 0;
            for (0..256) |i| {
                const fan = be32(bytes[8 + i * 4 ..][0..4]);
                if (fan < previous or fan > n) return error.InvalidPackIndex;
                previous = fan;
            }
            const pack_path = try std.fmt.allocPrint(self.allocator, "{s}.pack", .{idx_path[0 .. idx_path.len - 4]});
            try self.indexes.append(.{ .path = pack_path, .bytes = bytes, .count = n });
        }
    }

    fn locate(self: *Repository, id: []const u8) !struct { path: []const u8, offset: u64 } {
        try self.loadIndexes();
        const hash = try parseOid(id);
        for (self.indexes.items) |idx| {
            const bucket = hash[0];
            var low: usize = if (bucket == 0) 0 else be32(idx.bytes[8 + (@as(usize, bucket) - 1) * 4 ..][0..4]);
            var high: usize = be32(idx.bytes[8 + @as(usize, bucket) * 4 ..][0..4]);
            while (low < high) {
                const mid = low + (high - low) / 2;
                const candidate = idx.bytes[1032 + mid * 20 ..][0..20];
                switch (std.mem.order(u8, candidate, &hash)) {
                    .lt => low = mid + 1,
                    .gt => high = mid,
                    .eq => {
                        const word = be32(idx.bytes[1032 + idx.count * 24 + mid * 4 ..][0..4]);
                        var offset: u64 = word;
                        if (word & 0x80000000 != 0) {
                            const index: usize = word & 0x7fffffff;
                            const start = 1032 + idx.count * 28 + index * 8;
                            if (start + 8 > idx.bytes.len - 40) return error.InvalidPackIndex;
                            offset = std.mem.readInt(u64, idx.bytes[start..][0..8], .big);
                        }
                        return .{ .path = idx.path, .offset = offset };
                    },
                }
            }
        }
        return error.ObjectNotFound;
    }

    pub fn object(self: *Repository, id: []const u8) anyerror!Object {
        return self.objectDepth(id, 0);
    }

    fn remember(self: *Repository, key: []const u8, value: Object) !void {
        // Budget decoded immutable data; refs and config are always read anew.
        if (self.cache.count() >= 512 or self.cache_bytes + value.bytes.len > 16 * 1024 * 1024) return;
        try self.cache.put(try self.allocator.dupe(u8, key), value);
        self.cache_bytes += value.bytes.len;
    }

    fn objectDepth(self: *Repository, id: []const u8, depth: usize) anyerror!Object {
        if (depth >= max_delta_depth) return error.DeltaDepth;
        if (!isOid(id)) return error.InvalidObjectId;
        if (self.cache.get(id)) |cached| return cached;
        const path = try self.join(&.{ self.common, "objects", id[0..2], id[2..] });
        const value = if (readFile(self.allocator, path, max_object)) |compressed| blk: {
            const raw = try inflate(self.allocator, compressed);
            const nul = std.mem.indexOfScalar(u8, raw, 0) orelse return error.InvalidLooseObject;
            const space = std.mem.indexOfScalar(u8, raw[0..nul], ' ') orelse return error.InvalidLooseObject;
            const kind = raw[0..space];
            if (!isKind(kind)) return error.InvalidObjectKind;
            const size = try std.fmt.parseInt(usize, raw[space + 1 .. nul], 10);
            if (raw.len - nul - 1 != size) return error.ObjectSize;
            break :blk Object{ .kind = kind, .bytes = raw[nul + 1 ..] };
        } else |err| blk: {
            if (err != error.FileNotFound) return err;
            const at = try self.locate(id);
            break :blk try self.packedObject(at.path, at.offset, depth);
        };
        try verifyObject(id, value);
        try self.remember(id, value);
        return value;
    }

    fn packedObject(self: *Repository, path: []const u8, offset: u64, depth: usize) anyerror!Object {
        if (depth >= max_delta_depth) return error.DeltaDepth;
        const key = try std.fmt.allocPrint(self.allocator, "{s}:{d}", .{ path, offset });
        if (self.cache.get(key)) |cached| return cached;
        var file = try std.fs.openFileAbsolute(path, .{});
        defer file.close();
        var header: [12]u8 = undefined;
        if (try file.preadAll(&header, 0) != 12 or !std.mem.eql(u8, header[0..4], "PACK") or (be32(header[4..8]) != 2 and be32(header[4..8]) != 3)) return error.InvalidPack;
        const stat = try file.stat();
        if (stat.size < 32 or offset < 12 or offset >= stat.size - 20) return error.InvalidPackOffset;
        try file.seekTo(offset);
        var buffered = std.io.bufferedReader(file.reader());
        const reader = buffered.reader();
        var byte = try reader.readByte();
        const kind = (byte >> 4) & 7;
        var size: u64 = byte & 15;
        var shift: u6 = 4;
        while (byte & 128 != 0) {
            if (shift > 60) return error.InvalidPackSize;
            byte = try reader.readByte();
            size |= @as(u64, byte & 127) << shift;
            shift = std.math.add(u6, shift, 7) catch return error.InvalidPackSize;
        }
        if (size > max_object) return error.ObjectTooLarge;
        var base: ?Object = null;
        if (kind == 6) {
            byte = try reader.readByte();
            var distance: u64 = byte & 127;
            var count: usize = 1;
            while (byte & 128 != 0) {
                if (count >= 9) return error.InvalidDelta;
                byte = try reader.readByte();
                distance = std.math.mul(u64, std.math.add(u64, distance, 1) catch return error.InvalidDelta, 128) catch return error.InvalidDelta;
                distance += byte & 127;
                count += 1;
            }
            if (distance == 0 or distance > offset - 12) return error.InvalidDelta;
            base = try self.packedObject(path, offset - distance, depth + 1);
        } else if (kind == 7) {
            const hash = try reader.readBytesNoEof(20);
            const id = std.fmt.bytesToHex(hash, .lower);
            base = try self.objectDepth(&id, depth + 1);
        } else if (kind < 1 or kind > 4) return error.InvalidObjectKind;
        var sink = LimitedOutput.init(self.allocator, @intCast(size));
        try std.compress.zlib.decompress(reader, sink.writer());
        const bytes = try sink.list.toOwnedSlice();
        if (bytes.len != size) return error.ObjectSize;
        const result = if (base) |value| Object{ .kind = value.kind, .bytes = try applyDelta(self.allocator, value.bytes, bytes) } else Object{ .kind = ([_][]const u8{ "", "commit", "tree", "blob", "tag" })[kind], .bytes = bytes };
        try self.remember(key, result);
        return result;
    }

    pub fn commit(self: *Repository, revision: []const u8) anyerror!Commit {
        var id = try self.resolve(revision);
        var value = try self.object(id);
        var tags: usize = 0;
        while (std.mem.eql(u8, value.kind, "tag")) : (tags += 1) {
            if (tags >= 16 or !std.mem.startsWith(u8, value.bytes, "object ") or value.bytes.len < 47) return error.InvalidTag;
            id = value.bytes[7..47];
            value = try self.object(id);
        }
        if (!std.mem.eql(u8, value.kind, "commit")) return error.ExpectedCommit;
        return parseCommit(self.allocator, id, value.bytes);
    }

    pub fn tree(self: *Repository, id: []const u8) ![]Entry {
        const value = try self.object(id);
        if (!std.mem.eql(u8, value.kind, "tree")) return error.ExpectedTree;
        return parseTree(self.allocator, value.bytes);
    }

    fn pathId(self: *Repository, tree_id: []const u8, path: []const u8) !?[]const u8 {
        if (path.len == 0) return tree_id;
        var id = tree_id;
        var pieces = std.mem.splitScalar(u8, path, '/');
        while (pieces.next()) |name| {
            if (name.len == 0 or std.mem.eql(u8, name, ".") or std.mem.eql(u8, name, "..")) return error.InvalidPath;
            const entries = self.tree(id) catch |err| {
                if (err == error.ExpectedTree) return null;
                return err;
            };
            var found: ?[]const u8 = null;
            for (entries) |entry| if (std.mem.eql(u8, entry.name, name)) {
                found = entry.id;
                break;
            };
            id = found orelse return null;
        }
        return id;
    }

    pub fn show(self: *Repository, revision: []const u8, path: []const u8) !Object {
        const c = try self.commit(revision);
        const id = (try self.pathId(c.tree, path)) orelse return error.PathNotFound;
        return self.object(id);
    }
};

pub fn parseCommit(a: Allocator, id: []const u8, bytes: []const u8) !Commit {
    if (!std.unicode.utf8ValidateSlice(bytes)) return error.NonUtf8Metadata;
    const split = std.mem.indexOf(u8, bytes, "\n\n") orelse return error.InvalidCommit;
    var lines = std.mem.splitScalar(u8, bytes[0..split], '\n');
    var parents = std.ArrayList([]const u8).init(a);
    var result = Commit{ .id = id, .tree = "", .parents = &.{}, .author = "", .committer = "", .subject = "", .message = bytes[split + 2 ..], .timestamp = 0 };
    while (lines.next()) |line| {
        if (std.mem.startsWith(u8, line, "tree ")) result.tree = line[5..] else if (std.mem.startsWith(u8, line, "parent ")) {
            if (!isOid(line[7..])) return error.InvalidCommit;
            try parents.append(line[7..]);
        } else if (std.mem.startsWith(u8, line, "author ")) result.author = line[7..] else if (std.mem.startsWith(u8, line, "committer ")) result.committer = line[10..];
    }
    if (!isOid(result.tree)) return error.InvalidCommit;
    result.parents = try parents.toOwnedSlice();
    result.subject = if (std.mem.indexOfScalar(u8, result.message, '\n')) |end| result.message[0..end] else result.message;
    if (std.mem.lastIndexOfScalar(u8, result.committer, ' ')) |tz| {
        if (std.mem.lastIndexOfScalar(u8, result.committer[0..tz], ' ')) |at| result.timestamp = std.fmt.parseInt(i64, result.committer[at + 1 .. tz], 10) catch 0;
    }
    return result;
}

pub fn parseTree(a: Allocator, bytes: []const u8) ![]Entry {
    var entries = std.ArrayList(Entry).init(a);
    var at: usize = 0;
    while (at < bytes.len) {
        const space = std.mem.indexOfScalarPos(u8, bytes, at, ' ') orelse return error.InvalidTree;
        const nul = std.mem.indexOfScalarPos(u8, bytes, space + 1, 0) orelse return error.InvalidTree;
        if (nul + 21 > bytes.len) return error.InvalidTree;
        const mode = bytes[at..space];
        const name = bytes[space + 1 .. nul];
        if (!std.unicode.utf8ValidateSlice(name)) return error.NonUtf8Metadata;
        if (mode.len == 0 or name.len == 0 or std.mem.indexOfScalar(u8, name, '/') != null) return error.InvalidTree;
        for (mode) |digit| if (digit < '0' or digit > '7') return error.InvalidTree;
        const raw = bytes[nul + 1 ..][0..20].*;
        const hex = std.fmt.bytesToHex(raw, .lower);
        const kind: []const u8 = if (std.mem.eql(u8, mode, "40000") or std.mem.eql(u8, mode, "040000")) "tree" else if (std.mem.eql(u8, mode, "160000")) "commit" else "blob";
        try entries.append(.{ .name = name, .mode = mode, .kind = kind, .id = try a.dupe(u8, &hex) });
        at = nul + 21;
    }
    return entries.toOwnedSlice();
}

pub fn applyDelta(a: Allocator, base: []const u8, bytes: []const u8) ![]const u8 {
    var at: usize = 0;
    const source_size = try deltaSize(bytes, &at);
    const target_size = try deltaSize(bytes, &at);
    if (source_size != base.len) return error.DeltaBaseSize;
    if (target_size > max_object) return error.ObjectTooLarge;
    var result = try std.ArrayList(u8).initCapacity(a, target_size);
    while (at < bytes.len) {
        const op = bytes[at];
        at += 1;
        if (op == 0) return error.InvalidDelta;
        if (op & 128 == 0) {
            if (at + op > bytes.len or result.items.len + op > target_size) return error.InvalidDelta;
            try result.appendSlice(bytes[at .. at + op]);
            at += op;
        } else {
            var offset: usize = 0;
            var size: usize = 0;
            for (0..7) |bit| {
                if (op & (@as(u8, 1) << @as(u3, @intCast(bit))) == 0) continue;
                if (at >= bytes.len) return error.InvalidDelta;
                if (bit < 4) offset |= @as(usize, bytes[at]) << @as(u6, @intCast(bit * 8)) else size |= @as(usize, bytes[at]) << @as(u6, @intCast((bit - 4) * 8));
                at += 1;
            }
            if (size == 0) size = 65536;
            if (offset > base.len or size > base.len - offset or result.items.len + size > target_size) return error.InvalidDelta;
            try result.appendSlice(base[offset .. offset + size]);
        }
    }
    if (result.items.len != target_size) return error.DeltaTargetSize;
    return result.toOwnedSlice();
}

fn deltaSize(bytes: []const u8, at: *usize) !usize {
    var result: usize = 0;
    var shift: u6 = 0;
    while (at.* < bytes.len) {
        const byte = bytes[at.*];
        at.* += 1;
        if (shift > 56) return error.InvalidDelta;
        result |= @as(usize, byte & 127) << shift;
        if (byte & 128 == 0) return result;
        shift += 7;
    }
    return error.InvalidDelta;
}

const LimitedOutput = struct {
    list: std.ArrayList(u8),
    limit: usize,
    fn init(a: Allocator, limit: usize) LimitedOutput {
        return .{ .list = std.ArrayList(u8).init(a), .limit = limit };
    }
    fn write(self: *LimitedOutput, bytes: []const u8) error{ OutOfMemory, ObjectTooLarge }!usize {
        if (bytes.len > self.limit - self.list.items.len) return error.ObjectTooLarge;
        try self.list.appendSlice(bytes);
        return bytes.len;
    }
    fn writer(self: *LimitedOutput) std.io.Writer(*LimitedOutput, error{ OutOfMemory, ObjectTooLarge }, write) {
        return .{ .context = self };
    }
};

pub fn inflate(a: Allocator, compressed: []const u8) ![]const u8 {
    var input = std.io.fixedBufferStream(compressed);
    var output = LimitedOutput.init(a, max_object);
    try std.compress.zlib.decompress(input.reader(), output.writer());
    return output.list.toOwnedSlice();
}

pub fn sha1(bytes: []const u8) [20]u8 {
    var out: [20]u8 = undefined;
    std.crypto.hash.Sha1.hash(bytes, &out, .{});
    return out;
}
pub fn sha1Hex(a: Allocator, bytes: []const u8) ![]const u8 {
    const hex = std.fmt.bytesToHex(sha1(bytes), .lower);
    return a.dupe(u8, &hex);
}
fn verifyObject(id: []const u8, value: Object) !void {
    var hash = std.crypto.hash.Sha1.init(.{});
    hash.update(value.kind);
    hash.update(" ");
    var size: [32]u8 = undefined;
    hash.update(try std.fmt.bufPrint(&size, "{d}", .{value.bytes.len}));
    hash.update(&.{0});
    hash.update(value.bytes);
    const digest = hash.finalResult();
    const wanted = try parseOid(id);
    if (!std.mem.eql(u8, &digest, &wanted)) return error.ObjectChecksum;
}
fn parseOid(id: []const u8) ![20]u8 {
    if (!isOid(id)) return error.InvalidObjectId;
    var bytes: [20]u8 = undefined;
    _ = try std.fmt.hexToBytes(&bytes, id);
    return bytes;
}
fn isOid(id: []const u8) bool {
    if (id.len != 40) return false;
    for (id) |c| if (!std.ascii.isHex(c)) return false;
    return true;
}
fn isKind(kind: []const u8) bool {
    for ([_][]const u8{ "blob", "tree", "commit", "tag" }) |candidate| if (std.mem.eql(u8, kind, candidate)) return true;
    return false;
}
fn be32(bytes: []const u8) u32 {
    return std.mem.readInt(u32, bytes[0..4], .big);
}
fn readFile(a: Allocator, path: []const u8, limit: usize) ![]const u8 {
    const file = try std.fs.openFileAbsolute(path, .{});
    defer file.close();
    return file.readToEndAlloc(a, limit);
}
fn str(value: []const u8) J {
    return .{ .string = value };
}
fn obj(a: Allocator, fields: []const struct { []const u8, J }) !J {
    var map = std.json.ObjectMap.init(a);
    for (fields) |item| try map.put(item[0], item[1]);
    return .{ .object = map };
}
fn field(value: J, key: []const u8) ?J {
    return if (value == .object) value.object.get(key) else null;
}
fn textField(value: J, key: []const u8, default: []const u8) ![]const u8 {
    const v = field(value, key) orelse return default;
    if (v != .string) return error.InvalidRequest;
    return v.string;
}
fn intField(value: J, key: []const u8, default: i64) !i64 {
    const v = field(value, key) orelse return default;
    if (v != .integer) return error.InvalidRequest;
    return v.integer;
}
fn commitJson(a: Allocator, c: Commit) !J {
    var parents = std.json.Array.init(a);
    for (c.parents) |id| try parents.append(str(id));
    return obj(a, &.{ .{ "id", str(c.id) }, .{ "tree", str(c.tree) }, .{ "parents", .{ .array = parents } }, .{ "author", str(c.author) }, .{ "committer", str(c.committer) }, .{ "subject", str(c.subject) }, .{ "message", str(c.message) }, .{ "timestamp", .{ .integer = c.timestamp } } });
}
fn objectJson(a: Allocator, value: Object) !J {
    const encoder = std.base64.standard.Encoder;
    const bytes = try a.alloc(u8, encoder.calcSize(value.bytes.len));
    _ = encoder.encode(bytes, value.bytes);
    var result = try obj(a, &.{ .{ "kind", str(value.kind) }, .{ "bytes", str(bytes) }, .{ "encoding", str("base64") }, .{ "size", .{ .integer = @intCast(value.bytes.len) } } });
    if (std.unicode.utf8ValidateSlice(value.bytes)) try result.object.put("text", str(value.bytes));
    return result;
}
fn treeJson(a: Allocator, entries: []const Entry) !J {
    var result = std.json.Array.init(a);
    for (entries) |entry| try result.append(try obj(a, &.{ .{ "name", str(entry.name) }, .{ "mode", str(entry.mode) }, .{ "kind", str(entry.kind) }, .{ "id", str(entry.id) } }));
    return .{ .array = result };
}

/// Natural JSON request interface shared by CLI protocol and EYG GitQuery effect.
/// History is first-parent; filters do not change traversal order.
pub fn request(a: Allocator, input: J) !J {
    const action = try textField(input, "action", "query");
    if (@import("git_write.zig").handles(action)) return @import("git_write.zig").request(a, input);
    var repo = try Repository.init(a, try textField(input, "repo", "."));
    const revision = try textField(input, "ref", "HEAD");
    if (std.mem.eql(u8, action, "head")) return repo.head();
    if (std.mem.eql(u8, action, "remotes")) return @import("git_config.zig").remotes(a, try std.fs.path.join(a, &.{ repo.common, "config" }));
    if (std.mem.eql(u8, action, "resolve")) return str(try repo.resolve(revision));
    const id = try textField(input, "id", revision);
    if (std.mem.eql(u8, action, "object")) return objectJson(a, try repo.object(try repo.resolve(id)));
    if (std.mem.eql(u8, action, "commit")) return commitJson(a, try repo.commit(id));
    if (std.mem.eql(u8, action, "show")) return objectJson(a, try repo.show(revision, try textField(input, "path", "")));
    if (std.mem.eql(u8, action, "tree")) {
        const resolved = try repo.resolve(id);
        const value = try repo.object(resolved);
        return treeJson(a, try repo.tree(if (std.mem.eql(u8, value.kind, "commit")) (try repo.commit(resolved)).tree else resolved));
    }
    if (std.mem.eql(u8, action, "history") or std.mem.eql(u8, action, "query")) {
        const limit = try intField(input, "limit", 20);
        const scan_limit = try intField(input, "scan_limit", 10000);
        if (limit < 0 or limit > 10000 or scan_limit < 0 or scan_limit > 100000) return error.QueryLimit;
        const contains = try textField(input, "contains", "");
        const author = try textField(input, "author", "");
        const path = try textField(input, "path", "");
        const since = try intField(input, "since", std.math.minInt(i64));
        const until = try intField(input, "until", std.math.maxInt(i64));
        var result = std.json.Array.init(a);
        var next: ?[]const u8 = try repo.resolve(revision);
        var scanned: usize = 0;
        while (next) |current| {
            if (result.items.len >= limit or scanned >= scan_limit) break;
            const c = try repo.commit(current);
            scanned += 1;
            next = if (c.parents.len == 0) null else c.parents[0];
            if (c.timestamp < since or c.timestamp > until or std.mem.indexOf(u8, c.message, contains) == null or std.mem.indexOf(u8, c.author, author) == null) continue;
            if (path.len != 0) {
                const current_id = try repo.pathId(c.tree, path);
                const parent_id = if (next) |parent| try repo.pathId((try repo.commit(parent)).tree, path) else null;
                if (current_id == null and parent_id == null) continue;
                if (current_id != null and parent_id != null and std.mem.eql(u8, current_id.?, parent_id.?)) continue;
            }
            try result.append(try commitJson(a, c));
        }
        return .{ .array = result };
    }
    return error.UnknownGitAction;
}

test "delta reconstruction accepts insert/copy and rejects corrupt ranges" {
    var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer arena.deinit();
    const a = arena.allocator();
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("hello EYG", try applyDelta(a, "hello", &.{ 5, 9, 0x90, 5, 4, ' ', 'E', 'Y', 'G' }));
    try std.testing.expectError(error.InvalidDelta, applyDelta(a, "hello", &.{ 5, 9, 0 }));
    try std.testing.expectError(error.InvalidDelta, applyDelta(a, "hello", &.{ 5, 9, 0x91, 99, 5 }));
    try std.testing.expectError(error.DeltaBaseSize, applyDelta(a, "hello", &.{ 4, 0 }));
}

test "zlib checks Adler checksum and empty stream" {
    var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer arena.deinit();
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("", try inflate(arena.allocator(), &.{ 0x78, 0x9c, 3, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1 }));
    try std.testing.expectError(error.WrongZlibChecksum, inflate(arena.allocator(), &.{ 0x78, 0x9c, 3, 0, 0, 0, 0, 2 }));
}
```

```zig
//! Repository-local Git remote configuration, without global/include expansion.
const std = @import("std");
const A = std.mem.Allocator;
const J = std.json.Value;
const Remote = struct { name: []const u8, urls: std.json.Array, push_urls: std.json.Array, fetch: std.json.Array };

pub fn remotes(a: A, path: []const u8) !J {
    var file = try std.fs.openFileAbsolute(path, .{});
    defer file.close();
    return parse(a, try file.readToEndAlloc(a, 4 * 1024 * 1024));
}

pub fn parse(a: A, input: []const u8) !J {
    var logical = std.ArrayList(u8).init(a);
    var at: usize = 0;
    // Continuations are removed before parsing; every other escape is decoded
    // only within its value/subsection, preserving comment and quote context.
    while (at < input.len) : (at += 1) {
        if (input[at] == '\\' and at + 1 < input.len and input[at + 1] == '\n') {
            at += 1;
            continue;
        }
        if (input[at] == '\\' and at + 2 < input.len and input[at + 1] == '\r' and input[at + 2] == '\n') {
            at += 2;
            continue;
        }
        try logical.append(input[at]);
    }
    var items = std.ArrayList(Remote).init(a);
    var selected: ?usize = null;
    var lines = std.mem.splitScalar(u8, logical.items, '\n');
    while (lines.next()) |raw| {
        const line = std.mem.trim(u8, try uncomment(a, raw), " \t\r");
        if (line.len == 0) continue;
        if (line[0] == '[') {
            if (line[line.len - 1] != ']') return error.InvalidGitConfig;
            selected = null;
            const section = std.mem.trim(u8, line[1 .. line.len - 1], " \t");
            var name: ?[]const u8 = null;
            if (std.mem.indexOfAny(u8, section, " \t")) |space| {
                if (!std.ascii.eqlIgnoreCase(section[0..space], "remote")) continue;
                const subsection = std.mem.trim(u8, section[space..], " \t");
                if (subsection.len < 2 or subsection[0] != '"' or subsection[subsection.len - 1] != '"') return error.InvalidGitConfig;
                name = try decode(a, subsection, true);
            } else if (std.mem.indexOfScalar(u8, section, '.')) |dot| {
                if (std.ascii.eqlIgnoreCase(section[0..dot], "remote")) name = try std.ascii.allocLowerString(a, section[dot + 1 ..]);
            }
            if (name) |remote_name| {
                for (items.items, 0..) |item, index| if (std.mem.eql(u8, item.name, remote_name)) {
                    selected = index;
                    break;
                };
                if (selected == null) {
                    selected = items.items.len;
                    try items.append(.{ .name = remote_name, .urls = std.json.Array.init(a), .push_urls = std.json.Array.init(a), .fetch = std.json.Array.init(a) });
                }
            }
            continue;
        }
        const index = selected orelse continue;
        const eq = std.mem.indexOfScalar(u8, line, '=');
        const key = std.mem.trim(u8, if (eq) |e| line[0..e] else line, " \t");
        if (key.len == 0 or !std.ascii.isAlphabetic(key[0])) return error.InvalidGitConfig;
        for (key) |c| if (!std.ascii.isAlphanumeric(c) and c != '-') return error.InvalidGitConfig;
        const value = try decode(a, if (eq) |e| std.mem.trim(u8, line[e + 1 ..], " \t") else "true", false);
        const item = &items.items[index];
        if (std.ascii.eqlIgnoreCase(key, "url")) try item.urls.append(.{ .string = value }) else if (std.ascii.eqlIgnoreCase(key, "pushurl")) try item.push_urls.append(.{ .string = value }) else if (std.ascii.eqlIgnoreCase(key, "fetch")) try item.fetch.append(.{ .string = value });
    }
    var result = std.json.Array.init(a);
    for (items.items) |item| {
        var object = std.json.ObjectMap.init(a);
        try object.put("name", .{ .string = item.name });
        try object.put("urls", .{ .array = item.urls });
        try object.put("push_urls", .{ .array = if (item.push_urls.items.len == 0) item.urls else item.push_urls });
        try object.put("fetch", .{ .array = item.fetch });
        try result.append(.{ .object = object });
    }
    return .{ .array = result };
}

fn uncomment(a: A, input: []const u8) ![]const u8 {
    _ = a;
    var quote = false;
    var escape = false;
    for (input, 0..) |c, i| {
        if (escape) {
            escape = false;
            continue;
        }
        if (c == '\\') {
            escape = true;
            continue;
        }
        if (c == '"') quote = !quote;
        if (!quote and (c == '#' or c == ';')) return input[0..i];
    }
    if (quote or escape) return error.InvalidGitConfig;
    return input;
}
fn decode(a: A, input: []const u8, subsection: bool) ![]const u8 {
    var output = std.ArrayList(u8).init(a);
    var quote = false;
    var at: usize = 0;
    while (at < input.len) : (at += 1) {
        const c = input[at];
        if (c == '"') {
            quote = !quote;
            continue;
        }
        if (c == '\\') {
            at += 1;
            if (at >= input.len) return error.InvalidGitConfig;
            const escaped = input[at];
            if (subsection) {
                if (escaped != '"' and escaped != '\\') return error.InvalidGitConfig;
                try output.append(escaped);
            } else try output.append(switch (escaped) {
                'n' => '\n',
                't' => '\t',
                'b' => 8,
                '"' => '"',
                '\\' => '\\',
                else => return error.InvalidGitConfig,
            });
        } else try output.append(c);
    }
    if (quote or !std.unicode.utf8ValidateSlice(output.items)) return error.InvalidGitConfig;
    return output.toOwnedSlice();
}

test "remote values preserve quoted syntax, repetition, case and continuations" {
    var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer arena.deinit();
    const parsed = try parse(arena.allocator(), "[ReMoTe \"Origin\"]\nURL = \"https://example.test/a#b\" ; comment\nurl = one\\\n-two\npushurl = ssh://example.test/repo\nfetch = +refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/Origin/*\n");
    const remote = parsed.array.items[0].object;
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("Origin", remote.get("name").?.string);
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("https://example.test/a#b", remote.get("urls").?.array.items[0].string);
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("one-two", remote.get("urls").?.array.items[1].string);
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("ssh://example.test/repo", remote.get("push_urls").?.array.items[0].string);
}
```

```zig
//! Local immutable object writes and cooperative compare-and-swap branch refs.
//! No working tree/index mutations; all paths are repository-local.
const std = @import("std");
const git = @import("git.zig");
const A = std.mem.Allocator;
const J = std.json.Value;

pub fn handles(action: []const u8) bool {
    for ([_][]const u8{ "init", "write_object", "write_blob", "write_tree", "commit_tree", "update_ref", "create_branch", "snapshot_tree", "commit_snapshot" }) |known|
        if (std.mem.eql(u8, known, action)) return true;
    return false;
}

pub fn request(a: A, input: J) !J {
    const action = try text(input, "action", "");
    const root = try text(input, "repo", ".");
    if (std.mem.eql(u8, action, "init")) return .{ .string = try initialize(a, root, try text(input, "branch", "main")) };
    var repo = try git.Repository.init(a, root);
    if (std.mem.eql(u8, action, "write_blob") or std.mem.eql(u8, action, "write_object")) {
        const kind = if (std.mem.eql(u8, action, "write_blob")) "blob" else try text(input, "kind", "blob");
        return .{ .string = try writeObject(&repo, kind, try contents(a, input)) };
    }
    if (std.mem.eql(u8, action, "write_tree")) return .{ .string = try writeTree(&repo, get(input, "entries") orelse return error.InvalidRequest) };
    if (std.mem.eql(u8, action, "commit_tree")) return .{ .string = try commitTree(&repo, input) };
    if (std.mem.eql(u8, action, "snapshot_tree")) return .{ .string = try snapshotTree(&repo, get(input, "files") orelse return error.InvalidRequest) };
    if (std.mem.eql(u8, action, "update_ref") or std.mem.eql(u8, action, "create_branch")) {
        const ref = if (std.mem.eql(u8, action, "create_branch")) try std.fmt.allocPrint(a, "refs/heads/{s}", .{try text(input, "name", "")}) else try text(input, "ref", "");
        const id = try text(input, "id", "");
        const expected = if (std.mem.eql(u8, action, "create_branch")) null else get(input, "expected");
        try updateRef(&repo, ref, expected, id);
        return .{ .string = id };
    }
    if (std.mem.eql(u8, action, "commit_snapshot")) {
        var options = input;
        const tree_id = try snapshotTree(&repo, get(input, "files") orelse return error.InvalidRequest);
        try options.object.put("tree", .{ .string = tree_id });
        const expected = get(input, "expected");
        if (get(input, "parents") == null) {
            var parents = std.json.Array.init(a);
            if (expected) |old| if (old == .string) {
                try parents.append(old);
            };
            try options.object.put("parents", .{ .array = parents });
        }
        const id = try commitTree(&repo, options);
        try updateRef(&repo, try text(input, "ref", "refs/heads/main"), expected, id);
        var out = std.json.ObjectMap.init(a);
        try out.put("id", .{ .string = id });
        try out.put("tree", .{ .string = tree_id });
        return .{ .object = out };
    }
    return error.UnknownGitAction;
}

fn initialize(a: A, root: []const u8, branch: []const u8) ![]const u8 {
    const ref = try std.fmt.allocPrint(a, "refs/heads/{s}", .{branch});
    try validRef(ref);
    const abs = try std.fs.path.resolve(a, &.{root});
    const dotgit = try std.fs.path.join(a, &.{ abs, ".git" });
    try std.fs.cwd().makePath(dotgit);
    var dir = try std.fs.openDirAbsolute(dotgit, .{});
    defer dir.close();
    // Initialization refuses any existing configuration or HEAD.
    if (dir.access("HEAD", .{})) |_| return error.RepositoryExists else |err| if (err != error.FileNotFound) return err;
    if (dir.access("config", .{})) |_| return error.RepositoryExists else |err| if (err != error.FileNotFound) return err;
    try dir.makePath("objects/pack");
    try dir.makePath("refs/heads");
    var config = try dir.createFile("config", .{ .exclusive = true });
    defer config.close();
    try config.writeAll("[core]\n\trepositoryformatversion = 0\n\tbare = false\n\tfilemode = true\n");
    try config.sync();
    var head = try dir.createFile("HEAD", .{ .exclusive = true });
    defer head.close();
    try head.writer().print("ref: {s}\n", .{ref});
    try head.sync();
    return abs;
}

pub fn writeObject(repo: *git.Repository, kind: []const u8, bytes: []const u8) ![]const u8 {
    if (!std.mem.eql(u8, kind, "blob") and !std.mem.eql(u8, kind, "tree") and !std.mem.eql(u8, kind, "commit") and !std.mem.eql(u8, kind, "tag")) return error.InvalidObjectKind;
    if (bytes.len > 64 * 1024 * 1024) return error.ObjectTooLarge;
    const a = repo.allocator;
    var raw = std.ArrayList(u8).init(a);
    try raw.writer().print("{s} {d}\x00", .{ kind, bytes.len });
    try raw.appendSlice(bytes);
    const id = try git.sha1Hex(a, raw.items);
    const directory = try std.fs.path.join(a, &.{ repo.common, "objects", id[0..2] });
    try std.fs.cwd().makePath(directory);
    var dir = try std.fs.openDirAbsolute(directory, .{});
    defer dir.close();
    if (dir.access(id[2..], .{})) |_| {
        // Never replace an existing corrupt immutable object.
        _ = try repo.object(id);
        return id;
    } else |err| if (err != error.FileNotFound) return err;
    const temp = try std.fmt.allocPrint(a, "tmp_obj_{x}", .{std.crypto.random.int(u64)});
    var file = try dir.createFile(temp, .{ .exclusive = true, .mode = 0o444 });
    defer file.close();
    defer dir.deleteFile(temp) catch {};
    var source = std.io.fixedBufferStream(raw.items);
    try std.compress.zlib.compress(source.reader(), file.writer(), .{ .level = .fast });
    try file.sync();
    // Both sides of a race publish the same content-addressed immutable bytes.
    try dir.rename(temp, id[2..]);
    return id;
}

const TreeEntry = struct { name: []const u8, key: []const u8, mode: []const u8, id: []const u8 };
fn writeTree(repo: *git.Repository, items: J) ![]const u8 {
    if (items != .array) return error.InvalidRequest;
    const a = repo.allocator;
    var entries = std.ArrayList(TreeEntry).init(a);
    for (items.array.items) |item| {
        const name = try text(item, "name", "");
        try validName(name);
        const mode = try text(item, "mode", "100644");
        if (!validMode(mode, true)) return error.InvalidMode;
        const id = try text(item, "id", "");
        try validOid(id);
        // Gitlinks point into another repository and need not be locally present.
        if (!std.mem.eql(u8, mode, "160000")) {
            const object = try repo.object(id);
            const expected = if (std.mem.eql(u8, mode, "40000")) "tree" else "blob";
            if (!std.mem.eql(u8, object.kind, expected)) return error.InvalidTreeTarget;
        }
        try entries.append(.{ .name = name, .mode = mode, .id = id, .key = if (std.mem.eql(u8, mode, "40000")) try std.fmt.allocPrint(a, "{s}/", .{name}) else name });
    }
    std.mem.sort(TreeEntry, entries.items, {}, struct {
        fn less(_: void, lhs: TreeEntry, rhs: TreeEntry) bool {
            return std.mem.lessThan(u8, lhs.key, rhs.key);
        }
    }.less);
    var raw = std.ArrayList(u8).init(a);
    var seen = std.StringHashMap(void).init(a);
    for (entries.items) |entry| {
        if (seen.contains(entry.name)) return error.DuplicatePath;
        try seen.put(entry.name, {});
        try raw.writer().print("{s} {s}\x00", .{ entry.mode, entry.name });
        var hash: [20]u8 = undefined;
        _ = try std.fmt.hexToBytes(&hash, entry.id);
        try raw.appendSlice(&hash);
    }
    return writeObject(repo, "tree", raw.items);
}

fn commitTree(repo: *git.Repository, options: J) ![]const u8 {
    const a = repo.allocator;
    const tree_id = try text(options, "tree", "");
    const tree = try repo.object(tree_id);
    if (!std.mem.eql(u8, tree.kind, "tree")) return error.ExpectedTree;
    const parents: J = get(options, "parents") orelse .{ .array = std.json.Array.init(a) };
    if (parents != .array) return error.InvalidRequest;
    var raw = std.ArrayList(u8).init(a);
    try raw.writer().print("tree {s}\n", .{tree_id});
    for (parents.array.items) |parent| {
        if (parent != .string) return error.InvalidRequest;
        const object = try repo.object(parent.string);
        if (!std.mem.eql(u8, object.kind, "commit")) return error.ExpectedCommit;
        try raw.writer().print("parent {s}\n", .{parent.string});
    }
    const author = try identity(a, get(options, "author") orelse return error.InvalidIdentity);
    const committer = try identity(a, get(options, "committer") orelse return error.InvalidIdentity);
    const message = try text(options, "message", "");
    if (std.mem.indexOfScalar(u8, message, 0) != null) return error.InvalidCommit;
    try raw.writer().print("author {s}\ncommitter {s}\n\n{s}", .{ author, committer, message });
    if (message.len == 0 or message[message.len - 1] != '\n') try raw.append('\n');
    return writeObject(repo, "commit", raw.items);
}

fn identity(a: A, input: J) ![]const u8 {
    const name = try text(input, "name", "");
    const email = try text(input, "email", "");
    const timestamp = get(input, "timestamp") orelse return error.InvalidIdentity;
    const timezone = try text(input, "timezone", "+0000");
    if (name.len == 0 or email.len == 0 or std.mem.indexOfAny(u8, name, "\x00\r\n<>") != null or std.mem.indexOfAny(u8, email, "\x00\r\n<> ") != null or timestamp != .integer) return error.InvalidIdentity;
    if (timezone.len != 5 or (timezone[0] != '+' and timezone[0] != '-')) return error.InvalidIdentity;
    for (timezone[1..]) |digit| if (!std.ascii.isDigit(digit)) return error.InvalidIdentity;
    if (try std.fmt.parseInt(u8, timezone[1..3], 10) > 23 or try std.fmt.parseInt(u8, timezone[3..5], 10) > 59) return error.InvalidIdentity;
    return std.fmt.allocPrint(a, "{s} <{s}> {d} {s}", .{ name, email, timestamp.integer, timezone });
}

fn updateRef(repo: *git.Repository, ref: []const u8, expected: ?J, id: []const u8) !void {
    try validRef(ref);
    try validOid(id);
    const object = try repo.object(id);
    if (!std.mem.eql(u8, object.kind, "commit")) return error.ExpectedCommit;
    const a = repo.allocator;
    const packed_lock_path = try std.fs.path.join(a, &.{ repo.common, "packed-refs.lock" });
    var packed_lock = try std.fs.createFileAbsolute(packed_lock_path, .{ .exclusive = true });
    defer packed_lock.close();
    defer std.fs.deleteFileAbsolute(packed_lock_path) catch {};
    const path = try std.fs.path.join(a, &.{ repo.common, ref });
    try std.fs.cwd().makePath(std.fs.path.dirname(path).?);
    const lock_path = try std.fmt.allocPrint(a, "{s}.lock", .{path});
    var lock = try std.fs.createFileAbsolute(lock_path, .{ .exclusive = true });
    defer lock.close();
    defer std.fs.deleteFileAbsolute(lock_path) catch {};
    // Branch refs must be direct. Updating symbolic branch refs would require
    // locking the complete chain to avoid a race with a retargeting writer.
    if (std.fs.openFileAbsolute(path, .{})) |file| {
        defer file.close();
        var prefix: [5]u8 = undefined;
        if (try file.readAll(&prefix) == 5 and std.mem.eql(u8, &prefix, "ref: ")) return error.SymbolicWriteRef;
    } else |err| if (err != error.FileNotFound) return err;
    const previous: ?[]const u8 = repo.resolve(ref) catch |err| blk: {
        if (err != error.UnknownReference and err != error.FileNotFound) return err;
        break :blk null;
    };
    const wanted: ?[]const u8 = if (expected) |value| switch (value) {
        .null => null,
        .string => value.string,
        else => return error.InvalidRequest,
    } else null;
    if (wanted) |old| {
        try validOid(old);
        if (previous == null or !std.mem.eql(u8, previous.?, old)) return error.StaleReference;
    } else if (previous != null) return error.StaleReference;
    try lock.writer().print("{s}\n", .{id});
    try lock.sync();
    try std.fs.renameAbsolute(lock_path, path);
}

const Snapshot = struct { files: std.ArrayList(J), children: std.StringHashMap(*Snapshot) };
fn snapshotTree(repo: *git.Repository, files: J) ![]const u8 {
    if (files != .array) return error.InvalidRequest;
    var root = Snapshot{ .files = std.ArrayList(J).init(repo.allocator), .children = std.StringHashMap(*Snapshot).init(repo.allocator) };
    for (files.array.items) |file| {
        const path = try text(file, "path", "");
        var parts = std.mem.splitScalar(u8, path, '/');
        var node = &root;
        var part = parts.next() orelse return error.InvalidPath;
        while (parts.next()) |next| {
            try validName(part);
            const entry = try node.children.getOrPut(part);
            if (!entry.found_existing) {
                const child = try repo.allocator.create(Snapshot);
                child.* = .{ .files = std.ArrayList(J).init(repo.allocator), .children = std.StringHashMap(*Snapshot).init(repo.allocator) };
                entry.value_ptr.* = child;
            }
            node = entry.value_ptr.*;
            part = next;
        }
        try validName(part);
        const mode = try text(file, "mode", "100644");
        if (!validMode(mode, false)) return error.InvalidMode;
        const id = try writeObject(repo, "blob", try contents(repo.allocator, file));
        var object = std.json.ObjectMap.init(repo.allocator);
        try object.put("name", .{ .string = part });
        try object.put("mode", .{ .string = mode });
        try object.put("id", .{ .string = id });
        try node.files.append(.{ .object = object });
    }
    return snapshotNode(repo, &root);
}
fn snapshotNode(repo: *git.Repository, node: *Snapshot) anyerror![]const u8 {
    var entries = node.files;
    var iter = node.children.iterator();
    while (iter.next()) |child| {
        const id = try snapshotNode(repo, child.value_ptr.*);
        var object = std.json.ObjectMap.init(repo.allocator);
        try object.put("name", .{ .string = child.key_ptr.* });
        try object.put("mode", .{ .string = "40000" });
        try object.put("id", .{ .string = id });
        try entries.append(.{ .object = object });
    }
    return writeTree(repo, .{ .array = entries });
}

fn validName(name: []const u8) !void {
    if (name.len == 0 or std.mem.eql(u8, name, ".") or std.mem.eql(u8, name, "..") or std.ascii.eqlIgnoreCase(name, ".git") or std.mem.indexOfAny(u8, name, "/\x00") != null) return error.InvalidPath;
}
fn validMode(mode: []const u8, tree: bool) bool {
    for ([_][]const u8{ "100644", "100755", "120000" }) |candidate| if (std.mem.eql(u8, candidate, mode)) return true;
    return tree and (std.mem.eql(u8, mode, "40000") or std.mem.eql(u8, mode, "160000"));
}
fn validRef(ref: []const u8) !void {
    if (!std.mem.startsWith(u8, ref, "refs/heads/") or ref.len <= 11 or ref[ref.len - 1] == '.' or std.mem.indexOfAny(u8, ref, " ~^:?*[\\\x00\r\n\t") != null or std.mem.indexOf(u8, ref, "..") != null or std.mem.indexOf(u8, ref, "@{") != null) return error.InvalidReference;
    var parts = std.mem.splitScalar(u8, ref, '/');
    while (parts.next()) |part| if (part.len == 0 or part[0] == '.' or std.mem.endsWith(u8, part, ".lock")) return error.InvalidReference;
}
fn validOid(id: []const u8) !void {
    if (id.len != 40) return error.InvalidObjectId;
    for (id) |digit| if (!std.ascii.isHex(digit)) return error.InvalidObjectId;
}
fn get(input: J, key: []const u8) ?J {
    return if (input == .object) input.object.get(key) else null;
}
fn text(input: J, key: []const u8, default: []const u8) ![]const u8 {
    const value = get(input, key) orelse return default;
    if (value != .string) return error.InvalidRequest;
    return value.string;
}
fn contents(a: A, input: J) ![]const u8 {
    if (get(input, "text")) |value| {
        if (value != .string) return error.InvalidRequest;
        return value.string;
    }
    if (get(input, "contents")) |value| {
        if (value != .string) return error.InvalidRequest;
        return value.string;
    }
    const value = try text(input, "bytes", "");
    const decoder = std.base64.standard.Decoder;
    const bytes = try a.alloc(u8, try decoder.calcSizeForSlice(value));
    try decoder.decode(bytes, value);
    return bytes;
}
```

```zig
//! Native implementation of touch_grass Fetch. Networking remains an effect;
//! requests use configured proxies and verified TLS with the host CA bundle.
const std = @import("std");
const builtin = @import("builtin");
const interpreter = @import("interpreter.zig");
pub const Engine = interpreter.Engine;
const V = interpreter.Value;
const A = std.mem.Allocator;
const maximum_body = 64 * 1024 * 1024;
const maximum_headers = 64 * 1024;
const maximum_redirects = 20;

/// Match touch_grass/fetch: Result({status,headers,body}, String).
/// Network, protocol and malformed-request errors are values, not interpreter
/// panics. OutOfMemory remains an allocation error for the embedding host.
pub fn effect(engine: *Engine, lift: V) !V {
    const response = perform(engine, lift) catch |err| {
        if (err == error.OutOfMemory) return err;
        return engine.tag("Error", .{ .string = try errorMessage(engine.allocator, lift, err) });
    };
    return engine.tag("Ok", response);
}

/// Shared GET transport for native effect hosts, including the read-only hub.
/// Returned storage belongs to `a`; network/protocol errors propagate normally.
pub const Response = struct { status: u16, headers: []const std.http.Header, body: []const u8 };
pub fn get(a: A, url: []const u8) !Response {
    const uri = try std.Uri.parse(url);
    if (uri.user != null or uri.password != null) return error.UrlCredentialsForbidden;
    const scheme = if (std.ascii.eqlIgnoreCase(uri.scheme, "https")) "HTTPS" else if (std.ascii.eqlIgnoreCase(uri.scheme, "http")) "HTTP" else return error.UnsupportedUriScheme;
    var engine = Engine.init(a);
    const lift = try record(a, &.{
        .{ .name = "method", .value = try engine.tag("GET", interpreter.unit()) },
        .{ .name = "scheme", .value = try engine.tag(scheme, interpreter.unit()) },
        .{ .name = "host", .value = .{ .string = try (uri.host orelse return error.UriMissingHost).toRawMaybeAlloc(a) } },
        .{ .name = "port", .value = if (uri.port) |port| try engine.tag("Some", .{ .integer = port }) else try engine.tag("None", interpreter.unit()) },
        .{ .name = "path", .value = .{ .string = componentBytes(uri.path) } },
        .{ .name = "query", .value = if (uri.query) |query| try engine.tag("Some", .{ .string = componentBytes(query) }) else try engine.tag("None", interpreter.unit()) },
        .{ .name = "headers", .value = .{ .list = null } },
        .{ .name = "body", .value = .{ .binary = "" } },
    });
    const response = try perform(&engine, lift);
    const status = try field(response, "status");
    const body = try field(response, "body");
    var values = (try field(response, "headers")).list;
    var headers = std.ArrayList(std.http.Header).init(a);
    while (values) |cell| : (values = cell.tail) try headers.append(.{ .name = try string(try field(cell.head, "key")), .value = try string(try field(cell.head, "value")) });
    return .{ .status = @intCast(status.integer), .headers = try headers.toOwnedSlice(), .body = body.binary };
}

fn perform(engine: *Engine, lift: V) !V {
    // Release sockets, certificate parsing and request metadata after this
    // operation even when the interpreter itself owns a long-lived arena.
    var temporary = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.heap.page_allocator);
    defer temporary.deinit();
    const a = temporary.allocator();
    var uri = try requestUri(a, lift);
    var method = try methodName(a, try field(lift, "method"));
    const input_body = try field(lift, "body");
    if (input_body != .binary) return error.InvalidFetchBody;
    var body = if (std.mem.eql(u8, method, "GET") or std.mem.eql(u8, method, "HEAD")) @as([]const u8, "") else input_body.binary;
    if (std.mem.eql(u8, method, "OPTIONS") and body.len != 0) return error.OptionsBodyUnsupported;
    var headers = try requestHeaders(a, try field(lift, "headers"));
    var client = std.http.Client{ .allocator = a };
    defer client.deinit();
    try client.initDefaultProxies(a);
    const http_proxy = client.http_proxy;
    const https_proxy = client.https_proxy;
    const no_proxy = try environment(a, &.{ "no_proxy", "NO_PROXY" });
    var trust_ready = false;

    for (0..maximum_redirects + 1) |redirects| {
        if (!std.ascii.eqlIgnoreCase(uri.scheme, "http") and !std.ascii.eqlIgnoreCase(uri.scheme, "https")) return error.UnsupportedUriScheme;
        if (uri.user != null or uri.password != null) return error.UrlCredentialsForbidden;
        const host = try (uri.host orelse return error.UriMissingHost).toRawMaybeAlloc(a);
        if (host.len == 0 or std.mem.indexOfAny(u8, host, "\r\n\x00") != null) return error.InvalidFetchHost;
        const port = uri.port orelse if (std.ascii.eqlIgnoreCase(uri.scheme, "https")) @as(u16, 443) else 80;
        const direct = noProxyMatches(no_proxy orelse "", host, port);
        client.http_proxy = if (direct) null else http_proxy;
        client.https_proxy = if (direct) null else https_proxy;
        // Plain HTTP uses the proxy absolute-form request, not a CONNECT.
        if (client.http_proxy) |proxy| proxy.supports_connect = false;
        if (!trust_ready and std.ascii.eqlIgnoreCase(uri.scheme, "https")) {
            try configureTrust(&client, a);
            trust_ready = true;
        }
        var standard_headers = std.http.Client.Request.Headers{};
        standard_headers.authorization = .omit;
        if (hasHeader(headers.items, "host")) standard_headers.host = .omit;
        if (hasHeader(headers.items, "user-agent")) standard_headers.user_agent = .omit;
        if (hasHeader(headers.items, "connection")) standard_headers.connection = .omit;
        if (hasHeader(headers.items, "accept-encoding")) standard_headers.accept_encoding = .omit;
        if (hasHeader(headers.items, "content-type")) standard_headers.content_type = .omit;
        var outgoing = std.ArrayList(std.http.Header).init(a);
        try outgoing.appendSlice(headers.items);
        const send_body = !std.mem.eql(u8, method, "GET") and !std.mem.eql(u8, method, "HEAD");
        if (send_body) try outgoing.append(.{ .name = "content-length", .value = try std.fmt.allocPrint(a, "{d}", .{body.len}) });
        const header_buffer = try a.alloc(u8, maximum_headers);
        const connection: ?*std.http.Client.Connection = if (std.ascii.eqlIgnoreCase(uri.scheme, "https")) tunnel: {
            if (client.https_proxy) |proxy| switch (try tlsTunnel(&client, proxy, uri, a, engine)) {
                .connection => |conn| break :tunnel conn,
                .response => |response| return response,
            };
            break :tunnel try directTls(&client, uri, a);
        } else null;
        var req = client.open(if (method.len <= 8) @enumFromInt(std.http.Method.parse(method)) else .POST, uri, .{
            .server_header_buffer = header_buffer,
            .connection = connection,
            .redirect_behavior = .unhandled,
            .headers = standard_headers,
            .extra_headers = outgoing.items,
            .keep_alive = false,
        }) catch |err| {
            if (connection) |owned| {
                owned.closing = true;
                client.connection_pool.release(a, owned);
            }
            return err;
        };
        defer req.deinit();
        // std.http 0.14 disallows bodies for DELETE/OPTIONS even though fetch
        // permits them. We write their known-length payload through the same
        // acquired connection, with Content-Length emitted above.
        if (method.len <= 8) try req.send() else try sendLongMethod(&req, method, outgoing.items);
        if (send_body and body.len != 0) try req.connection.?.writer().writeAll(body);
        try req.finish();
        try req.wait();
        const code: u16 = @intFromEnum(req.response.status);
        if (isRedirect(code)) {
            const location = req.response.location orelse return responseValue(engine, &req);
            if (redirects == maximum_redirects) return error.TooManyHttpRedirects;
            // The location points into the response buffer; give the resolver
            // fresh storage that survives this request's deinitialization.
            const base_size = componentBytes(uri.path).len;
            var scratch = try a.alloc(u8, maximum_headers + base_size + location.len + 128);
            const next = try uri.resolve_inplace(location, &scratch);
            if (!sameOrigin(uri, next, a)) stripSensitive(&headers);
            const drop_body = code == 303 and !std.mem.eql(u8, method, "GET") and !std.mem.eql(u8, method, "HEAD") or ((code == 301 or code == 302) and std.mem.eql(u8, method, "POST"));
            if (drop_body) {
                method = "GET";
                body = "";
                stripBodyHeaders(&headers);
            }
            uri = next;
            continue;
        }
        return responseValue(engine, &req);
    }
    return error.TooManyHttpRedirects;
}

// Keep the TLS verifier's specific error instead of std.http's generic
// TlsInitializationFailed wrapper, so Fetch can retain oracle diagnostics.
fn directTls(client: *std.http.Client, uri: std.Uri, a: A) !*std.http.Client.Connection {
    const host = try (uri.host orelse return error.UriMissingHost).toRawMaybeAlloc(a);
    const conn = try client.connectTcp(host, uri.port orelse 443, .plain);
    errdefer {
        conn.closing = true;
        client.connection_pool.release(a, conn);
    }
    const tls = try a.create(std.crypto.tls.Client);
    errdefer a.destroy(tls);
    tls.* = try std.crypto.tls.Client.init(conn.stream, .{ .host = .{ .explicit = host }, .ca = .{ .bundle = client.ca_bundle } });
    tls.allow_truncation_attacks = true;
    conn.tls_client = tls;
    conn.protocol = .tls;
    return conn;
}

fn errorMessage(a: A, lift: V, err: anyerror) ![]const u8 {
    const message: []const u8 = switch (err) {
        error.ConnectionRefused => "Error: Unable to connect. Is the computer able to access the url?",
        error.CertificateIssuerNotFound, error.TlsCertificateNotVerified => "Error: unable to verify the first certificate",
        error.TooManyHttpRedirects => "Error: The response redirected too many times. For more information, pass `verbose: true` in the second argument to fetch()",
        error.OptionsBodyUnsupported => "TypeError [ERR_INVALID_ARG_VALUE]: fetch() request with GET/HEAD/OPTIONS method cannot have body.",
        error.CertificateHostMismatch => blk: {
            const uri = requestUri(a, lift) catch return @errorName(err);
            const url = try std.fmt.allocPrint(a, "{}", .{uri});
            break :blk try std.fmt.allocPrint(a, "Error: ERR_TLS_CERT_ALTNAME_INVALID fetching \"{s}\". For more information, pass `verbose: true` in the second argument to fetch()", .{url});
        },
        else => return @errorName(err),
    };
    const inspected = try std.json.stringifyAlloc(a, message, .{});
    return std.fmt.allocPrint(a, "NetworkError({s})", .{inspected});
}

// Zig 0.14's stock CONNECT helper leaves the tunnel at the proxy's transport
// protocol and does not send proxy authorization on CONNECT. Establish the
// tunnel explicitly, then verify the origin through native TLS. Never fall
// back to a plaintext HTTPS request or a direct connection after proxy failure.
const Tunnel = union(enum) { connection: *std.http.Client.Connection, response: V };
fn tlsTunnel(client: *std.http.Client, proxy: *std.http.Client.Proxy, uri: std.Uri, a: A, engine: *Engine) !Tunnel {
    if (proxy.protocol != .plain) return error.HttpsProxyTransportUnsupported;
    const host = try (uri.host orelse return error.UriMissingHost).toRawMaybeAlloc(a);
    const port = uri.port orelse 443;
    const conn = try client.connectTcp(proxy.host, proxy.port, .plain);
    var buffer: [maximum_headers]u8 = undefined;
    const auth: []const std.http.Header = if (proxy.authorization) |value| &.{.{ .name = "proxy-authorization", .value = value }} else &.{};
    var tunnel = client.open(.CONNECT, .{ .scheme = "http", .host = .{ .raw = host }, .port = port }, .{
        .connection = conn,
        .server_header_buffer = &buffer,
        .redirect_behavior = .unhandled,
        .extra_headers = auth,
        .keep_alive = false,
    }) catch |err| {
        conn.closing = true;
        client.connection_pool.release(a, conn);
        return err;
    };
    defer tunnel.deinit();
    try tunnel.send();
    try tunnel.finish();
    try tunnel.wait();
    // Bun exposes a refused CONNECT as its HTTP response. Retain that
    // observable result without sending an origin request or retrying directly.
    if (tunnel.response.status != .ok) return .{ .response = try responseValue(engine, &tunnel) };
    tunnel.connection = null;
    errdefer {
        conn.closing = true;
        client.connection_pool.release(a, conn);
    }
    const tls = try a.create(std.crypto.tls.Client);
    errdefer a.destroy(tls);
    tls.* = try std.crypto.tls.Client.init(conn.stream, .{ .host = .{ .explicit = host }, .ca = .{ .bundle = client.ca_bundle } });
    tls.allow_truncation_attacks = true; // HTTP framing detects incomplete bodies.
    const name = try a.dupe(u8, host);
    a.free(conn.host);
    conn.host = name;
    conn.port = port;
    conn.tls_client = tls;
    conn.protocol = .tls;
    conn.proxied = false;
    conn.closing = false;
    return .{ .connection = conn };
}

// The std.http Method enum stores at most eight bytes. Keep the standard
// connection, parser and TLS machinery for longer extension methods and emit
// their request line without truncation. The parser uses POST's body rules.
fn sendLongMethod(req: *std.http.Client.Request, method: []const u8, headers: []const std.http.Header) !void {
    const conn = req.connection.?;
    const writer = conn.writer();
    try writer.print("{s} ", .{method});
    try req.uri.writeToStream(.{ .scheme = conn.proxied, .authentication = false, .authority = conn.proxied, .path = true, .query = true }, writer);
    try writer.writeAll(" HTTP/1.1\r\n");
    if (!hasHeader(headers, "host")) {
        try writer.writeAll("host: ");
        try req.uri.writeToStream(.{ .authority = true }, writer);
        try writer.writeAll("\r\n");
    }
    if (!hasHeader(headers, "user-agent")) try writer.writeAll("user-agent: eyg-zig/0.1\r\n");
    if (!hasHeader(headers, "connection")) try writer.writeAll("connection: close\r\n");
    if (!hasHeader(headers, "accept-encoding")) try writer.writeAll("accept-encoding: gzip, deflate\r\n");
    for (headers) |header| try writer.print("{s}: {s}\r\n", .{ header.name, header.value });
    if (conn.proxied) {
        const proxy = if (conn.protocol == .tls) req.client.https_proxy else req.client.http_proxy;
        if (proxy) |configured| if (configured.authorization) |authorization| try writer.print("proxy-authorization: {s}\r\n", .{authorization});
    }
    try writer.writeAll("\r\n");
    try conn.flush();
}

fn responseValue(engine: *Engine, req: *std.http.Client.Request) !V {
    const a = engine.allocator;
    // Fetch exposes a decompressed byte body and the original response headers.
    const body = if (req.method == .TRACE) @as([]const u8, "") else try req.reader().readAllAlloc(a, maximum_body);
    var headers = std.ArrayList(std.http.Header).init(a);
    var iter = req.response.iterateHeaders();
    while (iter.next()) |header| {
        if (iter.is_trailer) break;
        const name = try std.ascii.allocLowerString(a, header.name);
        const header_value = try fromLatin1(a, header.value);
        var merged = false;
        if (!std.mem.eql(u8, name, "set-cookie")) {
            for (headers.items) |*previous| {
                if (std.mem.eql(u8, previous.name, name)) {
                    previous.value = header_value;
                    merged = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if (!merged) try headers.append(.{ .name = name, .value = header_value });
    }
    // The pinned Gleam/Bun transport lowercases names, keeps the last
    // ordinary repeated response field, and appends Set-Cookie fields after
    // lexically sorted ordinary headers. Its behavior is the oracle here.
    std.mem.sort(std.http.Header, headers.items, {}, struct {
        fn less(_: void, lhs: std.http.Header, rhs: std.http.Header) bool {
            const left_cookie = std.mem.eql(u8, lhs.name, "set-cookie");
            const right_cookie = std.mem.eql(u8, rhs.name, "set-cookie");
            if (left_cookie != right_cookie) return !left_cookie;
            return std.mem.lessThan(u8, lhs.name, rhs.name);
        }
    }.less);
    var result: V = .{ .list = null };
    var i = headers.items.len;
    while (i > 0) {
        i -= 1;
        const header = headers.items[i];
        const value = try record(a, &.{ .{ .name = "key", .value = .{ .string = header.name } }, .{ .name = "value", .value = .{ .string = header.value } } });
        result = try engine.cons(value, result.list);
    }
    return record(a, &.{ .{ .name = "status", .value = .{ .integer = @intFromEnum(req.response.status) } }, .{ .name = "headers", .value = result }, .{ .name = "body", .value = .{ .binary = body } } });
}

fn requestUri(a: A, lift: V) !std.Uri {
    const scheme = try field(lift, "scheme");
    if (scheme != .tagged) return error.InvalidFetchScheme;
    const scheme_text = if (std.mem.eql(u8, scheme.tagged.label, "HTTP")) "http" else if (std.mem.eql(u8, scheme.tagged.label, "HTTPS")) "https" else return error.InvalidFetchScheme;
    const host = try string(try field(lift, "host"));
    if (host.len == 0 or std.mem.indexOfAny(u8, host, "/@?#\r\n\x00 ") != null) return error.InvalidFetchHost;
    const port_value = try option(try field(lift, "port"));
    const port: ?u16 = if (port_value) |value| blk: {
        if (value != .integer or value.integer < 0 or value.integer > 65535) return error.InvalidFetchPort;
        break :blk @intCast(value.integer);
    } else null;
    const path = try string(try field(lift, "path"));
    const query_value = try option(try field(lift, "query"));
    const query = if (query_value) |value| try string(value) else null;
    var url = std.ArrayList(u8).init(a);
    try url.writer().print("{s}://{s}", .{ scheme_text, host });
    if (port) |number| try url.writer().print(":{d}", .{number});
    if (path.len == 0 or path[0] != '/') try url.append('/');
    try appendUrlText(&url, path);
    if (query) |value| {
        try url.append('?');
        try appendUrlText(&url, value);
    }
    const uri = try std.Uri.parse(url.items);
    if (uri.user != null or uri.password != null) return error.UrlCredentialsForbidden;
    return uri;
}

fn appendUrlText(output: *std.ArrayList(u8), text: []const u8) !void {
    // Keep existing percent escapes and URL delimiters. Encode UTF-8 bytes and
    // characters the fetch URL constructor percent-encodes in paths/queries.
    for (text) |byte| {
        if (byte <= 0x20 or byte >= 0x7f or byte == '"' or byte == '<' or byte == '>' or byte == '`') try output.writer().print("%{X:0>2}", .{byte}) else try output.append(byte);
    }
}

fn methodName(a: A, value: V) ![]const u8 {
    if (value != .tagged) return error.InvalidFetchMethod;
    const name = if (std.mem.eql(u8, value.tagged.label, "OTHER")) try string(value.tagged.value) else value.tagged.label;
    const method = try std.ascii.allocUpperString(a, name);
    // The pinned Bun Request constructor recognizes this method set. Other
    // strings (including valid extension tokens) become GET before transport.
    const known = std.StaticStringMap(void).initComptime(.{
        .{ "ACL", {} },        .{ "BIND", {} },        .{ "CHECKOUT", {} },
        .{ "CONNECT", {} },    .{ "COPY", {} },        .{ "DELETE", {} },
        .{ "GET", {} },        .{ "HEAD", {} },        .{ "LINK", {} },
        .{ "LOCK", {} },       .{ "M-SEARCH", {} },    .{ "MERGE", {} },
        .{ "MKACTIVITY", {} }, .{ "MKCALENDAR", {} },  .{ "MKCOL", {} },
        .{ "MOVE", {} },       .{ "NOTIFY", {} },      .{ "OPTIONS", {} },
        .{ "PATCH", {} },      .{ "POST", {} },        .{ "PROPFIND", {} },
        .{ "PROPPATCH", {} },  .{ "PURGE", {} },       .{ "PUT", {} },
        .{ "QUERY", {} },      .{ "REBIND", {} },      .{ "REPORT", {} },
        .{ "SEARCH", {} },     .{ "SOURCE", {} },      .{ "SUBSCRIBE", {} },
        .{ "TRACE", {} },      .{ "UNBIND", {} },      .{ "UNLINK", {} },
        .{ "UNLOCK", {} },     .{ "UNSUBSCRIBE", {} },
    });
    return if (known.has(method)) method else "GET";
}

fn requestHeaders(a: A, value: V) !std.ArrayList(std.http.Header) {
    if (value != .list) return error.InvalidFetchHeaders;
    var headers = std.ArrayList(std.http.Header).init(a);
    var cursor = value.list;
    var bytes: usize = 0;
    while (cursor) |cell| : (cursor = cell.tail) {
        const name = try std.ascii.allocLowerString(a, try string(try field(cell.head, "key")));
        const content = try headerText(std.mem.trim(u8, try string(try field(cell.head, "value")), " \t"));
        if (name.len == 0) return error.InvalidFetchHeader;
        for (name) |byte| if (!tokenByte(byte)) return error.InvalidFetchHeader;
        if (std.mem.indexOfAny(u8, content, "\r\n\x00") != null) return error.InvalidFetchHeader;
        bytes += name.len + content.len + 4;
        if (bytes > maximum_headers) return error.HttpHeadersOversize;
        // Framing belongs to the native transport; destination credentials may
        // never masquerade as configured proxy credentials.
        if (std.mem.eql(u8, name, "content-length") or std.mem.eql(u8, name, "transfer-encoding") or std.mem.eql(u8, name, "proxy-authorization")) continue;
        var merged = false;
        for (headers.items) |*previous| if (std.mem.eql(u8, previous.name, name)) {
            previous.value = try std.fmt.allocPrint(a, "{s}, {s}", .{ previous.value, content });
            merged = true;
            break;
        };
        if (!merged) try headers.append(.{ .name = name, .value = content });

    return headers;
}
fn headerText(input: []const u8) ![]const u8 {
    const decoded = std.unicode.Utf8View.init(input) catch return error.InvalidFetchHeader;
    var iter = decoded.iterator();
    while (iter.nextCodepoint()) |point| if (point > 255) return error.InvalidFetchHeader;
    // The pinned Bun Headers accepts ByteString code points but sends their
    // UTF-8 representation. Preserve that observable wire behavior.
    return input;
}

fn fromLatin1(a: A, input: []const u8) ![]const u8 {
    var result = std.ArrayList(u8).init(a);
    for (input) |byte| {
        var encoded: [4]u8 = undefined;
        const size = try std.unicode.utf8Encode(byte, &encoded);
        try result.appendSlice(encoded[0..size]);
    }
    return result.toOwnedSlice();
}

fn stripSensitive(headers: *std.ArrayList(std.http.Header)) void {
    var i: usize = 0;
    while (i < headers.items.len) {
        const name = headers.items[i].name;
        if (std.mem.eql(u8, name, "authorization") or std.mem.eql(u8, name, "cookie") or std.mem.eql(u8, name, "cookie2") or std.mem.eql(u8, name, "proxy-authorization") or std.mem.eql(u8, name, "host")) {
            _ = headers.orderedRemove(i);
        } else i += 1;
    }
}
fn stripBodyHeaders(headers: *std.ArrayList(std.http.Header)) void {
    var i: usize = 0;
    while (i < headers.items.len) {
        const name = headers.items[i].name;
        if (std.mem.eql(u8, name, "content-type") or std.mem.eql(u8, name, "content-language") or std.mem.eql(u8, name, "content-location") or std.mem.eql(u8, name, "content-encoding")) {
            _ = headers.orderedRemove(i);
        } else i += 1;
    }
}
fn sameOrigin(lhs: std.Uri, rhs: std.Uri, a: A) bool {
    const left = (lhs.host orelse return false).toRawMaybeAlloc(a) catch return false;
    const right = (rhs.host orelse return false).toRawMaybeAlloc(a) catch return false;
    const lp = lhs.port orelse if (std.ascii.eqlIgnoreCase(lhs.scheme, "https")) @as(u16, 443) else 80;
    const rp = rhs.port orelse if (std.ascii.eqlIgnoreCase(rhs.scheme, "https")) @as(u16, 443) else 80;
    return std.ascii.eqlIgnoreCase(lhs.scheme, rhs.scheme) and std.ascii.eqlIgnoreCase(left, right) and lp == rp;
}
fn isRedirect(code: u16) bool {
    return code == 301 or code == 302 or code == 303 or code == 307 or code == 308;
}
fn hasHeader(headers: []const std.http.Header, name: []const u8) bool {
    for (headers) |header| if (std.mem.eql(u8, header.name, name)) return true;

fn tokenByte(byte: u8) bool {
    return std.ascii.isAlphanumeric(byte) or std.mem.indexOfScalar(u8, "!#$%&'*+-.^_`|~", byte) != null;

fn componentBytes(value: std.Uri.Component) []const u8 {
    return switch (value) {
        .raw, .percent_encoded => |bytes| bytes,
    };
}
fn field(value: V, name: []const u8) !V {
    if (value == .record) for (value.record) |item| {
        if (std.mem.eql(u8, item.name, name)) return item.value;
    };
```
