//! Native entry point and deterministic JSONL test transport.
const std = @import("std");
const builtin = @import("builtin");
const parser = @import("parser.zig");
const interpreter = @import("interpreter.zig");
const tui = @import("tui.zig");
const git = @import("git.zig");
const platform = @import("platform.zig");
const input = @import("input.zig");
const json_wire = @import("json_wire.zig");
const J = std.json.Value;
const A = std.mem.Allocator;
var resize_write_fd: std.posix.fd_t = -1;

fn onResize(_: c_int) callconv(.c) void {
    if (resize_write_fd >= 0) _ = std.posix.write(resize_write_fd, "r") catch {};
}

fn field(value: J, key: []const u8) J {
    return if (value == .object) value.object.get(key) orelse .null else .null;
}
fn str(value: J) []const u8 {
    return if (value == .string) value.string else "";
}
fn number(value: J, default: usize) usize {
    return if (value == .integer and value.integer >= 0) @intCast(value.integer) else default;
}
fn equal(a: []const u8, b: []const u8) bool {
    return std.mem.eql(u8, a, b);
}
fn threadCpuNanoseconds() !u64 {
    const time = try std.posix.clock_gettime(std.posix.CLOCK.THREAD_CPUTIME_ID);
    return @as(u64, @intCast(time.sec)) * std.time.ns_per_s + @as(u64, @intCast(time.nsec));
}

pub fn main() !void {
    var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.heap.page_allocator);
    defer arena.deinit();
    const a = arena.allocator();
    const args = try std.process.argsAlloc(a);
    if (args.len == 1 or equal(args[1], "tui")) return interactive(a);
    if (equal(args[1], "--protocol")) return protocol();
    if (equal(args[1], "--help") or equal(args[1], "-h")) {
        try std.io.getStdOut().writeAll("EYG native runtime\n  eyg [tui]              Interactive structural shell\n  eyg eval -c SOURCE     Evaluate source\n  eyg eval FILE          Evaluate .eyg or canonical JSON IR\n  eyg parse -c SOURCE    Print canonical IR\n  eyg --protocol         Deterministic JSONL test transport\n");
        return;
    }
    if (equal(args[1], "--version")) {
        try std.io.getStdOut().writeAll("eyg-zig 0.1.0 (oracle next-tui be502aa)\n");
        return;
    }
    if (equal(args[1], "eval") or equal(args[1], "run") or equal(args[1], "parse")) {
        if (args.len < 3) return cliError("Expected -c SOURCE or a source file");
        const source = if (equal(args[2], "-c")) blk: {
            if (args.len != 4) return cliError("Expected one source argument after -c");
            break :blk args[3];
        } else try std.fs.cwd().readFileAlloc(a, args[2], 64 * 1024 * 1024);
        if (equal(args[1], "parse")) {
            const ir = if (!equal(args[2], "-c") and std.mem.endsWith(u8, args[2], ".json")) (try std.json.parseFromSlice(J, a, source, .{ .allocate = .alloc_always })).value else parser.parse(a, source) catch |err| return cliError(@errorName(err));
            try printJson(ir);
            return;
        }
        const sources = @import("source.zig");
        const resolved = if (equal(args[2], "-c")) null else try std.fs.path.resolve(a, &.{args[2]});
        const parsed = sources.parse(a, source, if (resolved) |path| .{ .disk = path } else .inline_code) catch |err| return cliError(@errorName(err));
        var engine = interpreter.Engine.init(a);
        var host = platform.Host.init(a);
        if (resolved) |path| host.directory = std.fs.path.dirname(path) orelse ".";
        host.attach(&engine);
        engine.inspection_meta = parsed.meta;
        const value = engine.eval(parsed.program) catch |err| {
            if (engine.failure) |reason| try printJson(try parser.object(a, &.{.{ "break", try engine.reasonJson(reason) }}));
            return cliError(@errorName(err));
        };
        try std.io.getStdOut().writeAll(try engine.inspect(value));
        try std.io.getStdOut().writeAll("\n");
        return;
    }
    return cliError("Unknown command; run eyg --help");
}

fn cliError(message: []const u8) error{CliFailure} {
    std.io.getStdErr().writer().print("eyg: {s}\n", .{message}) catch {};
    return error.CliFailure;
}
fn printJson(value: J) !void {
    var output = std.io.bufferedWriter(std.io.getStdOut().writer());
    try json_wire.write(value, output.writer());
    try output.writer().writeByte('\n');
    try output.flush();
}

fn protocol() !void {
    var reader = std.io.bufferedReader(std.io.getStdIn().reader());
    while (true) {
        var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.heap.page_allocator);
        defer arena.deinit();
        const a = arena.allocator();
        const line = try reader.reader().readUntilDelimiterOrEofAlloc(a, '\n', 128 * 1024 * 1024) orelse break;
        const parsed = std.json.parseFromSlice(J, a, line, .{ .allocate = .alloc_always }) catch |err| {
            try printJson(try parser.object(a, &.{.{ "error", .{ .string = @errorName(err) } }}));
            continue;
        };
        const response = request(a, parsed.value) catch |err| try parser.object(a, &.{.{ "error", .{ .string = @errorName(err) } }});
        try printJson(response);
    }
}

pub fn request(a: A, req: J) !J {
    const op = str(field(req, "op"));
    if (equal(op, "info")) return parser.object(a, &.{
        .{ "zig", .{ .string = builtin.zig_version_string } },
        .{ "mode", .{ .string = @tagName(builtin.mode) } },
        .{ "oracle", .{ .string = "be502aa03df926a8f9df474a0a7fe16c8fb14fbd" } },
        .{ "git_reference", .{ .string = "f1e32bad77d7ffdef6c416cb7ccbf7b23ec0bbd9" } },
        .{ "protocol", .{ .integer = 1 } },
    });
    if (equal(op, "eval")) {
        const effects = field(req, "effects");
        if (effects == .array and effects.array.items.len > 0) return interpreter.evaluateFixture(a, try parser.object(a, &.{ .{ "source", field(req, "program") }, .{ "effects", effects } }));
        return interpreter.evaluate(a, field(req, "program"));
    }
    if (equal(op, "input")) {
        const flush_value = field(req, "flush");
        const parsed = try input.parse(a, str(field(req, "text")), flush_value == .bool and flush_value.bool);
        return parser.object(a, &.{ .{ "events", .{ .array = parsed.events } }, .{ "remainder", .{ .string = parsed.remainder } } });
    }
    if (equal(op, "fixture")) return interpreter.evaluateFixture(a, field(req, "fixture"));
    if (equal(op, "parse")) {
        const ir = parser.parse(a, str(field(req, "source"))) catch return parser.object(a, &.{.{ "parse_error", .{ .bool = true } }});
        return parser.object(a, &.{.{ "program", ir }});
    }
    if (equal(op, "diagnostic")) return parser.object(a, &.{.{ "message", .{ .string = try parser.diagnostic(a, str(field(req, "source"))) } }});
    if (equal(op, "git")) return git.request(a, req);
    if (equal(op, "tui")) {
        var shell = tui.Tui.init(a);
        defer shell.shutdown();
        shell.sandboxed = true;
        shell.files = field(req, "files");
        shell.package_fixtures = field(req, "packages");
        var width = number(field(req, "width"), 80);
        var height = number(field(req, "height"), 24);
        if (width > 1000 or height > 1000) return error.InvalidDimensions;
        var frames = std.ArrayList(J).init(a);
        try frames.append(try shell.frame(width, height));
        const events = field(req, "events");
        if (events == .array) for (events.array.items) |event| {
            const size = field(event, "resize");
            if (size == .object or size == .array) {
                if (size == .array and size.array.items.len == 2) {
                    width = number(size.array.items[0], width);
                    height = number(size.array.items[1], height);
                } else {
                    width = number(field(size, "width"), width);
                    height = number(field(size, "height"), height);
                }
                if (width > 1000 or height > 1000) return error.InvalidDimensions;
            } else try shell.event(event);
            try frames.append(try shell.frame(width, height));
        };
        return parser.object(a, &.{.{ "frames", .{ .array = frames } }});
    }
    if (equal(op, "bench_tui")) {
        const width = number(field(req, "width"), 80);
        const height = number(field(req, "height"), 24);
        if (width > 1000 or height > 1000) return error.InvalidDimensions;
        const events = field(req, "events");
        var samples = std.ArrayList(J).init(a);
        var cpu_samples = std.ArrayList(J).init(a);
        // Timed frames are discarded, unlike the retained trace snapshots.
        // Reuse their owned output storage without retaining it in VM history.
        var frame_output = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.heap.page_allocator);
        defer frame_output.deinit();
        const iterations = @min(number(field(req, "iterations"), 100), 100000);
        for (0..iterations) |_| {
            var iteration = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.heap.page_allocator);
            defer iteration.deinit();
            var shell = tui.Tui.init(iteration.allocator());
            defer shell.shutdown();
            shell.sandboxed = true;
            shell.files = field(req, "files");
            shell.package_fixtures = field(req, "packages");
            _ = try shell.frameAlloc(frame_output.allocator(), width, height);
            _ = frame_output.reset(.retain_capacity);
            if (events == .array) for (events.array.items) |event| {
                var timer = try std.time.Timer.start();
                const cpu_start = try threadCpuNanoseconds();
                try shell.event(event);
                _ = try shell.frameAlloc(frame_output.allocator(), width, height);
                _ = frame_output.reset(.retain_capacity);
                const cpu_elapsed = (try threadCpuNanoseconds()) - cpu_start;
                try samples.append(.{ .integer = @intCast(timer.read()) });
                try cpu_samples.append(.{ .integer = @intCast(cpu_elapsed) });
            };
        }
        return parser.object(a, &.{ .{ "samples_ns", .{ .array = samples } }, .{ "cpu_samples_ns", .{ .array = cpu_samples } } });
    }
    return error.UnknownOperation;
}

const TerminalSize = struct { width: usize, height: usize };
fn terminalSize() TerminalSize {
    var size: std.posix.winsize = .{ .row = 24, .col = 80, .xpixel = 0, .ypixel = 0 };
    _ = std.posix.system.ioctl(std.io.getStdOut().handle, std.posix.T.IOCGWINSZ, @intFromPtr(&size));
    return .{ .width = if (size.col == 0) 80 else size.col, .height = if (size.row == 0) 24 else size.row };
}

fn interactive(a: A) !void {
    const stdin = std.io.getStdIn();
    const stdout = std.io.getStdOut();
    if (!std.posix.isatty(stdin.handle) or !std.posix.isatty(stdout.handle)) return cliError("The TUI needs terminal input and output");
    const previous = try std.posix.tcgetattr(stdin.handle);
    var raw = previous;
    raw.lflag.ICANON = false;
    raw.lflag.ECHO = false;
    raw.lflag.ISIG = false;
    raw.lflag.IEXTEN = false;
    raw.iflag.IXON = false;
    raw.iflag.ICRNL = false;
    raw.iflag.BRKINT = false;
    raw.iflag.INPCK = false;
    raw.iflag.ISTRIP = false;
    raw.oflag.OPOST = false;
    raw.cc[@intFromEnum(std.posix.V.MIN)] = 0;
    raw.cc[@intFromEnum(std.posix.V.TIME)] = 0;
    try std.posix.tcsetattr(stdin.handle, .FLUSH, raw);
    defer std.posix.tcsetattr(stdin.handle, .FLUSH, previous) catch {};
    const resize_pipe = try std.posix.pipe2(.{ .CLOEXEC = true, .NONBLOCK = true });
    defer std.posix.close(resize_pipe[0]);
    defer std.posix.close(resize_pipe[1]);
    var previous_resize: std.posix.Sigaction = undefined;
    const resize_action = std.posix.Sigaction{ .handler = .{ .handler = onResize }, .mask = std.posix.empty_sigset, .flags = 0 };
    resize_write_fd = resize_pipe[1];
    std.posix.sigaction(std.posix.SIG.WINCH, &resize_action, &previous_resize);
    defer {
        std.posix.sigaction(std.posix.SIG.WINCH, &previous_resize, null);
        resize_write_fd = -1;
    }
    try stdout.writeAll("\x1b[?2004h");
    defer stdout.writeAll("\x1b[?2026l\x1b[?2004l\x1b[0m\x1b[?25h") catch {};
    var shell = tui.Tui.init(a);
    defer shell.shutdown();
    try shell.startHub();
    var size = terminalSize();
    try draw(&shell, size);
    var pending = std.ArrayList(u8).init(a);
    var raw_input = std.ArrayList(u8).init(a);
    var chunk: [4096]u8 = undefined;
    var poll_fds = [_]std.posix.pollfd{
        .{ .fd = stdin.handle, .events = std.posix.POLL.IN, .revents = 0 },
        .{ .fd = resize_pipe[0], .events = std.posix.POLL.IN, .revents = 0 },
    };
    var last_input_ns: i128 = 0;
    while (true) {
        if (try shell.pollWork()) try draw(&shell, size);
        const ready = try std.posix.poll(&poll_fds, if (shell.hasPendingWork()) 1 else if (pending.items.len > 0) 40 else 100);
        if (poll_fds[0].revents & (std.posix.POLL.HUP | std.posix.POLL.ERR) != 0) return;
        const count = if (ready > 0 and poll_fds[0].revents & std.posix.POLL.IN != 0) try stdin.read(&chunk) else 0;
        if (poll_fds[1].revents & std.posix.POLL.IN != 0) {
            var notifications: [64]u8 = undefined;
            _ = try std.posix.read(resize_pipe[0], &notifications);
        }
        const new_size = terminalSize();
        if (new_size.width != size.width or new_size.height != size.height) {
            size = new_size;
            try draw(&shell, size);
        }
        if (count > 0) {
            last_input_ns = std.time.nanoTimestamp();
            try raw_input.appendSlice(chunk[0..count]);
            try decodeUtf8(&raw_input, &pending);
        }
        if (pending.items.len == 0) continue;
        const paste_pending = std.mem.startsWith(u8, pending.items, "\x1b[200~");
        // Editable nodes and closures retain labels from pasted source. Keep
        // their backing bytes independent from the reusable terminal buffer.
        const flush = std.time.nanoTimestamp() - last_input_ns >= 40 * std.time.ns_per_ms;
        const parsed = try input.parse(a, try a.dupe(u8, pending.items), flush and !paste_pending);
        for (parsed.events.items) |event| {
            if (equal(str(field(event, "key")), "ctrl+q")) return;
            try shell.event(event);
        }
        std.mem.copyForwards(u8, pending.items, parsed.remainder);
        pending.shrinkRetainingCapacity(parsed.remainder.len);
        if (parsed.events.items.len > 0) try draw(&shell, size);
    }
}

// Node's UTF-8 stream decoder retains incomplete scalars between reads. Match
// that boundary before etui's grapheme parser sees the input.
fn decodeUtf8(raw: *std.ArrayList(u8), decoded: *std.ArrayList(u8)) !void {
    var i: usize = 0;
    while (i < raw.items.len) {
        const length = std.unicode.utf8ByteSequenceLength(raw.items[i]) catch {
            try decoded.appendSlice("\xef\xbf\xbd");
            i += 1;
            continue;
        };
        var consumed: usize = 1;
        while (consumed < length and i + consumed < raw.items.len) : (consumed += 1) {
            const next = raw.items[i + consumed];
            const lead = raw.items[i];
            if (next < 0x80 or next > 0xbf or (consumed == 1 and ((lead == 0xe0 and next < 0xa0) or (lead == 0xed and next > 0x9f) or (lead == 0xf0 and next < 0x90) or (lead == 0xf4 and next > 0x8f)))) break;
        }
        if (consumed < length and i + consumed < raw.items.len) {
            try decoded.appendSlice("\xef\xbf\xbd");
            i += consumed;
            continue;
        }
        if (i + length > raw.items.len) break;
        try decoded.appendSlice(raw.items[i..][0..length]);
        i += length;
    }
    std.mem.copyForwards(u8, raw.items, raw.items[i..]);
    raw.shrinkRetainingCapacity(raw.items.len - i);
}

test "UTF-8 terminal reads retain incomplete scalars" {
    var raw = std.ArrayList(u8).init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer raw.deinit();
    var decoded = std.ArrayList(u8).init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer decoded.deinit();
    try raw.append(0xce);
    try decodeUtf8(&raw, &decoded);
    try std.testing.expectEqual(@as(usize, 0), decoded.items.len);
    try raw.append(0xbb);
    try decodeUtf8(&raw, &decoded);
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("λ", decoded.items);
    try std.testing.expectEqual(@as(usize, 0), raw.items.len);
    decoded.clearRetainingCapacity();
    try raw.appendSlice("\xe2\x82A");
    try decodeUtf8(&raw, &decoded);
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("\u{fffd}A", decoded.items);
    decoded.clearRetainingCapacity();
    try raw.appendSlice("\xe2A");
    try decodeUtf8(&raw, &decoded);
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("\u{fffd}A", decoded.items);
}

fn draw(shell: *tui.Tui, size: TerminalSize) !void {
    const frame = try shell.renderAnsiAlloc(std.heap.page_allocator, size.width, size.height);
    defer std.heap.page_allocator.free(frame);
    try std.io.getStdOut().writeAll(frame);
}

//! next-tui's JavaScript dictionaries expose CHAMP traversal order in type
//! diagnostics. Reproduce that order at the two observable runtime-to-type
//! boundaries; ordinary language record equality remains independent of order.
const std = @import("std");
const runtime = @import("interpreter.zig");
const A = std.mem.Allocator;
const Entry = struct { field: runtime.Field, hash: u32 };
fn stringHash(text: []const u8) u32 {
    var hash: u32 = 0;
    var i: usize = 0;
    while (i < text.len) {
        const len = std.unicode.utf8ByteSequenceLength(text[i]) catch 1;
        const end = @min(text.len, i + len);
        const cp = std.unicode.utf8Decode(text[i..end]) catch 0xfffd;
        i = end;
        if (cp <= 0xffff) hash = hash *% 31 +% cp else {
            const n = cp - 0x10000;
            hash = hash *% 31 +% (0xd800 + (n >> 10));
            hash = hash *% 31 +% (0xdc00 + (n & 0x3ff));
        }
    }
    return hash;
}
const Node = struct {
    entries: std.ArrayList(Entry),
    children: [32]?*Node = [_]?*Node{null} ** 32,
    fn create(allocator: A) !*Node {
        const node = try allocator.create(Node);
        node.* = .{ .entries = std.ArrayList(Entry).init(allocator) };
        return node;
    }
};
fn insert(allocator: A, node: *Node, entry: Entry, shift: usize) anyerror!void {
    if (shift > 32) {
        for (node.entries.items) |*old| if (runtime.eq(old.field.name, entry.field.name)) {
            old.* = entry;
            return;
        };
        try node.entries.append(entry);
        return;
    }
    const distance: u5 = @intCast(shift);
    const bucket = (entry.hash >> distance) & 31;
    if (node.children[bucket]) |child| return insert(allocator, child, entry, shift + 5);
    for (node.entries.items, 0..) |old, index| {
        if ((old.hash >> distance) & 31 != bucket) continue;
        if (runtime.eq(old.field.name, entry.field.name)) {
            node.entries.items[index] = entry;
            return;
        }
        const child = try Node.create(allocator);
        // CHAMP moves the incoming pair before the existing pair when a
        // collision creates a child. This matters for equal complete hashes.
        try insert(allocator, child, entry, shift + 5);
        try insert(allocator, child, old, shift + 5);
        node.children[bucket] = child;
        _ = node.entries.orderedRemove(index);
        return;
    }
    var at: usize = 0;
    while (at < node.entries.items.len and (node.entries.items[at].hash >> distance) & 31 < bucket) : (at += 1) {}
    try node.entries.insert(at, entry);
}
fn collect(node: *const Node, output: *std.ArrayList(runtime.Field)) anyerror!void {
    var bucket: usize = 32;
    while (bucket > 0) {
        bucket -= 1;
        if (node.children[bucket]) |child| try collect(child, output);
    }
    var index = node.entries.items.len;
    while (index > 0) {
        index -= 1;
        try output.append(node.entries.items[index].field);
    }
}
pub fn fields(allocator: A, input: []const runtime.Field) ![]const runtime.Field {
    const root = try Node.create(allocator);
    for (input) |field| try insert(allocator, root, .{ .field = field, .hash = stringHash(field.name) }, 0);
    var output = std.ArrayList(runtime.Field).init(allocator);
    try collect(root, &output);
    return output.toOwnedSlice();
}

test "CHAMP direct entries are reversed after nested collision buckets" {
    const input = [_]runtime.Field{ .{ .name = "a", .value = runtime.unit() }, .{ .name = "b", .value = runtime.unit() }, .{ .name = "c", .value = runtime.unit() } };
    var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer arena.deinit();
    const result = try fields(arena.allocator(), &input);
    // The auxiliary traversal allocations intentionally use an arena in callers.
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("c", result[0].name);
}

//! EYG surface syntax to canonical DAG-JSON IR. All storage belongs to the caller.
const std = @import("std");
const unicode = @import("unicode.zig");
const codec = @import("ir_codec.zig");
const A = std.mem.Allocator;
const J = std.json.Value;
const Span = @import("inspection.zig").Span;

pub const ParseError = error{ InvalidSyntax, IntegerOutOfRange, OutOfMemory };
const Kind = enum { name, upper, integer, string, lparen, rparen, lbrace, rbrace, lsquare, rsquare, comma, colon, dot, spread, arrow, equal, bang, hash, at, bar, minus, invalid, unterminated, invalid_escape, eof };
const Token = struct { kind: Kind, text: []const u8, at: usize };
const Pattern = struct { name: ?[]const u8 = null, fields: []const Field = &.{} };
const Field = struct { name: []const u8, value: J, span: Span = .{ 0, 0 }, colon: ?Span = null, from: usize = 0 };

pub fn object(a: A, fields: []const struct { []const u8, J }) !J {
    var obj = std.json.ObjectMap.init(a);
    for (fields) |pair| try obj.put(pair[0], pair[1]);
    return .{ .object = obj };
}
pub fn node(a: A, code: []const u8) !J {
    return object(a, &.{.{ "0", .{ .string = code } }});
}
pub fn label(a: A, code: []const u8, name: []const u8) !J {
    return object(a, &.{ .{ "0", .{ .string = code } }, .{ "l", .{ .string = name } } });
}
pub fn literal(a: A, code: []const u8, value: J) !J {
    return object(a, &.{ .{ "0", .{ .string = code } }, .{ "v", value } });
}
pub fn apply(a: A, f: J, arg: J) !J {
    return object(a, &.{ .{ "0", .{ .string = "a" } }, .{ "f", f }, .{ "a", arg } });
}
pub fn lambda(a: A, name: []const u8, body: J) !J {
    return object(a, &.{ .{ "0", .{ .string = "f" } }, .{ "l", .{ .string = name } }, .{ "b", body } });
}
pub fn letNode(a: A, name: []const u8, value: J, body: J) !J {
    return object(a, &.{ .{ "0", .{ .string = "l" } }, .{ "l", .{ .string = name } }, .{ "v", value }, .{ "t", body } });
}

pub fn parse(a: A, source: []const u8) ParseError!J {
    var p: Parser = .{ .a = a, .tokens = try lex(a, source) };
    const result = try p.block();
    if (p.peek().kind != .eof) return error.InvalidSyntax;
    return result;
}

pub fn parseExpression(a: A, source: []const u8) ParseError!J {
    var p: Parser = .{ .a = a, .tokens = try lex(a, source) };
    const result = try p.expression();
    if (p.peek().kind != .eof) return error.InvalidSyntax;
    return result;
}

/// The same parser with optional source offsets for imported module diagnostics.
/// Public DAG-JSON parsing and hashing keep using the unannotated entry points.
pub fn parseExpressionLocated(a: A, source: []const u8) ParseError!J {
    var p: Parser = .{ .a = a, .tokens = try lex(a, source), .located = true };
    const result = try p.expression();
    if (p.peek().kind != .eof) return error.InvalidSyntax;
    return result;
}

const Diagnostic = struct { kind: enum { unexpected, end, trailing, equals, arrow, unclosed, effect, builtin, cid, version, import_path, invalid, unterminated, escape, integer }, at: ?usize, token: []const u8 = "" };

/// The oracle's diagnostic text is part of the TUI buffer contract.
pub fn diagnostic(a: A, source: []const u8) ![]const u8 {
    var p: Parser = .{ .a = a, .tokens = try lex(a, source) };
    if (p.expression()) |_| {} else |_| {}
    const d = p.failure orelse Diagnostic{ .kind = .trailing, .at = p.peek().at, .token = p.peek().text };
    const description = switch (d.kind) {
        .end => try a.dupe(u8, "unexpected end of input"),
        .unexpected => try std.fmt.allocPrint(a, "unexpected `{s}` at position {d}", .{ d.token, d.at.? }),
        .trailing => try std.fmt.allocPrint(a, "unexpected `{s}` at position {d} — the expression is complete but there are leftover tokens", .{ d.token, d.at.? }),
        .equals => try std.fmt.allocPrint(a, "expected `=` after let binding name at position {d}", .{d.at.?}),
        .arrow => try std.fmt.allocPrint(a, "expected `->` followed by `{{` in function definition at position {d}", .{d.at.?}),
        .unclosed => try std.fmt.allocPrint(a, "unclosed function body — expected `}}` to close the `{{` opened at position {d}", .{d.at.?}),
        .effect => try std.fmt.allocPrint(a, "expected an uppercase effect name after `{s}` at position {d}", .{ d.token, d.at.? }),
        .builtin => try std.fmt.allocPrint(a, "expected a builtin identifier after `!` at position {d}", .{d.at.?}),
        .cid => try std.fmt.allocPrint(a, "invalid content identifier (CID) at position {d}", .{d.at.?}),
        .version => try std.fmt.allocPrint(a, "expected an integer release version after `:` at position {d}", .{d.at.?}),
        .import_path => try std.fmt.allocPrint(a, "expected a string path after `import` at position {d}", .{d.at.?}),
        .invalid => try std.fmt.allocPrint(a, "invalid character '{s}' at position {d}", .{ d.token, d.at.? }),
        .unterminated => try std.fmt.allocPrint(a, "unterminated string literal at position {d}", .{d.at.?}),
        .escape => try std.fmt.allocPrint(a, "invalid escape sequence `\\{s}` in string at position {d}", .{ d.token, d.at.? }),
        .integer => try std.fmt.allocPrint(a, "integer literal `{s}` is out of range at position {d}", .{ d.token, d.at.? }),
    };
    const hint = switch (d.kind) {
        .end => "program must end with valid expression",
        .unexpected => "view the syntax guide",
        .trailing => if (std.mem.eql(u8, d.token, "let")) "the previous expression already completed the block. If you meant the block to continue, bind that expression to `let _ = ...` first." else "EYG uses function calls for operations (e.g. !int_add(a, b)), not infix operators",
        .equals => "let bindings use the form `let name = expression`, names are lower snake_case such as `star_count`",
        .arrow => "functions are written as `(arg) -> { body }`",
        .unclosed => "every `{` in a function body must be closed with `}`",
        .effect => try std.fmt.allocPrint(a, "effect names must start with an uppercase letter, e.g. `{s} Log`", .{d.token}),
        .builtin => "builtins use lowercase names, e.g. `!int_add`",
        .cid => "CID references use a valid base32-encoded CID, e.g. `#bafyreig...`",
        .version => "pin a release with `@package:N` (e.g. `@tandard:3`) or omit `:` to track the latest",
        .import_path => "import paths must be string literals, e.g. `import \"./module.eyg.json\"`",
        .invalid => "remove or replace this character — EYG does not use it",
        .unterminated => "close the string with a double-quote `\"`",
        .escape => "valid escapes are \\n (newline), \\t (tab), \\r (carriage return), \\\" (quote), \\\\ (backslash)",
        .integer => "on the JavaScript target integers must be within the safe range (-(2^53-1) to 2^53-1)",
    };
    const prefix = try std.fmt.allocPrint(a, "error: {s}\nhint: {s}", .{ description, hint });
    const position = d.at orelse return prefix;
    var line_num: usize = 1;
    var start: usize = 0;
    while (start <= source.len) {
        var end = start;
        while (end < source.len and source[end] != '\r' and source[end] != '\n') : (end += 1) {}
        if (position <= end) {
            const gutter = try std.fmt.allocPrint(a, " {d} | ", .{line_num});
            const spaces = try a.alloc(u8, gutter.len + position - start);
            @memset(spaces, ' ');
            return std.fmt.allocPrint(a, "{s}\n\n{s}{s}\n{s}^", .{ prefix, gutter, source[start..end], spaces });
        }
        if (end == source.len) break;
        start = end + (if (source[end] == '\r' and end + 1 < source.len and source[end + 1] == '\n') @as(usize, 2) else 1);
        line_num += 1;
    }
    return prefix;
}

fn lex(a: A, source: []const u8) ParseError![]const Token {
    var tokens = std.ArrayList(Token).init(a);
    var i: usize = 0;
    while (i < source.len) {
        const at = i;
        const c = source[i];
        if (c == ' ' or c == '\t' or c == '\r' or c == '\n') {
            i += 1;
            continue;
        }
        if (c == '/' and i + 1 < source.len and source[i + 1] == '/') {
            while (i < source.len and source[i] != '\n') : (i += 1) {}
            continue;
        }
        if (std.ascii.isAlphabetic(c) or c == '_') {
            i += 1;
            while (i < source.len and (std.ascii.isLower(source[i]) or (std.ascii.isUpper(c) and std.ascii.isUpper(source[i])) or std.ascii.isDigit(source[i]) or source[i] == '_')) : (i += 1) {}
            try tokens.append(.{ .kind = if (std.ascii.isUpper(c)) .upper else .name, .text = source[at..i], .at = at });
            continue;
        }
        if (std.ascii.isDigit(c)) {
            i += 1;
            while (i < source.len and std.ascii.isDigit(source[i])) : (i += 1) {}
            try tokens.append(.{ .kind = .integer, .text = source[at..i], .at = at });
            continue;
        }
        if (c == '"') {
            i += 1;
            var text = std.ArrayList(u8).init(a);
            var bad_escape: ?Token = null;
            while (i < source.len and source[i] != '"') {
                if (source[i] == '\\') {
                    i += 1;
                    if (i >= source.len) break;
                    try text.append(switch (source[i]) {
                        'n' => '\n',
                        't' => '\t',
                        'r' => '\r',
                        '"' => '"',
                        '\\' => '\\',
                        else => blk: {
                            if (bad_escape == null) {
                                const raw = try std.mem.concat(a, u8, &.{ text.items, source[i - 1 ..] });
                                const first_end = unicode.graphemeEnd(raw, 0);
                                const second_end = unicode.graphemeEnd(raw, first_end);
                                bad_escape = .{ .kind = .invalid_escape, .text = raw[first_end..second_end], .at = at };
                            }
                            break :blk source[i];
                        },
                    });
                } else try text.append(source[i]);
                i += 1;
            }
            if (i == source.len) {
                try tokens.append(.{ .kind = .unterminated, .text = source[at..], .at = at });
                break;
            }
            i += 1;
            try tokens.append(bad_escape orelse .{ .kind = .string, .text = try text.toOwnedSlice(), .at = at });
            continue;
        }
        i += 1;
        const kind: Kind = switch (c) {
            '(' => .lparen,
            ')' => .rparen,
            '{' => .lbrace,
            '}' => .rbrace,
            '[' => .lsquare,
            ']' => .rsquare,
            ',' => .comma,
            ':' => .colon,
            '=' => .equal,
            '!' => .bang,
            '#' => .hash,
            '@' => .at,
            '|' => .bar,
            '.' => blk: {
                if (i < source.len and source[i] == '.') {
                    i += 1;
                    break :blk .spread;
                }
                break :blk .dot;
            },
            '-' => blk: {
                if (i < source.len and source[i] == '>') {
                    i += 1;
                    break :blk .arrow;
                }
                break :blk .minus;
            },
            else => .invalid,
        };
        if (kind == .invalid and c >= 128) i = unicode.graphemeEnd(source, at);
        try tokens.append(.{ .kind = kind, .text = source[at..i], .at = at });
    }
    try tokens.append(.{ .kind = .eof, .text = "", .at = source.len });
    return tokens.toOwnedSlice();
}

const Parser = struct {
    a: A,
    tokens: []const Token,
    pos: usize = 0,
    failure: ?Diagnostic = null,
    located: bool = false,
    fn withSpan(p: *Parser, ir: J, start: usize, end: usize) ParseError!J {
        if (!p.located) return ir;
        var result = ir;
        var offsets = std.ArrayList(J).init(p.a);
        try offsets.appendSlice(&.{ .{ .integer = @intCast(start) }, .{ .integer = @intCast(end) } });
        try result.object.put("_span", .{ .array = offsets });
        return result;
    }
    fn range(_: *Parser, ir: J) Span {
        return @import("inspection.zig").span(ir);
    }
    fn peek(p: *Parser) Token {
        return p.tokens[p.pos];
    }
    fn take(p: *Parser) Token {
        const t = p.peek();
        if (t.kind != .eof) p.pos += 1;
        return t;
    }
    fn accept(p: *Parser, kind: Kind) bool {
        if (p.peek().kind != kind) return false;
        _ = p.take();
        return true;
    }
    fn fail(p: *Parser, kind: @FieldType(Diagnostic, "kind"), at: ?usize, token: []const u8) ParseError {
        if (p.failure == null) p.failure = .{ .kind = kind, .at = at, .token = token };
        return error.InvalidSyntax;
    }
    fn unexpected(p: *Parser, t: Token) ParseError {
        return p.fail(if (t.kind == .eof) .end else .unexpected, if (t.kind == .eof) null else t.at, t.text);
    }
    fn expect(p: *Parser, kind: Kind) ParseError!Token {
        const t = p.take();
        if (t.kind != kind or (kind == .name and reserved(t.text))) return p.unexpected(t);
        return t;
    }
    fn word(p: *Parser, s: []const u8) bool {
        return p.peek().kind == .name and std.mem.eql(u8, p.peek().text, s);
    }

    fn pattern(p: *Parser) ParseError!Pattern {
        if (p.peek().kind == .name and !reserved(p.peek().text)) return .{ .name = p.take().text };
        _ = try p.expect(.lbrace);
        var fields = std.ArrayList(Field).init(p.a);
        while (!p.accept(.rbrace)) {
            const field = try p.expect(.name);
            const colon: ?Span = if (p.peek().kind == .colon) blk: {
                const at_ = p.take().at;
                break :blk .{ at_, at_ + 1 };
            } else null;
            const name = if (colon != null) (try p.expect(.name)).text else field.text;
            try fields.append(.{ .name = field.text, .value = .{ .string = name }, .span = .{ field.at, field.at + field.text.len }, .colon = colon });
            if (p.accept(.rbrace)) break;
            _ = try p.expect(.comma);
        }
        return .{ .fields = try fields.toOwnedSlice() };
    }
    fn destructure(p: *Parser, pattern_: Pattern, body_: J) ParseError!J {
        var body = body_;
        var n = pattern_.fields.len;
        while (n > 0) {
            n -= 1;
            const f = pattern_.fields[n];
            const colon = f.colon orelse f.span;
            const select = try p.withSpan(try label(p.a, "g", f.name), f.span[0], f.span[1]);
            const variable = try p.withSpan(try label(p.a, "v", "$"), colon[0], colon[1]);
            const value = try p.withSpan(try apply(p.a, select, variable), f.span[0], colon[1]);
            body = try p.withSpan(try letNode(p.a, f.value.string, value, body), f.span[0], p.range(body_)[1]);
        }
        return body;
    }
    fn bindPattern(p: *Parser, pat: Pattern, value: J, body: J, start: usize, end: usize) ParseError!J {
        return p.withSpan(try letNode(p.a, pat.name orelse "$", value, if (pat.name == null) try p.destructure(pat, body) else body), start, end);
    }
    fn block(p: *Parser) ParseError!J {
        if (p.word("let")) {
            const start = p.take().at;
            const pat = try p.pattern();
            if (!p.accept(.equal)) return if (p.peek().kind == .eof) p.unexpected(p.peek()) else p.fail(.equals, p.peek().at, "");
            const value = try p.expression();
            const body = if (p.peek().kind == .eof or p.peek().kind == .rbrace) try node(p.a, "z") else try p.block();
            return p.bindPattern(pat, value, body, start, p.range(body)[1]);
        }
        return p.expression();
    }
    fn expression(p: *Parser) ParseError!J {
        var value = try p.atom();
        while (true) {
            if (p.accept(.lparen)) {
                if (p.peek().kind == .rparen) return error.InvalidSyntax;
                while (true) {
                    const argument = try p.expression();
                    value = try p.withSpan(try apply(p.a, value, argument), p.range(value)[0], p.range(argument)[1] + 1);
                    if (p.accept(.rparen)) break;
                    _ = try p.expect(.comma);
                }
            } else if (p.peek().kind == .dot) {
                const dot = p.take().at;
                const field = try p.expect(.name);
                value = try p.withSpan(try apply(p.a, try p.withSpan(try label(p.a, "g", field.text), dot, field.at + field.text.len), value), p.range(value)[0], field.at + field.text.len);
            } else break;
        }
        return value;
    }
    fn atom(p: *Parser) ParseError!J {
        const t = p.take();
        switch (t.kind) {
            .integer, .minus => {
                const raw = if (t.kind == .minus) (try p.expect(.integer)).text else t.text;
                var n = std.fmt.parseInt(i64, raw, 10) catch {
                    p.failure = .{ .kind = .integer, .at = t.at, .token = raw };
                    return error.IntegerOutOfRange;
                };
                if (t.kind == .minus) n = -n;
                if (n > 9007199254740991 or n < -9007199254740991) {
                    p.failure = .{ .kind = .integer, .at = if (t.kind == .minus) t.at + 1 else t.at, .token = raw };
                    return error.IntegerOutOfRange;
                }
                const end = if (t.kind == .minus) p.tokens[p.pos - 1].at + raw.len else t.at + raw.len;
                return p.withSpan(try literal(p.a, "i", .{ .integer = n }), t.at, end);
            },
            .string => return p.withSpan(try literal(p.a, "s", .{ .string = t.text }), t.at, t.at + t.text.len + 2),
            .upper => return p.withSpan(try label(p.a, "t", t.text), t.at, t.at + t.text.len),
            .bang => {
                if (p.peek().kind != .name or reserved(p.peek().text)) return p.fail(.builtin, p.peek().at, "");
                const name = p.take();
                return p.withSpan(try label(p.a, "b", name.text), t.at, name.at + name.text.len);
            },
            .hash => {
                if (p.peek().kind != .name or !validCid(p.peek().text)) return p.fail(.cid, p.peek().at, "");
                const name = p.take();
                const cid = try canonicalCid(p.a, name.text);
                return p.withSpan(try object(p.a, &.{ .{ "0", .{ .string = "#" } }, .{ "l", try object(p.a, &.{.{ "/", .{ .string = cid } }}) } }), t.at, name.at + name.text.len);
            },
            .at => {
                var result = try object(p.a, &.{ .{ "0", .{ .string = "@" } }, .{ "p", .{ .string = (try p.expect(.name)).text } } });
                if (p.accept(.colon)) {
                    if (p.peek().kind != .integer) return p.fail(.version, p.peek().at, "");
                    const version_token = p.take();
                    const version = std.fmt.parseInt(i64, version_token.text, 10) catch return p.fail(.version, version_token.at, "");
                    if (version <= 0) return p.fail(.version, version_token.at, "");
                    try result.object.put("r", .{ .integer = version });
                    if (p.accept(.colon)) {
                        if (p.peek().kind != .name or !validCid(p.peek().text)) return p.fail(.cid, p.peek().at, "");
                        const cid = try canonicalCid(p.a, p.take().text);
                        try result.object.put("l", try object(p.a, &.{.{ "/", .{ .string = cid } }}));
                    }
                }
                const last = p.tokens[p.pos - 1];
                return p.withSpan(result, t.at, last.at + last.text.len);
            },
            .lparen => {
                var patterns = std.ArrayList(Pattern).init(p.a);
                try patterns.append(try p.pattern());
                while (p.accept(.comma)) try patterns.append(try p.pattern());
                _ = try p.expect(.rparen);
                if (!p.accept(.arrow)) return if (p.peek().kind == .eof) p.unexpected(p.peek()) else p.fail(.arrow, p.peek().at, "");
                if (p.peek().kind != .lbrace) return p.fail(.arrow, p.peek().at, "");
                const brace_at = p.take().at;
                var body = try p.expression();
                if (p.peek().kind != .rbrace) return p.fail(.unclosed, brace_at, "");
                const end = p.take().at + 1;
                var n = patterns.items.len;
                while (n > 0) {
                    n -= 1;
                    const pat = patterns.items[n];
                    body = try p.withSpan(try lambda(p.a, pat.name orelse "$", if (pat.name == null) try p.destructure(pat, body) else body), t.at, end);
                }
                return body;
            },
            .lsquare => {
                var items = std.ArrayList(Field).init(p.a);
                var tail = try node(p.a, "ta");
                var from = t.at;
                var finished = false;
                while (p.peek().kind != .rsquare) {
                    // The oracle accepts spread only after at least one item.
                    if (p.peek().kind == .spread) {
                        if (items.items.len == 0) return error.InvalidSyntax;
                        _ = p.take();
                        tail = try p.expression();
                        _ = try p.expect(.rsquare);
                        finished = true;
                        break;
                    }
                    try items.append(.{ .name = "", .value = try p.expression(), .from = from });
                    if (p.peek().kind == .rsquare) break;
                    from = (try p.expect(.comma)).at;
                }
                if (!finished) {
                    const close = p.take().at;
                    tail = try p.withSpan(tail, if (items.items.len == 0) t.at else if (from != t.at and p.tokens[p.pos - 2].kind == .comma) from else close, close + 1);
                }
                var n = items.items.len;
                while (n > 0) {
                    n -= 1;
                    const item = items.items[n];
                    const cons = try p.withSpan(try node(p.a, "c"), item.from, item.from + 1);
                    const inner = try p.withSpan(try apply(p.a, cons, item.value), item.from, p.range(item.value)[1]);
                    tail = try p.withSpan(try apply(p.a, inner, tail), item.from, p.range(tail)[1]);
                }
                return tail;
            },
            .lbrace => {
                var fields = std.ArrayList(Field).init(p.a);
                var tail = try node(p.a, "u");
                var overwrite = false;
                var from = t.at;
                var finished = false;
                while (p.peek().kind != .rbrace) {
                    if (p.accept(.spread)) {
                        tail = try p.expression();
                        overwrite = true;
                        _ = try p.expect(.rbrace);
                        finished = true;
                        break;
                    }
                    const name = try p.expect(.name);
                    const colon: ?usize = if (p.peek().kind == .colon) p.take().at else null;
                    const val = if (colon != null) try p.expression() else try p.withSpan(try label(p.a, "v", name.text), name.at, name.at + name.text.len);
                    try fields.append(.{ .name = name.text, .value = val, .span = .{ from, if (colon) |at_| at_ + 1 else name.at + name.text.len } });
                    if (p.peek().kind == .rbrace) break;
                    from = (try p.expect(.comma)).at;
                }
                if (!finished) {
                    const close = p.take().at;
                    tail = try p.withSpan(tail, if (fields.items.len == 0) from else close, close + 1);
                }
                var n = fields.items.len;
                while (n > 0) {
                    n -= 1;
                    const field = fields.items[n];
                    const extension = try p.withSpan(try label(p.a, if (overwrite) "o" else "e", field.name), field.span[0], field.span[1]);
                    const inner = try p.withSpan(try apply(p.a, extension, field.value), field.span[0], p.range(field.value)[1]);
                    tail = try p.withSpan(try apply(p.a, inner, tail), field.span[0], p.range(tail)[1]);
                }
                return tail;
            },
            .name => {
                if (std.mem.eql(u8, t.text, "deep")) return p.unexpected(t);
                if (std.mem.eql(u8, t.text, "todo")) return p.withSpan(try node(p.a, "z"), t.at, t.at + 4);
                if (std.mem.eql(u8, t.text, "import")) {
                    if (p.peek().kind != .string) return p.fail(.import_path, p.peek().at, "");
                    const name = p.take();
                    return p.withSpan(try object(p.a, &.{ .{ "0", .{ .string = "." } }, .{ "i", .{ .string = name.text } } }), t.at, name.at + name.text.len + 2);
                }
                if (std.mem.eql(u8, t.text, "perform") or std.mem.eql(u8, t.text, "handle")) {
                    if (p.peek().kind != .upper) return p.fail(.effect, p.peek().at, t.text);
                    const name = p.take();
                    return p.withSpan(try label(p.a, if (t.text[0] == 'p') "p" else "h", name.text), t.at, name.at + name.text.len);
                }
                if (std.mem.eql(u8, t.text, "let")) {
                    const pat = try p.pattern();
                    if (!p.accept(.equal)) return if (p.peek().kind == .eof) p.unexpected(p.peek()) else p.fail(.equals, p.peek().at, "");
                    const val = try p.expression();
                    const body = try p.expression();
                    return p.bindPattern(pat, val, body, t.at, p.range(body)[1]);
                }
                if (std.mem.eql(u8, t.text, "match")) {
                    const subject: ?J = if (p.peek().kind != .lbrace) try p.expression() else null;
                    const brace = try p.expect(.lbrace);
                    var branches = std.ArrayList(Field).init(p.a);
                    var tail = try node(p.a, "n");
                    var from = if (subject == null) t.at else brace.at;
                    var finished = false;
                    while (p.peek().kind != .rbrace) {
                        if (p.accept(.bar)) {
                            tail = try p.expression();
                            _ = try p.expect(.rbrace);
                            finished = true;
                            break;
                        }
                        const tag = try p.expect(.upper);
                        try branches.append(.{ .name = tag.text, .value = try p.expression(), .span = .{ tag.at, tag.at + tag.text.len }, .from = from });
                        from = p.peek().at;
                    }
                    if (!finished) tail = try p.withSpan(tail, from, p.take().at + 1);
                    const end = p.range(tail)[1];
                    var n = branches.items.len;
                    while (n > 0) {
                        n -= 1;
                        const b = branches.items[n];
                        const case_ = try p.withSpan(try label(p.a, "m", b.name), b.span[0], b.span[1]);
                        const inner = try p.withSpan(try apply(p.a, case_, b.value), b.span[0], p.range(b.value)[1]);
                        tail = try p.withSpan(try apply(p.a, inner, tail), b.from, end);
                    }
                    return if (subject) |s| try p.withSpan(try apply(p.a, tail, s), t.at, end) else tail;
                }
                return p.withSpan(try label(p.a, "v", t.text), t.at, t.at + t.text.len);
            },
            .invalid => return p.fail(.invalid, t.at, t.text),
            .unterminated => return p.fail(.unterminated, t.at, ""),
            .invalid_escape => return p.fail(.escape, t.at, t.text),
            else => return p.unexpected(t),
        }
    }
};

fn reserved(text: []const u8) bool {
    for ([_][]const u8{ "let", "match", "perform", "deep", "handle", "import", "todo" }) |word| if (std.mem.eql(u8, text, word)) return true;
    return false;
}

fn validCid(text: []const u8) bool {
    return codec.validCid(text);
}
fn canonicalCid(a: A, text: []const u8) ParseError![]const u8 {
    return codec.canonicalCid(a, text) catch |err| switch (err) {
        error.OutOfMemory => error.OutOfMemory,
        else => error.InvalidSyntax,
    };
}

test "surface syntax builds curried IR" {
    var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer arena.deinit();
    const result = try parse(arena.allocator(), "let {a} = {a: 20}\n!int_add(a, 22)");
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("l", result.object.get("0").?.string);
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("$", result.object.get("l").?.string);
    _ = try parse(arena.allocator(), "match Ok(42) { Ok(n) -> { n } | (_) -> { 0 } }");
    _ = try parse(arena.allocator(), "let f = (x, {y}) -> { let z = x !int_add(z,y) } f(1, {y: 2})");
    try std.testing.expectError(error.IntegerOutOfRange, parse(arena.allocator(), "9007199254740992"));
    try std.testing.expectError(error.InvalidSyntax, parse(arena.allocator(), "1 + 2"));
}

//! Computer effects and relative module loading shared by the CLI and TUI.
//! Pure differential tests deliberately do not attach this host.
const std = @import("std");
const interpreter = @import("interpreter.zig");
const parser = @import("parser.zig");
const git = @import("git.zig");
const computer = @import("computer.zig");
const hub = @import("hub.zig");
const http = @import("http.zig");
const effect_cast = @import("effect_cast.zig");
const sources = @import("source.zig");
const A = std.mem.Allocator;
const J = std.json.Value;
const V = interpreter.Value;
const Engine = interpreter.Engine;

pub const Host = struct {
    allocator: A,
    directory: []const u8 = ".",
    output_context: ?*anyopaque = null,
    output: ?*const fn (?*anyopaque, bool, []const u8) anyerror!void = null,
    loading: std.StringHashMap(void),
    hub_cache: ?hub.Cache = null,

    pub fn init(a: A) Host {
        return .{ .allocator = a, .loading = std.StringHashMap(void).init(a) };
    }
    pub fn attach(self: *Host, engine: *Engine) void {
        engine.effect_handler = effect;
        engine.effect_context = self;
        engine.reference_handler = reference;
        engine.reference_context = self;
        engine.origin = self.directory;
    }
    pub fn packages(self: *Host) !*hub.Cache {
        if (self.hub_cache == null) self.hub_cache = try hub.Cache.configured(self.allocator);
        return &self.hub_cache.?;
    }
};

fn valueField(value: V, name: []const u8) !V {
    if (value != .record) return error.InvalidEffectArgument;
    for (value.record) |f| if (std.mem.eql(u8, name, f.name)) return f.value;
    return error.InvalidEffectArgument;
}
fn text(value: V) ![]const u8 {
    return if (value == .string) value.string else error.InvalidEffectArgument;
}
fn binary(value: V) ![]const u8 {
    return if (value == .binary) value.binary else error.InvalidEffectArgument;
}
fn ok(engine: *Engine, value: V) !V {
    return engine.tag("Ok", value);
}
fn fail(engine: *Engine, err: anyerror) !V {
    return engine.tag("Error", .{ .string = switch (err) {
        error.FileNotFound => "No such file or directory",
        error.NotDir => "Not a directory",
        error.IsDir => "Is a directory",
        error.AccessDenied => "Permission denied",
        error.PathAlreadyExists => "File exists",
        else => @errorName(err),
    } });
}
fn effectPath(host: *Host, engine: *Engine, raw: []const u8) ![]const u8 {
    if (!std.fs.path.isAbsolute(raw) and engine.effect_origin == null) return error.NoSourceDirectory;
    return std.fs.path.resolve(engine.allocator, &.{ engine.effect_origin orelse host.directory, raw });
}
fn pathFailure(engine: *Engine, err: anyerror, raw: []const u8) !V {
    if (err == error.NoSourceDirectory) return engine.tag("Error", .{ .string = try std.fmt.allocPrint(engine.allocator, "relative path \"{s}\" requires a disk-backed source; use CWD or an absolute path", .{raw}) });
    return fail(engine, err);
}
fn eq(a: []const u8, b: []const u8) bool {
    return std.mem.eql(u8, a, b);
}

pub fn effect(context: ?*anyopaque, engine: *Engine, name: []const u8, lift: V) anyerror!V {
    try effect_cast.validateNative(engine, name, lift);
    const host: *Host = @ptrCast(@alignCast(context.?));
    const a = engine.allocator;
    if (eq(name, "Fetch")) return http.effect(engine, lift);
    if (eq(name, "EYGParse") or eq(name, "DecodeJSON") or eq(name, "CreateKey") or eq(name, "Sign")) return computer.effect(engine, name, lift);
    if (eq(name, "GitQuery")) {
        const req = engine.toPlainJson(lift) catch |err| return fail(engine, err);
        const response = git.request(a, req) catch |err| return fail(engine, err);
        return ok(engine, try engine.fromPlainJson(response));
    }
    if (eq(name, "Inflate")) {
        const bytes = git.inflate(a, try binary(lift)) catch |err| return fail(engine, err);
        return ok(engine, .{ .binary = bytes });
    }
    if (eq(name, "Hash")) {
        const algorithm = try valueField(lift, "algorithm");
        if (algorithm != .tagged) return error.InvalidEffectArgument;
        const bytes = try binary(try valueField(lift, "bytes"));
        if (eq(algorithm.tagged.label, "SHA1")) {
            const digest = try a.alloc(u8, 20);
            std.crypto.hash.Sha1.hash(bytes, digest[0..20], .{});
            return .{ .binary = digest };
        }
        if (eq(algorithm.tagged.label, "SHA256")) {
            const digest = try a.alloc(u8, 32);
            std.crypto.hash.sha2.Sha256.hash(bytes, digest[0..32], .{});
            return .{ .binary = digest };
        }
        return error.UnsupportedHash;
    }
    if (eq(name, "CWD")) return ok(engine, .{ .string = try std.process.getCwdAlloc(a) });
    if (eq(name, "Now")) return .{ .integer = std.time.milliTimestamp() };
    if (eq(name, "Random")) {
        const bound = try effect_cast.asNumber(engine, lift);
        return interpreter.numberValue(@floor(std.crypto.random.float(f64) * bound));
    }
    if (eq(name, "Flip")) return engine.boolean(std.crypto.random.boolean());
    if (eq(name, "Env")) {
        const value = std.process.getEnvVarOwned(a, try text(lift)) catch return engine.tag("None", interpreter.unit());
        return engine.tag("Some", .{ .string = value });
    }
    if (eq(name, "Sleep")) {
        const requested = try effect_cast.asNumber(engine, lift);
        // The oracle uses setTimeout: nonfinite, sub-millisecond and values
        // beyond a signed 32-bit timer duration are scheduled after 1 ms.
        const milliseconds: u64 = if (!std.math.isFinite(requested) or requested < 1 or requested > std.math.maxInt(i32)) 1 else @intFromFloat(requested);
        std.time.sleep(milliseconds * std.time.ns_per_ms);
        return interpreter.unit();
    }
    if (eq(name, "StandardOut") or eq(name, "StandardError")) {
        const output = try text(lift);
        const stderr = eq(name, "StandardError");
        if (host.output) |write| try write(host.output_context, stderr, output) else try (if (stderr) std.io.getStdErr() else std.io.getStdOut()).writeAll(output);
        return interpreter.unit();
    }
    if (eq(name, "ReadFile")) {
        const raw = try text(try valueField(lift, "path"));
        const path = effectPath(host, engine, raw) catch |err| return pathFailure(engine, err, raw);
        const offset = try effect_cast.asNumber(engine, try valueField(lift, "offset"));
        const limit = try effect_cast.asNumber(engine, try valueField(lift, "limit"));
        if (!std.math.isFinite(offset) or !std.math.isFinite(limit) or offset < 0 or offset >= 0x1p64 or limit < 0 or limit > 128 * 1024 * 1024) return fail(engine, error.InvalidReadRange);
        const file = std.fs.cwd().openFile(path, .{}) catch |err| return fail(engine, err);
        defer file.close();
        file.seekTo(@intFromFloat(offset)) catch |err| return fail(engine, err);
        var bytes = std.ArrayList(u8).init(a);
        var remaining: usize = @intFromFloat(limit);
        var chunk: [16 * 1024]u8 = undefined;
        while (remaining > 0) {
            const count = file.read(chunk[0..@min(chunk.len, remaining)]) catch |err| return fail(engine, err);
            if (count == 0) break;
            try bytes.appendSlice(chunk[0..count]);
            remaining -= count;
        }
        return ok(engine, .{ .binary = try bytes.toOwnedSlice() });
    }
    if (eq(name, "ReadDirectory")) {
        const raw = try text(lift);
        const path = effectPath(host, engine, raw) catch |err| return pathFailure(engine, err, raw);
        var directory = std.fs.cwd().openDir(path, .{ .iterate = true }) catch |err| return fail(engine, err);
        defer directory.close();
        var it = directory.iterate();
        var entries = std.ArrayList(V).init(a);
        while (it.next() catch |err| return fail(engine, err)) |entry| {
            const stat = directory.statFile(entry.name) catch continue;
            const kind = if (stat.kind == .directory) try engine.tag("Directory", interpreter.unit()) else if (stat.kind == .file) try engine.tag("File", .{ .record = try a.dupe(interpreter.Field, &.{.{ .name = "size", .value = .{ .integer = @intCast(stat.size) } }}) }) else continue;
            try entries.append(.{ .record = try a.dupe(interpreter.Field, &.{ .{ .name = "name", .value = .{ .string = try a.dupe(u8, entry.name) } }, .{ .name = "type", .value = kind } }) });
        }
        std.mem.sort(V, entries.items, {}, struct {
            fn less(_: void, x: V, y: V) bool {
                return @import("unicode.zig").utf16LessThan(x.record[0].value.string, y.record[0].value.string);
            }
        }.less);
        var result: ?*const interpreter.List = null;
        var i = entries.items.len;
        while (i > 0) {
            i -= 1;
            result = (try engine.cons(entries.items[i], result)).list;
        }
        return ok(engine, .{ .list = result });
    }
    if (eq(name, "WriteFile") or eq(name, "AppendFile")) {
        const raw = try text(try valueField(lift, "path"));
        const path = effectPath(host, engine, raw) catch |err| return pathFailure(engine, err, raw);
        const bytes = try binary(try valueField(lift, "contents"));
        const file = if (eq(name, "AppendFile")) blk: {
            const fd = std.posix.open(path, .{ .ACCMODE = .WRONLY, .CREAT = true, .APPEND = true, .CLOEXEC = true }, 0o666) catch |err| return fail(engine, err);
            break :blk std.fs.File{ .handle = fd };
        } else std.fs.cwd().createFile(path, .{}) catch |err| return fail(engine, err);
        defer file.close();
        file.writeAll(bytes) catch |err| return fail(engine, err);
        return ok(engine, interpreter.unit());
    }
    if (eq(name, "DeleteFile")) {
        const raw = try text(lift);
        const path = effectPath(host, engine, raw) catch |err| return pathFailure(engine, err, raw);
        _ = std.fs.cwd().statFile(path) catch |err| return fail(engine, err);
        std.fs.cwd().deleteTree(path) catch |err| return fail(engine, err);
        return ok(engine, interpreter.unit());
    }
    if (eq(name, "MakeDirectory")) {
        const raw = try text(lift);
        const path = effectPath(host, engine, raw) catch |err| return pathFailure(engine, err, raw);
        std.fs.cwd().makePath(path) catch |err| return fail(engine, err);
        return ok(engine, interpreter.unit());
    }
    return error.UnhandledEffect;
}

pub fn reference(context: ?*anyopaque, engine: *Engine, ir: J) anyerror!V {
    const host: *Host = @ptrCast(@alignCast(context.?));
    const code = interpreter.stringField(ir, "0") orelse return error.UndefinedReference;
    if (!eq(code, ".")) return (try host.packages()).resolve(engine, ir);
    const path = try std.fs.path.resolve(engine.allocator, &.{ engine.origin orelse host.directory, interpreter.stringField(ir, "i") orelse return error.UndefinedReference });
    if (host.loading.contains(path)) return error.CyclicImport;
    try host.loading.put(path, {});
    defer _ = host.loading.remove(path);
    const source = try std.fs.cwd().readFileAlloc(engine.allocator, path, 64 * 1024 * 1024);
    const parsed = try sources.disk(engine.allocator, source, path);
    const previous = host.directory;
    host.directory = std.fs.path.dirname(path) orelse ".";
    defer host.directory = previous;
    var imported = Engine.init(engine.allocator);
    host.attach(&imported);
    imported.inspection_meta = parsed.meta;
    // Module initialization is pure in next-tui. Exported functions retain
    // source origins and use their caller's effect host when later invoked.
    imported.effect_handler = null;
    const result = imported.eval(parsed.program) catch |err| {
        engine.failure = imported.failure;
        return err;
    };
    return result;
}

test "imported closures retain their source directory for file effects" {
    var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer arena.deinit();
    const a = arena.allocator();
    var temp = std.testing.tmpDir(.{});
    defer temp.cleanup();
    try temp.dir.makePath("module");
    try temp.dir.writeFile(.{ .sub_path = "module/data", .data = "source-relative" });
    try temp.dir.writeFile(.{ .sub_path = "module/read.eyg", .data = "(_) -> { perform ReadFile({path: \"data\", offset: 0, limit: 99}) }" });
    var host = Host.init(a);
    host.directory = try temp.dir.realpathAlloc(a, ".");
    var engine = Engine.init(a);
    host.attach(&engine);
    const result = try engine.eval(try parser.parse(a, "let read = import \"module/read.eyg\" read({})"));
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("Ok", result.tagged.label);
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("source-relative", result.tagged.value.binary);
}

test "published module closures require an absolute filesystem path" {
    var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer arena.deinit();
    const a = arena.allocator();
    var host = Host.init(a);
    host.hub_cache = try hub.Cache.init(a, "http://localhost:1");
    const source = try parser.parse(a, "(_) -> { perform ReadFile({path: \"data\", offset: 0, limit: 10}) }");
    const cid = try hub.canonicalCID(a, source);
    _ = try host.hub_cache.?.ingestModule(cid, try hub.canonicalBytes(a, source));
    try host.hub_cache.?.addPackage("demo", 1, cid, 1);
    var engine = Engine.init(a);
    host.attach(&engine);
    const value = try engine.eval(try parser.parseExpression(a, "@demo({})"));
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("Error", value.tagged.label);
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("relative path \"data\" requires a disk-backed source; use CWD or an absolute path", value.tagged.value.string);
}

test "relative module initializers do not run host effects" {
    var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer arena.deinit();
    const a = arena.allocator();
    var temp = std.testing.tmpDir(.{});
    defer temp.cleanup();
    try temp.dir.writeFile(.{ .sub_path = "effect.eyg", .data = "perform StandardOut(\"must not be emitted\")" });
    var host = Host.init(a);
    host.directory = try temp.dir.realpathAlloc(a, ".");
    var engine = Engine.init(a);
    host.attach(&engine);
    try std.testing.expectError(error.Runtime, engine.eval(try parser.parseExpression(a, "import \"effect.eyg\"")));
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("StandardOut", engine.failure.?.unhandled_effect.label);
}

test "host validates the complete lift before resolving a file path" {
    var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer arena.deinit();
    const a = arena.allocator();
    var host = Host.init(a);
    var engine = Engine.init(a);
    const write: V = .{ .record = try a.dupe(interpreter.Field, &.{
        .{ .name = "path", .value = .{ .string = "relative" } },
        .{ .name = "contents", .value = .{ .integer = 0 } },
    }) };
    try std.testing.expectError(error.Runtime, effect(&host, &engine, "WriteFile", write));
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("Binary", engine.failure.?.incorrect_term.expected);
    try std.testing.expectError(error.Runtime, effect(&host, &engine, "StandardOut", .{ .integer = 0 }));
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("String", engine.failure.?.incorrect_term.expected);
}

//! The small document algebra used by the Gleam oracle's value printer.
//! Groups choose a flat or broken layout from the same Unicode grapheme width.
const std = @import("std");
const runtime = @import("interpreter.zig");
const unicode = @import("unicode.zig");
const A = std.mem.Allocator;
pub const Doc = struct {
    length: usize,
    content: union(enum) {
        text: []const u8,
        sequence: []const *const Doc,
        line: struct { flat: []const u8, broken: []const u8 },
        nest: *const Doc,
        group: *const Doc,
    },
};
pub const Printer = struct {
    allocator: A,
    pub fn create(self: Printer, size: usize, content: @FieldType(Doc, "content")) !*const Doc {
        const doc = try self.allocator.create(Doc);
        doc.* = .{ .length = size, .content = content };
        return doc;
    }
    pub fn text(self: Printer, value: []const u8) !*const Doc {
        return self.create(length(value), .{ .text = value });
    }
    pub fn sequence(self: Printer, docs: []const *const Doc) !*const Doc {
        var size: usize = 0;
        for (docs) |doc| size +|= doc.length;
        return self.create(size, .{ .sequence = try self.allocator.dupe(*const Doc, docs) });
    }
    pub fn line(self: Printer, flat: []const u8, broken: []const u8) !*const Doc {
        return self.create(length(flat), .{ .line = .{ .flat = flat, .broken = broken } });
    }
    pub fn nest(self: Printer, inner: *const Doc) !*const Doc {
        return self.create(inner.length, .{ .nest = inner });
    }
    pub fn group(self: Printer, inner: *const Doc) !*const Doc {
        return self.create(inner.length, .{ .group = inner });
    }
    pub fn wrap(self: Printer, open: []const u8, inner: *const Doc, close: []const u8) !*const Doc {
        return self.group(try self.sequence(&.{ try self.text(open), try self.nest(try self.sequence(&.{ try self.line("", ""), inner })), try self.line("", ""), try self.text(close) }));
    }
    pub fn separated(self: Printer, items: []const *const Doc, open: []const u8, close: []const u8) !*const Doc {
        if (items.len == 0) return self.text(try std.mem.concat(self.allocator, u8, &.{ open, close }));
        var body = std.ArrayList(*const Doc).init(self.allocator);
        try body.append(try self.line("", ""));
        for (items, 0..) |item, i| {
            if (i > 0) try body.append(try self.line(", ", ","));
            try body.append(item);
        }
        return self.group(try self.sequence(&.{ try self.text(open), try self.nest(try self.sequence(body.items)), try self.line("", ","), try self.text(close) }));
    }
    pub fn quote(self: Printer, value: []const u8) ![]const u8 {
        var out = std.ArrayList(u8).init(self.allocator);
        try out.append('"');
        for (value) |c| switch (c) {
            '\\' => try out.appendSlice("\\\\"),
            '"' => try out.appendSlice("\\\""),
            '\n' => try out.appendSlice("\\n"),
            '\r' => try out.appendSlice("\\r"),
            '\t' => try out.appendSlice("\\t"),
            else => try out.append(c),
        };
        try out.append('"');
        return out.toOwnedSlice();
    }
    fn document(self: Printer, input: runtime.Value, depth: usize) anyerror!*const Doc {
        if (depth >= 8) return self.text("…");
        return switch (input) {
            .integer => |i| self.text(try runtime.integerText(self.allocator, i)),
            .javascript_integer => |f| self.text(try runtime.numberText(self.allocator, f)),
            .string => |s| self.text(try self.quote(s)),
            .binary => |s| self.text(try std.fmt.allocPrint(self.allocator, "Binary({d} bytes): {s}", .{ s.len, try paddedBase64(self.allocator, s) })),
            .tagged => |t| self.sequence(&.{ try self.text(t.label), try self.wrap("(", try self.document(t.value, depth + 1), ")") }),
            .closure => |c| self.text(try std.fmt.allocPrint(self.allocator, "fn({s}) {{ ... }}", .{c.param})),
            .@"resume" => |captured| self.wrap("Partial(", try self.text(try @import("resume_inspect.zig").head(self.allocator, captured)), ")"),
            .list => |list| blk: {
                var items = std.ArrayList(*const Doc).init(self.allocator);
                var cursor = list;
                while (cursor) |cell| : (cursor = cell.tail) try items.append(try self.document(cell.head, depth + 1));
                break :blk self.separated(items.items, "[", "]");
            },
            .record => |fields| blk: {
                const sorted = try self.allocator.dupe(runtime.Field, fields);
                std.mem.sort(runtime.Field, sorted, {}, struct {
                    fn less(_: void, x: runtime.Field, y: runtime.Field) bool {
                        return unicode.utf16LessThan(x.name, y.name);
                    }
                }.less);
                var items = std.ArrayList(*const Doc).init(self.allocator);
                for (sorted) |f| try items.append(try self.sequence(&.{ try self.text(try std.mem.concat(self.allocator, u8, &.{ f.name, ": " })), try self.document(f.value, depth + 1) }));
                break :blk self.separated(items.items, "{", "}");
            },
            .partial => |p| blk: {
                if (p.kind == .tag and p.args.len == 0) break :blk self.text(p.label);
                const name = switch (p.kind) {
                    .cons => "Cons",
                    .extend => "Extend",
                    .overwrite => "Overwrite",
                    .select => "Select",
                    .tag => "Tag",
                    .match => "Match",
                    .no_cases => "NoCases",
                    .perform => "Perform",
                    .handle => "Handle",
                    .builtin => "Builtin",
                };
                const head = if (p.label.len == 0) name else try std.fmt.allocPrint(self.allocator, "{s}({s}: {s})", .{ name, if (p.kind == .builtin) @as([]const u8, "identifier") else "label", try self.quote(p.label) });
                if (p.args.len == 0) break :blk self.wrap("Partial(", try self.text(head), ")");
                var items = std.ArrayList(*const Doc).init(self.allocator);
                try items.append(try self.text(head));
                for (p.args) |arg| {
                    try items.append(try self.text(","));
                    try items.append(try self.line(" ", ""));
                    try items.append(try self.document(arg, depth + 1));
                }
                break :blk self.wrap("Partial(", try self.sequence(items.items), ")");
            },
        };
    }
};
fn paddedBase64(allocator: A, bytes: []const u8) ![]const u8 {
    const encoder = std.base64.standard.Encoder;
    const output = try allocator.alloc(u8, encoder.calcSize(bytes.len));
    return encoder.encode(output, bytes);
}
fn length(text: []const u8) usize {
    var i: usize = 0;
    var count: usize = 0;
    while (i < text.len) : (count += 1) i = unicode.graphemeEnd(text, i);
    return count;
}
fn emit(doc: *const Doc, out: *std.ArrayList(u8), width: usize, column: *usize, indent: usize, flat: bool) anyerror!void {
    switch (doc.content) {
        .text => |text| {
            try out.appendSlice(text);
            column.* +|= doc.length;
        },
        .sequence => |docs| for (docs) |child| try emit(child, out, width, column, indent, flat),
        .nest => |inner| try emit(inner, out, width, column, indent + 2, flat),
        .group => |inner| try emit(inner, out, width, column, indent, column.* +| inner.length <= width),
        .line => |line| if (flat) {
            try out.appendSlice(line.flat);
            column.* +|= doc.length;
        } else {
            try out.appendSlice(line.broken);
            try out.append('\n');
            try out.appendNTimes(' ', indent);
            column.* = indent;
        },
    }
}
pub fn render(allocator: A, value: runtime.Value, width: usize) ![]const u8 {
    const printer = Printer{ .allocator = allocator };
    const doc = try printer.document(value, 0);
    return renderDocument(allocator, doc, width);
}
test "groups wrap exactly at the column budget" {
    var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer arena.deinit();
    var engine = runtime.Engine.init(arena.allocator());
    const list = try engine.cons(.{ .integer = 123 }, (try engine.cons(.{ .integer = 456 }, null)).list);
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("Binary(1 bytes): AQ==", try render(arena.allocator(), .{ .binary = &.{1} }, 80));
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("[123, 456]", try render(arena.allocator(), list, 10));
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("[\n  123,\n  456,\n]", try render(arena.allocator(), list, 9));
}

pub fn renderDocument(allocator: A, doc: *const Doc, width: usize) ![]const u8 {
    var output = std.ArrayList(u8).init(allocator);
    var column: usize = 0;
    try emit(doc, &output, width, &column, 0, true);
    return output.toOwnedSlice();
}
