//! The reference value printer exposes Gleam's generic inspector for a Resume
//! switch. Reconstruct that public text from native frames; the VM still owns
//! execution and never calls the oracle. Only its fixed builtin table is generated.
const std = @import("std");
const runtime = @import("interpreter.zig");
const order = @import("oracle_order.zig");
const builtins = @import("generated_builtins_inspect.zig");
const codec = @import("ir_codec.zig");
const A = std.mem.Allocator;
const J = std.json.Value;

pub fn head(a: A, captured: *const runtime.Resumption) ![]const u8 {
    var inspector = Inspector{ .allocator = a, .output = std.ArrayList(u8).init(a) };
    try inspector.resumeSwitch(captured);
    return inspector.output.toOwnedSlice();
}

const Inspector = struct {
    allocator: A,
    output: std.ArrayList(u8),
    fn write(self: *Inspector, text: []const u8) !void {
        try self.output.appendSlice(text);
    }
    fn quote(self: *Inspector, text: []const u8) !void {
        try self.write("\"");
        var i: usize = 0;
        while (i < text.len) {
            const size = std.unicode.utf8ByteSequenceLength(text[i]) catch 1;
            const end = @min(text.len, i + size);
            const cp = std.unicode.utf8Decode(text[i..end]) catch 0xfffd;
            switch (cp) {
                '\n' => try self.write("\\n"),
                '\r' => try self.write("\\r"),
                '\t' => try self.write("\\t"),
                12 => try self.write("\\f"),
                '\\' => try self.write("\\\\"),
                '"' => try self.write("\\\""),
                else => if (cp < 32 or (cp > 126 and cp < 160)) try self.output.writer().print("\\u{{{X:0>4}}}", .{cp}) else try self.write(text[i..end]),
            }
            i = end;
        }
        try self.write("\"");
    }
    fn meta(self: *Inspector, metadata: runtime.InspectionMeta) !void {
        switch (metadata) {
            .none => try self.write("Nil"),
            .literal => |text| try self.write(text),
            .located => |location| {
                try self.write("Location(origin: ");
                switch (location.source.origin) {
                    .disk => |path| {
                        try self.write("Disk(path: ");
                        try self.quote(path);
                        try self.write(")");
                    },
                    .content => |text| {
                        try self.write("Content(cid: ");
                        try self.cid(try runtime.object(self.allocator, &.{.{ "/", .{ .string = text } }}));
                        try self.write(")");
                    },
                    .inline_code => try self.write("Inline"),
                    .pipe => try self.write("Pipe"),
                    .repl => try self.write("Repl"),
                }
                try self.write(", source: ");
                if (location.source.code) |code| {
                    try self.write("Text(code: ");
                    try self.quote(code);
                    try self.output.writer().print(", span: #({d}, {d}))", .{ location.span[0], location.span[1] });
                } else try self.write("Json");
                try self.write(")");
            },
        }
    }
    fn binary(self: *Inspector, bytes: []const u8) !void {
        try self.write("<<");
        for (bytes, 0..) |byte, i| {
            if (i > 0) try self.write(", ");
            try self.output.writer().print("{d}", .{byte});
        }
        try self.write(">>");
    }
    fn number(self: *Inspector, value_: runtime.Value) !void {
        switch (value_) {
            .integer => |i| try self.write(try runtime.integerText(self.allocator, i)),
            .javascript_integer => |f| {
                try self.write(try runtime.numberText(self.allocator, f));
                if (!std.math.isFinite(f)) try self.write(".0");
            },
            else => unreachable,
        }
    }
    fn scope(self: *Inspector, first: ?*const runtime.Binding) anyerror!void {
        try self.write("[");
        var cursor = first;
        var index: usize = 0;
        while (cursor) |binding| : (cursor = binding.next) {
            if (index > 0) try self.write(", ");
            index += 1;
            try self.write("#(");
            try self.quote(binding.name);
            try self.write(", ");
            try self.value(binding.value);
            try self.write(")");
        }
        try self.write("]");
    }
    fn env(self: *Inspector, first: ?*const runtime.Binding) anyerror!void {
        try self.write("Env(scope: ");
        try self.scope(first);
        try self.write(", builtins: ");
        try self.write(builtins.builtins);
        try self.write(")");
    }
    fn value(self: *Inspector, value_: runtime.Value) anyerror!void {
        switch (value_) {
            .integer, .javascript_integer => {
                try self.write("Integer(value: ");
                try self.number(value_);
                try self.write(")");
            },
            .string => |s| {
                try self.write("String(value: ");
                try self.quote(s);
                try self.write(")");
            },
            .binary => |b| {
                try self.write("Binary(value: ");
                try self.binary(b);
                try self.write(")");
            },
            .list => |first| {
                try self.write("LinkedList(elements: [");
                var cursor = first;
                var i: usize = 0;
                while (cursor) |cell| : (cursor = cell.tail) {
                    if (i > 0) try self.write(", ");
                    i += 1;
                    try self.value(cell.head);
                }
                try self.write("])");
            },
            .record => |fields| {
                try self.write("Record(fields: dict.from_list([");
                // Generic string.inspect uses dict.fold; the language's
                // dict.to_list prepends and therefore exposes its reverse.
                const ordered = try order.fields(self.allocator, fields);
                var i = ordered.len;
                while (i > 0) {
                    i -= 1;
                    const field = ordered[i];
                    if (i + 1 < ordered.len) try self.write(", ");
                    try self.write("#(");
                    try self.quote(field.name);
                    try self.write(", ");
                    try self.value(field.value);
                    try self.write(")");
                }
                try self.write("]))");
            },
            .tagged => |tag| {
                try self.write("Tagged(label: ");
                try self.quote(tag.label);
                try self.write(", value: ");
                try self.value(tag.value);
                try self.write(")");
            },
            .closure => |closure| {
                try self.write("Closure(param: ");
                try self.quote(closure.param);
                try self.write(", body: ");
                try self.node(closure.body, closure.inspection_meta);
                try self.write(", env: ");
                try self.scope(closure.env);
                try self.write(")");
            },
            .partial => |partial| {
                try self.write("Partial(switch: ");
                try self.switch_(partial.kind, partial.label);
                try self.write(", arguments: [");
                for (partial.args, 0..) |arg, i| {
                    if (i > 0) try self.write(", ");
                    try self.value(arg);
                }
                try self.write("])");
            },
            .@"resume" => |resume_| {
                try self.write("Partial(switch: ");
                try self.resumeSwitch(resume_);
                try self.write(", arguments: [])");
            },
        }
    }
    fn switch_(self: *Inspector, kind: runtime.Kind, label: []const u8) !void {
        const name = switch (kind) {
            .cons => "Cons",
            .extend => "Extend",
            .overwrite => "Overwrite",
            .select => "Select",
            .tag => "Tag",
            .match => "Match",
            .no_cases => "NoCases",
            .perform => "Perform",
            .handle => "Handle",
            .builtin => "Builtin",
        };
        try self.write(name);
        if (kind == .cons or kind == .no_cases) return;
        try self.write(if (kind == .builtin) "(identifier: " else "(label: ");
        try self.quote(label);
        try self.write(")");
    }
    fn resumeSwitch(self: *Inspector, captured: *const runtime.Resumption) anyerror!void {
        var stack = std.ArrayList(*const runtime.Kont).init(self.allocator);
        var cursor = captured.head;
        while (cursor != captured.stop) {
            const entry = cursor orelse break;
            try stack.append(entry);
            cursor = entry.next;
        }
        try self.write("Resume(#([");
        var i = stack.items.len;
        while (i > 0) {
            i -= 1;
            if (i + 1 < stack.items.len) try self.write(", ");
            try self.write("#(");
            try self.frame(stack.items[i]);
            try self.write(", ");
            try self.meta(stack.items[i].inspection_meta);
            try self.write(")");
        }
        try self.write("], ");
        try self.env(captured.env);
        try self.write("))");
    }
    fn frame(self: *Inspector, frame_: *const runtime.Kont) anyerror!void {
        switch (frame_.action) {
            .argument => |ir| {
                try self.write("Arg(");
                try self.node(ir, frame_.inspection_meta);
            },
            .apply => |value_| {
                try self.write("Apply(");
                try self.value(value_);
            },
            .assign => |binding| {
                try self.write("Assign(");
                try self.quote(binding.name);
                try self.write(", ");
                try self.node(binding.then, frame_.inspection_meta);
            },
            .call_with => |value_| {
                try self.write("CallWith(");
                try self.value(value_);
            },
            .delimit => |handler| {
                try self.write("Delimit(");
                try self.quote(handler.label);
                try self.write(", ");
                try self.value(handler.handler);
            },
            .trace => |arg| {
                try self.write("Trace(");
                try self.value(arg);
            },
        }
        try self.write(", ");
        try self.env(frame_.env);
        if (frame_.action == .delimit) try self.write(", False");
        try self.write(")");
    }
    fn node(self: *Inspector, ir: J, context: runtime.InspectionMeta) anyerror!void {
        const metadata = context.at(ir);
        try self.write("#(");
        try self.expression(ir, metadata);
        try self.write(", ");
        try self.meta(metadata);
        try self.write(")");
    }
    fn cid(self: *Inspector, ir: J) !void {
        // Reuse the codec's Number rounding and accepted aliases before reading
        // canonical bytes. This printer does not implement a second CID decoder.
        const text = runtime.stringField(ir, "/") orelse return error.InvalidIR;
        const canonical = try codec.canonicalCid(self.allocator, text);
        var bytes = std.ArrayList(u8).init(self.allocator);
        var bits: u5 = 0;
        var buffer: u16 = 0;
        for (canonical[1..]) |char| {
            const digit: u16 = if (char >= 'a') char - 'a' else char - '2' + 26;
            buffer = (buffer << 5) | digit;
            bits += 5;
            if (bits >= 8) {
                bits -= 8;
                try bytes.append(@intCast((buffer >> @intCast(bits)) & 255));
                buffer &= (@as(u16, 1) << @intCast(bits)) - 1;
            }
        }
        var at: usize = 0;
        _ = readVarint(bytes.items, &at);
        const content_type = readVarint(bytes.items, &at);
        _ = readVarint(bytes.items, &at);
        const count: usize = @intFromFloat(readVarint(bytes.items, &at));
        try self.write("Cid(content_type: ");
        try self.write(try runtime.numberText(self.allocator, content_type));
        try self.write(", content: Multihash(algorithm: Sha256, digest: ");
        try self.binary(bytes.items[at..][0..count]);
        try self.write("))");
    }
    fn readVarint(bytes: []const u8, at: *usize) f64 {
        var value_: f64 = 0;
        var scale: f64 = 1;
        while (at.* < bytes.len) {
            const byte = bytes[at.*];
            at.* += 1;
            value_ += @as(f64, @floatFromInt(byte & 127)) * scale;
            if (byte < 128) break;
            scale *= 128;
        }
        return value_;
    }
    fn reference(self: *Inspector, ir: J, code: []const u8) !void {
        try self.write("Reference(reference: ");
        if (runtime.eq(code, ".")) {
            try self.write("Relative(location: ");
            try self.quote(runtime.stringField(ir, "i").?);
            try self.write(")");
        } else if (runtime.eq(code, "#")) {
            try self.write("Content(cid: ");
            try self.cid(runtime.field(ir, "l"));
            try self.write(")");
        } else {
            const version = runtime.field(ir, "r");
            const module = runtime.field(ir, "l");
            const pinned = module != .null;
            try self.write(if (pinned) "Pinned(release: Release(package: " else if (version != .null) "Version(package: " else "Package(package: ");
            try self.quote(runtime.stringField(ir, "p").?);
            if (version != .null) {
                try self.write(", version: ");
                try self.write(try runtime.numberText(self.allocator, codec.jsonInteger(version).?));
            }
            if (pinned) {
                try self.write(", module: ");
                try self.cid(module);
                try self.write(")");
            }
            try self.write(")");
        }
        try self.write(")");
    }
    fn expression(self: *Inspector, ir: J, metadata: runtime.InspectionMeta) anyerror!void {
        const code = runtime.stringField(ir, "0") orelse return error.InvalidIR;
        if (runtime.eq(code, "a")) {
            try self.write("Apply(func: ");
            try self.node(runtime.field(ir, "f"), metadata);
            try self.write(", argument: ");
            try self.node(runtime.field(ir, "a"), metadata);
            return self.write(")");
        }
        if (runtime.eq(code, "f")) {
            try self.write("Lambda(label: ");
            try self.quote(runtime.stringField(ir, "l").?);
            try self.write(", body: ");
            try self.node(runtime.field(ir, "b"), metadata);
            return self.write(")");
        }
        if (runtime.eq(code, "l")) {
            try self.write("Let(label: ");
            try self.quote(runtime.stringField(ir, "l").?);
            try self.write(", definition: ");
            try self.node(runtime.field(ir, "v"), metadata);
            try self.write(", body: ");
            try self.node(runtime.field(ir, "t"), metadata);
            return self.write(")");
        }
        if (runtime.eq(code, "s")) {
            try self.write("String(value: ");
            try self.quote(runtime.stringField(ir, "v").?);
            return self.write(")");
        }
        if (runtime.eq(code, "i")) {
            const v = runtime.field(ir, "v");
            try self.write("Integer(value: ");
            if (v == .integer) try self.write(try runtime.integerText(self.allocator, v.integer)) else if (v == .float) try self.write(try runtime.numberText(self.allocator, v.float)) else return error.InvalidIR;
            return self.write(")");
        }
        if (runtime.eq(code, "x")) {
            try self.write("Binary(value: ");
            try self.binary(try runtime.decodeBytes(self.allocator, runtime.field(ir, "v")));
            return self.write(")");
        }
        const codes = [_]struct { []const u8, []const u8 }{ .{ "ta", "Tail" }, .{ "c", "Cons" }, .{ "z", "Vacant" }, .{ "u", "Empty" }, .{ "n", "NoCases" } };
        for (codes) |pair| if (runtime.eq(code, pair[0])) return self.write(pair[1]);
        const labelled = [_]struct { []const u8, []const u8 }{ .{ "v", "Variable" }, .{ "e", "Extend" }, .{ "g", "Select" }, .{ "o", "Overwrite" }, .{ "t", "Tag" }, .{ "m", "Case" }, .{ "p", "Perform" }, .{ "h", "Handle" }, .{ "b", "Builtin" } };
        for (labelled) |pair| if (runtime.eq(code, pair[0])) {
            try self.write(pair[1]);
            try self.write(if (runtime.eq(code, "b")) "(identifier: " else "(label: ");
            try self.quote(runtime.stringField(ir, "l").?);
            return self.write(")");
        };
        if (runtime.eq(code, "#") or runtime.eq(code, "@") or runtime.eq(code, ".")) return self.reference(ir, code);
        return error.InvalidIR;
    }
};

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/src/sandbox.zig","sha256":"e8a69b3db5cc44eff88450159dffb5be18742d6eadad0c55b1de6e02d56e5754","bytes":11625} -->

//! Deterministic computer effects for the oracle test transport. Never touches
//! the real filesystem, clock, environment or network.
const std = @import("std");
const runtime = @import("interpreter.zig");
const platform = @import("platform.zig");
const effect_cast = @import("effect_cast.zig");
const A = std.mem.Allocator;
const J = std.json.Value;
const V = runtime.Value;
const Engine = runtime.Engine;

pub const Handler = struct {
    allocator: A,
    entries: std.StringHashMap(?[]const u8),
    host: platform.Host,

    pub fn init(a: A, files: J) !Handler {
        var self = Handler{ .allocator = a, .entries = std.StringHashMap(?[]const u8).init(a), .host = platform.Host.init(a) };
        try self.entries.put("/", null);
        if (files == .object) {
            var it = files.object.iterator();
            while (it.next()) |entry| {
                const fixture_path = try self.path(entry.key_ptr.*);
                try self.makeDirectory(std.fs.path.dirname(fixture_path) orelse "/");
                if (entry.value_ptr.* == .string) try self.entries.put(fixture_path, entry.value_ptr.string);
            }
        }
        return self;
    }
    fn path(self: *Handler, raw: []const u8) ![]const u8 {
        if (std.mem.indexOfScalar(u8, raw, 0) != null) return error.InvalidPath;
        return std.fs.path.resolve(self.allocator, &.{ "/", raw });
    }
    fn makeDirectory(self: *Handler, path_: []const u8) !void {
        if (self.entries.get(path_)) |entry| {
            if (entry != null) return error.PathAlreadyExists;
            return;
        }
        try self.makeDirectory(std.fs.path.dirname(path_) orelse "/");
        try self.entries.put(path_, null);
    }
    fn inspect(self: *Handler, path_: []const u8) !?[]const u8 {
        if (self.entries.get(path_)) |entry| return entry;
        var parent = std.fs.path.dirname(path_);
        while (parent) |part| {
            if (self.entries.get(part)) |entry| if (entry != null) return error.NotDir;
            if (std.mem.eql(u8, part, "/")) break;
            parent = std.fs.path.dirname(part);
        }
        return error.FileNotFound;
    }
    pub fn readFile(self: *Handler, name: []const u8) ![]const u8 {
        return (try self.inspect(try self.path(name))) orelse error.IsDir;
    }
    pub fn effect(self: *Handler, engine: *Engine, name: []const u8, lift: V) anyerror!V {
        try effect_cast.validate(engine, name, lift);
        const a = self.allocator;
        if (eq(name, "CWD")) return engine.tag("Ok", .{ .string = "/" });
        if (eq(name, "Now")) return .{ .integer = 0 };
        if (eq(name, "Env")) return engine.tag("None", runtime.unit());
        if (eq(name, "Sleep") or eq(name, "StandardOut") or eq(name, "StandardError")) return runtime.unit();
        if (eq(name, "Random") or eq(name, "Flip")) return error.UnconfiguredRandomFixture;
        if (eq(name, "Fetch")) return engine.tag("Error", .{ .string = "NetworkError(\"None provided\")" });
        if (eq(name, "ReadFile")) {
            const raw = try text(try field(lift, "path"));
            const offset = try effect_cast.asNumber(engine, try field(lift, "offset"));
            const limit = try effect_cast.asNumber(engine, try field(lift, "limit"));
            if (offset < 0 or limit < 0) return failure(engine, error.InvalidArgument);
            const bytes = self.readFile(raw) catch |err| return failure(engine, err);
            const size: f64 = @floatFromInt(bytes.len);
            if (offset >= size or std.math.isNan(offset)) return engine.tag("Ok", .{ .binary = "" });
            const begin: usize = @intFromFloat(offset);
            const remaining = bytes.len - begin;
            const count: usize = if (limit < @as(f64, @floatFromInt(remaining))) @intFromFloat(limit) else remaining;
            return engine.tag("Ok", .{ .binary = bytes[begin..][0..count] });
        }
        if (eq(name, "WriteFile") or eq(name, "AppendFile")) {
            const path_ = self.path(try text(try field(lift, "path"))) catch |err| return failure(engine, err);
            const bytes = try binary(try field(lift, "contents"));
            const old = self.inspect(path_) catch |err| switch (err) {
                error.FileNotFound => @as(?[]const u8, ""),
                else => return failure(engine, err),
            };
            if (old == null) return failure(engine, error.IsDir);
            const parent = self.inspect(std.fs.path.dirname(path_) orelse "/") catch |err| return failure(engine, err);
            if (parent != null) return failure(engine, error.NotDir);
            const content = if (eq(name, "AppendFile")) try std.mem.concat(a, u8, &.{ old.?, bytes }) else bytes;
            try self.entries.put(path_, content);
            return engine.tag("Ok", runtime.unit());
        }
        if (eq(name, "MakeDirectory")) {
            const path_ = self.path(try text(lift)) catch |err| return failure(engine, err);
            self.makeDirectory(path_) catch |err| return failure(engine, err);
            return engine.tag("Ok", runtime.unit());
        }
        if (eq(name, "DeleteFile")) {
            const path_ = self.path(try text(lift)) catch |err| return failure(engine, err);
            _ = self.inspect(path_) catch |err| return failure(engine, err);
            if (eq(path_, "/")) return failure(engine, error.ResourceBusy);
            const prefix = try std.mem.concat(a, u8, &.{ path_, "/" });
            var deleted = std.ArrayList([]const u8).init(a);
            var it = self.entries.keyIterator();
            while (it.next()) |key| if (eq(key.*, path_) or std.mem.startsWith(u8, key.*, prefix)) try deleted.append(key.*);
            for (deleted.items) |key| _ = self.entries.remove(key);
            return engine.tag("Ok", runtime.unit());
        }
        if (eq(name, "ReadDirectory")) {
            const path_ = self.path(try text(lift)) catch |err| return failure(engine, err);
            const entry = self.inspect(path_) catch |err| return failure(engine, err);
            if (entry != null) return failure(engine, error.NotDir);
            const prefix = if (eq(path_, "/")) "/" else try std.mem.concat(a, u8, &.{ path_, "/" });
            var names = std.ArrayList([]const u8).init(a);
            var it = self.entries.keyIterator();
            while (it.next()) |key| {
                if (!std.mem.startsWith(u8, key.*, prefix) or key.len <= prefix.len) continue;
                const rest = key.*[prefix.len..];
                if (std.mem.indexOfScalar(u8, rest, '/') == null) try names.append(rest);
            }
            std.mem.sort([]const u8, names.items, {}, struct {
                fn less(_: void, x: []const u8, y: []const u8) bool {
                    return @import("unicode.zig").utf16LessThan(x, y);
                }
            }.less);
            var list: ?*const runtime.List = null;
            var i = names.items.len;
            while (i > 0) {
                i -= 1;
                const child_name = names.items[i];
                const child_path = try std.mem.concat(a, u8, &.{ prefix, child_name });
                const bytes = self.entries.get(child_path).?;
                const kind = if (bytes) |data| try engine.tag("File", .{ .record = try a.dupe(runtime.Field, &.{.{ .name = "size", .value = .{ .integer = @intCast(data.len) } }}) }) else try engine.tag("Directory", runtime.unit());
                const child: V = .{ .record = try a.dupe(runtime.Field, &.{ .{ .name = "name", .value = .{ .string = child_name } }, .{ .name = "type", .value = kind } }) };
                list = (try engine.cons(child, list)).list;
            }
            return engine.tag("Ok", .{ .list = list });
        }
        // Hash, parse and signing are pure computer operations. Platform never
        // sees filesystem/network labels through this fallback.
        if (eq(name, "Hash") or eq(name, "CreateKey") or eq(name, "Sign") or eq(name, "DecodeJSON") or eq(name, "EYGParse")) return platform.effect(&self.host, engine, name, lift);
        return error.UnhandledEffect;
    }
};
fn eq(a: []const u8, b: []const u8) bool {
    return std.mem.eql(u8, a, b);
}
fn text(value: V) ![]const u8 {
    return if (value == .string) value.string else error.InvalidEffectArgument;
}
fn binary(value: V) ![]const u8 {
    return if (value == .binary) value.binary else error.InvalidEffectArgument;
}
fn field(value: V, key: []const u8) !V {
    if (value == .record) for (value.record) |f| {
        if (eq(f.name, key)) return f.value;
    };
    return error.InvalidEffectArgument;
}
fn failure(engine: *Engine, err: anyerror) !V {
    return engine.tag("Error", .{ .string = switch (err) {
        error.FileNotFound => "No such file or directory",
        error.NotDir => "Not a directory",
        error.IsDir => "Is a directory",
        error.InvalidArgument => "Invalid argument",
        error.PathAlreadyExists => "File exists",
        error.ResourceBusy => "Resource busy",
        error.InvalidPath => "ERR_INVALID_ARG_VALUE",
        else => @errorName(err),
    } });
}

test "sandbox reads and mutations stay in the fixture world" {
    const parser = @import("parser.zig");
    var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer arena.deinit();
    const a = arena.allocator();
    var engine = Engine.init(a);
    var files = std.json.ObjectMap.init(a);
    try files.put("/dir/a", .{ .string = "hello" });
    var world = try Handler.init(a, .{ .object = files });
    const request = try engine.fromPlainJson(try parser.object(a, &.{ .{ "path", .{ .string = "/dir/a" } }, .{ "offset", .{ .integer = 1 } }, .{ "limit", .{ .integer = 3 } } }));
    const answer = try world.effect(&engine, "ReadFile", request);
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("ell", answer.tagged.value.binary);
    _ = try world.effect(&engine, "DeleteFile", .{ .string = "/dir" });
    try std.testing.expectError(error.FileNotFound, world.readFile("/dir/a"));
}

test "sandbox validates before effects and accepts wide Integer read ranges" {
    var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer arena.deinit();
    const a = arena.allocator();
    var engine = Engine.init(a);
    var files = std.json.ObjectMap.init(a);
    try files.put("/data", .{ .string = "bytes" });
    var world = try Handler.init(a, .{ .object = files });
    try std.testing.expectError(error.Runtime, world.effect(&engine, "StandardOut", .{ .integer = 1 }));
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("String", engine.failure.?.incorrect_term.expected);
    const fields = try a.dupe(runtime.Field, &.{
        .{ .name = "path", .value = .{ .string = "/data" } },
        .{ .name = "offset", .value = .{ .integer = 0 } },
        .{ .name = "limit", .value = .{ .javascript_integer = 1e100 } },
    });
    const input: V = .{ .record = fields };
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("bytes", (try world.effect(&engine, "ReadFile", input)).tagged.value.binary);
    fields[1].value = .{ .javascript_integer = 1e100 };
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("", (try world.effect(&engine, "ReadFile", input)).tagged.value.binary);
    const write: V = .{ .record = try a.dupe(runtime.Field, &.{
        .{ .name = "path", .value = .{ .string = "/new" } },
        .{ .name = "contents", .value = .{ .integer = 0 } },
    }) };
    try std.testing.expectError(error.Runtime, world.effect(&engine, "WriteFile", write));
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("Binary", engine.failure.?.incorrect_term.expected);
    try std.testing.expect(!world.entries.contains("/new"));
}

//! loam.source.parse: JSON first, then surface syntax, with shared provenance.
const std = @import("std");
const parser = @import("parser.zig");
pub const runtime = @import("interpreter.zig");
pub const inspection = @import("inspection.zig");
pub const Parsed = struct { program: std.json.Value, meta: inspection.Meta };

pub fn disk(a: std.mem.Allocator, raw: []const u8, path: []const u8) !Parsed {
    return parse(a, raw, .{ .disk = path });
}

pub fn parse(a: std.mem.Allocator, raw: []const u8, origin: inspection.Origin) !Parsed {
    var code = raw;
    if (std.mem.startsWith(u8, code, "#!")) code = if (std.mem.indexOfScalar(u8, code, '\n')) |newline| code[newline + 1 ..] else "";
    if (std.json.parseFromSlice(std.json.Value, a, code, .{ .allocate = .alloc_always })) |parsed| {
        if (runtime.validIr(parsed.value)) return .{ .program = parsed.value, .meta = try inspection.create(a, origin, null) };
    } else |_| {}
    return .{ .program = try parser.parseExpressionLocated(a, code), .meta = try inspection.create(a, origin, code) };
}

pub fn content(a: std.mem.Allocator, cid: []const u8) !inspection.Meta {
    return inspection.create(a, .{ .content = cid }, null);
}

//! Native structural EYG editor and styled terminal buffer.
//! The adapter deliberately exposes cells, rather than stripping ANSI: callers
//! can compare the actual terminal contract with a pinned reference runtime.
const std = @import("std");
const parser = @import("parser.zig");
const interpreter = @import("interpreter.zig");
const unicode = @import("unicode.zig");
const platform = @import("platform.zig");
const inference = @import("inference.zig");
const sandbox = @import("sandbox.zig");
const async_git = @import("async_git.zig");
const hub = @import("hub.zig");
const async_hub = @import("async_hub.zig");
const patterns = @import("tui_patterns.zig");
const source_loader = @import("source.zig");
const effect_cast = @import("effect_cast.zig");
const Allocator = std.mem.Allocator;
const J = std.json.Value;
const Error = anyerror;

pub const Color = union(enum) { default, indexed: u8, rgb: [3]u8 };
pub const Style = struct {
    fg: Color = .default,
    bg: Color = .default,
    modifiers: u16 = 0,
    underline_color: Color = .default,
};
pub const Cell = struct {
    symbol: []const u8 = " ",
    width: u8 = 1,
    style: Style = .{},
};
const CellContext = struct {
    pub fn hash(_: CellContext, cell: Cell) u64 {
        var hasher = std.hash.Wyhash.init(0);
        hasher.update(cell.symbol);
        std.hash.autoHash(&hasher, cell.width);
        std.hash.autoHash(&hasher, cell.style);
        return hasher.final();
    }
    pub fn eql(_: CellContext, left: Cell, right: Cell) bool {
        return left.width == right.width and std.mem.eql(u8, left.symbol, right.symbol) and std.meta.eql(left.style, right.style);
    }
};
pub const Buffer = struct {
    allocator: Allocator,
    width: usize,
    height: usize,
    cells: []Cell,

    pub fn init(a: Allocator, width: usize, height: usize) !Buffer {
        const cells = try a.alloc(Cell, try std.math.mul(usize, width, height));
        @memset(cells, Cell{});
        return .{ .allocator = a, .width = width, .height = height, .cells = cells };
    }
    pub fn deinit(self: Buffer) void {
        self.allocator.free(self.cells);
    }
    fn set(self: *Buffer, x: usize, y: usize, symbol: []const u8, width: u8, style: Style) void {
        if (x >= self.width or y >= self.height) return;
        self.cells[y * self.width + x] = .{ .symbol = symbol, .width = width, .style = style };
        if (width == 2 and x + 1 < self.width) self.cells[y * self.width + x + 1] = .{ .symbol = " ", .width = 0, .style = style };
    }
    fn text(self: *Buffer, x: usize, y: usize, value: []const u8, style: Style, maximum: usize) void {
        if (y >= self.height or x >= self.width) return;
        var at = x;
        var pos: usize = 0;
        const limit = @min(self.width, x +| maximum);
        while (pos < value.len and at < limit) {
            const g = grapheme(value, pos);
            if (g.width == 0) {
                pos = g.end;
                continue;
            }
            if (at + g.width > limit) break;
            self.set(at, y, value[pos..g.end], g.width, style);
            at += g.width;
            pos = g.end;
        }
    }
    /// Returned symbols are owned by a; buffers and analysis caches may be reset.
    pub fn json(self: Buffer, a: Allocator) !J {
        var cells = std.ArrayList(J).init(a);
        try cells.ensureTotalCapacity(self.cells.len);
        // Most terminal cells are identical blanks. Share immutable JSON cell
        // objects within this frame instead of allocating a map for each cell.
        var interned = std.HashMap(Cell, J, CellContext, 80).init(a);
        defer interned.deinit();
        for (self.cells) |cell| {
            if (interned.get(cell)) |encoded| {
                try cells.append(encoded);
                continue;
            }
            const encoded = try object(a, &.{
                .{ "symbol", .{ .string = try a.dupe(u8, cell.symbol) } },
                .{ "width", jint(cell.width) },
                .{ "fg", try colorJson(a, cell.style.fg) },
                .{ "bg", try colorJson(a, cell.style.bg) },
                .{ "modifiers", jint(cell.style.modifiers) },
                .{ "sub_modifiers", jint(0) },
                .{ "underline_color", try colorJson(a, cell.style.underline_color) },
                .{ "link", .{ .string = "" } },
            });
            try interned.put(cell, encoded);
            try cells.append(encoded);
        }
        return object(a, &.{ .{ "width", jint(self.width) }, .{ "height", jint(self.height) }, .{ "cells", .{ .array = cells } } });
    }
    pub fn ansi(self: Buffer, a: Allocator) ![]u8 {
        var out = std.ArrayList(u8).init(a);
        const w = out.writer();
        try w.writeAll("\x1b[?2026h\x1b[2J");
        for (0..self.height) |y| {
            try w.print("\x1b[{};1H", .{y + 1});
            var current: ?Style = null;
            for (self.cells[y * self.width .. (y + 1) * self.width]) |cell| {
                if (cell.width == 0) continue;
                if (current == null or !std.meta.eql(current.?, cell.style)) {
                    try w.writeAll("\x1b[0m");
                    try ansiColor(w, cell.style.fg, 38);
                    try ansiColor(w, cell.style.bg, 48);
                    const bits = [_]u16{ 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64 };
                    const codes = [_]u8{ 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 9 };
                    for (bits, codes) |bit, code| if (cell.style.modifiers & bit != 0) {
                        try w.print("\x1b[{}m", .{code});
                    };
                    switch (cell.style.underline_color) {
                        .rgb => |rgb| try w.print("\x1b[58:2::{}:{}:{}m", .{ rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2] }),
                        .indexed => |i| try w.print("\x1b[58:5:{}m", .{i}),
                        .default => {},
                    }
                    current = cell.style;
                }
                try writeAnsiSymbol(w, cell.symbol);
            }
        }
        try w.writeAll("\x1b[0m\x1b[?2026l");
        return out.toOwnedSlice();
    }
};
fn ansiColor(w: anytype, color: Color, code: u8) !void {
    switch (color) {
        .default => {},
        .indexed => |n| if (n < 8) {
            try w.print("\x1b[{}m", .{@as(u16, code) - 8 + n});
        } else if (n < 16) {
            try w.print("\x1b[{}m", .{@as(u16, code) + 52 + n - 8});
        } else {
            try w.print("\x1b[{};5;{}m", .{ code, n });
        },
        .rgb => |rgb| try w.print("\x1b[{};2;{};{};{}m", .{ code, rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2] }),
    }
}
fn colorJson(a: Allocator, c: Color) !J {
    return switch (c) {
        .default => .null,
        .indexed => |n| jint(n),
        .rgb => |rgb| blk: {
            var arr = std.ArrayList(J).init(a);
            for (rgb) |n| try arr.append(jint(n));
            break :blk .{ .array = arr };
        },
    };
}
fn jint(n: anytype) J {
    return .{ .integer = @intCast(n) };
}
fn object(a: Allocator, pairs: []const struct { []const u8, J }) !J {
    var map = std.json.ObjectMap.init(a);
    for (pairs) |p| try map.put(p[0], p[1]);
    return .{ .object = map };
}
fn field(j: J, key: []const u8) J {
    return if (j == .object) j.object.get(key) orelse .null else .null;
}
fn str(j: J) []const u8 {
    return if (j == .string) j.string else "";
}
fn eq(a: []const u8, b: []const u8) bool {
    return std.mem.eql(u8, a, b);
}

const Kind = enum { vacant, integer, string, binary, variable, builtin, perform, handle, tag, reference, list, record, call, function, block, select, case, label, parameter, binding, field, branch };
const Node = struct {
    kind: Kind,
    text: []const u8 = "",
    number: i64 = 0,
    wide_number: ?f64 = null,
    children: std.ArrayList(*Node),
    parent: ?*Node = null,
    open: bool = true,
    spread: bool = false,
    reference_ir: J = .null,
    destructured: bool = false,
    fn create(a: Allocator, kind: Kind, text: []const u8) !*Node {
        const n = try a.create(Node);
        n.* = .{ .kind = kind, .text = try a.dupe(u8, text), .children = std.ArrayList(*Node).init(a) };
        return n;
    }
    fn add(n: *Node, child: *Node) !void {
        child.parent = n;
        try n.children.append(child);
    }
    fn isExpression(n: *Node) bool {
        return switch (n.kind) {
            .label, .parameter, .binding, .field, .branch => false,
            else => true,
        };
    }
    fn contains(n: *Node, child: *Node) bool {
        var p: ?*Node = child;
        while (p) |v| {
            if (v == n) return true;
            p = v.parent;
        }
        return false;
    }
};
const Snapshot = struct { root: *Node, selected: *Node };
const EffectRecord = struct { label: []const u8, lift: []const u8, reply: []const u8 };
const RenderCache = struct { width: usize, arena: std.heap.ArenaAllocator, text: []const u8 };
const History = struct { root: *Node, selected: *Node, result: ?[]const u8 = null, value: ?interpreter.Value = null, failure: bool = false, aborted: bool = false, code: bool = false, effects: bool = false, occured: []const EffectRecord = &.{}, render_cache: ?RenderCache = null };
const Mode = enum { navigating, input, picker, history, running };
const InputKind = enum { integer, string, variable, builtin, function, record, tag, select, perform, handle, assign, assign_before, overwrite, label, reference, release, import, match, reply, extend_field_before, extend_field_after, extend_branch_before, extend_branch_after, extend_parameter_before, extend_parameter_after, extend_pattern_before, extend_pattern_after };
const Choice = struct { name: []const u8, hint: []const u8 };
const Span = struct { text: []const u8, style: Style = .{} };
const Line = std.ArrayList(Span);
const Lines = std.ArrayList(Line);

pub const Tui = struct {
    allocator: Allocator,
    root: *Node,
    selected: *Node,
    mode: Mode = .navigating,
    input_kind: InputKind = .integer,
    input_value: []const u8 = "",
    input_cursor: usize = 0,
    choices: []const Choice = &.{},
    choice_selected: usize = 0,
    message: ?[]const u8 = null,
    quit: bool = false,
    history_selected: usize = 0,
    history: std.ArrayList(History),
    undo: std.ArrayList(Snapshot),
    redo: std.ArrayList(Snapshot),
    engine: interpreter.Engine,
    scratch: ?Allocator = null,
    host: platform.Host,
    pending_effects: std.ArrayList(EffectRecord),
    pending_index: usize = 0,
    pending_scope: ?*const interpreter.Binding = null,
    pending_lift: ?interpreter.Value = null,
    pending_exit: ?[]const u8 = null,
    last_value: ?interpreter.Value = null,
    analysis_errors: usize = 0,
    analysis_loading: usize = 0,
    files: J = .null,
    sandboxed: bool = false,
    scope_cache: inference.ScopeCache,
    sandbox_world: ?sandbox.Handler = null,
    analysis_arena: ?std.heap.ArenaAllocator = null,
    cached_analysis: ?inference.Analysis = null,
    analysis_hash: u64 = 0,
    git_worker: ?*async_git.Worker = null,
    retired_workers: std.ArrayList(*async_git.Worker),
    active_engine: ?*interpreter.Engine = null,
    import_stack: std.ArrayList(*interpreter.Engine),
    vm_paused: bool = false,
    package_fixtures: J = .null,
    hub_worker: ?*async_hub.Worker = null,
    hub_waiting: ?J = null,
    hub_attempted: std.StringHashMap(void),
    extension_header: bool = false,
    assign_before_target: ?*Node = null,
    assign_before_anchor: ?*Node = null,

    pub fn init(a: Allocator) Tui {
        const n = Node.create(a, .vacant, "") catch @panic("out of memory");
        return .{ .allocator = a, .root = n, .selected = n, .history = std.ArrayList(History).init(a), .undo = std.ArrayList(Snapshot).init(a), .redo = std.ArrayList(Snapshot).init(a), .engine = interpreter.Engine.init(a), .host = platform.Host.init(a), .pending_effects = std.ArrayList(EffectRecord).init(a), .scope_cache = inference.ScopeCache.init(a), .retired_workers = std.ArrayList(*async_git.Worker).init(a), .import_stack = std.ArrayList(*interpreter.Engine).init(a), .hub_attempted = std.StringHashMap(void).init(a) };
    }
    fn packages(self: *Tui) !*hub.Cache {
        if (self.host.hub_cache == null) {
            if (self.sandboxed) {
                self.host.hub_cache = try hub.Cache.init(self.allocator, "https://eyg.test");
                if (self.package_fixtures == .object) try self.host.hub_cache.?.ingestPackages(self.package_fixtures) else self.host.hub_cache.?.pulled = true;
            } else _ = try self.host.packages();
        }
        return &self.host.hub_cache.?;
    }
    pub fn startHub(self: *Tui) !void {
        if (self.sandboxed) return;
        const cache = try self.packages();
        if (self.hub_worker == null and !cache.pulled) self.hub_worker = try async_hub.Worker.start(cache, null);
    }
    fn referenceDescription(self: *Tui, n: *Node) ![]const u8 {
        const ir = n.reference_ir;
        if (eq(str(field(ir, "0")), "@") and field(ir, "r") == .integer and field(field(ir, "l"), "/") == .string) return std.fmt.allocPrint(self.temp(), "@{s}:{d}:{s}", .{ str(field(ir, "p")), field(ir, "r").integer, str(field(field(ir, "l"), "/")) });
        return n.text;
    }
    fn referenceLoading(context: ?*anyopaque, reference: J) bool {
        const self: *Tui = @ptrCast(@alignCast(context.?));
        if (self.sandboxed or eq(str(field(reference, "0")), ".")) return false;
        const cache = self.packages() catch return false;
        if (!cache.pulled) return true;
        const cid = (self.cachedCID(reference) catch return false) orelse return false;
        if (cache.modules.contains(cid)) return false;
        if (self.hub_worker != null) return true;
        const key = self.referenceKey(reference) catch return false;
        return !self.hub_attempted.contains(key);
    }
    fn effectChoices(self: *Tui) ![]const Choice {
        if (self.sandboxed) return &effect_choices;
        const choices = try self.allocator.alloc(Choice, effect_choices.len + 2);
        @memcpy(choices[0..effect_choices.len], &effect_choices);
        for (choices[0..effect_choices.len]) |*choice| if (eq(choice.name, "Hash")) {
            choice.hint = "{algorithm: [SHA1: {} | SHA256: {}], bytes: Binary} : Binary";
        };
        choices[effect_choices.len] = .{ .name = "GitQuery", .hint = "Dynamic : [Ok: Dynamic | Error: String]" };
        choices[effect_choices.len + 1] = .{ .name = "Inflate", .hint = "Binary : [Ok: Binary | Error: String]" };
        return choices;
    }
    fn releaseChoices(self: *Tui) !void {
        const entries = try (try self.packages()).packageList(self.allocator);
        const choices = try self.allocator.alloc(Choice, entries.len);
        for (entries, choices) |entry, *choice| choice.* = .{ .name = entry.name, .hint = try std.fmt.allocPrint(self.allocator, "{d}", .{entry.version}) };
        self.choices = choices;
    }
    fn cachedCID(self: *Tui, reference: J) !?[]const u8 {
        const cache = try self.packages();
        const pulled = cache.pulled;
        const refresh = cache.refresh_on_miss;
        cache.pulled = true;
        cache.refresh_on_miss = false;
        defer {
            cache.pulled = pulled;
            cache.refresh_on_miss = refresh;
        }
        return cache.referenceCID(reference) catch null;
    }
    fn cachedModule(self: *Tui, reference: J) !?J {
        const cid = try self.cachedCID(reference) orelse return null;
        const cache = try self.packages();
        return if (cache.modules.get(cid)) |module| module.source else null;
    }
    fn referenceKey(self: *Tui, reference: J) ![]const u8 {
        return std.json.stringifyAlloc(self.allocator, try hub.canonicalTree(self.allocator, reference), .{});
    }
    fn queueReference(self: *Tui, reference: J) !void {
        if (self.sandboxed or self.hub_worker != null) return;
        const key = try self.referenceKey(reference);
        if (self.hub_attempted.contains(key)) return;
        try self.hub_attempted.put(key, {});
        self.hub_worker = try async_hub.Worker.start(try self.packages(), reference);
    }
    fn prepareHub(self: *Tui) Error!void {
        if (self.sandboxed or self.hub_worker != null) return;
        if (self.hub_waiting) |reference| {
            try self.queueReference(reference);
            return;
        }
        try self.prepareNode(self.root);
    }
    fn prepareNode(self: *Tui, n: *Node) Error!void {
        if (self.hub_worker != null) return;
        if (n.kind == .reference) {
            const reference = try self.toIR(n);
            if (!eq(str(field(reference, "0")), ".") and try self.cachedModule(reference) == null) try self.queueReference(reference);
        }
        for (n.children.items) |child| try self.prepareNode(child);
    }
    fn pollHub(self: *Tui) Error!bool {
        const worker = self.hub_worker orelse return false;
        if (!worker.ready()) return false;
        self.hub_worker = null;
        defer worker.destroy();
        try worker.merge(try self.packages());
        self.cached_analysis = null;
        if (self.mode == .picker and self.input_kind == .release) try self.releaseChoices();
        if (self.hub_waiting) |reference| {
            if (try self.cachedModule(reference) == null and worker.reference == null) {
                try self.queueReference(reference);
                return true;
            }
            self.hub_waiting = null;
            const active = self.active_engine orelse &self.engine;
            const value = active.continueRun() catch |err| {
                try self.runError(err);
                return true;
            };
            try self.resumeParents(value);
        } else try self.prepareHub();
        return true;
    }
    fn remoteReference(self: *Tui, engine: *interpreter.Engine, reference: J) Error!interpreter.Value {
        const cache = try self.packages();
        const program = try self.cachedModule(reference) orelse {
            if (!self.sandboxed) {
                const key = try self.referenceKey(reference);
                if (self.hub_worker != null or !self.hub_attempted.contains(key)) {
                    self.hub_waiting = reference;
                    try self.queueReference(reference);
                    return error.TuiHub;
                }
            }
            engine.failure = .{ .undefined_reference = reference };
            return error.Runtime;
        };
        if (self.sandboxed) return cache.resolve(engine, reference);
        const cid = try self.cachedCID(reference) orelse unreachable;
        if (cache.modules.get(cid)) |module| if (module.value) |value| return value;
        const child = try self.allocator.create(interpreter.Engine);
        child.* = interpreter.Engine.init(self.allocator);
        child.time_budget_ns = 1_000_000;
        child.inspection_meta = try source_loader.content(self.allocator, cid);
        child.reference_handler = hubReference;
        child.reference_context = self;
        try self.import_stack.append(engine);
        self.active_engine = child;
        const value = child.eval(program) catch |err| {
            if (err == error.Yield or err == error.TuiHub) return err;
            _ = self.import_stack.pop();
            self.active_engine = engine;
            engine.failure = child.failure;
            return err;
        };
        _ = self.import_stack.pop();
        self.active_engine = engine;
        try cache.modules.put(cid, .{ .source = program, .value = value });
        return value;
    }
    fn hubReference(context: ?*anyopaque, engine: *interpreter.Engine, reference: J) Error!interpreter.Value {
        const self: *Tui = @ptrCast(@alignCast(context.?));
        const code = str(field(reference, "0"));
        if (eq(code, "#") or (eq(code, "@") and field(reference, "l") != .null)) return self.remoteReference(engine, reference);
        engine.failure = .{ .undefined_reference = reference };
        return error.Runtime;
    }
    pub fn hasPendingWork(self: *const Tui) bool {
        return self.vm_paused or self.git_worker != null or self.retired_workers.items.len > 0 or self.hub_worker != null or self.hub_waiting != null;
    }
    pub fn shutdown(self: *Tui) void {
        if (self.hub_worker) |worker| worker.destroy();
        self.hub_worker = null;
        self.hub_waiting = null;
        if (self.analysis_arena) |*arena| arena.deinit();
        self.analysis_arena = null;
        self.cached_analysis = null;
        for (self.history.items) |*entry| if (entry.render_cache) |*cache| {
            cache.arena.deinit();
            entry.render_cache = null;
        };
        if (self.git_worker) |job| job.destroy();
        self.git_worker = null;
        for (self.retired_workers.items) |job| job.destroy();
        self.retired_workers.clearRetainingCapacity();
    }
    /// Transfer a finished worker result into session storage before releasing
    /// the worker arena, then resume the interpreter on the UI thread.
    pub fn pollWork(self: *Tui) Error!bool {
        if (try self.pollHub()) return true;
        var i: usize = 0;
        while (i < self.retired_workers.items.len) {
            const job = self.retired_workers.items[i];
            if (job.ready()) {
                job.destroy();
                _ = self.retired_workers.swapRemove(i);
            } else i += 1;
        }
        if (self.vm_paused) {
            const active = self.active_engine orelse &self.engine;
            const value = active.continueRun() catch |err| {
                if (err == error.Yield) return false;
                self.vm_paused = false;
                try self.runError(err);
                return true;
            };
            self.vm_paused = false;
            try self.resumeParents(value);
            return true;
        }
        const job = self.git_worker orelse return false;
        if (!job.ready()) return false;
        self.git_worker = null;
        defer job.destroy();
        const value = switch (job.response) {
            .success => |response| blk: {
                const bytes = try std.json.stringifyAlloc(self.allocator, response, .{});
                const owned = (try std.json.parseFromSlice(J, self.allocator, bytes, .{ .allocate = .alloc_always })).value;
                break :blk try self.engine.tag("Ok", try self.engine.fromPlainJson(owned));
            },
            .failure => |err| try self.engine.tag("Error", .{ .string = @errorName(err) }),
            .pending => unreachable,
        };
        try self.pending_effects.append(.{ .label = "GitQuery", .lift = try self.engine.inspect(self.pending_lift.?), .reply = try self.engine.inspect(value) });
        self.mode = .navigating;
        try self.resumeActive(value);
        return true;
    }
    pub fn event(self: *Tui, ev: J) Error!void {
        defer if (!self.sandboxed and !self.quit) self.prepareHub() catch {};
        self.message = null;
        const key = str(field(ev, "key"));
        if (eq(key, "ctrl+q")) {
            self.quit = true;
            return;
        }
        if (field(ev, "paste") == .string) {
            const text = field(ev, "paste").string;
            if (self.mode == .input or self.mode == .picker) {
                try self.pasteInput(text);
                if (self.mode == .picker and self.input_kind == .import) try self.refreshImportChoices();
                return;
            }
            if (self.mode == .history or self.mode == .running) return;
            if (!self.selected.isExpression()) {
                self.message = "Select an expression to paste into";
                return;
            }
            const ir = self.parseSource(text) catch {
                self.message = try parser.diagnostic(self.allocator, text);
                return;
            };
            const n = try self.fromIR(ir);
            try self.save();
            self.replace(self.selected, n);
            self.selected = n;
            return;
        }
        if (key.len == 0) return;
        switch (self.mode) {
            .history => {
                if (eq(key, "up")) self.history_selected = @min(self.history_selected + 1, self.history.items.len - 1) else if (eq(key, "down")) {
                    if (self.history_selected == 0) self.mode = .navigating else self.history_selected -= 1;
                } else if (eq(key, "esc")) {
                    self.mode = .navigating;
                    for (self.history.items) |*h| {
                        h.code = false;
                        h.effects = false;
                    }
                } else if (eq(key, "k")) self.history.items[self.history_selected].code = !self.history.items[self.history_selected].code else if (eq(key, "K")) self.history.items[self.history_selected].effects = !self.history.items[self.history_selected].effects else if (eq(key, "enter")) {
                    const h = self.history.items[self.history_selected];
                    const copy = try self.cloneSnapshot(h.root, h.selected);
                    self.root = copy.root;
                    self.selected = copy.selected;
                    self.mode = .navigating;
                }
                return;
            },

    fn fail(self: *Tui, name: []const u8) !void {
        self.message = try std.fmt.allocPrint(self.allocator, "Action {s} not possible at this position", .{name});
    }
    fn cloneSnapshot(self: *Tui, root: *Node, selected: *Node) Error!Snapshot {

        const copy = try self.cloneNode(root, selected, &focus);

    }
    fn cloneNode(self: *Tui, n: *Node, selected: *Node, focus: *?*Node) Error!*Node {

        copy.wide_number = n.wide_number;
        copy.open = n.open;
        copy.spread = n.spread;
        copy.reference_ir = n.reference_ir;
        copy.destructured = n.destructured;

    fn save(self: *Tui) !void {

    fn replace(self: *Tui, old: *Node, new: *Node) void {

                new.parent = p;
                return;

            new.parent = null;
        }
    }
    fn wrap(self: *Tui, kind: Kind) !void {

        self.replace(old, n);
        try n.add(old);

    fn openInput(self: *Tui, kind: InputKind, value: []const u8, picker: bool) !void {

    fn pasteInput(self: *Tui, text: []const u8) !void {

    fn insertInput(self: *Tui, text: []const u8) !void {

        self.input_cursor += cellWidth(text);

    }
    fn inputKey(self: *Tui, key: []const u8) Error!void {

    fn moveInputRight(self: *Tui) void {

    fn backspaceInput(self: *Tui) !void {

    fn matches(self: *Tui) ![]const Choice {

    fn completion(self: *Tui) ![]const u8 {

    fn pickerInfo(self: *Tui) !?inference.Info {
        const analysis = try inference.analyzeWithOptions(self.allocator, try self.toIR(self.root), self.engine.scope, .{ .reference_resolver = resolveReference, .reference_context = self, .scope_cache = &self.scope_cache, .reference_loading = referenceLoading, .native_effects = !self.sandboxed, .collect_paths = true });

    }
    fn forwardInfo(self: *Tui) !?inference.Info {

        std.mem.reverse(usize, desired);

    fn toChoices(self: *Tui, items: []const inference.ScopeItem) ![]Choice {
        const choices = try self.allocator.alloc(Choice, items.len);

    }
    fn recordFields(self: *Tui, fields: []const inference.ScopeItem) Error!void {

            const f = try Node.create(self.allocator, .field, "");
            try f.add(try Node.create(self.allocator, .label, field_.name));
            try f.add(if (i == 0) old else try Node.create(self.allocator, .vacant, ""));
            try record.add(f);

    }
    fn matchVariants(self: *Tui, variants: []const inference.ScopeItem) Error!void {

    fn integerText(self: *Tui, n: *Node) ![]const u8 {

    }
    fn validReference(self: *Tui, text: []const u8) !bool {
