fn pathWithMode(a: Allocator, n: *Node, focus: ?*Node, rendering: bool) ![]usize {
    var path = std.ArrayList(usize).init(a);
    var at = n;
    while (at.parent) |parent| {
        const index = nodeIndex(parent, at);
        switch (parent.kind) {
            .field => {
                const owner = parent.parent.?;
                try path.append(nodeIndex(owner, parent) * 2 + index);
                at = owner;
            },
            .binding => {
                const block_ = parent.parent.?;
                try path.append(index);
                try path.append(nodeIndex(block_, parent));
                at = block_;
            },
            .branch => {
                const case_ = parent.parent.?;
                if (index > 0) try path.append(0);
                try path.append(nodeIndex(case_, parent));
                at = case_;
            },
            .select => {
                if (!rendering) {
                    try path.append(if (index == 0) @as(usize, 1) else 0);
                } else if (focus != null and focus.? == parent.children.items[1] and index == 0) {
                    // The selected field projection renders its source at the
                    // enclosing path, as the reference renderer does.
                } else try path.append(index);
                at = parent;
            },
            .record => {
                if (parent.spread and index + 1 == parent.children.items.len) {
                    const fields = parent.children.items.len - 1;
                    const zoomed = focus != null and at.contains(focus.?);
                    try path.append(if (zoomed) fields + 1 else fields * 2);
                } else try path.append(index);
                at = parent;
            },
            else => {
                try path.append(index);
                at = parent;
            },

}
fn annotateMetadata(ir: *J, path: []const usize, a: Allocator) anyerror!void {
    if (ir.* != .object or field(ir.*, "0") != .string or field(ir.*, "_native_path") == .array) return;
    var values = std.ArrayList(J).init(a);
    for (path) |index| try values.append(jint(index));
    try ir.object.put("_native_path", .{ .array = values });
    try ir.object.put("_native_depth", jint(path.len));
    var iterator = ir.object.iterator();
    while (iterator.next()) |entry| if (entry.value_ptr.* == .object) {
        try annotateMetadata(entry.value_ptr, path, a);
    };
}
fn hashNode(hash: *std.hash.Wyhash, n: *Node) void {
    const identity = @intFromPtr(n);
    const tag = @intFromEnum(n.kind);
    hash.update(std.mem.asBytes(&identity));
    hash.update(std.mem.asBytes(&tag));
    hash.update(n.text);
    hash.update(std.mem.asBytes(&n.number));
    if (n.wide_number) |wide| hash.update(std.mem.asBytes(&wide));
    hash.update(std.mem.asBytes(&n.spread));
    hash.update(std.mem.asBytes(&n.destructured));
    for (n.children.items) |child| hashNode(hash, child);
}

/// Result documents are immutable until the viewport width changes. Keeping
/// their temporary document graph in an owned arena avoids session-arena growth
/// on every key while a large query result remains in scrollback.
fn renderHistory(entry: *History, width: usize) ![]const u8 {
    if (entry.render_cache == null) entry.render_cache = .{ .width = 0, .arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.heap.page_allocator), .text = "" };
    const cache = &entry.render_cache.?;
    if (cache.width != width) {
        _ = cache.arena.reset(.retain_capacity);
        var printer = interpreter.Engine.init(cache.arena.allocator());
        cache.text = try printer.render(entry.value.?, width);
        cache.width = width;
    }
    return cache.text;
}

fn editableText(n: *Node) []const u8 {
    return switch (n.kind) {
        .select => n.children.items[1].text,
        .binding, .field, .branch => n.children.items[0].text,
        else => n.text,
    };
}

fn isExtension(kind: InputKind) bool {
    return switch (kind) {
        .extend_field_before, .extend_field_after, .extend_pattern_before, .extend_pattern_after, .extend_parameter_before, .extend_parameter_after, .extend_branch_before, .extend_branch_after => true,
        else => false,
    };
}
fn extensionBefore(kind: InputKind) bool {
    return switch (kind) {
        .extend_field_before, .extend_pattern_before, .extend_parameter_before, .extend_branch_before => true,
        else => false,
    };
}

fn parseEditorNumber(text: []const u8) !f64 {
    if (text.len == 0) return error.InvalidInteger;
    var i: usize = if (text[0] == '+' or text[0] == '-') 1 else 0;
    if (i == text.len) return error.InvalidInteger;
    while (i < text.len) : (i += 1) if (!std.ascii.isDigit(text[i])) return error.InvalidInteger;
    return std.fmt.parseFloat(f64, text);
}

//! The structural editor's view of lambda/let destructuring. This is the
//! reversible sugar used by morph/editable on the pinned oracle, not a second
//! runtime pattern matcher. In particular an unused empty pattern is Bind("$").
const std = @import("std");
const runtime = @import("interpreter.zig");
const parser = @import("parser.zig");
const A = std.mem.Allocator;
const J = std.json.Value;

pub const Field = struct { name: []const u8, variable: []const u8 };
pub const Pattern = struct {
    label: []const u8,
    fields: []const Field = &.{},
    destructured: bool = false,
};
pub const Gather = struct { pattern: Pattern, rest: J };
pub const Lowered = struct { label: []const u8, body: J };

/// Recognize consecutive selectors of the parameter/bound record. The oracle
/// deliberately keeps the original binding when the whole record is still
/// free in the remaining expression.
pub fn gather(a: A, label: []const u8, body: J) !Gather {
    var fields = std.ArrayList(Field).init(a);
    var rest = body;
    while (eq(code(rest), "l")) {
        const definition = field(rest, "v");
        if (!eq(code(definition), "a")) break;
        const select = field(definition, "f");
        const from = field(definition, "a");
        if (!eq(code(select), "g") or !eq(code(from), "v") or !eq(text(from, "l"), label)) break;
        try fields.append(.{ .name = text(select, "l"), .variable = text(rest, "l") });
        rest = field(rest, "t");
    }
    if (isFree(label, rest)) return .{ .pattern = .{ .label = label }, .rest = body };
    return .{ .pattern = .{ .label = label, .fields = fields.items, .destructured = fields.items.len != 0 }, .rest = rest };
}

/// Copy exactly morph/editable.is_free's scope rules. A let shadows its name
/// only in the continuation; a lambda shadows it in its body.
pub fn isFree(label: []const u8, ir: J) bool {
    const tag = code(ir);
    if (eq(tag, "v")) return eq(label, text(ir, "l"));
    if (eq(tag, "f")) return !eq(label, text(ir, "l")) and isFree(label, field(ir, "b"));
    if (eq(tag, "a")) return isFree(label, field(ir, "f")) or isFree(label, field(ir, "a"));
    if (eq(tag, "l")) return isFree(label, field(ir, "v")) or (!eq(label, text(ir, "l")) and isFree(label, field(ir, "t")));
    return false;
}

/// Lower an edited pattern. Every inserted selector, variable, application and
/// let is annotated with the same pattern path, as in pattern_to_annotated.
/// `reverse_path` has the innermost index first.
pub fn lower(a: A, pattern: Pattern, body: J, reverse_path: []const usize) !Lowered {
    if (!pattern.destructured) return .{ .label = pattern.label, .body = body };
    var result = body;
    var i = pattern.fields.len;
    while (i > 0) {
        i -= 1;
        const f = pattern.fields[i];
        const select = try annotate(a, try parser.label(a, "g", f.name), reverse_path);
        const variable = try annotate(a, try parser.label(a, "v", "$"), reverse_path);
        const definition = try annotate(a, try parser.apply(a, select, variable), reverse_path);
        result = try annotate(a, try parser.letNode(a, f.variable, definition, result), reverse_path);
    }
    return .{ .label = "$", .body = result };
}

/// Extend a REPL scope after the pattern's definition has completed. Binding
/// order mirrors the generated lets, including shadowing the synthetic "$".
pub fn bind(engine: *runtime.Engine, pattern: Pattern, value: runtime.Value) !void {
    if (!pattern.destructured) return engine.bind(pattern.label, value);
    try engine.bind("$", value);
    for (pattern.fields) |f| {
        var cursor = engine.scope;
        var current = value;
        while (cursor) |binding| : (cursor = binding.next) {
            if (eq(binding.name, "$")) {
                current = binding.value;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (current != .record) {
            engine.failure = .{ .incorrect_term = .{ .expected = "Record", .got = current } };
            return error.Runtime;
        }
        var selected: ?runtime.Value = null;
        for (current.record) |entry| if (eq(entry.name, f.name)) {
            selected = entry.value;
            break;
        };
        if (selected) |found| try engine.bind(f.variable, found) else {
            engine.failure = .{ .missing_field = f.name };
            return error.Runtime;
        }
    }
}

fn annotate(a: A, ir: J, reverse_path: []const usize) !J {
    var result = ir;
    var path = std.ArrayList(J).init(a);
    for (reverse_path) |index| try path.append(.{ .integer = @intCast(index) });
    try result.object.put("_native_path", .{ .array = path });
    try result.object.put("_native_depth", .{ .integer = @intCast(reverse_path.len) });
    return result;
}
fn field(value: J, label: []const u8) J {
    return runtime.field(value, label);
}
fn text(value: J, label: []const u8) []const u8 {
    return runtime.stringField(value, label) orelse "";
}
fn code(value: J) []const u8 {
    return text(value, "0");
}
fn eq(a: []const u8, b: []const u8) bool {
    return std.mem.eql(u8, a, b);
}

test "gather and lower preserve destructuring order and original record uses" {
    var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer arena.deinit();
    const a = arena.allocator();
    const source = try parser.parseExpression(a, "({x, y: z}) -> { !int_add(x, z) }");
    const gathered = try gather(a, text(source, "l"), field(source, "b"));
    try std.testing.expect(gathered.pattern.destructured);
    try std.testing.expectEqual(@as(usize, 2), gathered.pattern.fields.len);
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("x", gathered.pattern.fields[0].name);
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("z", gathered.pattern.fields[1].variable);
    const lowered = try lower(a, gathered.pattern, gathered.rest, &.{ 0, 2 });
    const reconstructed = try parser.lambda(a, lowered.label, lowered.body);
    const record = try parser.parseExpression(a, "{x: 20, y: 22}");
    var first = runtime.Engine.init(a);
    var second = runtime.Engine.init(a);
    try std.testing.expectEqual(@as(i64, 42), (try first.eval(try parser.apply(a, source, record))).integer);
    try std.testing.expectEqual(@as(i64, 42), (try second.eval(try parser.apply(a, reconstructed, record))).integer);
    try std.testing.expectEqual(@as(i64, 0), field(lowered.body, "_native_path").array.items[0].integer);
    const retained = try parser.parseExpression(a, "(record) -> { let x = record.x record }");
    const bound = try gather(a, "record", field(retained, "b"));
    try std.testing.expect(!bound.pattern.destructured);
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("l", code(bound.rest));
}

test "REPL destructuring exposes selected fields and missing fields fail" {
    var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer arena.deinit();
    const a = arena.allocator();
    var engine = runtime.Engine.init(a);
    const value = try engine.eval(try parser.parseExpression(a, "{x: 20, y: 22}"));
    const pattern = Pattern{ .label = "$", .destructured = true, .fields = &.{ .{ .name = "x", .variable = "a" }, .{ .name = "y", .variable = "b" } } };
    try bind(&engine, pattern, value);
    try std.testing.expectEqual(@as(i64, 42), (try engine.eval(try parser.parseExpression(a, "!int_add(a, b)"))).integer);
    try std.testing.expectError(error.Runtime, bind(&engine, .{ .label = "$", .destructured = true, .fields = &.{.{ .name = "absent", .variable = "a" }} }, value));
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("absent", engine.failure.?.missing_field);
}

test "empty destructure normalizes to the oracle synthetic binding" {
    var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.testing.allocator);
    defer arena.deinit();
    const a = arena.allocator();
    const source = try parser.parseExpression(a, "({}) -> { 42 }");
    const gathered = try gather(a, text(source, "l"), field(source, "b"));
    try std.testing.expect(!gathered.pattern.destructured);
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("$", gathered.pattern.label);
}

//! Unicode 16 extended grapheme clusters (UAX #29) and default case mapping.
const std = @import("std");
const data = @import("unicode_data.zig");
const Gcb = enum(u5) { other, cr, lf, control, extend, zwj, ri, prepend, spacing, l, v, t, lv, lvt };
fn properties(cp: u21) u16 {
    var lo: usize = 0;
    var hi = data.ranges.len;
    while (lo < hi) {
        const mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2;
        const r = data.ranges[mid];
        if (cp < r.first) hi = mid else if (cp > r.last) lo = mid + 1 else return r.flags;
    }
    return 0;
}
fn codepoint(text: []const u8, i: usize) struct { cp: u21, end: usize } {
    const len = std.unicode.utf8ByteSequenceLength(text[i]) catch return .{ .cp = 0xfffd, .end = i + 1 };
    if (i + len > text.len) return .{ .cp = 0xfffd, .end = i + 1 };
    return .{ .cp = std.unicode.utf8Decode(text[i .. i + len]) catch 0xfffd, .end = i + len };
}

/// JavaScript string order compares UTF-16 code units, not UTF-8 bytes or
/// Unicode scalar values. In particular, supplementary characters precede
/// BMP characters at U+E000 and above. No allocation or normalization occurs.
pub fn utf16Order(left: []const u8, right: []const u8) std.math.Order {
    var lhs = Utf16Units{ .text = left };
    var rhs = Utf16Units{ .text = right };
    while (true) {
        const a = lhs.next();
        const b = rhs.next();
        if (a == null) return if (b == null) .eq else .lt;
        if (b == null) return .gt;
        if (a.? < b.?) return .lt;
        if (a.? > b.?) return .gt;
    }
}

pub fn utf16LessThan(left: []const u8, right: []const u8) bool {
    return utf16Order(left, right) == .lt;
}

const Utf16Units = struct {
    text: []const u8,
    at: usize = 0,
    low_surrogate: ?u16 = null,

    fn next(self: *Utf16Units) ?u16 {
        if (self.low_surrogate) |low| {
            self.low_surrogate = null;
            return low;
        }
        if (self.at == self.text.len) return null;
        const first = self.text[self.at];
        if (first < 0x80) {
            self.at += 1;
            return first;
        }
        const point = codepoint(self.text, self.at);
        self.at = point.end;
        if (point.cp <= 0xffff) return @intCast(point.cp);
        const supplementary = point.cp - 0x10000;
        self.low_surrogate = @intCast(0xdc00 + (supplementary & 0x3ff));
        return @intCast(0xd800 + (supplementary >> 10));
    }
};

pub fn graphemeEnd(text: []const u8, start: usize) usize {
    if (start >= text.len) return text.len;
    const first = codepoint(text, start);
    var flags = properties(first.cp);
    var previous: Gcb = @enumFromInt(flags & 31);
    var regional: usize = if (previous == .ri) 1 else 0;
    var pictographic = flags & 32 != 0;
    var after_emoji_zwj = false;
    var consonant = flags & 64 != 0;
    var linker = false;
    var index = first.end;
    while (index < text.len) {
        const current = codepoint(text, index);
        flags = properties(current.cp);
        const next: Gcb = @enumFromInt(flags & 31);
        const joined = if (previous == .cr and next == .lf) true else if (previous == .cr or previous == .lf or previous == .control or next == .cr or next == .lf or next == .control) false else if (previous == .l and (next == .l or next == .v or next == .lv or next == .lvt)) true else if ((previous == .lv or previous == .v) and (next == .v or next == .t)) true else if ((previous == .lvt or previous == .t) and next == .t) true else if (next == .extend or next == .zwj or next == .spacing or previous == .prepend) true else if (consonant and linker and flags & 64 != 0) true else if (after_emoji_zwj and flags & 32 != 0) true else if (previous == .ri and next == .ri and regional % 2 == 1) true else false;
        if (!joined) return index;
        if (next == .ri) regional += 1 else regional = 0;
        after_emoji_zwj = next == .zwj and pictographic;
        if (next != .extend) pictographic = flags & 32 != 0;
        if (flags & 64 != 0) {
            consonant = true;
            linker = false;
        } else if (flags & 128 != 0) {
            linker = linker or consonant;
        } else if (flags & 256 == 0) {
            consonant = false;
            linker = false;
        }
        previous = next;
        index = current.end;
    }
    return text.len;
}
fn mapping(comptime upper: bool, cp: u21) ?[]const u8 {
    const table = if (upper) &data.upper else &data.lower;
    var lo: usize = 0;
    var hi: usize = table.len;
    while (lo < hi) {
        const mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2;
        if (cp < table[mid].cp) hi = mid else if (cp > table[mid].cp) lo = mid + 1 else return table[mid].text;
    }
    return null;
}
pub fn changeCase(allocator: std.mem.Allocator, text: []const u8, upper: bool) ![]const u8 {
    var output = std.ArrayList(u8).init(allocator);
    var i: usize = 0;
    var before_cased = false;
    while (i < text.len) {
        const point = codepoint(text, i);
        const flags = properties(point.cp);
        if (!upper and point.cp == 0x3a3 and before_cased) {
            var next = point.end;
            var after_cased = false;
            while (next < text.len) {
                const p = codepoint(text, next);
                const f = properties(p.cp);
                if (f & 1024 == 0) {
                    after_cased = f & 512 != 0;
                    break;
                }
                next = p.end;
            }
            try output.appendSlice(if (after_cased) "σ" else "ς");
        } else if (if (upper) mapping(true, point.cp) else mapping(false, point.cp)) |mapped| {
            try output.appendSlice(mapped);
        } else try output.appendSlice(text[i..point.end]);
        if (flags & 1024 == 0) before_cased = flags & 512 != 0;
        i = point.end;
    }
    return output.toOwnedSlice();
}
test "extended grapheme clusters and Unicode case" {
    const sample = "ß↑e̊👩🏿‍🚀🇬🇧क्ष";
    var index: usize = 0;
    var count: usize = 0;
    while (index < sample.len) : (count += 1) index = graphemeEnd(sample, index);
    try std.testing.expectEqual(@as(usize, 6), count);
    const upper = try changeCase(std.testing.allocator, "Straße κόσμος", true);
    defer std.testing.allocator.free(upper);
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("STRASSE ΚΌΣΜΟΣ", upper);
    const lower = try changeCase(std.testing.allocator, "ΟΣ ΟΣΑ", false);
    defer std.testing.allocator.free(lower);
    try std.testing.expectEqualStrings("ος οσα", lower);
}

test "JavaScript string order uses UTF-16 units" {
    const ordered = [_][]const u8{ "", "a", "aa", "λ", "\u{10000}", "\u{10000}a", "\u{10001}", "😀", "\u{e000}", "\u{ffff}" };
    for (ordered, 0..) |left, i| {
        try std.testing.expectEqual(std.math.Order.eq, utf16Order(left, left));
        for (ordered[i + 1 ..]) |right| {
            try std.testing.expectEqual(std.math.Order.lt, utf16Order(left, right));
            try std.testing.expectEqual(std.math.Order.gt, utf16Order(right, left));
        }
    }
}

## `packages/zig_runtime/tests/benchmark.py`

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/tests/benchmark.py","sha256":"d47660368e59dde80170ffcc64225132cd0255f983449c254c7c6fd20c6d51e3","bytes":10825} -->
```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Measure native key dispatch + complete cell-frame rendering; gate at 10 ms.

Wall timings include event dispatch, complete cell-frame construction, and
reset of the reusable frame-output arena. They exclude terminal transport and
JSON encoding. Paired thread CPU samples are diagnostic; only wall time gates
the 10 ms target. Native and Gleam execute the same event traces in separate
process phases. Correctness remains a separate gate.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
import platform
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

from differential import PACKAGE, REPO, ORACLE_SHA, Peer, tui_scenarios


def summary(samples):
    if not samples:
        raise ValueError("benchmark produced no samples")
    ordered = sorted(samples)
    percentile = lambda p: ordered[min(len(ordered) - 1, math.ceil(len(ordered) * p) - 1)] / 1e6
    return {"samples": len(samples), "p50_ms": percentile(.5), "p95_ms": percentile(.95),
            "p99_ms": percentile(.99), "max_ms": ordered[-1] / 1e6,
            "mean_ms": sum(samples) / len(samples) / 1e6,
            "under_10ms": all(sample < 10_000_000 for sample in samples)}


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument("--binary", type=Path, default=PACKAGE / "zig-out/bin/eyg")
    p.add_argument("--bun", default=os.environ.get("BUN") or shutil.which("bun") or "/workspace/tooling/bin/bun")
    p.add_argument("--iterations", type=int, default=100)
    p.add_argument("--warmup", type=int, default=10)
    p.add_argument("--parity-report", type=Path, default=PACKAGE / "reports/differential.json")
    p.add_argument("--input-report", type=Path, default=PACKAGE / "reports/input.json")
    p.add_argument("--pty-report", type=Path, default=PACKAGE / "reports/pty.json")
    p.add_argument("--hub-report", type=Path, default=PACKAGE / "reports/pty-hub.json")
    p.add_argument("--report", type=Path, default=PACKAGE / "reports/benchmark.json")
    p.add_argument("--oracle", action="store_true", help="also time the Gleam oracle")
    args = p.parse_args()
    binary = args.binary.resolve()
    native = Peer([str(binary), "--protocol"], timeout=120)
    build_info = native.request({"op": "info"})
    oracle = None
    scenarios = tui_scenarios()
    history = []
    for i in range(30):
        history += [{"paste": f"!int_add({i}, 1)"}, {"key": "enter"}]
    history += [{"key": k} for k in ("up", "up", "k", "down", "K", "esc")]
    workloads = {
        "integer-input": scenarios["integer-input"],
        "unicode-input": scenarios["string-unicode"],
        "arithmetic": scenarios["arithmetic-paste"],
        "picker": scenarios["builtin-picker"],
        "history-30": history,
        "structural-navigation": [{"paste": "{x: [1, 2, 3], y: 42}"}] + [{"key": k} for k in ("right", "right", "left", "up", "down", "a", "k", "left", "right")],
        "nested-program-edit": [{"paste": 'let data = {count: 42, items: [1, 2, 3], name: "EYG"} let {count, items} = data !list_fold(items, count, (x, total) -> { !int_add(x, total) })'}]
            + [{"key": k} for k in ("right", "right", "down", "right", "a", "left", "right", "k", "i", "esc", "right", "g", "esc", "up", "left", "right", "enter")],
        "long-cjk-input": scenarios["long-cjk-input"],
        "binary-value": scenarios["binary-ir-aqid"],
    }
    parity = json.loads(args.parity_report.read_text()) if args.parity_report.exists() else None
    raw_input = json.loads(args.input_report.read_text()) if args.input_report.exists() else None
    pty = json.loads(args.pty_report.read_text()) if args.pty_report.exists() else None
    hub = json.loads(args.hub_report.read_text()) if args.hub_report.exists() else None
    binary_sha = hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    matches = lambda r: bool(r and r.get("oracle") == ORACLE_SHA and r.get("binary_sha256") == binary_sha)
    required = ("spec", "generated-program", "generated-external-effects", "syntax-fixture", "generated-syntax", "real-world-syntax", "diagnostic-fixture", "tui-scenario", "tui-world", "tui-hub", "generated-behaviour", "generated-program-edit")
    full_coverage = bool(parity and all(parity.get("counts", {}).get(category, {}).get("checked", 0) > 0 for category in required))
    gates = {"release_fast_build": build_info.get("mode") == "ReleaseFast" and build_info.get("zig") == "0.14.1" and build_info.get("oracle") == ORACLE_SHA,
             "same_binary_full_differential": bool(matches(parity) and parity.get("passed") and full_coverage),
             "same_binary_raw_input": bool(matches(raw_input) and raw_input.get("passed")),
             "same_binary_pty_parity_cleanup": bool(matches(pty) and pty.get("parity_passed") and pty.get("cleanup_passed")),
             "same_binary_pty_under_10ms": bool(matches(pty) and pty.get("key_to_frame", {}).get("under_10ms")),
             "same_binary_ready_hub_parity_cleanup": bool(matches(hub) and hub.get("parity_passed") and hub.get("cleanup_passed")),
             "same_binary_ready_hub_under_10ms": bool(matches(hub) and hub.get("key_to_frame", {}).get("under_10ms"))}
    report = {
        "oracle": ORACLE_SHA, "binary_sha256": binary_sha,
        "build_info": build_info,
        "binary_bytes": binary.stat().st_size,
        "machine": {"platform": platform.platform(), "machine": platform.machine(), "processor": platform.processor(), "cpu_count": os.cpu_count()},
        "measurement": "Monotonic wall time for native event dispatch, complete cell-frame construction, and reusable frame-output arena reset inside the timed interval; excludes JSON serialization, terminal transport, startup; sandboxed effects in Gleam.",
        "clocks": {"wall": "std.time.Timer monotonic elapsed nanoseconds; the only performance-gate clock",
                   "cpu": "CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID elapsed nanoseconds for the same event/frame/reset; diagnostic only, excludes descheduled time",
                   "difference": "wall_minus_cpu_ns is diagnostic and includes scheduling plus clock/read overhead; samples are neither replaced nor filtered"},
        "warmup_iterations": args.warmup, "iterations": args.iterations,
        "parity_passed": gates["same_binary_full_differential"] and gates["same_binary_raw_input"] and gates["same_binary_pty_parity_cleanup"] and gates["same_binary_ready_hub_parity_cleanup"],
        "correctness_gates": gates,
        "parity_report": str(args.parity_report), "workloads": {},
        "measurement_phase_order": ["native", "gleam"] if args.oracle else ["native"],
        "process_isolation": "Complete all native workloads and close native before spawning the Gleam oracle; handshake oracle imports before its warmup. Preserve all samples and outliers.",
    }
    try:
        for name, events in workloads.items():
            request = {"op": "bench_tui", "width": 80, "height": 24, "events": events}
            native.request({**request, "iterations": args.warmup})
            got = native.request({**request, "iterations": args.iterations})
            wall_samples, cpu_samples = got.get("samples_ns"), got.get("cpu_samples_ns")
            count = args.iterations * len(events)
            if not isinstance(wall_samples, list) or not isinstance(cpu_samples, list) or len(wall_samples) != count or len(cpu_samples) != count:
                raise RuntimeError(f"native benchmark {name} requires {count} paired wall/CPU samples; got wall={len(wall_samples) if isinstance(wall_samples, list) else None}, cpu={len(cpu_samples) if isinstance(cpu_samples, list) else None}")
            if any(type(ns) is not int or ns < 0 for ns in [*wall_samples, *cpu_samples]):
                raise RuntimeError(f"native benchmark {name} contains invalid nanosecond samples")
            cpu_summary = {key: value for key, value in summary(cpu_samples).items() if key != "under_10ms"}
            result = {"native": summary(wall_samples), "native_cpu": cpu_summary,
                      "events_per_iteration": len(events), "events": events,
                      "samples_ns": wall_samples, "cpu_samples_ns": cpu_samples,
                      "outliers": [{"iteration": i // len(events), "event_index": i % len(events),
                                    "event": events[i % len(events)], "ns": ns,
                                    "cpu_ns": cpu_samples[i], "wall_minus_cpu_ns": ns - cpu_samples[i]}
                                   for i, ns in enumerate(wall_samples) if ns >= 10_000_000]}
            report["workloads"][name] = result
            print("native", name, json.dumps({k: v for k, v in result.items() if k not in ("events", "samples_ns", "cpu_samples_ns")}), flush=True)
        # Importing the large compiled Gleam module graph and its later GC must
        # not overlap the native measurements. Keep the same workload requests
        # and complete the second phase only after the native child has exited.
        native.close()
        native = None
        if args.oracle:
            oracle = Peer([args.bun, str(PACKAGE / "tests/oracle.mjs")], timeout=120)
            ready = oracle.request({"op": "parse", "source": "42"})
            if ready != {"program": {"0": "i", "v": 42}}:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Gleam oracle handshake failed: {ready}")
            for name, events in workloads.items():
                request = {"op": "bench_tui", "width": 80, "height": 24, "events": events}
                oracle.request({**request, "iterations": args.warmup})
                expected = oracle.request({**request, "iterations": args.iterations})
                if "samples_ns" not in expected:
                    raise RuntimeError(f"Gleam benchmark failed: {expected}")
                result = report["workloads"][name]
                result["gleam"] = summary(expected["samples_ns"])
                result["gleam_samples_ns"] = expected["samples_ns"]
                result["median_speedup"] = result["gleam"]["p50_ms"] / max(result["native"]["p50_ms"], 1e-9)
                print("gleam", name, json.dumps({"gleam": result["gleam"], "median_speedup": result["median_speedup"]}), flush=True)
        report["performance_passed"] = all(w["native"]["under_10ms"] for w in report["workloads"].values())
        report["passed"] = report["performance_passed"] and report["parity_passed"] and gates["release_fast_build"] and gates["same_binary_pty_under_10ms"] and gates["same_binary_ready_hub_under_10ms"]
    finally:
        if native:
            native.close()
        if oracle:
            oracle.close()
        args.report.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        args.report.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
    return 0 if report.get("passed") else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

// Thin calls into the pinned implementation's pure computer-effect contracts.
import {createInterface} from 'node:readline';
import {fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL} from 'node:url';
import {resolve, dirname} from 'node:path';
import {encodeValue, encodeBreak} from './oracle.mjs';

const root = resolve(process.env.EYG_ORACLE_ROOT || resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../../../work/oracle-next-tui'));
const build = resolve(root, 'packages/gleam_cli/build/dev/javascript');
const load = path => import(pathToFileURL(resolve(build, path)).href);
const [runtime, values, dict, source, eygParse, json, sign, computer, eddsa, gleamJson, irCodec, expression, breaks, system] = await Promise.all([
  'eyg_cli/gleam.mjs', 'eyg_interpreter/eyg/interpreter/value.mjs',
  'gleam_stdlib/gleam/dict.mjs', 'loam/loam/source.mjs',
  'touch_grass/touch_grass/eyg_parse.mjs', 'touch_grass/touch_grass/decode_json.mjs',
  'touch_grass/touch_grass/cryptography/sign.mjs', 'loam/loam/platform/computer.mjs',
  'kryptos/kryptos/eddsa.mjs',
  'gleam_json/gleam/json.mjs', 'eyg_ir/eyg/ir/dag_json.mjs',
  'eyg_interpreter/eyg/interpreter/expression.mjs', 'eyg_interpreter/eyg/interpreter/break.mjs',
  'loam/loam/system.mjs',
].map(load));

function decode(v) {
  if ('integer' in v) return new values.Integer(v.integer);
  if ('string' in v) return new values.String(v.string);
  if ('binary' in v) return new values.Binary(runtime.toBitArray([Uint8Array.from(Buffer.from(v.binary['/'].bytes, 'base64'))]));
  if ('record' in v) return new values.Record(dict.from_list(runtime.toList(Object.entries(v.record).map(([k, v]) => [k, decode(v)]))));
  if ('tagged' in v) return new values.Tagged(v.tagged.label, decode(v.tagged.value));
  if ('list' in v) return new values.LinkedList(runtime.toList(v.list.map(decode)));
  throw new Error('not a data fixture');
}

async function handle(request) {
  if (request.program) {
    const decoded = gleamJson.parse(JSON.stringify(request.program), irCodec.decoder(null));
    if (decoded.constructor.name !== 'Ok') return {decode_error: true};
    let result = expression.execute(decoded[0], runtime.toList([]));
    for (let budget = 1000; budget > 0; --budget) {
      if (result.constructor.name === 'Ok') return {value: encodeValue(result[0])};
      const reason = result[0][0];
      if (!(reason instanceof breaks.UnhandledEffect)) return {break: encodeBreak(reason)};
      const cast = computer.cast(reason.label, reason.value);
      if (cast.constructor.name === 'Error') return {break: encodeBreak(cast[0])};
      const reply = await system.run(computer.extrinsic(cast[0], source.Origin$Inline$const));
      result = expression.resume(reply, result[0][2], result[0][3]);
    }
    throw new Error('pure-effect program exhausted its effect budget');
  }
  const lift = decode(request.lift);
  if (request.label !== 'derive-public-key') {
    const cast = computer.cast(request.label, lift);
    if (cast.constructor.name === 'Error') return {break: encodeBreak(cast[0])};
    if (request.cast_only) return {valid: true};
  }
  if (request.label === 'DecodeJSON') return {value: encodeValue(json.sync(lift.value))};
  if (request.label === 'EYGParse') return {value: encodeValue(eygParse.encode(source.parse(lift.value, source.Origin$Inline$const)))};
  if (request.label === 'Sign') {
    const cast = sign.decode(lift);
    if (cast.constructor.name === 'Error') return {break: encodeBreak(cast[0])};
    return {value: encodeValue(sign.encode(computer.sign(cast[0])))};
  }
  if (request.label === 'derive-public-key') {
    const imported = eddsa.from_bytes(eddsa.Curve$Ed25519$const, lift.value);
    if (imported.constructor.name === 'Error') throw new Error('oracle rejected generated private key');
    return encodeValue(new values.Binary(eddsa.public_key_to_bytes(imported[0][1])));
  }
  throw new Error(`unknown pure effect ${request.label}`);
}

for await (const line of createInterface({input: process.stdin, crlfDelay: Infinity})) {
  try { process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(await handle(JSON.parse(line))) + '\n'); }
  catch (error) { process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({adapter_error: String(error)}) + '\n'); }
}
```

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/tests/computer_runner.zig","sha256":"42ab16b9da57c26ce763d1f7ca10ded91ee08120462b0152a192e96be8f59b6c","bytes":1950} -->
```zig
//! Direct pure-effect transport, independent of the terminal integration.
const std = @import("std");
const computer = @import("computer");
const runtime = computer.runtime;
const J = std.json.Value;

pub fn main() !void {
    var input = std.io.bufferedReader(std.io.getStdIn().reader());
    const writer = std.io.getStdOut().writer();
    while (true) {
        var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.heap.page_allocator);
        defer arena.deinit();
        const a = arena.allocator();
        const line = try input.reader().readUntilDelimiterOrEofAlloc(a, '\n', 16 * 1024 * 1024) orelse break;
        const request = (try std.json.parseFromSlice(J, a, line, .{ .allocate = .alloc_always })).value;
        var engine = runtime.Engine.init(a);
        if (runtime.field(request, "program") != .null) {
            engine.effect_handler = hostEffect;
            const response = try engine.evaluate(runtime.field(request, "program"));
            try std.json.stringify(response, .{}, writer);
            try writer.writeByte('\n');
            continue;
        }
        const lift = try engine.fromJson(runtime.field(request, "lift"));
        const value = computer.effect(&engine, runtime.stringField(request, "label") orelse "", lift) catch |err| {
            const response = if (err == error.Runtime) try runtime.object(a, &.{.{ "break", try engine.reasonJson(engine.failure.?) }}) else try runtime.object(a, &.{.{ "host_error", .{ .string = @errorName(err) } }});
            try std.json.stringify(response, .{}, writer);
            try writer.writeByte('\n');
            continue;
        };
        try std.json.stringify(try runtime.object(a, &.{.{ "value", try engine.toJson(value) }}), .{}, writer);
        try writer.writeByte('\n');
    }
}
fn hostEffect(_: ?*anyopaque, engine: *runtime.Engine, label: []const u8, lift: runtime.Value) anyerror!runtime.Value {
    return computer.effect(engine, label, lift);
}
```

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Deterministic differential checks against the pinned next-tui implementation.

Run from any directory; build first. A mismatch is a failing test, never an
expected failure. Reproducers retain the seed, original request, and a smaller
request. No renderer output is normalized away.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import base64
from collections import Counter
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import random
import select
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time

PACKAGE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
REPO = PACKAGE.parents[1]
ORACLE = Path(os.environ.get("EYG_ORACLE_ROOT", REPO / "work/oracle-next-tui")).resolve()
ORACLE_SHA = "be502aa03df926a8f9df474a0a7fe16c8fb14fbd"
UNICODE = ["", "abc", "a\nb\t\"", "λ", "é", "e\u0301", "👩‍💻", "\u2028", "Straße", "İ",
           "\r\n", "각", "🇬🇧🇳🇿", "👩🏽‍💻", "क्‍ष", "क्\u0937", "ΟΣ", "ΟΣΑ", "Σ'", "ß"]


class Peer:
    def __init__(self, command: list[str], timeout: float = 30):
        self.command, self.timeout = command, timeout
        self.process = subprocess.Popen(command, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                                        stderr=subprocess.PIPE, bufsize=0, cwd=REPO)
        self.stderr_tail = bytearray()

    def request(self, payload):
        encoded = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode() + b"\n"
        self.process.stdin.write(encoded)
        self.process.stdin.flush()
        # Use raw os.read rather than buffered readline: large frame responses
        # otherwise can hide bytes from select and cause a false timeout.
        deadline, response = time.monotonic() + self.timeout, bytearray()
        stderr_open = True
        while True:
            remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
            if remaining <= 0:
                raise TimeoutError(f"{self.command[0]} did not answer within {self.timeout}s")
            watched = [self.process.stdout] + ([self.process.stderr] if stderr_open else [])
            ready, _, _ = select.select(watched, [], [], remaining)
            if not ready:
                raise TimeoutError(f"{self.command[0]} did not answer within {self.timeout}s")
            if self.process.stderr in ready:
                chunk = os.read(self.process.stderr.fileno(), 65536)
                stderr_open = bool(chunk)
                self.stderr_tail.extend(chunk)
                del self.stderr_tail[:-65536]
            if self.process.stdout in ready:
                chunk = os.read(self.process.stdout.fileno(), 65536)
                if not chunk:
                    raise RuntimeError(f"{self.command[0]} exited {self.process.poll()}: "
                                       + self.stderr_tail.decode(errors="replace")[-2000:])
                response.extend(chunk)
                if response.endswith(b"\n"):
                    return json.loads(response)

    def close(self):
        if self.process.poll() is None:
            try:
                self.process.stdin.close()
                self.process.wait(timeout=.25)
            except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, BrokenPipeError):
                self.process.terminate()
                try:
                    self.process.wait(timeout=1)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    self.process.kill()
                    self.process.wait(timeout=1)
        for stream in (self.process.stdin, self.process.stdout, self.process.stderr):
            if stream and not stream.closed:
                stream.close()

    def restart(self):
        self.close()
        self.__init__(self.command, self.timeout)


def node(tag, **fields):
    return {"0": tag, **fields}


def call(function, *arguments):
    for argument in arguments:
        function = node("a", f=function, a=argument)
    return function


def builtin(name, *arguments):
    return call(node("b", l=name), *arguments)


def returned_resumption_program():
    return call(node("h", l="Ping"),
                node("f", l="x", b=node("f", l="resume", b=node("v", l="resume"))),
                node("f", l="_", b=call(node("p", l="Ping"), node("i", v=1))))


def unicode_record_program():
    value = node("u")
    for label, number in (("\ue000", 1), ("𐀀", 2), ("😀", 3), ("λ", 4)):
        value = call(node("e", l=label), node("i", v=number), value)
    return value


def literal_fixture(rng, depth=2):
    """Produce the same arbitrary value as both canonical IR and fixture JSON."""
    kind = rng.choice(("int", "string", "binary", "list", "record", "tagged") if depth else ("int", "string", "binary"))
    if kind == "int":
        value = rng.randrange(-1000, 1000)
        return node("i", v=value), {"integer": value}
    if kind == "string":
        value = rng.choice(UNICODE)
        return node("s", v=value), {"string": value}
    if kind == "binary":
        data = bytes(rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(rng.randrange(16)))
        encoded = {"/": {"bytes": base64.b64encode(data).decode().rstrip("=")}}
        return node("x", v=encoded), {"binary": encoded}
    if kind == "tagged":
        label = rng.choice(("Some", "X", "Nested", "Ok"))
        inner, value = literal_fixture(rng, depth - 1)
        return call(node("t", l=label), inner), {"tagged": {"label": label, "value": value}}
    if kind == "list":
        result, values = node("ta"), []
        for _ in range(rng.randrange(5)):
            inner, value = literal_fixture(rng, depth - 1)
            result = call(node("c"), inner, result)
            values.insert(0, value)
        return result, {"list": values}
    result, values = node("u"), {}
    for key in rng.sample(("a", "z", "Aa", "BB", "value", "\ue000", "𐀀", "😀", "λ"), rng.randrange(5)):
        inner, value = literal_fixture(rng, depth - 1)
        result = call(node("e", l=key), inner, result)
        values[key] = value
    return result, {"record": values}


def generated_program(rng, depth=4, kind=None, scope=()):
    """A bounded, typed grammar plus intentional well-formed runtime errors.

    Random trees cover lexical binding, closure capture, records, unions, lists,
    strings, integer edges and handled effects, without relying on Zig parsing.
    The bounded grammar excludes diverging recursion. Recursion has spec cases.
    """
    kind = kind or rng.choice(("int", "string", "list", "record", "union", "error", "effect", "builtin", "match", "reference", "fix"))
    if depth <= 0:
        if kind == "int":
            return rng.choice([node("i", v=rng.randint(-1000, 1000)), node("v", l=rng.choice(scope))]) if scope else node("i", v=rng.choice([-9007199254740991, -1, 0, 1, 9007199254740991]))
        if kind == "string":
            return node("s", v=rng.choice(UNICODE))
        if kind == "list":
            return node("ta")
        if kind == "record":
            return node("u")
        if kind == "union":
            return call(node("t", l="Some"), node("u"))
        if kind == "error":
            return rng.choice([node("v", l="missing"), node("b", l="missing"), node("z")])
        return call(node("p", l="Probe"), node("i", v=1))
    descend = lambda k=kind: generated_program(rng, depth - 1, k, scope)
    if kind == "int":
        choice = rng.randrange(7)
        if choice == 0:
            return node("i", v=rng.randint(-10000, 10000))
        if choice == 1:
            label = f"x{depth}"
            return node("l", l=label, v=descend(), t=generated_program(rng, depth - 1, "int", scope + (label,)))
        if choice == 2:
            return call(node("f", l="n", b=builtin("int_add", node("v", l="n"), node("i", v=3))), descend())
        if choice == 3:
            return call(node("g", l="answer"), call(node("e", l="answer"), descend(), node("u")))
        if choice == 4:
            return builtin("int_absolute", descend())
        return builtin(rng.choice(("int_add", "int_subtract", "int_multiply")), descend(), descend())
    if kind == "string":
        if rng.randrange(3) == 0:
            return builtin(rng.choice(("string_uppercase", "string_lowercase")), descend())
        if rng.randrange(2) == 0:
            return builtin("string_append", descend(), descend())
        return builtin("int_to_string", descend("int"))
    if kind == "list":
        result = node("ta")
        for _ in range(rng.randrange(5)):
            result = call(node("c"), descend(rng.choice(("int", "string"))), result)
        return result
    if kind == "record":
        result = node("u")
        for key in rng.sample(("x", "y", "name", "a", "z"), rng.randrange(5)):
            result = call(node("e", l=key), descend(rng.choice(("int", "string", "list"))), result)
        return result
    if kind == "union":
        return builtin(rng.choice(("equal", "int_compare", "int_divide")), descend("int"), descend("int"))
    if kind == "effect":
        # A deep handler resumes once, with a transformed argument. Both the
        # handler function and suspended continuation are exercised.
        function = node("f", l="_", b=builtin("int_add", call(node("p", l="Probe"), node("i", v=rng.randrange(9))), node("i", v=2)))
        handler = node("f", l="x", b=node("f", l="resume", b=call(node("v", l="resume"), builtin("int_add", node("v", l="x"), node("i", v=1)))))
        return call(node("h", l="Probe"), handler, function)
    if kind == "builtin":
        name = rng.choice(("int_parse", "string_split", "string_split_once", "string_replace", "string_length",
                           "string_starts_with", "string_ends_with", "string_to_binary", "string_from_binary",
                           "binary_from_integers", "binary_concat", "binary_compare", "binary_size", "binary_fold", "list_fold", "list_pop"))
        string = lambda: node("s", v=rng.choice(UNICODE))
        binary = lambda: builtin("string_to_binary", string())
        if name == "int_parse":
            return builtin(name, node("s", v=rng.choice(["", "x", "42", "-0004", "+1", "12.0", "9007199254740992", " 12", "12 "])))
        if name in ("string_split", "string_split_once", "string_starts_with", "string_ends_with"):
            return builtin(name, string(), string())
        if name == "string_replace":
            return builtin(name, string(), string(), string())
        if name in ("string_length", "string_to_binary"):
            return builtin(name, string())
        if name in ("string_from_binary", "binary_size"):
            return builtin(name, binary())
        if name in ("binary_concat", "binary_compare"):
            return builtin(name, binary(), binary())
        if name in ("list_fold", "binary_fold"):
            collection = descend("list") if name == "list_fold" else binary()
            return builtin(name, collection, node("i", v=0), node("f", l="el", b=node("f", l="acc", b=builtin("int_add", node("v", l="el"), node("v", l="acc")))))
        if name == "list_pop":
            return builtin(name, descend("list"))
        collection = node("ta")
        for _ in range(rng.randrange(8)):
            collection = call(node("c"), node("i", v=rng.randrange(-300, 1000)), collection)
        return builtin(name, collection)
    if kind == "match":
        label = rng.choice(("Some", "Other"))
        tagged = call(node("t", l=label), descend("int"))
        branch = node("f", l="x", b=builtin("int_add", node("v", l="x"), node("i", v=1)))
        return call(node("m", l="Some"), branch, node("n"), tagged)
    if kind == "reference":
        return rng.choice([node(".", i="./module.eyg"), node("@", p="standard"), node("@", p="demo", r=rng.randrange(1, 20)),
                           node("#", l={"/": "baguqeera2rxu3p44bxjutnjlpeffcmkgdmh5mmyeqgpatyaae6ezybzg4azq"})])
    if kind == "fix":
        recurse = call(node("v", l="self"), builtin("int_subtract", node("v", l="n"), node("i", v=1)))
        branch = node("f", l="_", b=node("i", v=0))
        otherwise = node("f", l="_", b=builtin("int_add", node("v", l="n"), recurse))
        body = call(node("m", l="Eq"), branch, otherwise, builtin("int_compare", node("v", l="n"), node("i", v=0)))
        return call(builtin("fix", node("f", l="self", b=node("f", l="n", b=body))), node("i", v=rng.randrange(30)))
    choice = rng.randrange(5)
    if choice == 0:
        return call(node("i", v=7), descend("int"))
    if choice == 1:
        return builtin("int_add", descend("string"), descend("int"))
    if choice == 2:
        return call(node("g", l="absent"), descend("record"))
    if choice == 3:
        return builtin("int_add", node("i", v=9007199254740991), node("i", v=1))
    return descend("error")


def generated_source(rng, depth=3):
    if depth <= 0:
        return rng.choice((str(rng.randint(-1000, 1000)), json.dumps(rng.choice(("", "hi", "λ", "a\nb", "\"\\")), ensure_ascii=False), "{}", "[]", "todo"))
    expr = lambda: generated_source(rng, depth - 1)
    choice = rng.randrange(10)
    if choice == 0:
        return f"let x = {expr()} x"
    if choice == 1:
        return f"(x, y) -> {{ {expr()} }}"
    if choice == 2:
        return f"!int_add({expr()}, {expr()})"
    if choice == 3:
        return f"{{foo: {expr()}, bar: {expr()}}}"
    if choice == 4:
        return f"[{expr()}, {expr()}]"
    if choice == 5:
        return f"Some({expr()})"
    if choice == 6:
        return f"match Some({expr()}) {{ Some(x) -> {{ x }} | (_) -> {{ {expr()} }} }}"
    if choice == 7:
        return f"perform StandardOut({expr()})"
    if choice == 8:
        return f"((x) -> {{ x }})({expr()})"
    return f"{{foo: {expr()}}}.foo"


def generated_edit_source(rng, depth=3, kind=None):
    """Closed, type-consistent programs give navigation a substantial AST."""
    kind = kind or rng.choice(("int", "string", "record", "list", "function"))
    if depth <= 0:
        if kind == "string":
            return json.dumps(rng.choice(("hello", "λ", "界", "a\nb", "é")), ensure_ascii=False)
        return str(rng.randrange(-100, 100))
    integer = lambda: generated_edit_source(rng, depth - 1, "int")
    string = lambda: generated_edit_source(rng, depth - 1, "string")
    if kind == "int":
        choice = rng.randrange(8)
        if choice == 0:
            return f"!int_add({integer()}, {integer()})"
        if choice == 1:
            return f"((x) -> {{ !int_add(x, {rng.randrange(10)}) }})({integer()})"
        if choice == 2:
            return f"let x = {integer()} !int_multiply(x, 2)"
        if choice == 3:
            return f"{{answer: {integer()}, name: {string()}}}.answer"
        if choice == 4:
            return f"match Some({integer()}) {{ Some(x) -> {{ x }} | (_) -> {{ 0 }} }}"
        if choice == 6:
            return f"let {{x, y: z}} = {{x: {integer()}, y: {integer()}}} !int_add(x, z)"
        if choice == 7:
            return f"(({{x, y: z}}) -> {{ !int_add(x, z) }})({{x: {integer()}, y: {integer()}}})"
        return f"!list_fold([{integer()}, {integer()}], 0, (x, acc) -> {{ !int_add(x, acc) }})"
    if kind == "string":
        return f"!string_append({string()}, {string()})" if rng.randrange(2) else f"!int_to_string({integer()})"
    if kind == "record":
        return f"{{count: {integer()}, name: {string()}, items: [{integer()}, {integer()}]}}"
    if kind == "list":
        return f"[{integer()}, {integer()}, {integer()}]"
    return f"(x) -> {{ !int_add(x, {integer()}) }}"


def generated_program_edit_trace(rng, length):
    navigation = ("left", "right", "right", "right", "up", "down", "a", " ", "k")
    editing = ("i", "o", "x", "<", ">", "c", "C", "g", "e", "E", "f", "l", "r", "m", "d", "z", "Z")
    events = []
    for _ in range(length):
        choice = rng.randrange(10)
        if choice < 6:
            events.append({"key": rng.choice(navigation)})
        elif choice < 9:
            events.append({"key": rng.choice(editing)})
        else:
            events.append(rng.choice([{"key": "enter"}, {"key": "esc"}, {"key": "tab"}, {"paste": "field"}, {"paste": "7"}]))
    return events


SYNTAX_CASES = [
    "42", "-42", '"hello\\nworld"', "todo", "let x = 1 x", "let x = 1 let x = 2 x",
    "(x, y) -> { !int_add(x, y) }", "let {x, y: z} = {x: 1, y: 2} z",
    "({name, age: n}) -> { name }", "{}", "{x: 1, y: 2}", "{x: 1}.x", "[1, 2, 3]",
    "Some(42)", "match Some(1) { Some(x) -> { x } | (_) -> { 0 } }",
    "perform StandardOut(\"hello\")", "let module = import \"./foo.eyg\" module.x",
    "@standard", "@standard:1", "// hi\nlet x = 1 // comment\nx",
    "!fix((self, n) -> { match !int_compare(n, 0) { Eq(_) -> { 1 } | (_) -> { !int_multiply(n, self(!int_subtract(n, 1))) } } })(5)",
]

DIAGNOSTIC_CASES = ["let x 1", "let x =", "(x) { x }", "(x) -> { x", "perform x", "!", "#bad", "@foo:nope",
                    "import 1", "import", "1 2", "§", '"unterminated', '"bad\\q"', "9007199254740992",
                    "let x = 1\nlet y 2", "let λ = 1", "match X(1) { X(x) { x } }", "{x:", "[1, 2",
                    "@", "#", "(x) -> { let y 2 }", '"λ\\q"', "// hi\nlet x 1"]


def tui_scenarios():
    key = lambda x: {"key": x}
    record = "{x: 1, y: 2}"
    match = "match Some(1) { Some(x) -> { x } | (_) -> { 0 } }"
    binary = lambda encoded: [{"paste": json.dumps({"0": "x", "v": {"/": {"bytes": encoded}}})}, key("enter")]
    field_edit = lambda side: [{"paste": record}, key("right"), key(side), {"paste": "added"}, key("enter"), key("n"), {"paste": "9"}, key("enter"), key("a"), key("enter")]
    branch_edit = lambda side: [{"paste": match}, key("right"), key("right"), key("right"), key(side), {"paste": "Other"}, key("enter"), key("esc"), key("a")]
    long_input = lambda text: [key("s"), {"paste": text}, key("home"), key("right"), key("end"), key("enter"), key("enter")]
    return {
        "empty": [],
        "integer-input": list(map(key, ("n", "1", "2", "backspace", "3", "left", "4", "enter", "enter"))),
        "invalid-integer": list(map(key, ("n", "backspace", "-", "enter", "esc"))),
        "string-unicode": [key("s"), {"paste": "hello λ👩‍💻é\nworld"}, key("enter"), key("enter")],
        "arithmetic-paste": [{"paste": "!int_add(20, 22)"}, key("enter")],
        "history-source-lifetime": [{"paste": "!int_add(20, 22)"}, key("enter"), key("s"), {"paste": "hello λé"}, key("enter"), key("enter")],
        "multiline-history": [{"paste": "let x = 1 let y = 2 !int_add(x, y)"}, key("enter"), key("up"), key("k"), key("K"), key("k"), key("esc")],
        "expanded-effect-history": [{"paste": 'let _ = perform StandardOut("hello") let _ = perform Sleep(1) 42'}, key("enter"), key("up"), key("K"), key("k"), key("K"), key("esc")],
        "scope-history": [{"paste": "let x = 42 x"}, key("enter"), {"paste": "x"}, key("enter"), key("up"), key("up"), key("down"), key("enter")],
        "history-recall": [{"paste": "[1, 2, 3]"}, key("enter"), key("up"), key("enter"), key("esc")],
        "builtin-picker": list(map(key, ("j", "i", "n", "t", "_", "a", "down", "up", "tab", "enter"))),
        "record-list": list(map(key, ("R", "r", "x", "enter", "n", "3", "enter", "esc", "L"))),
        "function-edit": list(map(key, ("f", "x", "enter", "n", "5", "enter", "a", "left", "right", "up", "down"))),
        "delete-undo": [{"paste": "{x: 1, y: [2, 3]}"}, *map(key, ("right", "d", "u", "ctrl+z", "ctrl+y"))],
        "standard-input": [{"paste": "perform StandardIn({})"}, key("enter"), {"paste": "hello"}, key("enter")],
        "standard-input-cancel": [{"paste": "perform StandardIn({})"}, key("enter"), key("esc")],
        "resize": [{"resize": [20, 5]}, key("n"), {"resize": [120, 40]}, key("esc"), {"resize": [1, 1]}, {"resize": [80, 24]}],
        "invalid-paste": [{"paste": "this is not valid eyg !!"}, key("enter"), key("esc")],
        "unknown-keys": list(map(key, ("?", "ctrl+x", "home", "end", "pageup", "esc"))),
        "binary-ir-aqid": binary("AQID"),
        "binary-ir-ascii-padded": binary("aGVsbG8="),
        "binary-ir-unicode": binary(base64.b64encode("λ界".encode()).decode()),
        "destructured-let": [{"paste": "let {x, y: z} = {x: 20, y: 22} !int_add(x, z)"}, key("right"), key("down"), key("a"), key("enter"), {"paste": "!int_add(x, z)"}, key("enter")],
        "destructured-lambda": [{"paste": "({x}) -> { x }"}, key("right"), key("right"), key("left"), key("a")],
        "destructured-lambda-run": [{"paste": "(({x, y: z}) -> { !int_add(x, z) })({x: 20, y: 22})"}, key("enter")],
        "whole-record-lambda": [{"paste": "(r) -> { let x = r.x r }"}, key("right"), key("right"), key("a")],
        "selector-let-pattern": [{"paste": "let value = {x: 20, y: 22} let x = value.x let z = value.y !int_add(x, z)"}, key("enter")],
        "empty-destructure": [{"paste": "let {} = {x: 1} 42"}, key("enter"), {"paste": "({}) -> { 42 }"}, key("right")],
        "field-before": field_edit("<"),
        "field-after": field_edit(">"),
        "branch-before": branch_edit("<"),
        "branch-after": branch_edit(">"),
        "long-ascii-input": long_input("x" * 300),
        "long-cjk-input": long_input("界" * 150),
        "long-combining-input": long_input("é" * 300),
        "input-cell-boundary-overshoot": long_input("x" * 255 + "界Z"),
        "wide-cursor-input-edit": [key("s"), {"paste": "界x"}, key("left"), key("left"), key("z"), key("w"), key("backspace"), key("enter"), key("enter")],
        "returned-resumption": [{"paste": json.dumps(returned_resumption_program())}, key("enter")],
        "unicode-record-key-order": [{"paste": json.dumps(unicode_record_program(), ensure_ascii=False)}, key("enter")],
        "primitive-select": [{"paste": json.dumps(node("g", l="answer"))}, key("right"), key("left"), key("enter")],
        "primitive-select-apply": [{"paste": json.dumps(call(node("g", l="answer"), call(node("e", l="answer"), node("i", v=42), node("u"))))}, key("enter")],
        "primitive-partial-case": [{"paste": json.dumps(call(node("m", l="Some"), node("f", l="x", b=node("v", l="x"))))}, key("right"), key("left"), key("enter")],
        "primitive-case-apply": [{"paste": json.dumps(call(node("m", l="Some"), node("f", l="x", b=node("v", l="x")), node("n"), call(node("t", l="Some"), node("i", v=42))))}, key("enter")],
        "primitive-bare-case": [{"paste": json.dumps(node("m", l="Some"))}, key("enter")],
        "primitive-bare-no-cases": [{"paste": json.dumps(node("n"))}, key("enter")],
        "multiline-first-call-argument": [{"paste": "f(match Some(1) { Some(x) -> { x } | (_) -> { 0 } }, 2)"}, key("right"), key("right")],
        "multiline-final-call-argument": [{"paste": "f(2, match Some(1) { Some(x) -> { x } | (_) -> { 0 } })"}, key("right"), key("right")],
        "multiline-match-subject": [{"paste": "match (match Some(1) { Some(x) -> { Some(x) } | (_) -> { Some(0) } }) { Some(x) -> { x } | (_) -> { 0 } }"}, key("right")],
    }


def generated_trace(rng, length=25):
    keys = ["n", "s", "j", "f", "r", "R", "l", "L", "i", "e", "E", "w", "g", "t", "p", "h", "o", "d", "a", "k",
            "q", "@", "#", "z", "Z", "x", "c", "C", "b", "m", "v", "<", ">", "y", "Y", "K",
            "left", "right", "up", "down", "enter", "esc", "tab", "backspace", "delete", "home", "end", "ctrl+a", "ctrl+e", "ctrl+k", "ctrl+u", "?", "1", "x", "_", " "]
    events = []
    for _ in range(length):
        n = rng.randrange(20)
        if n == 0:
            events.append({"resize": [rng.choice([1, 20, 40, 80, 100, 120]), rng.choice([1, 3, 5, 10, 24, 40])]})
        elif n < 4:
            events.append({"paste": rng.choice(["42", '!int_add(20, 22)', '"hello λ"', "let x = 2 x", "[1, 2, 3]", "{x: 1, y: 2}", "todo", "invalid!!", "👩‍💻é"])})
        else:
            events.append({"key": rng.choice(keys)})
    return events


def first_difference(expected, got, path="$"):
    # JSON has one Number type. Decimal and exponent spellings round to the
    # same IEEE-754 value in the JavaScript oracle; Python's parser happens to
    # distinguish int and float tokens. Booleans remain a separate JSON type.
    numbers = (int, float)
    if isinstance(expected, numbers) and not isinstance(expected, bool) and isinstance(got, numbers) and not isinstance(got, bool):
        try:
            if float(expected) == float(got):
                return None
        except OverflowError:
            pass
        return {"path": path, "expected": expected, "got": got}
    if type(expected) is not type(got):
        return {"path": path, "expected": expected, "got": got}
    if isinstance(expected, dict):
        if expected.keys() != got.keys():
            return {"path": path, "expected_keys": sorted(expected), "got_keys": sorted(got)}
        for key in expected:
            difference = first_difference(expected[key], got[key], f"{path}.{key}")
            if difference:
                return difference
    elif isinstance(expected, list):
        if len(expected) != len(got):
            return {"path": path, "expected_length": len(expected), "got_length": len(got)}
        for i, (e, g) in enumerate(zip(expected, got)):
            difference = first_difference(e, g, f"{path}[{i}]")
            if difference:
                return difference
    elif expected != got:
        return {"path": path, "expected": expected, "got": got}
    return None


def same(expected, got):
    return first_difference(expected, got) is None


def shrink_program(program, fails):
    """Greedy tree/constant shrinking; every candidate is rerun in both engines."""
    current = program
    for _ in range(50):
        candidates = [node("i", v=0), node("u"), node("ta")]
        if isinstance(current, dict):
            candidates += [v for v in current.values() if isinstance(v, dict) and "0" in v]
            for key, child in current.items():
                if isinstance(child, dict) and "0" in child:
                    candidates.append({**current, key: node("i", v=0)})
        smaller = [c for c in candidates if len(json.dumps(c)) < len(json.dumps(current))]
        replacement = next((c for c in smaller if fails(c)), None)
        if replacement is None:
            break
        current = replacement
    return current


def shrink_events(events, fails):
    """Delta debugging removes chunks while retaining an observed mismatch."""
    current, granularity = list(events), 2
    if fails([]):
        return []
    while current:
        size = max(1, (len(current) + granularity - 1) // granularity)
        for start in range(0, len(current), size):
            candidate = current[:start] + current[start + size:]
            if fails(candidate):
                current, granularity = candidate, max(2, granularity - 1)
                break
        else:
            if granularity >= len(current):
                break
            granularity = min(len(current), granularity * 2)
    return current


def main():
    args = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    args.add_argument("--binary", type=Path, default=PACKAGE / "zig-out/bin/eyg")
    args.add_argument("--bun", default=os.environ.get("BUN") or shutil.which("bun") or "/workspace/tooling/bin/bun")
    args.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=20261028)
    args.add_argument("--programs", type=int, default=1000)
    args.add_argument("--syntax", type=int, default=200)
    args.add_argument("--traces", type=int, default=100)
    args.add_argument("--trace-length", type=int, default=25)
    args.add_argument("--edit-traces", type=int, help="nested-program editing traces; defaults to --traces")
    args.add_argument("--edit-length", type=int, default=20)
    args.add_argument("--only", choices=("eval", "parse", "tui"))
    args.add_argument("--scenario", help="run one named TUI scenario")
    args.add_argument("--named-only", action="store_true", help="run only the fixed TUI scenarios")
    args.add_argument("--edit-only", action="store_true", help="run only generated nested-program editing traces")
    args.add_argument("--replay", type=Path)
    args.add_argument("--report", type=Path, default=PACKAGE / "reports/differential.json")
    args.add_argument("--no-shrink", action="store_true")
    args.add_argument("--oracle-timeout", type=float, default=30, help="seconds per oracle response; a timeout is retained as a failure and the oracle is restarted")
    options = args.parse_args()
    if options.edit_traces is None:
        options.edit_traces = options.traces
    if options.named_only:
        options.only, options.traces, options.edit_traces = "tui", 0, 0
    if options.edit_only:
        options.only, options.traces = "tui", 0
    options.report = options.report.resolve()
    actual_sha = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=ORACLE, text=True).strip()
    if actual_sha != ORACLE_SHA:
        raise SystemExit(f"oracle revision is {actual_sha}; expected {ORACLE_SHA}")
    if subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--quiet", "HEAD", "--"], cwd=ORACLE).returncode:
        raise SystemExit("oracle tracked sources are modified")
    native = Peer([str(options.binary.resolve()), "--protocol"])
    oracle = Peer([options.bun, str(PACKAGE / "tests/oracle.mjs")], timeout=options.oracle_timeout)
    report = {"seed": options.seed, "oracle": ORACLE_SHA,
              "binary_sha256": hashlib.sha256(options.binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              "oracle_manifest_sha256": hashlib.sha256((ORACLE / "packages/gleam_cli/manifest.toml").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              "command": sys.argv, "comparison": "Exact object keys, arrays, strings and buffer cells; JSON Numbers compare by JavaScript IEEE-754 value, with booleans separate. Rendered text is never normalized.", "rng_streams": {"programs": options.seed, "syntax": options.seed + 1, "behaviour": options.seed, "program_edits": options.seed + 2}, "passed": False, "status": "running", "counts": {}, "failures": [], "sensitivity": {}, "coverage": {"ir_nodes": {}, "builtins": {}}, "peer_failures": [], "oracle_timeout_seconds": options.oracle_timeout}
    node_coverage, builtin_coverage = Counter(), Counter()
    rng = random.Random(options.seed)
    artifact_dir = options.report.parent / "failures"
    started = time.monotonic()
    shrink_categories = set()
    options.report.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    options.report.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2) + "\n")

    def save_report():
        options.report.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2) + "\n")

    def save_failure(category, name, request, failure, minimized=None):
        artifact_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        identity = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(request, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=True).encode()).hexdigest()[:10]
        path = artifact_dir / f"{category}-{options.seed}-{report['binary_sha256'][:8]}-{identity}.json"
        path.write_text(json.dumps({"seed": options.seed, "oracle": ORACLE_SHA,
            "binary_sha256": report["binary_sha256"], "category": category, "name": name,
            "request": request, "minimized": minimized or request, "failure": failure}, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2) + "\n")
        failure["reproducer"] = str(path.relative_to(PACKAGE)) if path.is_relative_to(PACKAGE) else str(path)
        report["failures"].append(failure)
        save_report()

    def exchange(peer, request):
        try:
            response = peer.request(request)
            if isinstance(response, dict) and "adapter_error" in response:
                raise RuntimeError(str(response))
            return response, None
        except (TimeoutError, RuntimeError, OSError, ValueError) as error:
            detail = {"kind": "timeout" if isinstance(error, TimeoutError) else "exception", "error": str(error)}
            peer.restart()
            return None, detail

    def check(category, name, request, expected_fixture=None):
        if request["op"] == "tui":
            request = {"files": {}, **request}
        def coverage(value):
            if isinstance(value, dict):
                if "0" in value:
                    node_coverage[value["0"]] += 1
                    if value["0"] == "b":
                        builtin_coverage[value["l"]] += 1
                for child in value.values():
                    coverage(child)
            elif isinstance(value, list):
                for child in value:
                    coverage(child)
        if "program" in request:
            coverage(request["program"])
        counter = report["counts"].setdefault(category, {"checked": 0, "compared": 0, "passed": 0, "failed": 0, "uncomparable": 0})
        counter["checked"] += 1
        # Ask both independently: an oracle timeout is not evidence that native
        # matched it. Keep the request and continue with a fresh oracle process.
        got, native_error = exchange(native, request)
        expected, oracle_error = exchange(oracle, request)
        if native_error or oracle_error:
            counter["failed"] += 1
            counter["uncomparable"] += 1
            failure = {"category": category, "name": name, "request": request,
                       "native_error": native_error, "oracle_error": oracle_error}
            report["peer_failures"].append({k: v for k, v in failure.items() if k != "request"})
            save_failure(category, name, request, failure)
            print(f"UNCOMPARABLE {category}/{name}: {oracle_error or native_error}", file=sys.stderr)
            return
        counter["compared"] += 1
        if expected_fixture is not None and not same(expected, expected_fixture):
            raise AssertionError(f"oracle fixture self-check failed for {name}: {expected} != {expected_fixture}")
        if same(expected, got):
            counter["passed"] += 1
            if counter["checked"] % 25 == 0:
                save_report()
            return
        counter["failed"] += 1
        failure = {"category": category, "name": name, "difference": first_difference(expected, got), "request": request}
        # Shrinking only retains a finite, observed comparison mismatch. A hang
        # encountered during shrinking never replaces the original mismatch.
        def differs(candidate):
            actual, n_error = exchange(native, candidate)
            reference, o_error = exchange(oracle, candidate)
            return not (n_error or o_error) and not same(reference, actual)
        minimized = request
        if category not in shrink_categories and not options.no_shrink:
            shrink_categories.add(category)
            if request["op"] == "eval":
                minimized = {**request, "program": shrink_program(request["program"], lambda p: differs({**request, "program": p}))}
            elif request["op"] == "tui":
                minimized = {**request, "events": shrink_events(request["events"], lambda e: differs({**request, "events": e}))}
        save_failure(category, name, request, failure, minimized)
        if counter["failed"] <= 5:
            print(f"FAIL {category}/{name}: {ascii(failure['difference'])}", file=sys.stderr)

    try:
        # Sensitivity checks are against the comparator itself, before native
        # tests. A one-cell symbol/style/width mutation must not compare equal.
        probe = oracle.request({"op": "tui", "width": 20, "height": 5, "events": []})
        for field, changed in (("symbol", "X"), ("fg", 4), ("modifiers", 32), ("width", 2), ("underline_color", 1), ("link", "https://example.com")):
            mutated = json.loads(json.dumps(probe))
            mutated["frames"][0]["cells"][0][field] = changed
            report["sensitivity"][field] = first_difference(probe, mutated) is not None
        assert all(report["sensitivity"].values())
        report["sensitivity"]["json_types"] = not same({"integer": 1}, {"integer": True})
        assert report["sensitivity"]["json_types"]
        report["sensitivity"]["number_difference"] = not same(1, 1.5)
        report["sensitivity"]["numeric_string"] = not same("1", 1)
        report["sensitivity"]["number_token_equivalence"] = same(10**20, 1e20)
        assert all(report["sensitivity"].values())

        if options.replay:
            saved = json.loads(options.replay.read_text())
            request = saved.get("minimized", saved.get("request", saved))
            check("replay", options.replay.name, request)
        else:
            if options.only in (None, "eval"):
                for path in sorted((ORACLE / "spec/evaluation").glob("*_suite.json")):
                    for fixture in json.loads(path.read_text()):
                        expected = {"value": fixture["value"]} if "value" in fixture else {"break": fixture["break"]}
                        check("spec", fixture["name"], {"op": "eval", "program": fixture["source"], "effects": fixture.get("effects", [])}, expected)
                for i in range(options.programs):
                    check("generated-program", str(i), {"op": "eval", "program": generated_program(rng)})
                    if i % 10 == 0:
                        first, second = rng.randrange(-100, 100), rng.randrange(-100, 100)
                        source = node("l", l="a", v=call(node("p", l="First"), node("i", v=1)),
                                      t=node("l", l="b", v=call(node("p", l="Second"), node("v", l="a")), t=builtin("int_add", node("v", l="a"), node("v", l="b"))))
                        check("generated-external-effects", str(i), {"op": "eval", "program": source, "effects": [
                            {"label": "First", "lift": {"integer": 1}, "reply": {"integer": first}},
                            {"label": "Second", "lift": {"integer": first}, "reply": {"integer": second}}]})
                    if i % 20 == 0:
                        lift_ir, lift = literal_fixture(rng)
                        _, first = literal_fixture(rng)
                        _, second = literal_fixture(rng)
                        source = node("l", l="a", v=call(node("p", l="First"), lift_ir), t=call(node("p", l="Second"), node("v", l="a")))
                        check("generated-external-values", str(i), {"op": "eval", "program": source, "effects": [
                            {"label": "First", "lift": lift, "reply": first}, {"label": "Second", "lift": first, "reply": second}]})
            if options.only in (None, "parse"):
                rng = random.Random(options.seed + 1)
                for i, source in enumerate(SYNTAX_CASES):
                    check("syntax-fixture", str(i), {"op": "parse", "source": source})
                for i, source in enumerate(DIAGNOSTIC_CASES):
                    check("diagnostic-fixture", str(i), {"op": "diagnostic", "source": source})
                for i in range(options.syntax):
                    check("generated-syntax", str(i), {"op": "parse", "source": generated_source(rng)})
                real = REPO / "work/oracle-real-world/dark"
                for path in sorted(real.glob("git/*.eyg")):
                    check("real-world-syntax", path.name, {"op": "parse", "source": path.read_text()})
            if options.only in (None, "tui"):
                rng = random.Random(options.seed)
                scenarios = {} if options.edit_only else tui_scenarios()
                if options.scenario:
                    scenarios = {options.scenario: scenarios[options.scenario]}
                for name, events in scenarios.items():
                    check("tui-scenario", name, {"op": "tui", "width": 80, "height": 24, "events": events})
                if not options.scenario and not options.named_only and not options.edit_only:
                    files = {"lib/answer.eyg": "42", "main.eyg": "{answer: 42}", ".hidden.eyg": "0"}
                    fixture_scenarios = {
                        "import-picker": [{"key": "q"}, {"paste": "lib/answer.eyg"}, {"key": "enter"}, {"key": "enter"}],
                        "import-hidden": [{"key": "q"}, {"key": "."}, {"key": "down"}, {"key": "esc"}],
                        "import-directory": [{"key": "q"}, {"paste": "lib/"}, {"key": "enter"}, {"key": "esc"}],
                        "import-expression": [{"paste": 'import "lib/answer.eyg"'}, {"key": "enter"}],
                        "import-missing": [{"paste": 'import "missing.eyg"'}, {"key": "enter"}],
                        "package-empty": [{"key": "@"}, {"key": "tab"}, {"key": "enter"}, {"key": "esc"}],
                        "cid-invalid": [{"key": "#"}, {"paste": "bad-cid"}, {"key": "enter"}, {"key": "esc"}],

                    for name, events in fixture_scenarios.items():

                    check("tui-world", "import-exported-effect", {"op": "tui", "width": 80, "height": 24,
                        "files": {"callable.eyg": '(_) -> { perform StandardOut("hello") }'},

                    for name, expression in {
