```python
                        "readfile-missing": 'perform ReadFile({})',
                        "readfile-first-field": 'perform ReadFile({limit: {}, offset: "bad", path: 1})',
                        "readfile-offset": 'perform ReadFile({path: "main.eyg", offset: "bad", limit: 1})',
                        "readfile-limit": 'perform ReadFile({path: "main.eyg", offset: 0, limit: "bad"})',
                        "fetch-missing": 'perform Fetch({})',
                        "fetch-nested-header": 'perform Fetch({method: GET({}), scheme: HTTP({}), host: "localhost", port: None({}), path: "/", query: None({}), headers: [{value: "ok", key: 1}], body: !binary_from_integers([])})',
                        "fetch-unit-payload": 'perform Fetch({method: GET("bad"), scheme: HTTP({})})',
                        "stdin-type": 'perform StandardIn("bad")',
                        "stdin-extra-unit-field": 'perform StandardIn({unexpected: 1})',
                        "stdout-type": 'perform StandardOut(42)',
                        "stderr-type": 'perform StandardError({})',
                        "exit-type": 'perform Exit("bad")',
                        "hash-unit-payload": 'perform Hash({algorithm: SHA256("bad"), bytes: !binary_from_integers([])})',
                        "sign-field-order": 'perform Sign({key: "bad", data: 1})',
                    }.items():
                        check("tui-effect-cast", name, {"op": "tui", "width": 80, "height": 24, "files": files,
                            "events": [{"paste": expression}, {"key": "enter"}, {"key": "up"}, {"key": "K"}]})
                    for extension, module in (("text", '(_) -> { perform Ping(1) }'), ("json", json.dumps(node("f", l="_", b=call(node("p", l="Ping"), node("i", v=1)))))):
                        imported_resume = call(node("h", l="Ping"), node("f", l="x", b=node("f", l="resume", b=node("v", l="resume"))), node(".", i="closure.eyg"))
                        check("tui-world", "import-resumption-" + extension, {"op": "tui", "width": 120, "height": 40,
                            "files": {"closure.eyg": module}, "events": [{"paste": json.dumps(imported_resume)}, {"key": "enter"}, {"key": "up"}, {"key": "K"}, {"key": "k"}, {"resize": [40, 24]}]})
                    packages = {
                        "alpha": {"version": 3, "program": node("i", v=7)},
                        "demo": {"version": 1, "program": node("i", v=42)},
                        "record": {"version": 2, "program": call(node("e", l="answer"), node("i", v=42), node("u"))},
                        "succ": {"version": 1, "program": node("f", l="x", b=builtin("int_add", node("v", l="x"), node("i", v=1)))},
                    }
                    metadata = oracle.request({"op": "package_metadata", "packages": packages})
                    cids = {p["name"]: p["cid"] for p in metadata["packages"]}
                    hub_scenarios = {
                        "release-picker": [{"key": "@"}, {"key": "tab"}, {"key": "enter"}, {"key": "enter"}],
                        "floating": [{"paste": "@demo"}, {"key": "enter"}],
                        "version": [{"paste": "@demo:1"}, {"key": "enter"}],
                        "pinned": [{"paste": "@demo:1:" + cids["demo"]}, {"key": "enter"}],
                        "mismatched-pin": [{"paste": "@demo:1:" + cids["alpha"]}, {"key": "enter"}],
                        "content": [{"paste": "#" + cids["demo"]}, {"key": "enter"}],
                        "record-field": [{"paste": "@record.answer"}, {"key": "enter"}],
                        "function": [{"paste": "@succ(41)"}, {"key": "enter"}],
                    }
                    for name, events in hub_scenarios.items():
                        check("tui-hub", name, {"op": "tui", "width": 80, "height": 24, "packages": packages, "events": events})
                for i in range(options.traces):
                    check("generated-behaviour", str(i), {"op": "tui", "width": rng.choice((20, 40, 80, 120)), "height": rng.choice((5, 10, 24, 40)), "events": generated_trace(rng, options.trace_length)})
                if not options.scenario and not options.named_only:
                    edit_rng = random.Random(options.seed + 2)
                    for i in range(options.edit_traces):
                        # The independent Gleam parser filters candidates; the
                        # generated text is then pasted into both real reducers.
                        for _ in range(100):
                            source = generated_edit_source(edit_rng)
                            if "program" in oracle.request({"op": "parse", "source": source}):

        report["passed"] = all(c["failed"] == 0 for c in report["counts"].values())
        report["status"] = "complete"
    finally:
        native.close()
        oracle.close()
        report["elapsed_seconds"] = time.monotonic() - started
        report["coverage"] = {"ir_nodes": dict(sorted(node_coverage.items())), "builtins": dict(sorted(builtin_coverage.items()))}
        options.report.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        options.report.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({"report": str(options.report), "passed": report.get("passed", False), "counts": report["counts"]}))
    return 0 if report.get("passed") else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compare pure computer effects with their actual pinned Gleam handlers."""
import argparse
import base64
from collections import Counter
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import random
import shutil
import sys

from differential import PACKAGE, ORACLE_SHA, Peer, first_difference, generated_source, node, call, builtin


def binary(data):
    return {"binary": {"/": {"bytes": base64.b64encode(data).decode().rstrip("=")}}}


def signing(seed, message):
    return {"label": "Sign", "lift": {"record": {
        "key": {"tagged": {"label": "Eddsa", "value": {"record": {"d": binary(seed)}}}},
        "data": binary(message),
    }}}


def unwrap(tag, value):
    return call(node("m", l=tag), node("f", l="payload", b=node("v", l="payload")), node("n"), value)


def json_term(raw):
    parsed = unwrap("Ok", call(node("p", l="DecodeJSON"), node("x", v=binary(raw)["binary"])))
    popped = unwrap("Ok", builtin("list_pop", parsed))
    return call(node("g", l="term"), call(node("g", l="head"), popped))


def parsed_integer(raw):
    return unwrap("Integer", json_term(raw))


def json_value(rng, depth=3):
    if depth <= 0:
        return rng.choice([None, True, False, rng.randint(-100000, 100000), rng.choice(["", "λ", "\0\r\n", "👩🏽‍💻", "é", "quote\"\\"])])
    kind = rng.randrange(4)
    if kind == 0:
        return [json_value(rng, depth - 1) for _ in range(rng.randrange(5))]
    if kind == 1:
        return {key: json_value(rng, depth - 1) for key in rng.sample(["x", "y", "a", "λ", "name"], rng.randrange(5))}
    return json_value(rng, 0)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--binary", type=Path, default=PACKAGE / "work/computer-check")
    parser.add_argument("--bun", default=shutil.which("bun") or "/workspace/tooling/bin/bun")
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=20261028)
    parser.add_argument("--cases", type=int, default=1000)
    parser.add_argument("--report", type=Path, default=PACKAGE / "reports/computer.json")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    rng = random.Random(args.seed)
    native = Peer([str(args.binary.resolve())])
    oracle = Peer([args.bun, str(PACKAGE / "tests/computer_oracle.mjs")])
    counts = Counter()
    report = {"oracle": ORACLE_SHA, "seed": args.seed, "binary_sha256": hashlib.sha256(args.binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "failures": []}

    def compare(request):
        expected, got = oracle.request(request), native.request(request)
        counts[request.get("label", "unsafe-program")] += 1
        if expected != got:
            if len(report["failures"]) < 20:
                report["failures"].append({"request": request, "difference": first_difference(expected, got), "expected": expected, "got": got})
            return False
        return True

    try:
        raw_cases = [b"", b" ", b"[", b"{", b"-", b"1.", b"1e", b"1e+", b"1e-", b"01", b"1 garbage", b"truefalse", b"[1,]", b'{"x":1,}', b'{"x":1,"x":2}', b"-0.000e-0", b"9007199254740993", b'"\\uD83D\\uDE80"', b'"\\uD800"', b'"\\uDC00"', b'"\\u123"', b'"\\u+123"', b'"\\q"', b'"\\', b'"raw\nline"', b'"\xff"', b"\xff"]
        raw_cases += [b'"' + b'\xff' * 64 + b'"', b'"\xc3"', b'{"x":"\xc3"}']
        for _ in range(args.cases):
            encoded = json.dumps(json_value(rng), ensure_ascii=rng.choice([True, False]), separators=(",", ":")).encode()
            raw_cases.append(encoded)
            raw_cases.append(encoded[:rng.randrange(len(encoded) + 1)])
        for _ in range(args.cases):
            sign = rng.choice(["", "-"])
            decimal = rng.choice(["", "." + str(rng.randrange(100000)).zfill(rng.randrange(1, 8))])
            exponent = rng.choice(["", "e+0", "e" + str(rng.randint(-100, 100)), "E-03"])
            raw_cases.append(f"{sign}{rng.randrange(10000)}{decimal}{exponent}".encode())
        for raw in raw_cases:
            compare({"label": "DecodeJSON", "lift": binary(raw)})
        for _ in range(args.cases // 2):
            compare({"label": "DecodeJSON", "lift": binary(str(rng.randrange(10**16, 10**18)).encode())})
        huge = ["9" * 400, "-" + "9" * 400, "9223372036854775808", "-9223372036854775808", "18446744073709551616", "1" + "0" * 100]
        for raw in huge + ["1." + "9" * 400 + "e-" + "9" * 400]:
            compare({"label": "DecodeJSON", "lift": binary(raw.encode())})

        # Obtain unsafe Integer values through the actual host effect, then
        # apply language operations. This checks behavior beyond wire printing.
        raw_numbers = [str(n) for n in [0, 9007199254740991, 9007199254740992, (1 << 63) - 1024, 1 << 63, -(1 << 63), 1 << 64, -(1 << 64)]]
        raw_numbers += huge + [str(rng.randrange(10**16, 10**18)) for _ in range(20)]
        n = node("v", l="number")
        self_divided = unwrap("Ok", builtin("int_divide", n, n))
        operations = [builtin("int_to_string", n), builtin("int_absolute", n), builtin("int_compare", n, node("i", v=9007199254740991)), builtin("int_add", n, node("i", v=1)), builtin("int_subtract", n, n), builtin("int_multiply", n, node("i", v=0)), builtin("int_divide", n, node("i", v=3)), builtin("int_divide", n, n), builtin("equal", n, n), builtin("binary_from_integers", call(node("c"), n, node("ta"))), builtin("int_parse", builtin("int_to_string", n)), builtin("int_to_string", self_divided), builtin("int_compare", self_divided, self_divided), builtin("equal", self_divided, self_divided)]
        for raw in raw_numbers:
            for operation in operations:
                compare({"op": "eval", "program": node("l", l="number", v=parsed_integer(raw.encode()), t=operation)})
            quotient = builtin("int_divide", n, node("i", v=3))
            program = node("l", l="number", v=parsed_integer(raw.encode()), t=quotient)
            expected = oracle.request({"op": "eval", "program": program})
            try:
                reply = expected["value"]["tagged"]["value"]["integer"]
                if isinstance(reply, int):
                    same = builtin("equal", unwrap("Ok", quotient), parsed_integer(str(reply).encode()))
                    compare({"op": "eval", "program": node("l", l="number", v=parsed_integer(raw.encode()), t=same)})
            except KeyError:
                pass
        # Gleam's structural equality recognizes the same boxed Integer object
        # before inspecting its NaN payload. Copies of one bound value therefore
        # differ from two independently computed NaN Integer objects.
        infinity = node("v", l="infinity")
        nan = node("v", l="nan")
        make_nan = unwrap("Ok", builtin("int_divide", infinity, infinity))
        nan_cases = [builtin("equal", nan, nan), builtin("equal", call(node("c"), nan, node("ta")), call(node("c"), nan, node("ta"))), builtin("equal", nan, make_nan)]
        for operation in nan_cases:
            compare({"op": "eval", "program": node("l", l="infinity", v=parsed_integer(("9" * 400).encode()), t=node("l", l="nan", v=make_nan, t=operation))})
        sources = ["42", "todo", "", "!int_add(20, 22)", "let x = 1 x", "import \"./a.eyg\"", "@standard", "@standard:2", "#!/usr/bin/env eyg\n42", '{"0":"i","v":42}', '{"0":"u"}', "{x: 1, y: [2, 3]}"]
        sources += [generated_source(rng) for _ in range(args.cases)]
        sources += [json.dumps({"0": "i", "v": 1.0}), json.dumps({"0": "@", "p": "demo", "r": -2}), json.dumps({"0": "x", "v": {"/": {"bytes": "AR=="}}})]
        for source in sources:
            compare({"label": "EYGParse", "lift": {"string": source}})
        for _ in range(args.cases):
            compare(signing(rng.randbytes(32), rng.randbytes(rng.randrange(513))))
        for length in [0, 1, 31, 33, 64]:
            compare(signing(rng.randbytes(length), b"test"))
        for request in [
            {"label": "DecodeJSON", "lift": {"string": "[]"}},
            {"label": "EYGParse", "lift": {"integer": 1}},
            {"label": "CreateKey", "lift": {"record": {}}},
            {"label": "CreateKey", "lift": {"tagged": {"label": "Other", "value": {"record": {}}}}},
            {"label": "Sign", "lift": {"record": {}}},
            {"label": "Sign", "lift": {"record": {"key": {"integer": 1}, "data": binary(b"test")}}},
        ]:
            compare(request)
        for _ in range(100):
            request = {"label": "CreateKey", "lift": {"tagged": {"label": "Eddsa", "value": {"record": {}}}}}
            generated = native.request(request)
            counts["CreateKey"] += 1
            try:
                key = generated["value"]["tagged"]["value"]["tagged"]["value"]["record"]
                if key["kty"] != {"string": "OKP"} or key["crv"] != {"string": "Ed25519"}:
                    raise ValueError("wrong JWK metadata")
                if len(base64.b64decode(key["d"]["binary"]["/"]["bytes"] + "==")) != 32:
                    raise ValueError("wrong seed length")
                derived = oracle.request({"label": "derive-public-key", "lift": key["d"]})
                if derived != key["x"]:
                    raise ValueError("public key differs from actual oracle's seed import")
                compare(signing(base64.b64decode(key["d"]["binary"]["/"]["bytes"] + "=="), b"generated-key"))
            except (KeyError, ValueError) as error:
                report["failures"].append({"request": request, "got": generated, "error": str(error)})
        report["passed"] = not report["failures"]
    finally:
        native.close()
        oracle.close()
        report["counts"] = dict(counts)
        args.report.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        args.report.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({key: value for key, value in report.items() if key != "failures"}))
    if report["failures"]:
        print(json.dumps(report["failures"][:3], ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), file=sys.stderr)
    return 0 if report.get("passed") else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compare validation against actual next-tui decoders without running effects."""
import argparse
from collections import Counter
from copy import deepcopy
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import random
import shutil
import sys

from differential import PACKAGE, ORACLE_SHA, Peer, first_difference, literal_fixture, same

UNIT = {"record": {}}
BINARY = {"binary": {"/": {"bytes": ""}}}
TEXT = {"string": "text"}
INTEGER = {"integer": 42}


def tag(label, value=UNIT):
    return {"tagged": {"label": label, "value": deepcopy(value)}}


def record(**fields):
    return {"record": fields}


def profiles():
    valid = {label: deepcopy(UNIT) for label in ("CWD", "Now", "Flip", "StandardIn")}
    valid.update({label: deepcopy(TEXT) for label in ("StandardOut", "StandardError", "Env", "EYGParse", "ReadDirectory", "MakeDirectory", "DeleteFile")})
    valid.update({label: deepcopy(INTEGER) for label in ("Sleep", "Random", "Exit")})
    valid["DecodeJSON"] = deepcopy(BINARY)
    valid["ReadFile"] = record(path=TEXT, offset=INTEGER, limit=INTEGER)
    valid["WriteFile"] = record(path=TEXT, contents=BINARY)
    valid["AppendFile"] = deepcopy(valid["WriteFile"])
    valid["Hash"] = record(algorithm=tag("SHA256"), bytes=BINARY)
    valid["CreateKey"] = tag("Eddsa", TEXT)  # Options are accepted and ignored.
    valid["Sign"] = record(key=tag("Eddsa", record(d=BINARY)), data=BINARY)
    valid["Fetch"] = record(method=tag("GET"), scheme=tag("HTTPS"), host=TEXT,
                            port=tag("None"), path=TEXT, query=tag("None"),
                            headers={"list": [record(key=TEXT, value=TEXT)]}, body=BINARY)
    return valid


def mutations(value):
    # Replace every decoded nested value independently. Keep records' insertion
    # order so simultaneous wrong/missing fields exercise the decoder sequence.
    replacements = [UNIT, INTEGER, {"integer": 1e100}, TEXT, BINARY,
                    {"list": []}, tag("Unknown"), tag("None", TEXT), tag("Some", INTEGER)]
    for replacement in replacements:
        yield deepcopy(replacement)
    if "record" in value:
        for name, child in value["record"].items():
            missing = deepcopy(value)
            del missing["record"][name]
            yield missing
            for mutated in mutations(child):
                result = deepcopy(value)
                result["record"][name] = mutated
                yield result
    elif "tagged" in value:
        for payload in replacements:
            result = deepcopy(value)
            result["tagged"]["value"] = deepcopy(payload)
            yield result
    elif "list" in value:
        for index, child in enumerate(value["list"]):
            for mutated in mutations(child):
                result = deepcopy(value)
                result["list"][index] = mutated
                yield result


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--binary", type=Path, default=PACKAGE / "work/effect-cast-check")
    parser.add_argument("--bun", default=shutil.which("bun") or "/workspace/tooling/bin/bun")
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=20261028)
    parser.add_argument("--cases", type=int, default=2000)
    parser.add_argument("--report", type=Path, default=PACKAGE / "reports/effect-cast.json")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    rng = random.Random(args.seed)
    native = Peer([str(args.binary.resolve())])
    oracle = Peer([args.bun, str(PACKAGE / "tests/computer_oracle.mjs")])
    report = {"oracle": ORACLE_SHA, "seed": args.seed,
              "binary_sha256": hashlib.sha256(args.binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              "checked": 0, "failed": 0, "failures": [], "passed": False}
    counts = Counter()
    valid_counts = Counter()

    def compare(label, lift):
        request = {"label": label, "lift": lift, "cast_only": True}
        expected, got = oracle.request(request), native.request(request)
        report["checked"] += 1
        counts[label] += 1
        if expected == {"valid": True}:
            valid_counts[label] += 1
        if not same(expected, got):
            report["failed"] += 1
            if len(report["failures"]) < 20:
                report["failures"].append({"request": request,
                    "difference": first_difference(expected, got), "expected": expected, "got": got})
            if report["failed"] <= 5:
                print(json.dumps({"label": label, "difference": first_difference(expected, got)}, ensure_ascii=False), file=sys.stderr)

    try:
        valid = profiles()
        for label, lift in valid.items():
            compare(label, lift)
            for mutated in mutations(lift):
                compare(label, mutated)
        for _ in range(args.cases):
            _, lift = literal_fixture(rng, depth=rng.randrange(1, 5))
            compare(rng.choice(list(valid)), lift)
        report["counts"] = dict(counts)
        report["valid_counts"] = dict(valid_counts)
        report["passed"] = report["failed"] == 0 and set(valid_counts) == set(valid)
    finally:
        native.close()
        oracle.close()
        args.report.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        args.report.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in report.items() if k != "failures"}))
    return 0 if report["passed"] else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Offline CID bytes and cache resolution compared with the actual Gleam hub."""
import argparse
import base64
from collections import Counter
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import random
import shutil
import sys

from differential import PACKAGE, ORACLE_SHA, Peer, first_difference, generated_program, node, call, builtin


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument("--binary", type=Path, default=PACKAGE / "work/hub-check")
    p.add_argument("--bun", default=shutil.which("bun") or "/workspace/tooling/bin/bun")
    p.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=20261028)
    p.add_argument("--cases", type=int, default=200)
    p.add_argument("--report", type=Path, default=PACKAGE / "reports/hub.json")
    args = p.parse_args()
    rng = random.Random(args.seed)
    native = Peer([str(args.binary.resolve())])
    oracle = Peer([args.bun, str(PACKAGE / "tests/hub_oracle.mjs")])
    counts = Counter()
    report = {"oracle": ORACLE_SHA, "seed": args.seed, "binary_sha256": hashlib.sha256(args.binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "failures": []}

    def check(category, request, expected):
        got = native.request(request)
        counts[category] += 1
        if got != expected and len(report["failures"]) < 20:
            report["failures"].append({"category": category, "request": request, "difference": first_difference(expected, got), "expected": expected, "got": got})

    try:
        programs = [generated_program(rng) for _ in range(args.cases)]
        programs += [node("i", v=42, _native_node=123), node("u", l="ignored", extra=True), node("i", v=1.0), node("x", v={"/": {"bytes": "AR=="}}), node("s", v="\0\b\f\nλé👩🏽‍💻"), node("s", v="".join(map(chr, range(32))))]
        programs += [node("@", p="demo", r=version) for version in [9007199254740992, 10**18, 10**20, 10**21, -9007199254740992]]
        programs += [node("@", p="demo", r=rng.randrange(1 << 53, 1 << 62)) for _ in range(50)]
        packages = {f"probe{i}": {"version": 1, "program": program} for i, program in enumerate(programs)}
        metadata = oracle.request({"op": "package_metadata", "packages": packages})
        http_fixture = oracle.request({"op": "hub_fixture", "packages": packages})
        if "packages" not in metadata or "modules" not in http_fixture:
            raise RuntimeError(f"oracle fixture failure: {metadata}")
        for entry in metadata["packages"]:
            check("canonicalCID", {"op": "cid", "program": entry["program"]}, {"cid": entry["cid"], "bytes": base64.b64decode(http_fixture["modules"][entry["cid"]]).decode()})

        for i in range(args.cases):
            kind = rng.randrange(5)
            n = rng.randrange(1000)
            module = node("i", v=n) if kind == 0 else node("s", v=f"λ{n}") if kind == 1 else node("f", l="x", b=builtin("int_add", node("v", l="x"), node("i", v=n))) if kind == 2 else call(node("t", l="Some"), node("i", v=n)) if kind == 3 else call(node("c"), node("i", v=n), node("ta"))
            version = rng.randint(1, 10)
            fixture = {"demo": {"version": version, "program": module}}
            cid = oracle.request({"op": "package_metadata", "packages": fixture})["packages"][0]["cid"]
            reference = rng.choice([node("@", p="demo"), node("@", p="demo", r=version), node("@", p="demo", r=version, l={"/": cid}), node("#", l={"/": cid})])
            program = call(reference, node("i", v=7)) if kind == 2 else reference
            request = {"op": "fixture", "packages": fixture, "program": program}
            check("cachedResolution", request, oracle.request(request))

        fixture = {"demo": {"program": node("i", v=42)}}
        request = {"op": "fixture", "packages": fixture, "program": node("@", p="demo")}
        check("defaultVersion", request, oracle.request(request))
        source = node("i", v=42)
        cid = oracle.request({"op": "package_metadata", "packages": {"demo": {"program": source}}})["packages"][0]["cid"]
        check("rejectTamperedModule", {"op": "verify", "cid": cid, "bytes": '{"0":"i","v":41}'}, {"error": "ModuleHashMismatch"})
        check("verifyReorderedModule", {"op": "verify", "cid": cid, "bytes": '{"extra":"ignored","v":42,"0":"i"}'}, {"verified": True})
        for broken in [node("v", l="missing"), call(node("p", l="Probe"), node("u")), node("@", p="unknown")]:
            request = {"op": "fixture", "packages": {"demo": {"version": 1, "program": broken}}, "program": node("@", p="demo")}
            check("rejectImpureOrBrokenModule", request, oracle.request(request))
        for reference in [node("@", p="absent"), node("@", p="demo", r=0), node("@", p="demo", r=2)]:
            request = {"op": "fixture", "packages": fixture, "program": reference}
            check("unknownRelease", request, oracle.request(request))
        report["passed"] = not report["failures"]
    finally:
        native.close()
        oracle.close()
        report["counts"] = dict(counts)
        args.report.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        args.report.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({key: value for key, value in report.items() if key != "failures"}))
    if report["failures"]:
        print(json.dumps(report["failures"][:3], ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), file=sys.stderr)
    return 0 if report.get("passed") else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compare every node's inferred type, effect, and diagnostic to Gleam."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import random
import shutil
import sys

from differential import PACKAGE, ORACLE_SHA, Peer, generated_program, node, call, builtin, first_difference, same, UNICODE


def annotate(program, counter):
    if isinstance(program, dict):
        if "0" in program:
            counter[0] += 1
            program["_native_node"] = counter[0]
        for key in list(program):
            annotate(program[key], counter)
    elif isinstance(program, list):
        for child in program:
            annotate(child, counter)


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument("--binary", type=Path, default=PACKAGE / "zig-out/bin/inference-runner")
    p.add_argument("--bun", default=os.environ.get("BUN") or shutil.which("bun") or "/workspace/tooling/bin/bun")
    p.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=20261028)
    p.add_argument("--programs", type=int, default=1000)
    p.add_argument("--scopes", type=int, default=300)
    p.add_argument("--report", type=Path, default=PACKAGE / "reports/inference.json")
    args = p.parse_args()
    native = Peer([str(args.binary.resolve())])
    oracle = Peer([args.bun, str(PACKAGE / "tests/inference_oracle.mjs")])
    rng = random.Random(args.seed)
    report = {"seed": args.seed, "oracle": ORACLE_SHA, "binary_sha256": hashlib.sha256(args.binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              "programs": 0, "scopes": 0, "node_annotations": 0, "failed": 0, "failures": []}
    try:
        for index in range(args.programs + args.scopes):
            scope = []
            names = []
            if index >= args.programs:
                for i in range(rng.randrange(1, 5)):
                    name = f"prior{i}"
                    scope.append({"name": name, "program": node("i", v=rng.randrange(-1000, 1000))})
                    names.append(name)
                # Runtime closures and partially applied builtins are retyped
                # in a session; scope tests expose their captured environments.
                scope.append({"name": "adder", "program": node("f", l="x", b=builtin("int_add", node("v", l="x"), node("v", l=names[0])))})
                scope.append({"name": "plus3", "program": call(node("b", l="int_add"), node("i", v=3))})
                scope.append({"name": "text", "program": node("s", v=rng.choice(UNICODE))})
            program = generated_program(rng, scope=tuple(names))
            if scope and rng.randrange(3) == 0:
                program = call(node("v", l=rng.choice(("adder", "plus3"))), program)
            counter = [0]
            annotate(program, counter)
            report["node_annotations"] += counter[0]
            for entry in scope:
                annotate(entry["program"], counter)
            request = {"program": program, "scope": scope}
            expected, got = oracle.request(request), native.request(request)
            if "error" in expected:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Gleam inference adapter error: {expected}")
            report["scopes" if scope else "programs"] += 1
            if not same(expected, got):
                report["failed"] += 1
                failure = {"index": index, "request": request, "difference": first_difference(expected, got)}
                if len(report["failures"]) < 30:
                    report["failures"].append(failure)
                if report["failed"] <= 5:
                    print(json.dumps(failure, ensure_ascii=False), file=sys.stderr)
        report["passed"] = report["failed"] == 0
    finally:
        native.close()
        oracle.close()
        args.report.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        args.report.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in report.items() if k != "failures"}))
    return 0 if report.get("passed") else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compare raw terminal decoding, including every intermediate input fragment."""
import argparse
import json
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import random
import os
import shutil
import sys

from differential import PACKAGE, ORACLE_SHA, Peer, UNICODE, first_difference, same


def corpus(rng, count):
    yield from [chr(i) for i in range(128)]
    yield from UNICODE
    yield from ["\x1b", "\x1b[", "\x1bO", "\x1b[1;", "\x1b[200~", "\x1b[200~abc", "\x1b[200~\nλ\x1b[201~"]
    for final in "ABCDHFPQRSZ~uXYZ":
        for modifier in range(1, 9):
            yield f"\x1b[1;{modifier}{final}"
    for number in range(1, 35):
        yield f"\x1b[{number}~"
    for final in "ABCDHFPQRSxyz":
        yield "\x1bO" + final
    for code in (0, 1, 2, 3, 32, 33, 34, 35, 64, 65, 66, 67):
        for final in "Mm":
            yield f"\x1b[<{code};10;20{final}"
    atoms = ["a", "λ", "é", "👩🏽‍💻", "\t", "\r", "\x7f", "\x01", "\x11", "\x1b[A", "\x1b[1;5C", "\x1bOQ", "\x1b[<64;3;8M", "\x1bz"]
    for _ in range(count):
        if rng.randrange(5) == 0:
            yield "\x1b[200~" + "".join(rng.choice(atoms) for _ in range(rng.randrange(8))) + "\x1b[201~"
        else:
            yield "".join(rng.choice(atoms) for _ in range(rng.randrange(1, 12)))


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--binary", type=Path, default=PACKAGE / "zig-out/bin/eyg")
    parser.add_argument("--bun", default=os.environ.get("BUN") or shutil.which("bun") or "/workspace/tooling/bin/bun")
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=20261028)
    parser.add_argument("--cases", type=int, default=1000)
    parser.add_argument("--report", type=Path, default=PACKAGE / "reports/input.json")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    rng = random.Random(args.seed)
    native = Peer([str(args.binary.resolve()), "--protocol"])
    oracle = Peer([args.bun, str(PACKAGE / "tests/oracle.mjs")])
    report = {"seed": args.seed, "oracle": ORACLE_SHA, "binary_sha256": hashlib.sha256(args.binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "checked": 0, "failed": 0, "failures": []}

    def check(request):
        expected, got = oracle.request(request), native.request(request)
        report["checked"] += 1
        if not same(expected, got):
            report["failed"] += 1
            if len(report["failures"]) < 20:
                report["failures"].append({"request": request, "difference": first_difference(expected, got)})
        return expected

    try:
        for text in corpus(rng, args.cases):
            check({"op": "input", "text": text, "flush": False})
            check({"op": "input", "text": text, "flush": True})
            # Character boundary fragments model the runtime's UTF-8 decoder.
            # A split UTF-8 scalar is not passed to an API taking valid strings.
            remainder = ""
            at = 0
            while at < len(text):
                end = min(len(text), at + rng.randrange(1, 5))
                response = check({"op": "input", "text": remainder + text[at:end], "flush": False})
                remainder = response["remainder"]
                at = end
            check({"op": "input", "text": remainder, "flush": True})
        report["passed"] = report["failed"] == 0
    finally:
        native.close()
        oracle.close()
        args.report.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        args.report.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in report.items() if k != "failures"}))
    if report["failures"]:
        print(json.dumps(report["failures"][:3], ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), file=sys.stderr)
    return 0 if report.get("passed") else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Seeded structural-pattern recognition/lowering vs pinned morph/editable."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, hashlib, json, random, sys
from differential import PACKAGE, ORACLE_SHA, Peer, same, first_difference

def node(code, **fields): return {'0':code, **fields}
def selector(label, name): return node('a', f=node('g',l=name), a=node('v',l=label))
def cases(rng, count):
    for index in range(count):
        label = rng.choice(('$','record','arg','λ'))
        fields = [{'name':rng.choice(('x','y','value','λ')), 'variable':rng.choice(('a','b','x','_','$'))} for _ in range(rng.randrange(5))]
        tail = rng.choice([node('i',v=42),node('v',l=label),node('v',l='a'),node('f',l=label,b=node('v',l=label)),node('l',l=label,v=node('i',v=2),t=node('v',l=label))])
        body = tail
        for f in reversed(fields): body=node('l',l=f['variable'],v=selector(label,f['name']),t=body)
        yield f'gather-{index}', {'op':'gather','label':label,'body':body}
        # Constant bodies avoid unrelated Editable normalization in this helper.
        pattern={'label':label,'destructured':bool(rng.randrange(2)),'fields':fields}
        yield f'lower-{index}', {'op':'lower','pattern':pattern,'body':node('i',v=rng.randrange(-100,100))}

def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);p.add_argument('--binary',type=Path,default=PACKAGE/'work/patterns-native');p.add_argument('--bun',default='/workspace/tooling/bin/bun');p.add_argument('--seed',type=int,default=20261028);p.add_argument('--cases',type=int,default=1000);p.add_argument('--report',type=Path,default=PACKAGE/'reports/patterns.json');args=p.parse_args()
    native=Peer([str(args.binary.resolve())]);oracle=Peer([args.bun,str(PACKAGE/'tests/patterns_oracle.mjs')]);report={'oracle':ORACLE_SHA,'seed':args.seed,'checked':0,'failed':0,'failures':[],'binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256(args.binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
    try:
        for name,request in cases(random.Random(args.seed),args.cases):
            got=native.request(request);expected=oracle.request(request);report['checked']+=1
            if not same(expected,got):
                report['failed']+=1
                if len(report['failures'])<10:report['failures'].append({'name':name,'request':request,'difference':first_difference(expected,got),'expected':expected,'got':got})
        report['passed']=not report['failed']
    finally:
        native.close();oracle.close();args.report.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True,parents=True);args.report.write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in report.items() if k!='failures'}));return 0 if report.get('passed') else 1
if __name__=='__main__':sys.exit(main())
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compare actual Gleam glam layouts for values, closures, and partial functions."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import random
import shutil
import sys

from differential import PACKAGE, ORACLE_SHA, Peer, literal_fixture, node, call, builtin, first_difference, same, unicode_record_program


def directed():
    for code in [node("c"), node("e", l="x"), node("o", l="x"), node("g", l="x"), node("t", l="Some"), node("m", l="Some"), node("n"), node("p", l="Ping"), node("h", l="Ping"), node("b", l="int_add"), node("f", l="argument", b=node("v", l="argument"))]:
        yield code
    yield call(node("c"), node("i", v=42))
    yield call(node("e", l="answer"), node("i", v=42))
    yield builtin("int_add", node("i", v=42))
    yield builtin("fix", node("f", l="self", b=node("f", l="x", b=node("v", l="x"))))
    yield call(node("h", l="Ping"), node("f", l="x", b=node("f", l="resume", b=node("v", l="resume"))), node("f", l="_", b=call(node("p", l="Ping"), node("i", v=1))))
    for size in (0, 1, 2, 10, 30, 80):
        value = node("ta")
        for i in range(size):
            value = call(node("c"), node("i", v=i), value)
        yield value
    for depth in range(1, 13):
        value = node("s", v="deep")
        for _ in range(depth):
            value = call(node("e", l="nested"), call(node("c"), value, node("ta")), node("u"))
        yield value
    for i in range(32):
        yield node("s", v="a" + chr(i) + "b")
    yield unicode_record_program()


def unicode_records(rng, count):
    """Exercise UTF-16 order with unique scalar labels and shared prefixes."""
    def scalar():
        point = rng.randrange(0x110000 - 0x800)
        return chr(point + 0x800 if point >= 0xD800 else point)

    for _ in range(count):
        shared = chr(rng.randrange(0x10000, 0x110000))
        candidates = [chr(rng.randrange(0xE000, 0x10000)),
                      chr(rng.randrange(0x10000, 0x110000)),
                      shared, shared + "a", shared + scalar()]
        candidates += ["".join(scalar() for _ in range(rng.randrange(1, 4)))
                       for _ in range(rng.randrange(5))]
        labels = list(dict.fromkeys(candidates))
        rng.shuffle(labels)
        program = node("u")
        for index, label in enumerate(labels):
            program = call(node("e", l=label), node("i", v=index), program)
        yield program


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument("--binary", type=Path, default=PACKAGE / "zig-out/bin/pretty-runner")
    p.add_argument("--bun", default=os.environ.get("BUN") or shutil.which("bun") or "/workspace/tooling/bin/bun")
    p.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=20261028)
    p.add_argument("--programs", type=int, default=1000)
    p.add_argument("--unicode-records", type=int, default=300)
    p.add_argument("--report", type=Path, default=PACKAGE / "reports/pretty.json")
    args = p.parse_args()
    native = Peer([str(args.binary.resolve())])
    oracle = Peer([args.bun, str(PACKAGE / "tests/oracle.mjs")])
    rng = random.Random(args.seed)
    report = {"oracle": ORACLE_SHA, "binary_sha256": hashlib.sha256(args.binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              "seed": args.seed, "checked": 0, "unicode_records": 0, "failed": 0, "failures": [], "passed": False}
    widths = (1, 2, 3, 8, 20, 40, 80, 120)

    def check(program, width):
        request = {"op": "pretty", "program": program, "width": width}
        expected, got = oracle.request(request), native.request(request)
        report["checked"] += 1
        if not same(expected, got):
            report["failed"] += 1
            if len(report["failures"]) < 40:
                failure = {"request": request, "difference": first_difference(expected, got), "expected": expected, "got": got}
                report["failures"].append(failure)
                if report["failed"] <= 5:
                    print(json.dumps({"width": width, "path": failure["difference"]["path"],
                                      "expected_preview": str(expected.get("text", expected))[:160],
                                      "got_preview": str(got.get("text", got))[:160]}, ensure_ascii=False), file=sys.stderr)

    try:
        for program in directed():
            for width in widths:
                check(program, width)
        for _ in range(args.programs):
            program, _ = literal_fixture(rng, depth=rng.randrange(1, 5))
            check(program, rng.choice(widths))
        for program in unicode_records(rng, args.unicode_records):
            check(program, rng.choice(widths))
            report["unicode_records"] += 1
        report["passed"] = report["failed"] == 0
    finally:
        native.close()
        oracle.close()
        args.report.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        args.report.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in report.items() if k != "failures"}))
    return 0 if report["passed"] else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/tests/differential_resume.py","sha256":"17997f7f9e92ab0f4ab6e44eb68b62aa0e4eaf8cbb761fdcfa957b60d9a4fae9","bytes":5821} -->
```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate captured CEK contexts and compare the actual oracle inspector text."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import random
import shutil
import sys

from differential import PACKAGE, ORACLE_SHA, Peer, node, call, builtin, literal_fixture, first_difference, same


def lam(name, body):
    return node("f", l=name, b=body)


def var(name):
    return node("v", l=name)


def let(name, value, body):
    return node("l", l=name, v=value, t=body)


def effect(label="Ping"):
    return call(node("p", l=label), node("i", v=42))


def handle(body, label="Ping", handler=None):
    if handler is None:
        handler = lam("payload", lam("resume", var("resume")))
    return call(node("h", l=label), handler, lam("unit", body))


def directed():
    # Each frame action appears in the captured prefix, including CallWith from
    # a suspended curried handler. Pending code is inspected, never evaluated.
    yield "trace", handle(effect())
    yield "argument", handle(call(effect(), node("s", v="pending argument")))
    yield "apply", handle(call(lam("x", var("x")), effect()))
    yield "assign", handle(let("result", effect(), var("result")))
    yield "nested-delimit", handle(handle(effect(), "Other"))
    q_handler = lam("q", let("interrupted", effect(), lam("resumeQ", var("resumeQ"))))
    yield "call-with-resumption", handle(handle(effect("Other"), "Other", q_handler))
    yield "tail-trace-replacement", handle(call(lam("a", call(lam("b", effect()), node("s", v="latest argument"))), node("i", v=123)))
    pending = [node("." , i="./path/quoted\".eyg"), node("@", p="package"), node("@", p="version", r=123)]
    cid = {"/": "baguqeeraaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"}
    pending.extend([node("#", l=cid), node("@", p="pinned", r=7, l=cid)])
    for i, code in enumerate(pending):
        yield f"reference-{i}", handle(let("pending", effect(), code))
    values = [node("s", v="\u0000\u0007\b\f\n\r\t\u007f\u0085\"\\🦊"),
              node("x", v={"/": {"bytes": "AAECf4D/"}}),
              call(node("t", l="Some"), node("i", v=-123)),
              builtin("int_add", node("i", v=9)),
              lam("closure", let("inside", node("u"), var("captured")))]
    for i, value in enumerate(values):
        yield f"scope-value-{i}", let("captured", node("s", v="outer"), let("bound", value, handle(effect())))
    # A prior captured continuation becomes an ordinary value in the next Env.
    yield "continuation-in-env", let("saved", handle(effect()), handle(effect()))


def generated(rng):
    body = effect()
    for index in range(rng.randrange(1, 7)):
        value, _ = literal_fixture(rng, depth=rng.randrange(1, 4))
        name = f"local{index}"
        choice = rng.randrange(5)
        if choice == 0:
            body = call(body, value)
        elif choice == 1:
            body = call(lam(name, value), body)
        elif choice == 2:
            body = let(name, body, value)
        elif choice == 3:
            body = call(lam(name, body), value)
        else:
            body = handle(body, f"Other{index}")
    value, _ = literal_fixture(rng, depth=3)
    return let("outer", value, handle(body))


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--binary", type=Path, default=PACKAGE / "zig-out/bin/pretty-runner")
    parser.add_argument("--bun", default=os.environ.get("BUN") or shutil.which("bun") or "/workspace/tooling/bin/bun")
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=20261028)
    parser.add_argument("--programs", type=int, default=300)
    parser.add_argument("--report", type=Path, default=PACKAGE / "reports/resume.json")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    rng = random.Random(args.seed)
    native = Peer([str(args.binary.resolve())])
    oracle = Peer([args.bun, str(PACKAGE / "tests/oracle.mjs")])
    report = {"oracle": ORACLE_SHA, "binary_sha256": hashlib.sha256(args.binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              "seed": args.seed, "checked": 0, "failed": 0, "failures": [], "passed": False}
    widths = (1, 2, 3, 8, 20, 40, 80, 120)

    def check(name, program, width, meta):
        request = {"op": "pretty", "program": program, "width": width, "meta": meta}
        expected, got = oracle.request(request), native.request(request)
        report["checked"] += 1
        if "text" not in expected or not expected["text"].startswith("Partial(") or not same(expected, got):
            report["failed"] += 1
            if len(report["failures"]) < 20:
                report["failures"].append({"name": name, "request": request,
                    "difference": first_difference(expected, got), "expected": expected, "got": got})
            if report["failed"] <= 5:
                print(json.dumps({"case": name, "width": width, "meta": meta,
                                  "path": first_difference(expected, got)["path"]}, ensure_ascii=False), file=sys.stderr)

    try:
        for name, program in directed():
            for width in widths:
                for meta in (None, "repl"):
                    check(name, program, width, meta)
        for index in range(args.programs):
            program = generated(rng)
            width = rng.choice(widths)
            for meta in (None, "repl"):
                check(f"generated-{index}", program, width, meta)
        report["passed"] = report["failed"] == 0
    finally:
        native.close()
        oracle.close()
        args.report.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        args.report.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in report.items() if k != "failures"}))
    return 0 if report["passed"] else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

## `packages/zig_runtime/tests/differential_source.py`

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/tests/differential_source.py","sha256":"bf6ccb0aebafda3dc035cd61fa6114d7e78394cf830f09409eacc51a2cb724ab","bytes":6985} -->
```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compare located source trees and captured contexts with actual loam.source."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import random
import shutil
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from differential import PACKAGE, ORACLE_SHA, Peer, first_difference, same, node, call


def syntax(rng, depth=3):
    if depth == 0:
        return rng.choice((str(rng.randrange(-100, 100)), '{}', '[]', 'todo',
                           json.dumps(rng.choice(('hello', '界', 'é', 'a\nb', '"\\')), ensure_ascii=False)))
    child = lambda: syntax(rng, depth - 1)
    choice = rng.randrange(13)
    if choice == 0:
        return f'let x = {child()} x'
    if choice == 1:
        return f'(x, y) -> {{ {child()} }}'
    if choice == 2:
        return f'!int_add({child()},   {child()})'
    if choice == 3:
        return f'{{foo: {child()}, bar: {child()}}}'
    if choice == 4:
        return f'[{child()}, {child()},]'
    if choice == 5:
        return f'Some({child()})'
    if choice == 6:
        return f'match Some({child()}) {{ Some(x) -> {{ x }} | (_) -> {{ {child()} }} }}'
    if choice == 7:
        return f'perform StandardOut({child()})'
    if choice == 8:
        return f'(x) -> {{ x }}({child()})'
    if choice == 9:
        return f'{{foo: {child()}}}.foo'
    if choice == 10:
        return f'let {{foo, bar: other}} = {child()} [foo,other]'
    if choice == 11:
        return f'[1, {child()}, ..tail]'
    return f'{{foo:{child()}, ..tail}}'


def context(rng, depth=4):
    body = 'perform Ping(42)'
    for index in range(rng.randrange(1, depth + 1)):
        choice = rng.randrange(7)
        if choice == 0:
            body = f'let result{index} = {body} {{result: result{index}, pending: [1,2,3]}}'
        elif choice == 1:
            body = f'let callable{index} = (local{index}) -> {{ {body} }} callable{index}({rng.randrange(100)})'
        elif choice == 2:
            body = f'!int_add({body}, {rng.randrange(100)})'
        elif choice == 3:
            body = f'{body}(0)'
        elif choice == 4:
            body = f'handle Other((value, resume) -> {{ resume }}, (_) -> {{ {body} }})'
        elif choice == 5:
            body = f'let captured{index} = (x) -> {{ {{x:x, content:"界"}} }} {body}'
        else:
            body = f'let {{a,b:c}} = {{a:1,b:2}} {body}'
    return f'handle Ping((value, resume) -> {{ resume }}, (_) -> {{ {body} }})'


def directed():
    yield 'empty-record', '{}'
    yield 'empty-list', '[]'
    yield 'trailing-comma-list', '[1,2,]'
    yield 'nested-spread-list', '[[1, ..xs], [2, ..ys]]'
    yield 'nested-spread-record', '{a:{b:2, ..r}, ..s}'
    yield 'record-shorthand', '{a,b,c}'
    yield 'record-trailing-comma', '{a:1,b:2,}'
    yield 'empty-pattern', 'let {} = {} 1'
    yield 'pattern-colons', '({a, b : c},d) -> { let {x:y,z} = d [a,c,y,z] }'
    yield 'match-cases', 'match Some(1) { Some(x) -> { x } Other(y) -> { y } }'
    yield 'open-match', 'match { Some(x) -> {x} | (_) -> {0} }'
    yield 'call-spaces', '!int_add(1,      2)'
    yield 'string-offsets', 'let x = "\\n界👩🏽‍💻\\\"" {x:x}.x'
    yield 'source-comments', '// leading comment\nlet x=42\r\n// comment\r\nx'
    yield 'shebang', '#!/usr/bin/env eyg\nlet x=42 x'
    yield 'disk-json', json.dumps(node('f', l='x', b=node('v', l='x')))
    yield 'import-reference', 'import "./quoted\\\".eyg"'


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument('--binary', type=Path, default=PACKAGE / 'work/source-runner')
    p.add_argument('--bun', default=os.environ.get('BUN') or shutil.which('bun') or '/workspace/tooling/bin/bun')
    p.add_argument('--programs', type=int, default=1000)
    p.add_argument('--contexts', type=int, default=300)
    p.add_argument('--seed', type=int, default=20261028)
    p.add_argument('--report', type=Path, default=PACKAGE / 'reports/source-metadata.json')
    args = p.parse_args()
    native = Peer([str(args.binary.resolve())])
    oracle = Peer([args.bun, str(PACKAGE / 'tests/oracle.mjs')])
    report = {'oracle': ORACLE_SHA, 'binary_sha256': hashlib.sha256(args.binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              'seed': args.seed, 'checked': 0, 'parsed_trees': 0, 'captured_contexts': 0,
              'failed': 0, 'failures': [], 'passed': False}
    rng = random.Random(args.seed)

    def check(name, request):
        expected, got = oracle.request(request), native.request(request)
        report['checked'] += 1
        if request['op'] == 'source_parse' and 'program' in expected:
            report['parsed_trees'] += 1
        if request['op'] == 'pretty_source' and expected.get('text', '').startswith('Partial('):
            report['captured_contexts'] += 1
        if not same(expected, got):
            report['failed'] += 1
            difference = first_difference(expected, got)
            if len(report['failures']) < 20:
                report['failures'].append({'name': name, 'request': request, 'difference': difference,
                                           'expected': expected, 'got': got})
            if report['failed'] <= 5:
                print(json.dumps({'name': name, 'difference': difference}, ensure_ascii=False)[:1000], file=sys.stderr)

    try:
        for name, text in directed():
            check(name, {'op': 'source_parse', 'source': text})
        for i in range(args.programs):
            check(f'tree-{i}', {'op': 'source_parse', 'source': syntax(rng, rng.randrange(1, 5))})
        for i in range(args.contexts):
            text = context(rng, depth=rng.randrange(1, 7))
            if i % 5 == 0:
                text = '#!/usr/bin/env eyg\n' + text
            check(f'context-{i}', {'op': 'pretty_source', 'source': text,
                                  'path': rng.choice(('/module.eyg', '/quoted"界.eyg', '/tmp/line\nbreak.eyg')),
                                  'origin': rng.choice(('disk', 'disk', 'inline', 'pipe', 'repl')),
                                  'width': rng.choice((1, 2, 8, 20, 40, 80, 120))})
        # JSON file annotations use Json throughout the same continuation tree.
        ping = call(node('p', l='Ping'), node('i', v=42))
        handler = node('f', l='value', b=node('f', l='resume', b=node('v', l='resume')))
        program = call(node('h', l='Ping'), handler, node('f', l='_', b=ping))
        check('json-context', {'op': 'pretty_source', 'source': json.dumps(program), 'path': '/module.eyg.json'})
        report['passed'] = report['failed'] == 0 and report['parsed_trees'] >= args.programs and report['captured_contexts'] == args.contexts + 1
    finally:
        native.close()
        oracle.close()
        args.report.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        args.report.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in report.items() if k != 'failures'}))
    return 0 if report['passed'] else 1


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
```

```zig
//! Validation-only transport. It never invokes an effect provider.
const std = @import("std");
const cast = @import("effect_cast");
const runtime = cast.runtime;
const J = runtime.Json;

pub fn main() !void {
    var input = std.io.bufferedReader(std.io.getStdIn().reader());
    const out = std.io.getStdOut().writer();
    while (true) {
        var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.heap.page_allocator);
        defer arena.deinit();
        const a = arena.allocator();
        const line = try input.reader().readUntilDelimiterOrEofAlloc(a, '\n', 16 * 1024 * 1024) orelse break;
        const request = (try std.json.parseFromSlice(J, a, line, .{ .allocate = .alloc_always })).value;
        var engine = runtime.Engine.init(a);
        const lift = try engine.fromJson(runtime.field(request, "lift"));
        const response = response: {
            cast.validate(&engine, runtime.stringField(request, "label") orelse "", lift) catch {
                break :response try runtime.object(a, &.{.{ "break", try engine.reasonJson(engine.failure.?) }});
            };
            break :response try runtime.object(a, &.{.{ "valid", .{ .bool = true } }});
        };
        try std.json.stringify(response, .{}, out);
        try out.writeByte('\n');
    }
}
```

```zig
//! Small interpreter-only test transport, useful while porting the terminal.
const std = @import("std");
const interpreter = @import("interpreter");
const J = std.json.Value;

pub fn main() !void {
    var reader = std.io.bufferedReader(std.io.getStdIn().reader());
    const writer = std.io.getStdOut().writer();
    while (true) {
        var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.heap.page_allocator);
        defer arena.deinit();
        const a = arena.allocator();
        const line = try reader.reader().readUntilDelimiterOrEofAlloc(a, '\n', 16 * 1024 * 1024) orelse break;
        const parsed = try std.json.parseFromSlice(J, a, line, .{});
        const request = parsed.value.object;
        var fixture = std.json.ObjectMap.init(a);
        try fixture.put("source", request.get("program") orelse .null);
        if (request.get("effects")) |effects| try fixture.put("effects", effects);
        const response = try interpreter.evaluateFixture(a, .{ .object = fixture });
        try std.json.stringify(response, .{}, writer);
        try writer.writeByte('\n');
    }
}
```

```javascript
// Fixture loading and evaluation use the pinned Gleam cache, not a JS cache port.
import {createInterface} from 'node:readline';
import {fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL} from 'node:url';
import {resolve, dirname} from 'node:path';
import {handle as common, encodeValue, encodeBreak} from './oracle.mjs';

const root = resolve(process.env.EYG_ORACLE_ROOT || resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../../../work/oracle-next-tui'));
const build = resolve(root, 'packages/gleam_cli/build/dev/javascript');
const load = path => import(pathToFileURL(resolve(build, path)).href);
const [runtime, json, codec, expression, cache, dict, cidV1] = await Promise.all([
  'eyg_cli/gleam.mjs', 'gleam_json/gleam/json.mjs', 'eyg_ir/eyg/ir/dag_json.mjs',
  'eyg_interpreter/eyg/interpreter/expression.mjs', 'eyg_hub/eyg/hub/cache.mjs',
  'gleam_stdlib/gleam/dict.mjs', 'multiformats/multiformats/cid/v1.mjs',
].map(load));
const cls = value => value?.constructor?.name;
const decode = source => {
  const result = json.parse(JSON.stringify(source), codec.decoder(null));
  if (cls(result) !== 'Ok') throw new Error('invalid fixture IR');
  return result[0];
};

function handle(request) {
  if (request.op === 'package_metadata' || request.op === 'hub_fixture') return common(request);
  const packages = common({...request, op: 'package_metadata'}).packages;
  let current = cache.empty();
  const entries = packages.map(p => ({...p, cid: cidV1.from_string(p.cid)[0][0]}));
  current.packages = dict.from_list(runtime.toList(entries.map(p => [p.name, new cache.Entry(p.version, p.cid, 1, 1, p.cid)])));
  current.releases = dict.from_list(runtime.toList(entries.map(p => [[p.name, p.version], p.cid])));
  for (const p of entries) current = cache.fetch_module_completed(current, p.cid, new runtime.Ok(decode(p.program)))[0];
  let result = expression.execute(decode(request.program), runtime.toList([]));
  result = cache.static_loop(result, current, expression.resume);
  return cls(result) === 'Ok' ? {value: encodeValue(result[0])} : {break: encodeBreak(result[0][0])};
}

for await (const line of createInterface({input: process.stdin, crlfDelay: Infinity})) {
  try { process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(handle(JSON.parse(line))) + '\n'); }
  catch (error) { process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({adapter_error: String(error), stack: error.stack}) + '\n'); }
}
```

```zig
//! Read-only hub/cache transport for content-ID and offline/live integration tests.
const std = @import("std");
const hub = @import("hub");
const runtime = hub.runtime;
const J = std.json.Value;

pub fn main() !void {
    var input = std.io.bufferedReader(std.io.getStdIn().reader());
    const writer = std.io.getStdOut().writer();
    while (true) {
        var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.heap.page_allocator);
        defer arena.deinit();
        const a = arena.allocator();
        const line = try input.reader().readUntilDelimiterOrEofAlloc(a, '\n', 64 * 1024 * 1024) orelse break;
        const request = (try std.json.parseFromSlice(J, a, line, .{ .allocate = .alloc_always })).value;
        const response = handle(a, request) catch |err| try runtime.object(a, &.{.{ "error", .{ .string = @errorName(err) } }});
        try std.json.stringify(response, .{}, writer);
        try writer.writeByte('\n');
    }
}
fn reference(context: ?*anyopaque, engine: *runtime.Engine, ir: J) anyerror!runtime.Value {
    const cache: *hub.Cache = @ptrCast(@alignCast(context.?));
    return cache.resolve(engine, ir);
}
fn handle(a: std.mem.Allocator, request: J) !J {
    const op = runtime.stringField(request, "op") orelse "";
    const program = runtime.field(request, "program");
    if (std.mem.eql(u8, op, "cid")) return runtime.object(a, &.{
        .{ "cid", .{ .string = try hub.canonicalCID(a, program) } },
        .{ "bytes", .{ .string = try hub.canonicalBytes(a, program) } },
    });
    var cache = try hub.Cache.init(a, runtime.stringField(request, "origin") orelse "https://eyg.run");
    if (std.mem.eql(u8, op, "verify")) {
        _ = try cache.ingestModule(runtime.stringField(request, "cid") orelse return error.MissingCid, runtime.stringField(request, "bytes") orelse return error.MissingBytes);
        return runtime.object(a, &.{.{ "verified", .{ .bool = true } }});
    }
    const fixtures = runtime.field(request, "packages");
    if (fixtures != .null) try cache.ingestPackages(fixtures);
    if (std.mem.eql(u8, op, "pull")) {
        try cache.pull();
        const entries = try cache.packageList(a);
        return (try std.json.parseFromSlice(J, a, try std.json.stringifyAlloc(a, entries, .{}), .{})).value;
    }
    var engine = runtime.Engine.init(a);
    engine.reference_context = &cache;
    engine.reference_handler = reference;
    return engine.evaluate(program);
}
```

```javascript
// Calls the actual next-tui checker, including its runtime scope conversion.
import { createInterface } from 'node:readline';
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { resolve, dirname } from 'node:path';
const root = resolve(process.env.EYG_ORACLE_ROOT || resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../../../work/oracle-next-tui'));
const build = resolve(root, 'packages/gleam_cli/build/dev/javascript');
const load = path => import(pathToFileURL(resolve(build, path)).href);
const [runtime,json,codec,infer,debug,computer,iface,expression,analysis,dict] = await Promise.all([
  'eyg_cli/gleam.mjs', 'gleam_json/gleam/json.mjs', 'eyg_ir/eyg/ir/dag_json.mjs',
  'eyg_analysis/eyg/analysis/inference/levels_j/contextual.mjs',
  'eyg_analysis/eyg/analysis/type_/binding/debug.mjs',
  'loam/loam/platform/computer.mjs', 'touch_grass/touch_grass/interface.mjs',
  'eyg_interpreter/eyg/interpreter/expression.mjs', 'morph/morph/analysis.mjs',
  'gleam_stdlib/gleam/dict.mjs',
].map(load));
function annotate(source, tree, depths, depth = 0) {
  tree[1] = source._native_node;
  depths.set(source._native_node, depth);
  if (source['0'] === 'a') {
    annotate(source.f, tree[0].func, depths, depth + 1);
    annotate(source.a, tree[0].argument, depths, depth + 1);
  } else if (source['0'] === 'l') {
    annotate(source.v, tree[0].definition, depths, depth + 1);
    annotate(source.t, tree[0].body, depths, depth + 1);
  } else if (source['0'] === 'f') annotate(source.b, tree[0].body, depths, depth + 1);
}
export function check(request) {
  const input = request.program;
  let scope = runtime.toList([]);
  for (const entry of request.scope || []) {
    const parsed = json.parse(JSON.stringify(entry.program), codec.decoder(null))[0];
    const result = expression.execute(parsed, scope);
    if (result.constructor.name !== 'Ok') throw new Error('binding program failed');
    scope = runtime.toList([[entry.name, result[0]], ...scope]);
  }
  const tree = json.parse(JSON.stringify(input), codec.decoder(null))[0];
  const depths = new Map();
  annotate(input, tree, depths);
  const context = infer.with_effects(infer.pure(), iface.types(computer.effects()));
  const [bindings, env] = analysis.env_to_tenv(scope, null);
  context.level = 0; context.bindings = bindings; context.env = env;
  const checked = infer.check_with_references(context, dict.new$(), tree);
  const errors = Array.from(infer.all_errors(checked));
  const info = {};
  for (const id of depths.keys()) {
    const found = infer.info_at(checked, id)[0];
    if (!found) continue;
    info[id] = {
      type: debug.mono(found.type_),
      problem: found.status.constructor.name === 'Error' ? debug.reason(found.status[0]) : null,
      effect: debug.effect(found.effect),
    };
  }
  return {
    root_type: debug.mono(infer.type_(checked)),
    error_count: errors.filter(([id,e]) => e.constructor.name !== 'MissingReference' && !(e.constructor.name === 'Todo' && depths.get(id) < 2)).length,
    loading_count: errors.filter(([,e]) => e.constructor.name === 'MissingReference').length,
    info,
  };
}
const lines = createInterface({ input: process.stdin });
for await (const line of lines) {
  try { console.log(JSON.stringify(check(JSON.parse(line)))); }
  catch (error) { console.log(JSON.stringify({ error: String(error) })); }
}
```

```zig
const std = @import("std");
const core = @import("eyg_native");
const inference = core.inference;
const runtime = core.interpreter;
const J = std.json.Value;
pub fn main() !void {
    var reader = std.io.bufferedReader(std.io.getStdIn().reader());
    while (true) {
        var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.heap.page_allocator);
        defer arena.deinit();
        const a = arena.allocator();
        const line = try reader.reader().readUntilDelimiterOrEofAlloc(a, '\n', 16 * 1024 * 1024) orelse break;
        const input = try std.json.parseFromSlice(J, a, line, .{});
        var engine = runtime.Engine.init(a);
        const scope = runtime.field(input.value, "scope");
        if (scope == .array) for (scope.array.items) |b| {
            const value = try engine.eval(runtime.field(b, "program"));
            try engine.bind(runtime.stringField(b, "name").?, value);
        };
        const result = try inference.analyze(a, runtime.field(input.value, "program"), engine.scope);
        var map = std.json.ObjectMap.init(a);
        try map.put("root_type", .{ .string = result.root_type });
        try map.put("error_count", .{ .integer = @intCast(result.error_count) });
        try map.put("loading_count", .{ .integer = @intCast(result.loading_count) });
        var info = std.json.ObjectMap.init(a);
        var it = result.info.iterator();
        while (it.next()) |entry| {
            var fields = std.json.ObjectMap.init(a);
            try fields.put("type", .{ .string = entry.value_ptr.type_text });
            try fields.put("problem", if (entry.value_ptr.problem) |p| .{ .string = p } else .null);
            try fields.put("effect", .{ .string = entry.value_ptr.effect_text });
            try info.put(try std.fmt.allocPrint(a, "{d}", .{entry.key_ptr.*}), .{ .object = fields });
        }
        try map.put("info", .{ .object = info });
        try std.json.stringify(J{ .object = map }, .{}, std.io.getStdOut().writer());
        try std.io.getStdOut().writeAll("\n");
    }
}
```

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/tests/malformed_ir.py","sha256":"68aca2967f1a5f63755ccd7d3607d7fb8bc559ca668d79194f96b000aa51c43d","bytes":8588} -->

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Mutate canonical IR fields and compare decoding to the pinned Gleam oracle.

Includes accepted noncanonical encodings as well as malformed input: preserving
an oracle's codec contract includes accepting its aliases and rejecting unsafe
integers before evaluation.
Build the isolated transport without replacing the interactive binary:
  zig build-exe -OReleaseFast --dep eyg_interpreter \
    -Mroot=tests/evaluation_runner.zig -Meyg_interpreter=src/interpreter.zig \
    -femit-bin=work/evaluation-validation
"""
import argparse, base64, copy, hashlib, json, os, random, shutil, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
from differential import PACKAGE, ORACLE, ORACLE_SHA, Peer, node, generated_program, same, first_difference


def varint(value, extra=0):
    out = bytearray()
    while value >= 128:
        out.append((value & 127) | 128); value >>= 7
    if extra:
        out.append(value | 128); out.extend([128] * (extra - 1)); out.append(0)
    else: out.append(value)
    return bytes(out)


def cid(raw, padded=False):
    text = base64.b32encode(raw).decode().lower()
    return 'b' + (text if padded else text.rstrip('='))


def cases(rng, count):
    originals = [node('i', v=1), node('s', v='s'), node('v', l='x'), node('z'),
                 node('f', l='x', b=node('v', l='x')), node('l', l='x', v=node('i', v=1), t=node('v', l='x')),
                 node('a', f=node('f', l='x', b=node('v', l='x')), a=node('i', v=1)),
                 node('x', v={'/': {'bytes': 'AQ'}}), node('@', p='standard'), node('.', i='./a.eyg')]
    for tag in ('c','ta','u','n','e','g','o','t','m','p','h','b'):
        originals.append(node(tag, **({} if tag in ('c','ta','u','n') else {'l':'label'})))
    raw = varint(1) + varint(297) + varint(18) + varint(32) + bytes(range(32))
    originals += [node('#', l={'/':cid(raw)}), node('@', p='standard', r=3, l={'/':cid(raw)})]
    for program in originals: yield 'baseline', program
    for base in originals:
        for key in list(base):
            mutated=copy.deepcopy(base); del mutated[key]; yield 'missing-field',mutated
            for value in [None,False,True,1,1.0,1.5,'',[],{},['0']]:
                mutated=copy.deepcopy(base);mutated[key]=value;yield 'field-type',mutated
        mutated=copy.deepcopy(base);mutated['extra']={'garbage':True};yield 'extra-field',mutated
    for number in [0.0,1.0,-0.0,1.5,-9007199254740991,9007199254740991,9007199254740992,9007199254740993,-9007199254740992,9223372036854775807,1e99]:
        yield 'integer-edge', node('i',v=number)
        yield 'version-edge', node('@',p='standard',r=number)
    for encoded in ['', 'AQ', 'AQ==', 'AR', 'AR==', 'A Q\n', '\tAQ\r\n', 'A=', 'A===', '====', 'AAA=', 'AAAA', 'AAAA=', 'AQ-_', 'AQ+/', 'A\vQ', 'A\fQ', 'AA\u00a0', 'AA', 'A', '###', 'Zg=']:
        yield 'base64-edge',node('x',v={'/':{'bytes':encoded}})
    for size in [0,1,2,3,4,5,8,16,32]:
        for codec in [0,85,113,297,2**32-1,2**53,2**63,2**64,2**127,2**128,2**511,2**1023]:
            for extra in [0,1]:
                raw = varint(1,extra)+varint(codec,extra)+varint(18,extra)+varint(size,extra)+bytes([255])*size
                text=cid(raw)
                for alias in [text,'b'+text[1:].upper(),cid(raw,True),cid(raw+b'trailing')]:
                    yield 'cid-alias',node('#',l={'/':alias})
    # Unknown fields and encoding aliases are discarded by decoding even
    # inside function bodies; closure equality exposes that normalization.
    reference=cid(varint(1)+varint(297)+varint(18)+varint(32)+bytes(range(32)))
    bodies=[(node('v',l='x',_native_node=1),node('v',l='x',_native_node=2)),
            (node('i',v=1),node('i',v=1.0,extra=True)),
            (node('x',v={'/':{'bytes':'AQ'}}),node('x',v={'/':{'bytes':'AR=='}})),
            (node('#',l={'/':reference}),node('#',l={'/':'b'+reference[1:].upper()}))]
    for left,right in bodies:
        function=node('b',l='equal')
        for body in (left,right):function=node('a',f=function,a=node('f',l='x',b=body))
        yield 'closure-normalization',function
    values=[None,True,False,0,1.0,1.5,'',[],{},'a',{'/':'bad'},{'/':{'bytes':'!'}}]
    for index in range(count):
        choice=rng.randrange(5)
        if choice==0:
            original=copy.deepcopy(rng.choice(originals));key=rng.choice(['0','f','a','v','t','b','l','p','r','i']);original[key]=copy.deepcopy(rng.choice(values));yield 'random-field',original
        elif choice==1:
            encoded=''.join(rng.choices('ABab09+/=_-! \n\t\r',k=rng.randrange(30)));yield 'random-base64',node('x',v={'/':{'bytes':encoded}})
        elif choice==2:
            raw=varint(rng.choice([0,1,2,4]))+varint(rng.randrange(512))+varint(rng.choice([0,18,19]))+varint(rng.randrange(5))+rng.randbytes(rng.randrange(5))
            yield 'random-cid',node('#',l={'/':cid(raw)})
        elif choice==3:
            program=generated_program(rng,depth=2)
            if isinstance(program,dict):program[rng.choice(['0','f','a','b','v','t'])]=copy.deepcopy(rng.choice(values))
            yield 'nested-mutation',program
        else:
            program=node('@',p=rng.choice(['','standard',None,1]),r=rng.choice(values))
            if rng.randrange(2):program['l']=rng.choice([None,{}, {'/':cid(varint(1)+varint(297)+varint(18)+varint(0))},{'/':'bad'}])
            yield 'random-release',program


def main():
    args=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    args.add_argument('--binary',type=Path,default=PACKAGE/'work/evaluation-validation')
    args.add_argument('--bun',default=os.environ.get('BUN') or shutil.which('bun') or '/workspace/tooling/bin/bun')
    args.add_argument('--seed',type=int,default=20261028)
    args.add_argument('--cases',type=int,default=2000)
    args.add_argument('--report',type=Path,default=PACKAGE/'reports/malformed-ir.json')
    options=args.parse_args()
    actual=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ORACLE,text=True).strip()
    if actual!=ORACLE_SHA:raise SystemExit('oracle revision mismatch')
    if subprocess.run(['git','diff','--quiet','HEAD','--'],cwd=ORACLE).returncode:raise SystemExit('oracle tracked source is dirty')
    native=Peer([str(options.binary.resolve())]);oracle=Peer([options.bun,str(PACKAGE/'tests/oracle.mjs')])
    report={'seed':options.seed,'oracle':ORACLE_SHA,'binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256(options.binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'checked':0,'failed':0,'categories':{},'failures':[],'oracle_crashes':[],'native_rejections_of_oracle_crashes':0}
    started=time.monotonic()
    try:
        for category,program in cases(random.Random(options.seed),options.cases):
            request={'op':'eval','program':program};expected=oracle.request(request);got=native.request(request)
            report['checked']+=1;report['categories'][category]=report['categories'].get(category,0)+1
            if 'adapter_error' in expected:
                # This is a bug observed in the actual oracle decoder, not a
                # successful decode or an evaluation result. Retain the exact
                # reproducers separately; require the native boundary to reject.
                report['oracle_crashes'].append({'category':category,'request':request,'error':expected['adapter_error'],'native':got})
                if got=={'decode_error':True}:
                    report['native_rejections_of_oracle_crashes']+=1
                    continue
            if not same(expected,got):
                report['failed']+=1
                failure={'category':category,'request':request,'expected':expected,'got':got,'difference':first_difference(expected,got)}
                if len(report['failures'])<30:report['failures'].append(failure)
                if report['failed']<=5:print(json.dumps(failure,ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
        report['comparable']=report['checked']-len(report['oracle_crashes'])
        report['oracle_crash_count']=len(report['oracle_crashes'])
        report['passed']=report['failed']==0
        report['limitation']='Oracle decoder crashes are recorded separately; native rejects those malformed trees safely rather than reproducing host stack overflows.'
    finally:
        native.close();oracle.close();report['seconds']=round(time.monotonic()-started,3)
        options.report.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);options.report.write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in report.items() if k not in ('failures','oracle_crashes')}))
    return 0 if report.get('passed') else 1
if __name__=='__main__':raise SystemExit(main())
```
