<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/tests/oracle.mjs","sha256":"ba1f67c2c0b7e794a5113a42675789e050c9d03036ce533dd74c4a633b9eb148","bytes":16587} -->
```javascript
// Thin adapter around the pinned, compiled Gleam implementation. No EYG or TUI
// semantics are reimplemented here. This intentionally lives outside the oracle.
import { createInterface } from 'node:readline';
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { resolve, dirname } from 'node:path';
import { isDeepStrictEqual } from 'node:util';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';

const here = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const root = resolve(process.env.EYG_ORACLE_ROOT || resolve(here, '../../../work/oracle-next-tui'));
const build = resolve(root, 'packages/gleam_cli/build/dev/javascript');
const load = (path) => import(pathToFileURL(resolve(build, path)).href);
const [runtime, json, dict, codec, expression, values, breaks, state, view, backend,
  geometry, buffer, execute, cache, origin, sandbox, lexer, token, parser, ir, input, sourceParser,
  cidV1, hashes, response, hubSchema, publisher, simpleDebug, sourceLocation] = await Promise.all([
  'eyg_cli/gleam.mjs', 'gleam_json/gleam/json.mjs', 'gleam_stdlib/gleam/dict.mjs',
  'eyg_ir/eyg/ir/dag_json.mjs', 'eyg_interpreter/eyg/interpreter/expression.mjs',
  'eyg_interpreter/eyg/interpreter/value.mjs', 'eyg_interpreter/eyg/interpreter/break.mjs',
  'eyg_cli/eyg/cli/tui/state.mjs', 'eyg_cli/eyg/cli/tui/view.mjs',
  'etui/etui/backend.mjs', 'etui/etui/geometry.mjs', 'etui/etui/buffer.mjs',
  'loam/loam/execute.mjs', 'eyg_hub/eyg/hub/cache.mjs', 'ogre/ogre/origin.mjs',
  'loam/loam/sandbox.mjs',
  'eyg_parser/eyg/parser/lexer.mjs', 'eyg_parser/eyg/parser/token.mjs', 'eyg_parser/eyg/parser/parser.mjs',
  'eyg_ir/eyg/ir/tree.mjs',
  'etui/etui/input.mjs',
  'eyg_parser/eyg/parser.mjs',
  'multiformats/multiformats/cid/v1.mjs', 'multiformats/multiformats/hashes.mjs',
  'gleam_http/gleam/http/response.mjs',
  'eyg_hub/eyg/hub/schema.mjs', 'eyg_hub/eyg/hub/publisher.mjs',
  'eyg_interpreter/eyg/interpreter/simple_debug.mjs',
  'loam/loam/source.mjs',
].map(load));

const list = (items) => runtime.toList(items);
const array = (items) => Array.from(items);
const cls = (x) => x?.constructor?.name;
const color = (c) => cls(c) === 'Default' ? null : cls(c) === 'Indexed' ? c[0] : [c[0], c[1], c[2]];

export function encodeValue(v) {
  if (v instanceof values.Integer) return { integer: v.value };
  if (v instanceof values.String) return { string: v.value };
  if (v instanceof values.Binary) return { binary: { '/': { bytes: Buffer.from(v.value.rawBuffer).toString('base64').replace(/=+$/, '') } } };
  if (v instanceof values.LinkedList) return { list: array(v.elements).map(encodeValue) };
  if (v instanceof values.Record) return { record: Object.fromEntries(array(dict.to_list(v.fields)).map(([k,v]) => [k, encodeValue(v)])) };
  if (v instanceof values.Tagged) return { tagged: { label: v.label, value: encodeValue(v.value) } };
  if (v instanceof values.Closure || v instanceof values.Partial) return { function: true };
  throw new Error(`unknown oracle value ${cls(v)}`);
}

function decodeValue(v) {
  if ('integer' in v) return new values.Integer(v.integer);
  if ('string' in v) return new values.String(v.string);
  if ('binary' in v) return new values.Binary(runtime.toBitArray([Uint8Array.from(Buffer.from(v.binary['/'].bytes, 'base64'))]));
  if ('list' in v) return new values.LinkedList(list(v.list.map(decodeValue)));
  if ('record' in v) return new values.Record(dict.from_list(list(Object.entries(v.record).map(([k,v]) => [k, decodeValue(v)]))));
  if ('tagged' in v) return new values.Tagged(v.tagged.label, decodeValue(v.tagged.value));
  throw new Error(`not a fixture value: ${JSON.stringify(v)}`);
}

export function encodeBreak(reason) {
  if (reason instanceof breaks.UndefinedVariable) return { UndefinedVariable: reason.variable };
  if (reason instanceof breaks.UndefinedBuiltin) return { UndefinedBuiltin: reason.identifier };
  if (reason instanceof breaks.Vacant) return { NotImplemented: '' };
  if (reason instanceof breaks.NotAFunction) return { NotAFunction: encodeValue(reason.value) };
  if (reason instanceof breaks.NoMatch) return { NoMatch: encodeValue(reason.term) };
  if (reason instanceof breaks.MissingField) return { MissingField: reason.label };
  if (reason instanceof breaks.IncorrectTerm) return { IncorrectTerm: { expected: reason.expected, got: encodeValue(reason.got) } };
  if (reason instanceof breaks.UnhandledEffect) return { UnhandledEffect: { label: reason.label, value: encodeValue(reason.value) } };
  if (reason instanceof breaks.Unrepresentable) return { Unrepresentable: { builtin: reason.builtin, args: array(reason.args).map(encodeValue) } };
  if (reason instanceof breaks.UndefinedReference) return { UndefinedReference: JSON.parse(codec.to_string([new ir.Reference(reason.reference), null])) };
  throw new Error(`unknown oracle break ${cls(reason)}`);
}

export function evaluate(request) {
  const decoded = json.parse(JSON.stringify(request.program), codec.decoder(null));
  if (cls(decoded) !== 'Ok') return { decode_error: true };
  let result = expression.execute(decoded[0], list([]));
  const observed = [];
  for (const effect of request.effects || []) {
    const reason = result[0]?.[0];
    if (cls(result) !== 'Error' || !(reason instanceof breaks.UnhandledEffect)) {
      return { effect_mismatch: { expected: effect, got: cls(result) } };
    }
    const got = { label: reason.label, lift: encodeValue(reason.value) };
    observed.push(got);
    if (!isDeepStrictEqual(got, {label: effect.label, lift: effect.lift})) {
      return { effect_mismatch: { expected: effect, got } };
    }
    result = expression.resume(decodeValue(effect.reply), result[0][2], result[0][3]);
  }
  return cls(result) === 'Ok' ? { value: encodeValue(result[0]) } : { break: encodeBreak(result[0][0]) };
}

export function pretty(request) {
  const meta = request.meta === 'repl' ? new sourceLocation.Location(sourceLocation.Origin$Repl$const, sourceLocation.Source$Json$const) : undefined;
  const decoded = json.parse(JSON.stringify(request.program), codec.decoder(meta));
  if (cls(decoded) !== 'Ok') return {decode_error:true};
  const result = expression.execute(decoded[0], list([]));
  return cls(result) === 'Ok' ? {text:simpleDebug.render(result[0], request.width ?? 80)} : {break:encodeBreak(result[0][0])};
}

// Source annotations are observable inside captured continuations. Ask the
// actual loam parser to retain them; this adapter only transports its nodes.
export function prettySource(request) {
  const origin = request.origin === 'inline' ? sourceLocation.Origin$Inline$const
    : request.origin === 'pipe' ? sourceLocation.Origin$Pipe$const
    : request.origin === 'repl' ? sourceLocation.Origin$Repl$const
    : new sourceLocation.Disk(request.path ?? '/module.eyg');
  const parsed = sourceLocation.parse(request.source, origin);
  if (cls(parsed) !== 'Ok') return {parse_error:true};
  if (request.op === 'source_parse') {
    const withSpans = (node) => {
      const [expression, location] = node;
      const json = JSON.parse(codec.to_string(node));
      if (location.source instanceof sourceLocation.Text) json._span = location.source.span;
      if (expression instanceof ir.Apply) {
        json.f = withSpans(expression.func);
        json.a = withSpans(expression.argument);
      } else if (expression instanceof ir.Lambda) json.b = withSpans(expression.body);
      else if (expression instanceof ir.Let) {
        json.v = withSpans(expression.definition);
        json.t = withSpans(expression.body);
      }
      return json;
    };
    return {program:withSpans(parsed[0])};
  }
  const result = expression.execute(parsed[0], list([]));
  return cls(result) === 'Ok' ? {text:simpleDebug.render(result[0], request.width ?? 80)} : {break:encodeBreak(result[0][0])};
}

function frame(current, width, height) {
  const rendered = view.render(current, geometry.rect_new(0, 0, width, height));
  const cells = [];
  for (let y = 0; y < height; ++y) for (let x = 0; x < width; ++x) {
    const cell = buffer.get_cell(rendered, new geometry.Position(x, y));
    cells.push({
      symbol: buffer.cell_symbol(cell),
      width: buffer.is_continuation(cell) ? 0 : cell.content.width,
      fg: color(cell.style.fg), bg: color(cell.style.bg),
      modifiers: cell.style.modifier.bits, sub_modifiers: cell.style.sub_modifier.bits,
      underline_color: color(cell.style.underline_color), link: cell.link,
    });
  }
  return { width, height, cells };
}

function fixturePackages(request) {
  const packages = [];
  for (const [name, fixture] of Object.entries(request.packages || {})) {
    const decoded = json.parse(JSON.stringify(fixture.program), codec.decoder(null));
    if (cls(decoded) !== 'Ok') throw new Error(`invalid package fixture ${name}`);
    const bytes = codec.to_block(decoded[0]);
    const digest = createHash('sha256').update(Buffer.from(bytes.rawBuffer)).digest();
    const cid = new cidV1.Cid(297, new hashes.Multihash(hashes.Algorithm$Sha256$const, runtime.toBitArray([new Uint8Array(digest)])));
    const cidText = cidV1.to_string(cid);
    if (fixture.cid && fixture.cid !== cidText) throw new Error(`package fixture CID mismatch ${name}: ${fixture.cid} != ${cidText}`);
    packages.push({name, version: fixture.version ?? 1, cid, cidText, bytes, program: fixture.program});
  }
  const initial = cache.empty();
  initial.packages = dict.from_list(list(packages.map(p => [p.name, new cache.Entry(p.version, p.cid, 1, 1, p.cid)])));
  initial.releases = dict.from_list(list(packages.map(p => [[p.name, p.version], p.cid])));
  return {initial, packages};
}

function httpHubFixture(request) {
  const fixtures = fixturePackages(request).packages;
  const modules = {}, entries = [];
  for (const [index, p] of fixtures.entries()) {
    modules[p.cidText] = Buffer.from(p.bytes.rawBuffer).toString('base64');
    const payload = JSON.stringify({sequence:p.version,previous:null,signatory:{'/':p.cidText},key:'fixture-key',type:'release',content:{package:p.name,version:p.version,module:{'/':p.cidText}}});
    if (cls(json.parse(payload, publisher.decoder())) !== 'Ok') throw new Error('invalid fixture publisher entry');
    const digest = createHash('sha256').update(payload).digest();
    const entryCid = cidV1.to_string(new cidV1.Cid(297, new hashes.Multihash(hashes.Algorithm$Sha256$const, runtime.toBitArray([new Uint8Array(digest)]))));
    entries.push({cursor:index+1,cid:{'/':entryCid},payload,entity:{'/':p.cidText},sequence:p.version,type:'release'});
  }
  const ledger = {entries};
  if (cls(json.parse(JSON.stringify(ledger), hubSchema.pull_response_decoder())) !== 'Ok') throw new Error('invalid fixture ledger');
  return {ledger,modules};
}

export function tui(request) {
  let width = request.width ?? 80, height = request.height ?? 24;
  const fixtures = fixturePackages(request);
  let current = state.init(list([]), new execute.State(origin.https('eyg.test'), fixtures.initial));
  let world = sandbox.sandbox();
  for (const [path, text] of Object.entries(request.files || {})) world = sandbox.with_file(world, resolve('/', path), text);
  if (fixtures.packages.length) world = sandbox.with_network(world, (request, accumulator) => {
    const module = fixtures.packages.find(p => request.path.includes(p.cidText));
    return [new runtime.Ok(response.set_body(response.new$(module ? 200 : 404), module ? module.bytes : runtime.toBitArray([]))), accumulator];
  }, undefined);
  const frames = [frame(current, width, height)];
  for (const event of request.events || []) {
    if (event.resize) [width, height] = event.resize;
    else {
      const input = event.paste !== undefined ? new backend.Paste(event.paste)
        : event.tick ? backend.InputEvent$Tick$const : new backend.KeyPress(event.key);
      let result = state.update(current, new state.Input(input));
      current = result[0];
      const pending = array(result[1]);
      let budget = 1000;
      while (pending.length) {
        if (!budget--) throw new Error('oracle effect budget exhausted');
        const [outcome, nextWorld] = sandbox.run(pending.shift(), world);
        world = nextWorld;
        if (!(outcome instanceof sandbox.Returned)) throw new Error('oracle TUI exited');
        result = state.update(current, new state.Task(outcome[0]));
        current = result[0];
        pending.push(...array(result[1]));
      }
    }
    frames.push(frame(current, width, height));
  }
  return { frames };
}

export function benchmark(request) {
  const width = request.width ?? 80, height = request.height ?? 24;
  const samples_ns = [];
  for (let iteration = 0; iteration < (request.iterations ?? 100); ++iteration) {
    let current = state.init(list([]), new execute.State(origin.https('eyg.test'), cache.empty()));
    let world = sandbox.sandbox();
    frame(current, width, height);
    for (const event of request.events || []) {
      const started = performance.now();
      const input = event.paste !== undefined ? new backend.Paste(event.paste) : new backend.KeyPress(event.key);
      let result = state.update(current, new state.Input(input));
      current = result[0];
      const pending = array(result[1]);
      let budget = 1000;
      while (pending.length) {
        if (!budget--) throw new Error('oracle effect budget exhausted');
        const [outcome, nextWorld] = sandbox.run(pending.shift(), world);
        world = nextWorld;
        if (!(outcome instanceof sandbox.Returned)) throw new Error('oracle TUI exited');
        result = state.update(current, new state.Task(outcome[0]));
        current = result[0];
        pending.push(...array(result[1]));
      }
      frame(current, width, height);
      samples_ns.push(Math.round((performance.now() - started) * 1e6));
    }
  }
  return { samples_ns };
}

export function handle(request) {
  if (request.op === 'eval') return evaluate(request);
  if (request.op === 'pretty') return pretty(request);
  if (request.op === 'pretty_source' || request.op === 'source_parse') return prettySource(request);
  if (request.op === 'tui') return tui(request);
  if (request.op === 'bench_tui') return benchmark(request);
  if (request.op === 'package_metadata') return {packages: fixturePackages(request).packages.map(p => ({name:p.name,version:p.version,cid:p.cidText,program:p.program}))};
  if (request.op === 'hub_fixture') return httpHubFixture(request);
  if (request.op === 'input') {
    const parsed = input.parse(request.text);
    const events = [...array(parsed.events), ...request.flush ? array(input.flush(parsed.remainder)) : []];
    const mouseButton = (b) => cls(b) === 'MouseLeft' ? 'left' : cls(b) === 'MouseMiddle' ? 'middle' : 'right';
    return {events: events.map(e => {
      if (e instanceof backend.KeyPress) return {key:e.key};
      if (e instanceof backend.Paste) return {paste:e.text};
      if (e instanceof backend.MouseScroll) return {mouse:{kind:'scroll',x:e.x,y:e.y,up:e.up}};
      if (e instanceof backend.MouseMove) return {mouse:{kind:'move',x:e.x,y:e.y}};
      const kind = e instanceof backend.MousePress ? 'press' : e instanceof backend.MouseRelease ? 'release' : 'drag';
      return {mouse:{kind,x:e.x,y:e.y,button:mouseButton(e.button)}};
    }), remainder: request.flush ? '' : parsed.remainder};
  }
  if (request.op === 'parse') {
    const parsed = parser.block(token.drop_comments(token.drop_whitespace(lexer.lex(request.source))));
    if (cls(parsed) !== 'Ok') return { parse_error: true };
    return { program: JSON.parse(codec.to_string(parsed[0][0])) };
  }
  if (request.op === 'diagnostic') {
    const parsed = sourceParser.all_from_string(request.source);
    return {message: cls(parsed) === 'Ok' ? '' : sourceParser.format_error(parsed[0], request.source)};
  }
  throw new Error(`unknown op ${request.op}`);
}

if (process.argv[1] && resolve(process.argv[1]) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) {
  for await (const line of createInterface({input: process.stdin, crlfDelay: Infinity})) {
    try {
      // Some upstream morph cases print diagnostic messages. Keep their real
      // side effects on stderr without corrupting this adapter's JSONL channel.
      const originalLog = console.log;
      let result;
      try {
        console.log = (...parts) => process.stderr.write(parts.map(String).join(' ') + '\n');
        result = handle(JSON.parse(line));
      } finally { console.log = originalLog; }
      process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(result) + '\n');
    }
    catch (error) { process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({adapter_error: String(error), stack: error.stack}) + '\n'); }
  }
}
```

```zig
//! Parser-only transport for developing the syntax port independently.
const std = @import("std");
const parser = @import("parser");
const J = std.json.Value;

pub fn main() !void {
    var reader = std.io.bufferedReader(std.io.getStdIn().reader());
    const writer = std.io.getStdOut().writer();
    while (true) {
        var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.heap.page_allocator);
        defer arena.deinit();
        const a = arena.allocator();
        const line = try reader.reader().readUntilDelimiterOrEofAlloc(a, '\n', 16 * 1024 * 1024) orelse break;
        const parsed = try std.json.parseFromSlice(J, a, line, .{});
        const request = parsed.value.object;
        const source = request.get("source").?.string;
        const response = if (std.mem.eql(u8, request.get("op").?.string, "diagnostic"))
            try parser.object(a, &.{.{ "message", .{ .string = try parser.diagnostic(a, source) } }})
        else blk: {
            const ir = parser.parse(a, source) catch break :blk try parser.object(a, &.{.{ "parse_error", .{ .bool = true } }});
            break :blk try parser.object(a, &.{.{ "program", ir }});
        };
        try std.json.stringify(response, .{}, writer);
        try writer.writeByte('\n');
    }
}
```

```javascript
// Calls the compiled, pinned morph implementation; no pattern recognition is
// implemented in this adapter.
import { createInterface } from 'node:readline';
import { dirname, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
const here = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const root = resolve(process.env.EYG_ORACLE_ROOT || resolve(here, '../../../work/oracle-next-tui'));
const build = resolve(root, 'packages/gleam_cli/build/dev/javascript');
const load = path => import(pathToFileURL(resolve(build, path)).href);
const [runtime, json, codec, editable] = await Promise.all([
  'morph/gleam.mjs', 'gleam_json/gleam/json.mjs',
  'eyg_ir/eyg/ir/dag_json.mjs', 'morph/morph/editable.mjs',
].map(load));
const list = xs => runtime.toList(xs);
function decode(program) {
  const parsed = json.parse(JSON.stringify(program), codec.decoder(null));
  if (parsed.constructor.name !== 'Ok') throw new Error('bad oracle IR fixture');
  return parsed[0];
}
function handle(request) {
  if (request.op === 'gather') {
    const ast = editable.from_annotated(decode({'0':'f', l:request.label, b:request.body}));
    const pattern = Array.from(ast[0])[0];
    return pattern instanceof editable.Bind
      ? {label:pattern[0],destructured:false,fields:[]}
      : {label:request.label,destructured:true,fields:Array.from(pattern[0]).map(([name,variable]) => ({name,variable}))};
  }
  const p = request.pattern;
  const pattern = p.destructured ? new editable.Destructure(list(p.fields.map(f => [f.name,f.variable]))) : new editable.Bind(p.label);
  const body = editable.from_annotated(decode(request.body));
  const result = editable.to_annotated(new editable.Function(list([pattern]), body), list([]));
  return JSON.parse(codec.to_string(result));
}
for await (const line of createInterface({input:process.stdin})) {
  try { process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(handle(JSON.parse(line)))+'\n'); }
  catch (error) { process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({adapter_error:String(error)})+'\n'); }
}
```

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/tests/patterns_runner.zig","sha256":"023c2ce1839d583ef21afd9c8746db0f506ecd17abed9dc30e4b103e43010255","bytes":3219} -->
```zig
//! Isolated transport for the structural-pattern compatibility helper.
const std = @import("std");
const patterns = @import("patterns");
const J = std.json.Value;
const A = std.mem.Allocator;

fn field(value: J, name: []const u8) J {
    return if (value == .object) value.object.get(name) orelse .null else .null;
}
fn text(value: J, name: []const u8) []const u8 {
    const v = field(value, name);
    return if (v == .string) v.string else "";
}
fn object(a: A, fields: []const struct { []const u8, J }) !J {
    var map = std.json.ObjectMap.init(a);
    for (fields) |f| try map.put(f[0], f[1]);
    return .{ .object = map };
}
fn encodePattern(a: A, pattern: patterns.Pattern) !J {
    var fields = std.ArrayList(J).init(a);
    for (pattern.fields) |f| try fields.append(try object(a, &.{ .{ "name", .{ .string = f.name } }, .{ "variable", .{ .string = f.variable } } }));
    return object(a, &.{ .{ "label", .{ .string = pattern.label } }, .{ "destructured", .{ .bool = pattern.destructured } }, .{ "fields", .{ .array = fields } } });
}
fn clean(a: A, value: J) anyerror!J {
    if (value == .object) {
        var result = std.json.ObjectMap.init(a);
        var it = value.object.iterator();
        while (it.next()) |entry| if (!std.mem.startsWith(u8, entry.key_ptr.*, "_native_")) try result.put(entry.key_ptr.*, try clean(a, entry.value_ptr.*));
        return .{ .object = result };
    }
    if (value == .array) {
        var result = std.ArrayList(J).init(a);
        for (value.array.items) |item| try result.append(try clean(a, item));
        return .{ .array = result };
    }
    return value;
}
pub fn main() !void {
    var reader = std.io.bufferedReader(std.io.getStdIn().reader());
    const writer = std.io.getStdOut().writer();
    while (true) {
        var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.heap.page_allocator);
        defer arena.deinit();
        const a = arena.allocator();
        const line = try reader.reader().readUntilDelimiterOrEofAlloc(a, '\n', 16 * 1024 * 1024) orelse break;
        const request = (try std.json.parseFromSlice(J, a, line, .{})).value;
        const response = if (std.mem.eql(u8, text(request, "op"), "gather")) blk: {
            const result = try patterns.gather(a, text(request, "label"), field(request, "body"));
            break :blk try encodePattern(a, result.pattern);
        } else blk: {
            const raw = field(request, "pattern");
            var fields = std.ArrayList(patterns.Field).init(a);
            const items = field(raw, "fields");
            if (items == .array) for (items.array.items) |item| try fields.append(.{ .name = text(item, "name"), .variable = text(item, "variable") });
            const d = field(raw, "destructured");
            const p = patterns.Pattern{ .label = text(raw, "label"), .destructured = d == .bool and d.bool, .fields = fields.items };
            const result = try patterns.lower(a, p, field(request, "body"), &.{0});
            break :blk try clean(a, try object(a, &.{ .{ "0", .{ .string = "f" } }, .{ "l", .{ .string = result.label } }, .{ "b", result.body } }));
        };
        try std.json.stringify(response, .{}, writer);
        try writer.writeByte('\n');
    }
}
```

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/tests/pretty_runner.zig","sha256":"f8ac2b90b3eacd13ad62d9aea834a2bccecf2f623114c3ab41570dd14c9bd599","bytes":1849} -->
```zig
//! Isolated value-layout transport; build with the named eyg_interpreter module.
const std = @import("std");
const runtime = @import("eyg_interpreter");
const J = runtime.Json;

pub fn main() !void {
    var reader = std.io.bufferedReader(std.io.getStdIn().reader());
    const out = std.io.getStdOut().writer();
    while (true) {
        var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.heap.page_allocator);
        defer arena.deinit();
        const a = arena.allocator();
        const line = try reader.reader().readUntilDelimiterOrEofAlloc(a, '\n', 16 * 1024 * 1024) orelse break;
        const parsed = try std.json.parseFromSlice(J, a, line, .{});
        const request = parsed.value;
        var engine = runtime.Engine.init(a);
        if (runtime.stringField(request, "meta")) |meta| if (runtime.eq(meta, "repl")) {
            engine.inspection_meta = .{ .literal = "Location(origin: Repl, source: Json)" };
        };
        const response = response: {
            const value = engine.eval(runtime.field(request, "program")) catch |err| {
                if (err == error.InvalidIR) break :response try runtime.object(a, &.{.{ "decode_error", .{ .bool = true } }});
                if (engine.failure) |reason| break :response try runtime.object(a, &.{.{ "break", try engine.reasonJson(reason) }});
                break :response try runtime.object(a, &.{.{ "error", .{ .string = @errorName(err) } }});
            };
            const width_field = runtime.field(request, "width");
            const width: usize = if (width_field == .integer and width_field.integer > 0) @intCast(width_field.integer) else 80;
            break :response try runtime.object(a, &.{.{ "text", .{ .string = try engine.render(value, width) } }});
        };
        try std.json.stringify(response, .{}, out);
        try out.writeByte('\n');
    }
}
```

## `packages/zig_runtime/tests/pty_hub.py`

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/tests/pty_hub.py","sha256":"09ca50ba3f806e062e8733f470947c89ae3d4ebcf768e4ace4127798831f9fc3","bytes":6726} -->
```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Exercise cache.ready, package selection, loading, and CIDs over a real HTTP hub.

The local server uses module bytes and ledger payloads produced and decoded by
the pinned Gleam adapter. A delayed module response makes the loading screen
observable independently of the later resolved screen.
"""
import argparse
import base64
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import sys
import threading
import time
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlparse

from differential import PACKAGE, ORACLE, ORACLE_SHA, Peer, first_difference
from terminal import Terminal
from benchmark import summary


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument("--binary", type=Path, default=PACKAGE / "zig-out/bin/eyg")
    p.add_argument("--bun", default=os.environ.get("BUN") or shutil.which("bun") or "/workspace/tooling/bin/bun")
    p.add_argument("--gleam", default=os.environ.get("GLEAM") or shutil.which("gleam") or "/workspace/tooling/bin/gleam")
    p.add_argument("--report", type=Path, default=PACKAGE / "reports/pty-hub.json")
    args = p.parse_args()
    adapter = Peer([args.bun, str(PACKAGE / "tests/oracle.mjs")])
    try:
        fixture = adapter.request({"op": "hub_fixture", "packages": {"demo": {"version": 1, "program": {"0": "i", "v": 42}}}})
    finally:
        adapter.close()
    modules = {cid: base64.b64decode(data) for cid, data in fixture["modules"].items()}
    module_cid = next(iter(modules))
    requests, phase = [], [""]

    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        def do_GET(self):
            parsed = urlparse(self.path)
            requests.append({"phase": phase[0], "path": self.path, "user_agent": self.headers.get("User-Agent", "")})
            status, body = 200, b""
            if parsed.path == "/packages/pull":
                since = int(parse_qs(parsed.query).get("since", ["0"])[0])
                body = json.dumps(fixture["ledger"] if since == 0 else {"entries": []}, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
            elif parsed.path.startswith("/modules/") and parsed.path[9:] in modules:
                time.sleep(.5)
                body = modules[parsed.path[9:]]
            else:
                status, body = 404, b"unknown fixture route"
            self.send_response(status)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(body)

        def log_message(self, *args):
            pass

    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    thread.start()
    origin = f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}"
    report = {"oracle": ORACLE_SHA, "binary_sha256": hashlib.sha256(args.binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              "fixture": {"cid": module_cid, "program": {"0": "i", "v": 42}, "module_delay_ms": 500},
              "passed": False, "failures": [], "requests": requests, "native_samples_ns": []}
    args.report.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.report.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")

    def exercise(label, command, cwd):
        phase[0] = label
        snapshots = []
        with Terminal(command, cwd=cwd, env={"EYG_ORIGIN": origin}) as term:
            term.frame()
            # A ready cache requests another page after every nonempty page.
            deadline = time.monotonic() + 10
            while not any(r["phase"] == label and "since=1" in r["path"] for r in requests):
                term.settle(quiet=.02, timeout=1)
                if time.monotonic() > deadline:
                    raise TimeoutError(f"{label} did not pull and finish the fixture ledger")
            term.settle(quiet=.05)
            snapshots.append(("startup", term.snapshot()))
            for name, data in (("release-picker", b"@"), ("release-complete", b"\t"), ("reference-loading", b"\r")):
                _, elapsed = term.send(data)
                if label == "native":
                    report["native_samples_ns"].append(elapsed)
                snapshots.append((name, term.snapshot()))
            # Typing and cancellation stay responsive while a module request is
            # pending; its eventual reply must preserve the current editor mode.
            _, elapsed = term.send(b"n")
            if label == "native":
                report["native_samples_ns"].append(elapsed)
            snapshots.append(("modal-during-load", term.snapshot()))
            term.send(b"\x1b")
            snapshots.append(("modal-cancelled-load", term.snapshot()))
            if "loading" in term.plain():
                term.frame(timeout=5)
                term.settle(quiet=.03)
            snapshots.append(("reference-resolved", term.snapshot()))
            for name, data in (("run-release", b"\r"), ("paste-content", ("\x1b[200~#" + module_cid + "\x1b[201~").encode()), ("run-content", b"\r")):
                _, elapsed = term.send(data)
                if label == "native":
                    report["native_samples_ns"].append(elapsed)
                snapshots.append((name, term.snapshot()))
            report[label + "_cleanup"] = term.quit()
        return snapshots

    try:
        expected = exercise("gleam", [args.gleam, "run", "--", "tui"], ORACLE / "packages/gleam_cli")
        got = exercise("native", [str(args.binary.resolve())], PACKAGE.parents[1])
        for (name, e), (native_name, g) in zip(expected, got):
            assert name == native_name
            difference = first_difference(e, g)
            if difference:
                report["failures"].append({"name": name, "difference": difference})
        report["checked"] = len(expected)
        report["parity_passed"] = not report["failures"]
        report["cleanup_passed"] = all(report[key]["exit_code"] == 0 and report[key]["termios_restored"] and report[key]["paste_disabled"] for key in ("native_cleanup", "gleam_cleanup"))
        report["key_to_frame"] = summary(report["native_samples_ns"])
        report["passed"] = report["parity_passed"] and report["cleanup_passed"] and report["key_to_frame"]["under_10ms"]
    except Exception as error:
        report["error"] = str(error)
        raise
    finally:
        server.shutdown()
        server.server_close()
        args.report.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in report.items() if k not in ("requests", "native_samples_ns")}))
    return 0 if report["passed"] else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/tests/pty_parity.py","sha256":"0441a1b0f5ab596730bfd5840996bdfaca9ef376cf787f022a8b8f8cef9066d9","bytes":5127} -->
```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Exercise real Gleam and Zig terminals, compare VT cells, time key-to-frame."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import sys

from differential import PACKAGE, ORACLE, ORACLE_SHA, first_difference
from benchmark import summary
from terminal import Terminal


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument("--binary", type=Path, default=PACKAGE / "zig-out/bin/eyg")
    p.add_argument("--report", type=Path, default=PACKAGE / "reports/pty.json")
    p.add_argument("--cast", type=Path, default=PACKAGE / "recordings/parity.cast")
    p.add_argument("--gleam", default=os.environ.get("GLEAM") or shutil.which("gleam") or "/workspace/tooling/bin/gleam")
    args = p.parse_args()
    events = [("integer-open", b"n"), ("integer-type", b"7"), ("integer-apply", b"\r"), ("integer-run", b"\r"),
              ("history-open", b"\x1b[A"), ("history-close", b"\x1b[B"),
              ("paste-arithmetic", b"\x1b[200~!int_add(20, 22)\x1b[201~"), ("run-arithmetic", b"\r"),
              ("string-open", b"s"), ("unicode-paste", "\x1b[200~hello λé\x1b[201~".encode()),
              ("string-apply", b"\r"), ("string-run", b"\r"),
              ("picker-open", b"j"), ("picker-next", b"\x1b[B"), ("picker-close", b"\x1b")]
    report = {"oracle": ORACLE_SHA, "binary_sha256": hashlib.sha256(args.binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              "measurement": "write key bytes to local PTY through read of synchronized frame terminator; includes dispatch, rendering, ANSI encoding, transport, Python reader scheduling; timestamp before observer VT decoding; excludes startup; standalone Escape has oracle 40ms timeout",
              "terminal_model": "pyte 0.8.2; internal full-cell tests additionally cover dim, underline color, hyperlinks",
              "checked": 0, "failures": [], "interactions": []}
    args.report.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.report.write_text(json.dumps({**report, "passed": False, "status": "running"}, indent=2) + "\n")
    with Terminal([str(args.binary.resolve())], env={"EYG_ORIGIN": "http://127.0.0.1:9"}) as native, Terminal([args.gleam, "run", "--", "tui"], cwd=ORACLE / "packages/gleam_cli", env={"EYG_ORIGIN": "http://127.0.0.1:9"}) as oracle:
        def compare(name):
            report["checked"] += 1
            difference = first_difference(oracle.snapshot(), native.snapshot())
            if difference:
                report["failures"].append({"name": name, "difference": difference})
                if len(report["failures"]) < 5:
                    print(f"FAIL PTY {name}: {difference}", file=sys.stderr)
        native.frame()
        oracle.frame()
        native.settle()
        oracle.settle()
        compare("startup")
        _, native_ns = native.send(b"s")
        _, oracle_ns = oracle.send(b"s")
        report["interactions"].append({"name": "split-utf8-open", "native_ns": native_ns, "gleam_ns": oracle_ns, "standalone_escape": False})
        compare("split-utf8-open")
        native.send(b"\xce", wait=False)
        oracle.send(b"\xce", wait=False)
        native.settle(quiet=.02)
        oracle.settle(quiet=.02)
        compare("split-utf8-prefix")
        _, native_ns = native.send(b"\xbb")
        _, oracle_ns = oracle.send(b"\xbb")
        report["interactions"].append({"name": "split-utf8-complete", "native_ns": native_ns, "gleam_ns": oracle_ns, "standalone_escape": False})
        compare("split-utf8-complete")
        native.send(b"\x1b")
        oracle.send(b"\x1b")
        compare("split-utf8-cancel")
        for name, data in events:
            _, native_ns = native.send(data)
            _, oracle_ns = oracle.send(data)
            compare(name)
            report["interactions"].append({"name": name, "native_ns": native_ns, "gleam_ns": oracle_ns,
                                           "standalone_escape": data == b"\x1b"})
        native.resize(100, 30)
        oracle.resize(100, 30)
        compare("resize")
        report["native_cleanup"] = native.quit()
        report["gleam_cleanup"] = oracle.quit()
        native.save_cast(args.cast, "EYG native terminal parity exercise")
        samples = [x["native_ns"] for x in report["interactions"] if not x["standalone_escape"]]
        report["key_to_frame"] = summary(samples)
        report["parity_passed"] = not report["failures"]
        report["cleanup_passed"] = all(report[key]["exit_code"] == 0 and report[key]["termios_restored"] and report[key]["paste_disabled"] for key in ("native_cleanup", "gleam_cleanup"))
        report["passed"] = report["parity_passed"] and report["cleanup_passed"] and report["key_to_frame"]["under_10ms"]
    args.report.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.report.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({"checked": report["checked"], "parity_passed": report["parity_passed"], "cleanup_passed": report["cleanup_passed"], "key_to_frame": report["key_to_frame"]}))
    return 0 if report["passed"] else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Record real Zig TUI queries; export cast, snapshots, verification and MP4.
No terminal output is replayed during capture. Movie export renders the cast.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse,hashlib,json,math,subprocess,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
from terminal import Terminal,REPO

REV='f1e32bad77d7ffdef6c416cb7ccbf7b23ec0bbd9'

def record(binary,out):
 out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);checks=[]
 with Terminal([str(binary)],cwd=REPO,width=136,height=40) as terminal:
  executable_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(f"/proc/{terminal.process.pid}/exe").read_bytes()).hexdigest()
  terminal.frame();time.sleep(.8);terminal.settle(quiet=.2)
  def command(title,code,expected):
   terminal.send('\x1b[200~'+code+'\x1b[201~');time.sleep(.7);terminal.settle(quiet=.15)
   previous_matches=terminal.plain().count(expected)
   started=time.perf_counter_ns()
   _,feedback=terminal.send('\r')
   deadline=time.monotonic()+30
   while terminal.plain().count(expected)<=previous_matches and time.monotonic()<deadline:
    terminal.frame(timeout=max(.1,deadline-time.monotonic()))
   duration=terminal.frame_completed_ns-started
   screen=terminal.plain()
   assert '✘' not in screen,screen
   assert screen.count(expected)>previous_matches,(title,expected,screen)
   row=dict(title=title,code=code,enter_to_first_feedback_ms=round(feedback/1e6,4),enter_to_complete_frame_ms=round(duration/1e6,4),verified_visible=expected)
   checks.append(row);(out/f'{len(checks):02d}-screen.txt').write_text(screen+'\n');time.sleep(1.6)
  command('Load the EYG Git facade',f'let git = import "packages/zig_runtime/git/native.eyg"\nlet repo = {json.dumps(str(REPO))}\nlet revision = "{REV}"\nlet subjects = (rows) -> {{ !list_fold(rows, [], (commit, found) -> {{ [commit.subject, ..found] }}) }}\n{{}}','= {}')
  command('Inspect the current commit', 'subjects(git.query({repo, ref: revision, limit: 1}))','Verify subsecond TUI history')
  command('Search commit messages', 'subjects(git.query({repo, ref: revision, contains: "TUI", limit: 1}))','Verify subsecond TUI history')
  command('Filter by author and time window', 'subjects(git.query({repo, ref: revision, author: "Peter", since: 1793200000, until: 1793210000, limit: 1}))','Verify subsecond TUI history')
  command('Find changes to the Git reader', 'subjects(git.query({repo, ref: revision, path: "dark/git/read.eyg", limit: 1}))','Accelerate EYG Git decoding')
  terminal.send('\x1b[A');time.sleep(.8);terminal.send('k');time.sleep(1.3)
  checks.append(dict(title='Browse and expand query history',verified_visible='selected history'))
  assert 'selected history' in terminal.plain(),terminal.plain()
  result=terminal.quit();assert result['exit_code']==0 and result['termios_restored'],result
  terminal.save_cast(out/'eyg-git-history.cast','EYG in Zig: structured queries over its own Git history')
 (out/'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(real_pty=True,executable_sha256=executable_sha256,oracle_git_revision=REV,steps=checks,cleanup=result),indent=2)+'\n')
 return out/'eyg-git-history.cast'

def movie(cast,out,fps=15):
 import pyte
 from PIL import Image,ImageDraw,ImageFont
 lines=[json.loads(line) for line in cast.read_text().splitlines()];header=lines[0];events=lines[1:]
 width,height=header['width'],header['height'];cellw,cellh=9,19;bar=38
 fontpath='/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono.ttf';font=ImageFont.truetype(fontpath,14);bold=ImageFont.truetype(fontpath.replace('.ttf','-Bold.ttf'),14)
 screen=pyte.Screen(width,height);stream=pyte.Stream(screen)
 colours={'default':'#d9e0ee','black':'#181b24','red':'#f38ba8','green':'#a6e3a1','brown':'#f9e2af','blue':'#89b4fa','magenta':'#cba6f7','cyan':'#94e2d5','white':'#cdd6f4','brightblack':'#6c7086','brightred':'#f38ba8','brightgreen':'#a6e3a1','brightbrown':'#f9e2af','brightblue':'#89b4fa','brightmagenta':'#cba6f7','brightcyan':'#94e2d5','brightwhite':'#ffffff'}
 def colour(value,default):
  if value=='default':return default
  return colours.get(value,'#'+value if len(value)==6 else default)
 def render():
  image=Image.new('RGB',(width*cellw,height*cellh+bar),'#181b24');draw=ImageDraw.Draw(image)
  draw.rectangle((0,0,image.width,bar),fill='#242938');draw.text((12,10),'EYG / Zig   ·   local Git history as structured data',font=bold,fill='#a6e3a1')
  for y in range(height):
   for x in range(width):
    char=screen.buffer[y][x];fg=colour(char.fg,'#d9e0ee');bg=colour(char.bg,'#181b24')
    if char.reverse:fg,bg=bg,fg
    px,py=x*cellw,y*cellh+bar
    if bg!='#181b24':draw.rectangle((px,py,px+cellw,py+cellh),fill=bg)
    if char.data and char.data!=' ':draw.text((px,py),char.data,font=bold if char.bold else font,fill=fg)
    if char.underscore:draw.line((px,py+cellh-2,px+cellw,py+cellh-2),fill=fg)
  return image
 duration=events[-1][0]+.8;index=0;frame=render();encoded=frame.tobytes()
 process=subprocess.Popen(['ffmpeg','-hide_banner','-loglevel','error','-y','-f','rawvideo','-pixel_format','rgb24','-video_size',f'{frame.width}x{frame.height}','-framerate',str(fps),'-i','-','-an','-c:v','libx264','-preset','fast','-crf','20','-pix_fmt','yuv420p','-movflags','+faststart',str(out/'eyg-git-history.mp4')],stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
 for n in range(math.ceil(duration*fps)):
  changed=False
  while index<len(events) and events[index][0]<=n/fps:
   _,kind,data=events[index]
   if kind=='o':stream.feed(data);changed=True
   index+=1
  if changed:frame=render();encoded=frame.tobytes()
  process.stdin.write(encoded)
  if n==math.ceil(duration*fps)-int(fps*1.5):frame.save(out/'eyg-git-history.png')
 process.stdin.close();assert process.wait()==0

def main():
 ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('--binary',type=Path,default=REPO/'packages/zig_runtime/zig-out/bin/eyg');ap.add_argument('--output',type=Path,default=REPO/'work/eyg-git-recording');ap.add_argument('--movie-only',action='store_true');ap.add_argument('--no-movie',action='store_true');args=ap.parse_args()
 cast=args.output/'eyg-git-history.cast' if args.movie_only else record(args.binary.resolve(),args.output)
 if not args.no_movie:movie(cast,args.output)
 print(args.output)
if __name__=='__main__':main()
```

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/tests/source_runner.zig","sha256":"f79d0878e38f9fc740b167f532501a14f223b720c7a57678e0b71acdc4e002d2","bytes":2126} -->

```zig
//! Isolated source-location and continuation inspector differential transport.
const std = @import("std");
const source = @import("eyg_source");
const runtime = source.runtime;
const J = std.json.Value;

pub fn main() !void {
    var reader = std.io.bufferedReader(std.io.getStdIn().reader());
    const out = std.io.getStdOut().writer();
    while (true) {
        var arena = std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(std.heap.page_allocator);
        defer arena.deinit();
        const a = arena.allocator();
        const line = try reader.reader().readUntilDelimiterOrEofAlloc(a, '\n', 16 * 1024 * 1024) orelse break;
        const request = (try std.json.parseFromSlice(J, a, line, .{})).value;
        const response = response: {
            const origin = runtime.stringField(request, "origin") orelse "disk";
            const parsed = source.parse(a, runtime.stringField(request, "source").?, if (runtime.eq(origin, "inline")) .inline_code else if (runtime.eq(origin, "pipe")) .pipe else if (runtime.eq(origin, "repl")) .repl else .{ .disk = runtime.stringField(request, "path") orelse "/module.eyg" }) catch break :response try runtime.object(a, &.{.{ "parse_error", .{ .bool = true } }});
            if (runtime.eq(runtime.stringField(request, "op") orelse "", "source_parse")) break :response try runtime.object(a, &.{.{ "program", parsed.program }});
            var engine = runtime.Engine.init(a);
            engine.inspection_meta = parsed.meta;
            const value = engine.eval(parsed.program) catch |err| {
                if (engine.failure) |reason| break :response try runtime.object(a, &.{.{ "break", try engine.reasonJson(reason) }});
                break :response try runtime.object(a, &.{.{ "error", .{ .string = @errorName(err) } }});
            };
            const width = runtime.field(request, "width");
            break :response try runtime.object(a, &.{.{ "text", .{ .string = try engine.render(value, if (width == .integer and width.integer > 0) @intCast(width.integer) else 80) } }});
        };
        try std.json.stringify(response, .{}, out);
        try out.writeByte('\n');
    }
}
```

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/tests/terminal.py","sha256":"bf9f229071d7618c2337a2fb72d51579e37c49c2a394b444be51ae8e17b1d9a2","bytes":7822} -->
```python
"""A real pseudoterminal driver; useful for parity tests and demo recordings.

Frame completion is the synchronized-output terminator emitted by both CLIs.
The VT model is pyte (test-only dependency), loaded from normal site-packages or
the workspace test dependency directory. Internal cell differential tests cover
attributes absent from pyte, notably dim, underline color, and hyperlinks.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import codecs
import fcntl
import os
from pathlib import Path
import select
import signal
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import termios
import time

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO / "work/test-dependencies"))
try:
    import pyte
except ImportError as error:
    raise ImportError("Install the test dependency: python3 -m pip install pyte==0.8.2") from error

FRAME_END = b"\x1b[?2026l"


class Terminal:
    def __init__(self, command, cwd=REPO, width=80, height=24, env=None):
        self.width, self.height = width, height
        self.initial_width, self.initial_height = width, height
        self.master, self.slave = os.openpty()
        self.original_attrs = termios.tcgetattr(self.slave)
        fcntl.ioctl(self.slave, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, struct.pack("HHHH", height, width, 0, 0))
        self.screen = pyte.Screen(width, height)
        self.stream = pyte.ByteStream(self.screen)
        process_env = dict(os.environ, TERM="xterm-256color")
        process_env["PATH"] = "/workspace/tooling/bin:" + process_env.get("PATH", "")
        if env:
            process_env.update(env)
        self.process = subprocess.Popen(command, stdin=self.slave, stdout=self.slave, stderr=self.slave,
                                        cwd=cwd, env=process_env, start_new_session=True)
        os.set_blocking(self.master, False)
        self.recording = []
        self.started = time.monotonic()
        self.last_output = b""
        self._frame_pending = bytearray()
        self._output_decoder = codecs.getincrementaldecoder("utf-8")(errors="replace")
        self._input_decoder = codecs.getincrementaldecoder("utf-8")(errors="replace")

    def _read(self, timeout, decode=True):
        if not select.select([self.master], [], [], max(timeout, 0))[0]:
            return b""
        try:
            data = os.read(self.master, 1024 * 1024)
        except OSError:
            return b""
        if data:
            self.last_read_ns = time.perf_counter_ns()
            if decode:
                self.stream.feed(data)
            text = self._output_decoder.decode(data)
            if text:
                self.recording.append([time.monotonic() - self.started, "o", text])
        return data

    def frame(self, timeout=30):
        deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
        output = self._frame_pending
        self._frame_pending = bytearray()
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            output.extend(self._read(min(.1, deadline - time.monotonic()), decode=False))
            if FRAME_END in output:
                # Timestamp receipt before running the observer's VT parser on
                # any chunk of this frame. Keep a following partial frame out
                # of the completed snapshot and carry it into the next read.
                self.frame_completed_ns = self.last_read_ns
                end = output.rfind(FRAME_END) + len(FRAME_END)
                completed = bytes(output[:end])
                self._frame_pending.extend(output[end:])
                self.stream.feed(completed)
                self.last_output = completed
                return completed
            if self.process.poll() is not None:
                raise RuntimeError(f"terminal exited {self.process.returncode}: {bytes(output)[-1000:]!r}")
        raise TimeoutError(f"no complete terminal frame in {timeout}s; output {bytes(output)[-1000:]!r}")

    def send(self, data, wait=True, timeout=30):
        if isinstance(data, str):
            data = data.encode()
        # A background task may have drawn while the other terminal was being
        # observed. Consume already available output before starting this key.
        self.settle(quiet=0)
        text = self._input_decoder.decode(data)
        if text:
            self.recording.append([time.monotonic() - self.started, "i", text])
        start = time.perf_counter_ns()
        os.write(self.master, data)
        output = self.frame(timeout) if wait else b""
        return output, (self.frame_completed_ns - start) if wait else time.perf_counter_ns() - start

    def settle(self, quiet=.1, timeout=5):
        """Drain asynchronous startup work before timing user interactions."""
        deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
        output = self._frame_pending
        self._frame_pending = bytearray()
        if output:
            self.stream.feed(output)
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            data = self._read(min(quiet, deadline - time.monotonic()))
            if not data:
                self.last_output = bytes(output)
                return bytes(output)
            output.extend(data)
        raise TimeoutError("terminal did not become idle")

    def resize(self, width, height, timeout=30):
        self.settle(quiet=0)
        self.width, self.height = width, height
        self.screen.resize(height, width)
        self.recording.append([time.monotonic() - self.started, "r", f"{width}x{height}"])
        start = time.perf_counter_ns()
        fcntl.ioctl(self.slave, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, struct.pack("HHHH", height, width, 0, 0))
        os.killpg(self.process.pid, signal.SIGWINCH)
        output = self.frame(timeout)
        return output, self.frame_completed_ns - start

    def snapshot(self):
        return {"width": self.width, "height": self.height,
                "cells": [self.screen.buffer[y][x]._asdict() for y in range(self.height) for x in range(self.width)]}

    def plain(self):
        return "\n".join(self.screen.display)

    def quit(self, timeout=10):
        self.settle(quiet=0)
        self.recording.append([time.monotonic() - self.started, "i", "\x11"])
        os.write(self.master, b"\x11")
        deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
        cleanup = bytearray()
        while self.process.poll() is None and time.monotonic() < deadline:
            cleanup.extend(self._read(.05))
        if self.process.poll() is None:
            raise TimeoutError("Ctrl+Q did not exit the terminal")
        while True:
            data = self._read(0)
            if not data:
                break
            cleanup.extend(data)
        return {"exit_code": self.process.returncode,
                "termios_restored": termios.tcgetattr(self.slave) == self.original_attrs,
                "paste_disabled": b"\x1b[?2004l" in cleanup,
                "cleanup": cleanup.decode(errors="replace")}

    def save_cast(self, path, title="EYG native shell"):
        import json
        path = Path(path)
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        header = {"version": 2, "width": self.initial_width, "height": self.initial_height, "timestamp": int(time.time()), "title": title,
                  "env": {"TERM": "xterm-256color", "SHELL": "eyg"}}
        path.write_text("\n".join(json.dumps(x, ensure_ascii=False) for x in [header, *self.recording]) + "\n")

    def close(self):
        if self.process.poll() is None:
            os.killpg(self.process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
            try:
                self.process.wait(timeout=3)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                os.killpg(self.process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                self.process.wait(timeout=3)
        os.close(self.master)
        os.close(self.slave)

    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *exc):
        self.close()
```

## `packages/zig_runtime/tests/verify.py`

<!-- eyg-source: {"path":"packages/zig_runtime/tests/verify.py","sha256":"1495c72105ef98e57affe749d7589d6295a2b743070337eb498399da596430df","bytes":15971} -->
```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build immutable native executables and run the pinned-oracle validation gates.

Default coverage includes 5,000 generated programs, 1,000 generated syntax cases,
100 empty-root and 100 nested-program editing traces, and all subsystem suites.
Every suite runs even when a previous suite fails. Oracle crashes/timeouts keep
strict qualification red; successful comparable tests are reported separately.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time

from differential import PACKAGE, REPO, ORACLE, ORACLE_SHA, Peer

REAL_SHA = "f1e32bad77d7ffdef6c416cb7ccbf7b23ec0bbd9"


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def write_json(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2) + "\n")


def source_manifest():
    paths = {PACKAGE / "build.zig", PACKAGE / "build.zig.zon"}
    for directory in ("src", "tests", "scripts", "git", "http"):
        paths.update(p for p in (PACKAGE / directory).rglob("*") if p.is_file() and p.suffix in (".zig", ".py", ".mjs", ".eyg", ".sh", ".json"))
    paths.update(p for p in (PACKAGE / "scripts").iterdir() if p.is_file())
    paths.add(PACKAGE / "tests/requirements.txt")
    paths.update((REPO / "spec/evaluation").glob("*.json"))
    paths.update((ORACLE / "spec/evaluation").glob("*.json"))
    return {(str(p.relative_to(PACKAGE)) if p.is_relative_to(PACKAGE) else ("oracle/" + str(p.relative_to(ORACLE)) if p.is_relative_to(ORACLE) else "repository/" + str(p.relative_to(REPO)))): digest(p) for p in sorted(paths) if p.exists()}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--setup", action="store_true", help="prepare pinned oracle worktrees/build and install pinned Python test dependencies")
    parser.add_argument("--quick", action="store_true", help="smaller diagnostic campaign; cannot qualify full requested coverage")
    parser.add_argument("--skip-performance", action="store_true", help="run all functional checks; leave performance qualification incomplete")
    parser.add_argument("--binary", type=Path, help="copy and validate an existing ReleaseFast executable instead of building the main executable")
    parser.add_argument("--bun", default=os.environ.get("BUN") or shutil.which("bun") or "/workspace/tooling/bin/bun")
    parser.add_argument("--gleam", default=os.environ.get("GLEAM") or shutil.which("gleam") or "/workspace/tooling/bin/gleam")
    parser.add_argument("--oracle-timeout", type=float, default=30)
    parser.add_argument("--report", type=Path, default=PACKAGE / "reports/verification.json")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    args.report = args.report.resolve()
    stamp = time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ", time.gmtime()) + f"-{os.getpid()}"
    run = PACKAGE / "work/verification" / stamp
    artifacts = args.report.parent / ("verification-" + stamp)
    bin_dir, logs = run / "bin", artifacts / "logs"
    bin_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
    logs.mkdir(parents=True)
    env = dict(os.environ, BUN=args.bun, GLEAM=args.gleam, EYG_ORACLE_ROOT=str(ORACLE))
    env["PATH"] = str(Path(args.gleam).resolve().parent) + os.pathsep + env.get("PATH", "")
    env["PYTHONPATH"] = str(REPO / "work/test-dependencies") + os.pathsep + env.get("PYTHONPATH", "")
    result = {"passed": False, "qualified": False, "status": "running", "quick": args.quick,
              "performance_requested": not args.skip_performance, "oracle": ORACLE_SHA,
              "git_reference": REAL_SHA, "command": sys.argv, "artifacts": str(artifacts),
              "stages": [], "known_oracle_gaps": [], "executables": {}}
    started = time.monotonic()
    original_sources = source_manifest()
    write_json(artifacts / "sources.json", original_sources)
    result["source_manifest_sha256"] = digest(artifacts / "sources.json")
    write_json(args.report, result)

    def stage(name, command, report=None, external_report=None, binary=None):
        entry = {"name": name, "command": list(map(str, command)), "passed": False}
        if binary and Path(binary).exists():
            entry["binary_sha256"] = digest(Path(binary))
        result["stages"].append(entry)
        log = logs / (name + ".log")
        entry["log"] = str(log)
        if report:
            Path(report).unlink(missing_ok=True)
        if external_report:
            Path(external_report).unlink(missing_ok=True)
        then = time.monotonic()
        print(f"[{name}]", flush=True)
        try:
            with log.open("wb") as output:
                child = subprocess.run(list(map(str, command)), cwd=PACKAGE, env=env,
                                       stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
            entry["exit_code"] = child.returncode
            if external_report and Path(external_report).exists():
                shutil.copy2(external_report, report)
            if report and Path(report).exists():
                document = json.loads(Path(report).read_text())
                entry["report"], entry["report_sha256"] = str(report), digest(Path(report))
                entry["report_passed"] = bool(document.get("passed"))
                entry["passed"] = child.returncode == 0 and entry["report_passed"]
                # Subsystem helpers are separate executables built from the
                # same captured sources. Main/UI reports must match main SHA.
                recorded = document.get("binary_sha256")
                if recorded and recorded != entry.get("binary_sha256"):
                    entry["passed"] = False
                    entry["error"] = "report binary hash differs from the invoked executable"
                pin = document.get("oracle", document.get("oracle_commit"))
                if pin and pin != ORACLE_SHA:
                    entry["passed"] = False
                    entry["error"] = "report oracle revision differs from pinned next-tui"
                gaps = {key: document[key] for key in ("oracle_crash_count", "unsupported_count") if document.get(key)}
                if document.get("peer_failures"):
                    gaps["peer_failures"] = document["peer_failures"]
                if gaps:
                    result["known_oracle_gaps"].append({"stage": name, **gaps})
            elif report:
                entry["error"] = "command produced no report"
            else:
                entry["passed"] = child.returncode == 0
        except Exception as error:
            entry["error"] = repr(error)
        entry["seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - then, 3)
        write_json(args.report, result)
        print(f"  {'PASS' if entry['passed'] else 'FAIL'} ({entry['seconds']}s)", flush=True)
        return entry["passed"]

    try:
        if args.setup:
            stage("setup-oracles", [PACKAGE / "scripts/prepare-oracles.sh"])
            stage("setup-python", [sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "--target", REPO / "work/test-dependencies", "-r", PACKAGE / "tests/requirements.txt"])
        pins = {}
        for name, checkout, expected in (("next-tui", ORACLE, ORACLE_SHA), ("real-world", REPO / "work/oracle-real-world", REAL_SHA)):
            actual = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=checkout, text=True).strip()
            clean = subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--quiet", "HEAD", "--"], cwd=checkout).returncode == 0
            pins[name] = {"actual": actual, "expected": expected, "tracked_sources_clean": clean}
            if actual != expected or not clean:
                raise RuntimeError(f"{name} oracle is not the clean pinned revision")
        result["pins"] = pins
        compiled_oracle = ORACLE / "packages/gleam_cli/build/dev/javascript"
        built = {str(p.relative_to(compiled_oracle)): digest(p) for p in sorted(compiled_oracle.rglob("*.mjs"))}
        if not built:
            raise RuntimeError("oracle is not built; run scripts/verify --setup")
        write_json(artifacts / "oracle-build.json", built)
        result["oracle_build_manifest_sha256"] = digest(artifacts / "oracle-build.json")
        zig = PACKAGE / "scripts/zig"
        result["zig"] = subprocess.check_output([zig, "version"], text=True, env=env).strip()
        result["bun"] = subprocess.check_output([args.bun, "--version"], text=True, env=env).strip()
        result["gleam"] = subprocess.check_output([args.gleam, "--version"], text=True, env=env).strip()
        stage("units", [zig, "build", "test", "-Doptimize=ReleaseFast"])
        if args.binary:
            source_binary = args.binary.resolve()
        else:
            stage("build-main", [zig, "build", "-Doptimize=ReleaseFast", "--prefix", run / "install"])
            source_binary = run / "install/bin/eyg"
        binary = bin_dir / "eyg"
        shutil.copy2(source_binary, binary)
        binary.chmod(0o555)
        result["binary_sha256"] = digest(binary)
        probe = Peer([str(binary), "--protocol"])
        try:
            result["build_info"] = probe.request({"op": "info"})
        finally:
            probe.close()
        info = result["build_info"]
        result["release_fast_build"] = info.get("mode") == "ReleaseFast" and info.get("oracle") == ORACLE_SHA and info.get("zig") == "0.14.1" and info.get("git_reference") == REAL_SHA
        helpers = {
            "inference-runner": ("tests/inference_runner.zig", "eyg_native", "src/lib.zig"),
            "pretty-runner": ("tests/pretty_runner.zig", "eyg_interpreter", "src/interpreter.zig"),
            "evaluation-runner": ("tests/evaluation_runner.zig", "eyg_interpreter", "src/interpreter.zig"),
            "computer-runner": ("tests/computer_runner.zig", "computer", "src/computer.zig"),
            "effect-cast-runner": ("tests/effect_cast_runner.zig", "effect_cast", "src/effect_cast.zig"),
            "hub-runner": ("tests/hub_runner.zig", "hub", "src/hub.zig"),
            "patterns-runner": ("tests/patterns_runner.zig", "patterns", "src/tui_patterns.zig"),
            "source-runner": ("tests/source_runner.zig", "eyg_source", "src/source.zig"),
            "http-driver": ("http/driver.zig", "http", "src/http.zig"),
        }
        for name, (root, module, source) in helpers.items():
            target = bin_dir / name
            stage("build-" + name, [zig, "build-exe", "-OReleaseFast", "--dep", module,
                                   "-Mroot=" + root, "-M" + module + "=" + source, "-femit-bin=" + str(target)])
            if target.exists():
                target.chmod(0o555)
        result["executables"] = {p.name: {"path": str(p), "sha256": digest(p)} for p in sorted(bin_dir.iterdir()) if p.is_file() and p.suffix != ".o"}
        full = not args.quick
        def suite(name, script, executable=binary, extra=()):
            report = artifacts / (name + ".json")
            return stage(name, [sys.executable, PACKAGE / script, "--binary", executable, "--bun", args.bun, "--report", report, *extra], report=report, binary=executable)
        suite("differential", "tests/differential.py", extra=("--programs", 5000 if full else 100, "--syntax", 1000 if full else 30, "--traces", 100 if full else 5, "--edit-traces", 100 if full else 5, "--oracle-timeout", args.oracle_timeout, "--no-shrink"))
        suite("input", "tests/differential_input.py", extra=("--cases", 1000 if full else 30))
        suite("inference", "tests/differential_inference.py", bin_dir / "inference-runner", ("--programs", 1000 if full else 50, "--scopes", 300 if full else 10))
        suite("pretty", "tests/differential_pretty.py", bin_dir / "pretty-runner", ("--programs", 1000 if full else 50, "--unicode-records", 300 if full else 20))
        suite("resume", "tests/differential_resume.py", bin_dir / "pretty-runner", ("--programs", 300 if full else 20))
        suite("source-metadata", "tests/differential_source.py", bin_dir / "source-runner", ("--programs", 1000 if full else 50, "--contexts", 300 if full else 20))
        for name, runner, count in (("patterns", "patterns-runner", 2000), ("computer", "computer-runner", 1000), ("effect_cast", "effect-cast-runner", 2000), ("hub", "hub-runner", 1000)):
            suite(name, "tests/differential_" + name + ".py", bin_dir / runner, ("--cases", count if full else 30))
        suite("malformed-ir", "tests/malformed_ir.py", bin_dir / "evaluation-runner", ("--cases", 2000 if full else 50))
        for name, script, external, executable, extra in (
            ("http", "http/verify.py", REPO / "work/http-verification/result.json", bin_dir / "http-driver", ("--bun", args.bun)),
            ("git-read", "git/verify_native.py", REPO / "work/git-native-verification/result.json", binary, ("--protocol", "--objects", 100 if full else 20)),
            ("git-write", "git/verify_writes.py", REPO / "work/git-native-verification/writes.json", binary, ("--protocol",)),
        ):
            report = artifacts / (name + ".json")
            stage(name, [sys.executable, PACKAGE / script, "--binary", executable, *extra], report=report, external_report=external, binary=executable)
        # All compilers and functional subprocesses have exited before these
        # actual key-to-render measurements and the final dispatch benchmark.
        for name, script, extra in (("pty", "tests/pty_parity.py", ("--cast", artifacts / "parity.cast")), ("pty-hub", "tests/pty_hub.py", ("--bun", args.bun))):
            report = artifacts / (name + ".json")
            stage(name, [sys.executable, PACKAGE / script, "--binary", binary, "--gleam", args.gleam, "--report", report, *extra], report=report, binary=binary)
        if not args.skip_performance:
            suite("benchmark", "tests/benchmark.py", extra=("--iterations", 100 if full else 10, "--oracle", "--parity-report", artifacts / "differential.json", "--input-report", artifacts / "input.json", "--pty-report", artifacts / "pty.json", "--hub-report", artifacts / "pty-hub.json"))
        final_sources = source_manifest()
        result["sources_unchanged"] = original_sources == final_sources
        result["source_changes"] = sorted(key for key in original_sources.keys() | final_sources.keys() if original_sources.get(key) != final_sources.get(key))
        result["binary_unchanged"] = all(Path(item["path"]).exists() and digest(Path(item["path"])) == item["sha256"] for item in result["executables"].values())
        result["oracle_build_unchanged"] = built == {str(p.relative_to(compiled_oracle)): digest(p) for p in sorted(compiled_oracle.rglob("*.mjs"))}
        result["oracle_sources_unchanged"] = all(subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=checkout, text=True).strip() == expected and subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--quiet", "HEAD", "--"], cwd=checkout).returncode == 0 for checkout, expected in ((ORACLE, ORACLE_SHA), (REPO / "work/oracle-real-world", REAL_SHA)))
        result["passed"] = all(s["passed"] for s in result["stages"]) and not result["known_oracle_gaps"] and result["sources_unchanged"] and result["binary_unchanged"] and result["oracle_build_unchanged"] and result["oracle_sources_unchanged"] and result["release_fast_build"]
        result["qualified"] = result["passed"] and full and not args.skip_performance
        result["status"] = "complete"
    except Exception as error:
        result["error"] = repr(error)
        result["status"] = "interrupted"
    finally:
        result["seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - started, 3)
        write_json(args.report, result)
    print(json.dumps({"report": str(args.report), "passed": result["passed"], "qualified": result["qualified"], "status": result["status"], "failed_stages": [s["name"] for s in result["stages"] if not s["passed"]], "known_oracle_gaps": result["known_oracle_gaps"]}, ensure_ascii=True))
    return 0 if result["passed"] else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```
